_meta.note: Model-generated example sentences written for this project; every entry is short, uses the word naturally and ships with a Chinese translation. Replace with a licensed corpus if you need dictionary-sourced examples.

a.example: I saw a small bird sitting on the old wooden fence.
a.zh: 我看见一只小鸟停在旧木栅栏上。

abandon.example: They had to abandon the car in the deep snow.
abandon.zh: 他们不得不把车丢在深雪里。

abbreviation.example: This abbreviation is often used in formal writing and official papers.
abbreviation.zh: 这个缩写在正式写作和官方文件中经常使用。

abide.example: Most people find it hard to abide by such strict rules.
abide.zh: 大多数人觉得很难遵守这样严格的规则。

able.example: She is able to solve the problem without any help.
able.zh: 她不需要任何帮助就能解决这个问题。

abnormal.example: The doctor said the test result was abnormal and needed checking.
abnormal.zh: 医生说检查结果不正常，需要进一步查看。

aboard.example: All passengers were already aboard the ship when the storm began.
aboard.zh: 暴风雨来临时，所有乘客都已经在船上了。

abolish.example: The city plans to abolish the old parking fee next year.
abolish.zh: 这座城市计划明年废除旧的停车费。

abort.example: The team decided to abort the test after the first error.
abort.zh: 出现第一个错误后，团队决定中止测试。

about.example: We talked about the new plan for almost two hours.
about.zh: 我们讨论新计划谈了将近两个小时。

above.example: The plane was flying above the thick white clouds.
above.zh: 飞机在厚厚的白云上方飞行。

abreast.example: The two runners stayed abreast for most of the race.
abreast.zh: 两名跑者在比赛的大部分时间里并排前进。

abroad.example: My cousin went abroad to study and came back last spring.
abroad.zh: 我表姐出国求学，去年春天回来了。

abrupt.example: The car came to an abrupt stop at the corner.
abrupt.zh: 汽车在拐角处突然停了下来。

absent.example: Three students were absent from class because of the flu.
absent.zh: 三名学生因为流感没来上课。

absolute.example: I have absolute trust in my old friend's judgment.
absolute.zh: 我完全信任我老朋友的判断。

absorb.example: Dry soil can absorb a large amount of rainwater quickly.
absorb.zh: 干燥的土壤能很快吸收大量雨水。

abstract.example: The idea of freedom is abstract and hard to explain.
abstract.zh: 自由这个概念是抽象的，很难解释清楚。

absurd.example: It seems absurd to carry an umbrella on a sunny day.
absurd.zh: 晴天带伞看起来有点荒谬。

abundant.example: Fresh water is abundant in this area during the rainy season.
abundant.zh: 雨季时这一带的淡水很充足。

abuse.example: The new rule aims to prevent the abuse of power.
abuse.zh: 新规定旨在防止滥用权力。

academy.example: She studies music at a small academy near her home.
academy.zh: 她在家附近一所小学院里学音乐。

accelerate.example: The car began to accelerate as it left the busy street.
accelerate.zh: 汽车离开繁忙的街道后开始加速。

accent.example: He spoke English with a heavy accent that was hard to follow.
accent.zh: 他讲英语口音很重，很难听懂。

accept.example: I accept your apology and we can start again.
accept.zh: 我接受你的道歉，我们可以重新开始。

access.example: Students have free access to the library and its computers.
access.zh: 学生可以免费使用图书馆和里面的电脑。

accessory.example: This small bag is a useful accessory for any trip.
accessory.zh: 这个小包是任何旅行都用得上的实用配件。

accident.example: He broke his arm in a bicycle accident last week.
accident.zh: 他上周在一次自行车事故中摔断了胳膊。

acclaim.example: Her first novel won wide acclaim from readers and critics.
acclaim.zh: 她的第一部小说赢得了读者和评论家的广泛赞誉。

accommodate.example: The hall can accommodate up to three hundred guests.
accommodate.zh: 这个大厅最多能容纳三百位客人。

accompany.example: I will accompany you to the station after dinner.

accomplish.example: They worked all night to accomplish the task on time.
accomplish.zh: 为了按时完成任务，他们工作了一整夜。

accord.example: The two sides finally reached an accord after long talks.
accord.zh: 经过长时间商谈，双方终于达成了一项协定。

accordance.example: The work was done in accordance with the safety rules.
accordance.zh: 这项工作是按安全规定进行的。

according to.example: According to the weather report, it will rain tomorrow morning.
according to.zh: 根据天气预报，明天早上会下雨。

accordingly.example: The plan changed, so we adjusted our schedule accordingly.
accordingly.zh: 计划变了，所以我们相应地调整了日程。

account.example: Please check your bank account before you pay the bill.
account.zh: 付账之前请先查看你的银行账户。

accountable.example: The manager is accountable for the team's weekly results.
accountable.zh: 经理对团队的每周业绩负有责任。

accumulate.example: Dust can accumulate quickly on the shelves in a closed room.
accumulate.zh: 在封闭的房间里，灰尘会很快在架子上积起来。

accurate.example: The clock keeps accurate time and never needs adjusting.
accurate.zh: 这个钟走时准确，从不需要调整。

accuse.example: They accused him of taking the money without permission.
accuse.zh: 他们指责他未经允许就拿了钱。

accustom.example: It takes a while to accustom yourself to the cold weather.
accustom.zh: 你需要一段时间才能习惯寒冷的天气。

ace.example: She is an ace at solving difficult math problems.
ace.zh: 她是解决数学难题的高手。

ache.example: I have a dull ache in my back after the long drive.
ache.zh: 长途开车后我的背隐隐作痛。

achieve.example: She worked hard to achieve her goal within one year.
achieve.zh: 她努力工作，想在一年内实现目标。

acid.example: This acid is often used in science classes at school.
acid.zh: 这种酸常用于学校的科学课上。

acknowledge.example: He acknowledged his mistake and promised to be more careful.
acknowledge.zh: 他承认了自己的错误，并保证以后更小心。

acquaint.example: Let me acquaint you with the rules of the game.
acquaint.zh: 让我给你介绍一下这个游戏的规则。

acquire.example: Children acquire language skills through daily contact with others.
acquire.zh: 孩子们通过与他人的日常接触获得语言能力。

acre.example: They grow corn on forty acres of land near the river.
acre.zh: 他们在河边四十英亩的土地上种玉米。

across.example: We walked across the bridge and into the quiet park.
across.zh: 我们走过桥，进入了安静的公园。

act.example: She decided to act on the advice of her teacher.
act.zh: 她决定照老师的建议去做。

activate.example: Press this button to activate the machine before use.
activate.zh: 使用前按这个按钮启动机器。

active.example: My grandmother stays active by walking every morning.
active.zh: 我奶奶每天早晨散步，保持活力。

actor.example: The young actor practised his lines for many hours.
actor.zh: 那位年轻演员练了好几个小时的台词。

actual.example: The actual cost was higher than the first estimate.
actual.zh: 实际费用比最初的估算要高。

acupuncture.example: He tried acupuncture to ease the pain in his knee.
acupuncture.zh: 他尝试用针灸减轻膝盖的疼痛。

acute.example: She has acute hearing and notices every small sound.
acute.zh: 她听觉敏锐，能注意到每一个细微的声音。

adapt.example: Animals adapt to new surroundings in different ways.
adapt.zh: 动物以不同的方式适应新环境。

add.example: Please add a little salt to the soup before serving.
add.zh: 上菜前请在汤里加一点盐。

addict.example: He became a computer game addict during the long holiday.
addict.zh: 长假期间他成了一个电脑游戏迷。

address.example: Please write your address clearly at the top of the form.
address.zh: 请把你的地址清楚地写在表格顶部。

adequate.example: The small room has adequate light for reading and writing.
adequate.zh: 这个小房间光线充足，可以读书写字。

adhere.example: Please make sure the sticker will adhere to the dry surface.
adhere.zh: 请确保贴纸能粘在干燥的表面上。

adjacent.example: Our office is adjacent to a small coffee shop.
adjacent.zh: 我们的办公室紧挨着一家小咖啡店。

adjective.example: In this sentence the adjective comes before the noun.
adjective.zh: 在这个句子中，形容词放在名词前面。

adjust.example: You may adjust the chair height to suit your desk.
adjust.zh: 你可以调整椅子的高度，以适应你的桌子。

administer.example: She was asked to administer the fund for the school.
administer.zh: 她被请来管理学校的这笔资金。

admire.example: I admire her patience when she works with young children.
admire.zh: 我很钦佩她带小孩子时的耐心。

admit.example: He admitted that he had forgotten the meeting time.
admit.zh: 他承认自己忘了开会的时间。

adolescent.example: Many adolescent boys and girls need more sleep than adults.
adolescent.zh: 许多青春期的男孩女孩比成年人需要更多睡眠。

adopt.example: The company decided to adopt a new safety policy.
adopt.zh: 公司决定采用一项新的安全政策。

adore.example: The children adore their new puppy and play with it daily.
adore.zh: 孩子们非常喜爱他们的小狗，每天都和它玩。

adult.example: Every adult must show a ticket at the entrance.
adult.zh: 每个成年人在入口处都必须出示门票。

advance.example: Please book your tickets in advance to avoid long lines.
advance.zh: 请提前订票，以免排长队。

advantage.example: One advantage of cycling is that it keeps you fit.
advantage.zh: 骑自行车的一个好处是能让你保持健康。

advent.example: The advent of the internet changed how we study and work.
advent.zh: 互联网的出现改变了我们学习和工作的方式。

adventure.example: Their trip to the mountains turned into a real adventure.
adventure.zh: 他们的山区之行变成了一次真正的冒险。

adverb.example: An adverb often tells us how, when, or where something happens.
adverb.zh: 副词常常告诉我们某事如何、何时或何地发生。

adversary.example: He remained calm even when his adversary spoke too loudly.
adversary.zh: 即使对手说话很响，他依然保持冷静。

adverse.example: Bad weather had an adverse effect on the harvest this year.
adverse.zh: 恶劣的天气对今年的收成产生了不利影响。

advertise.example: The shop advertises its new products on the local radio.
advertise.zh: 这家商店在当地广播里为新商品做广告。

advice.example: She gave me useful advice about saving money each month.
advice.zh: 她给了我一些每月存钱的有用建议。

advise.example: The doctor advised him to rest and drink more water.
advise.zh: 医生建议他多休息、多喝水。

advocate.example: Many teachers advocate reading aloud in the early years.
advocate.zh: 许多老师主张在低年级多朗读。

aerial.example: The old aerial on the roof still picks up a few channels.
aerial.zh: 屋顶上那根旧天线还能收到几个频道。

aesthetic.example: The garden has aesthetic value as well as practical use.
aesthetic.zh: 这个花园既有审美价值，也有实用价值。

affair.example: The whole affair was settled quietly within a few days.
affair.zh: 整件事在几天内就悄悄解决了。

affect.example: Lack of sleep can affect your memory and your mood.
affect.zh: 睡眠不足会影响你的记忆和情绪。

affection.example: She shows great affection for the old dog she rescued.
affection.zh: 她对她救下的那只老狗非常疼爱。

affiliate.example: The small clinic decided to affiliate with a larger hospital.
affiliate.zh: 这家小诊所决定并入一家更大的医院。

affirm.example: The manager affirmed that the order would arrive on Monday.
affirm.zh: 经理确认订单会在周一送到。

affix.example: Please affix a stamp to the envelope before posting it.
affix.zh: 寄信前请在信封上贴一张邮票。

affluent.example: The family moved to a more affluent part of town.
affluent.zh: 这家人搬到了城里更富裕的地区。

afford.example: We cannot afford a new car this year.

afloat.example: The empty boat stayed afloat on the calm blue water.
afloat.zh: 那只空船在平静的蓝水面上漂着。

afraid.example: She is afraid of walking home alone after dark.
afraid.zh: 她害怕天黑后一个人走路回家。

after.example: We went for a walk after the rain had stopped.
after.zh: 雨停之后我们去散了步。

aftermath.example: The town slowly rebuilt itself in the aftermath of the flood.
aftermath.zh: 洪水过后，小镇慢慢重建起来。

afternoon.example: I usually take a short walk in the afternoon.
afternoon.zh: 我通常在下午散一会儿步。

afterward.example: They had dinner together and afterward walked by the river.
afterward.zh: 他们一起吃了晚饭，之后在河边散步。

again.example: Please read the question again before you write your answer.
again.zh: 写答案之前请把题目再读一遍。

against.example: He leaned against the wall and waited for the bus.
against.zh: 他靠在墙上等公共汽车。

age.example: Children of his age enjoy stories about animals and travel.
age.zh: 他这么大的孩子喜欢关于动物和旅行的故事。

agenda.example: The first item on the agenda is the school budget.
agenda.zh: 议程上的第一项是学校的预算。

agent.example: Our travel agent found a cheaper flight for us.
agent.zh: 我们的旅行代理帮我们找到了一班更便宜的航班。

aggravate.example: Scratching the skin will only aggravate the itching.
aggravate.zh: 抓挠皮肤只会让瘙痒加重。

aggregate.example: The aggregate score of both games decided the winner.
aggregate.zh: 两场比赛的总分决定了胜者。

aggressive.example: His aggressive sales style made some customers uncomfortable.
aggressive.zh: 他咄咄逼人的销售风格让一些顾客感到不舒服。

agitate.example: The machine begins to agitate the water and soap together.
agitate.zh: 机器开始把水和皂液一起搅动。

ago.example: We moved to this quiet town three years ago.
ago.zh: 三年前我们搬到了这个安静的小镇。

agony.example: He was in agony after dropping the heavy box on his foot.
agony.zh: 沉重的箱子砸到脚上后，他痛苦不堪。

agree.example: I agree with your plan to start the meeting earlier.
agree.zh: 我同意你提前开会的计划。

agriculture.example: Modern agriculture uses less water than it did years ago.
agriculture.zh: 现代农业比多年前用水更少。

ahead.example: There is a small hotel just ahead on the left.
ahead.zh: 前面左边就有一家小旅馆。

aid.example: The map will aid you in finding the shortest route.
aid.zh: 这张地图会帮你找到最短的路线。

aide.example: A teacher's aide helped the children with their reading.
aide.zh: 一位教师助理帮助孩子们阅读。

AIDS.example: Researchers have spent many years looking for a cure for AIDS.
AIDS.zh: 研究人员花了很多年寻找艾滋病的治疗方法。

ail.example: What ails you? You look pale and very tired.
ail.zh: 你哪里不舒服？你看上去脸色苍白，很疲倦。

aim.example: Our aim is to finish the report before Friday noon.
aim.zh: 我们的目标是在周五中午前完成报告。

air.example: The air in the forest smells fresh after the rain.
air.zh: 雨后的森林里空气闻起来很清新。

air-conditioning.example: The office air-conditioning keeps the room cool on hot days.
air-conditioning.zh: 炎热的日子里，办公室的空调让房间保持凉爽。

airborne.example: The seeds of this plant are airborne and travel long distances.
airborne.zh: 这种植物的种子随风飘散，能传播很远。

aircraft.example: Several aircraft were waiting on the runway this morning.
aircraft.zh: 今天上午有几架飞机在跑道上等待。

airline.example: This airline offers cheap tickets to small cities.
airline.zh: 这家航空公司提供飞往小城市的便宜机票。

airplane.example: The airplane rose slowly above the hills and disappeared.
airplane.zh: 飞机慢慢升到山丘上方，然后消失了。

airport.example: We arrived at the airport two hours before the flight.
airport.zh: 我们在航班起飞前两小时到达机场。

aisle.example: Please keep the aisle clear so people can walk safely.
aisle.zh: 请保持过道畅通，以便人们安全行走。

akin.example: His way of thinking is akin to that of a scientist.
akin.zh: 他的思维方式类似于科学家的思维方式。

alarm.example: My phone alarm woke me at six this morning.
alarm.zh: 今天早上六点我的手机闹铃把我叫醒了。

album.example: She put all the holiday photos into a large album.
album.zh: 她把所有假期照片都放进了一本大相册。

alcohol.example: This drink contains no alcohol and is safe for children.
alcohol.zh: 这种饮料不含酒精，孩子喝也安全。

ale.example: The old pub still serves warm ale in the winter.
ale.zh: 那家老酒馆在冬天仍供应温热的麦芽酒。

alert.example: The driver stayed alert during the long night journey.
alert.zh: 司机在漫长的夜间行车中保持警觉。

algebra.example: We learned how to solve simple equations in algebra class.
algebra.zh: 我们在代数课上学习了如何解简单方程。

alien.example: The word alien here simply means a person from abroad.
alien.zh: 这里的 alien 一词只是指来自国外的人。

align.example: Please align the two edges before you glue them together.
align.zh: 请把两条边对齐后再粘在一起。

alike.example: The two sisters look so alike that people often mix them up.
alike.zh: 这两姐妹长得很像，人们常常把她们弄混。

alive.example: The plant is still alive even after weeks without water.
alive.zh: 这株植物几周没浇水也还活着。

all.example: All the students finished the test before the bell rang.
all.zh: 所有学生都在铃响前完成了测验。

allege.example: The report alleges that the company broke the safety rules.
allege.zh: 报告称这家公司违反了安全规定。

allergic.example: She is allergic to cats and starts sneezing near them.
allergic.zh: 她对猫过敏，一靠近猫就打喷嚏。

alleviate.example: A warm drink may help alleviate the pain in your throat.
alleviate.zh: 一杯热饮也许有助于减轻你喉咙的疼痛。

alley.example: The cat ran down the narrow alley behind the shops.
alley.zh: 那只猫沿着商店后面的窄巷跑走了。

allocate.example: The school will allocate more money to the music room.
allocate.zh: 学校会给音乐教室拨更多的钱。

allot.example: Each group was allotted ten minutes to present its idea.
allot.zh: 每个小组分到十分钟来展示自己的想法。

allow.example: The rules do not allow visitors to enter this room.
allow.zh: 规定不允许访客进入这个房间。

allowance.example: His parents give him a small monthly allowance for books.
allowance.zh: 他父母每月给他一点买书的零用钱。

alloy.example: The frame is made of a light alloy that resists rust.
alloy.zh: 这个框架由一种不易生锈的轻合金制成。

allude.example: In his talk he alluded to a problem we all knew.
allude.zh: 他在讲话中隐约提到了一个我们都知道的问题。

allure.example: The allure of the sea brings many visitors to this quiet town.
allure.zh: 大海的魅力吸引了许多游客来到这个安静的小镇。

ally.example: A good friend is a useful ally when times are hard.
ally.zh: 在困难时期，好朋友是有用的盟友。

almighty.example: The villagers believed an almighty power lived on the mountain top.
almighty.zh: 村民们相信山顶上住着一种无所不能的力量。

almost.example: The train was almost full when we finally got on.
almost.zh: 我们终于上车时，火车几乎已经满了。

aloft.example: The flag was raised aloft on a tall white pole.
aloft.zh: 旗帜被高高升到一根白色的高杆上。

alone.example: She lives alone in a small house near the river.
alone.zh: 她独自住在河边的一座小房子里。

along.example: We walked along the river and watched the boats pass by.
along.zh: 我们沿着河边散步，看着船只经过。

alongside.example: The small boat moved alongside the larger ship for a while.
alongside.zh: 那只小船有一段时间与大船并排而行。

aloud.example: The teacher asked us to read the passage aloud in class.
aloud.zh: 老师让我们在课堂上朗读这一段。

alphabet.example: Children learn the alphabet before they start to read words.
alphabet.zh: 孩子们在开始读单词之前先学字母表。

already.example: He had already finished his homework before dinner was ready.
already.zh: 晚饭做好之前他就已经完成了作业。

also.example: She also enjoys swimming in the lake during the summer.
also.zh: 夏天她也喜欢在湖里游泳。

alter.example: They had to alter the plan when the weather suddenly changed.
alter.zh: 天气突然变化，他们不得不修改计划。

alternate.example: The two friends take alternate turns driving on long trips.
alternate.zh: 这两个朋友长途旅行时轮流开车。

alternative.example: If the train is late, we have no alternative but to wait.
alternative.zh: 如果火车晚点，我们除了等待别无选择。

although.example: Although it was raining, we still went out for a walk.
although.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是出去散步了。

altitude.example: The plane climbed to a high altitude before turning east.
altitude.zh: 飞机爬升到很高的高度后转向东方。

altogether.example: The trip cost us about three hundred dollars altogether.
altogether.zh: 这次旅行总共花了我们大约三百美元。

aluminum.example: This light chair is made of aluminum and strong plastic.
aluminum.zh: 这把轻便的椅子是用铝和结实的塑料制成的。

always.example: She always walks to the office when the weather is fine.
always.zh: 天气好的时候她总是步行去办公室。

am.example: I am always the first person to arrive at the office every morning.
am.zh: 每天早上我总是第一个到办公室的人。

amass.example: Over the years he managed to amass a large collection of books.
amass.zh: 多年来他设法积累了大量藏书。

amateur.example: She is an amateur photographer who takes pictures on weekends.
amateur.zh: 她是一位业余摄影师，周末拍照。

amaze.example: The size of the old tree amazed all the visitors.
amaze.zh: 那棵老树的大小让所有游客惊叹。

ambassador.example: The ambassador gave a short talk to the students yesterday.
ambassador.zh: 昨天大使给学生们做了简短的讲话。

ambiguous.example: His answer was so ambiguous that nobody knew what he meant.
ambiguous.zh: 他的回答如此含糊，没人知道他的意思。

ambition.example: Her ambition is to open a small bakery of her own.
ambition.zh: 她的志向是开一家属于自己的小面包店。

ambulance.example: An ambulance arrived within minutes and took the man to hospital.
ambulance.zh: 救护车几分钟内就赶到了，把那个人送到了医院。

amend.example: The team decided to amend the plan after the first test.
amend.zh: 第一次测试后，团队决定修改这个计划。

amiable.example: Our new neighbor is an amiable man who loves gardening.
amiable.zh: 我们的新邻居是个和蔼可亲的人，很喜欢园艺。

amid.example: Amid the noise of the crowd, she heard her name called.
amid.zh: 在人群的喧闹声中，她听到有人叫她的名字。

ammunition.example: The guards kept the ammunition locked in a store room.
ammunition.zh: 守卫们把弹药锁在一间储藏室里。

among.example: The little house stood among tall trees near the quiet lake.
among.zh: 那座小房子坐落在安静湖泊附近的高树之间。

amount.example: A large amount of rain fell during the night.

ample.example: There is ample time to finish the report before Friday.
ample.zh: 有充足的时间在周五之前完成报告。

amplify.example: The speaker will amplify her voice so everyone can hear.
amplify.zh: 演讲者会放大她的声音，让每个人都能听见。

amuse.example: The funny story amused the children on the long bus ride.
amuse.zh: 那个有趣的故事在长途汽车上逗乐了孩子们。

analogue.example: This simple model is a useful analogue of the real system.
analogue.zh: 这个简单的模型是真实系统的有用类似物。

analogy.example: He explained the idea by drawing an analogy with water pipes.
analogy.zh: 他用水管作类比来解释这个想法。

analyze.example: Scientists analyze the water to find out what is in it.
analyze.zh: 科学家分析这些水，看看里面有什么。

ancestor.example: My ancestor came to this town more than a hundred years ago.
ancestor.zh: 我的祖先一百多年前来到这个小镇。

anchor.example: The ship dropped its anchor in the quiet bay for the night.
anchor.zh: 船在安静的海湾里抛锚过夜。

ancient.example: We visited an ancient temple that was built long ago.
ancient.zh: 我们参观了一座很久以前建造的古老寺庙。

and.example: She bought bread and milk on her way home from work.
and.zh: 她下班回家的路上买了面包和牛奶。

anecdote.example: She told a short anecdote about her first day at work.
anecdote.zh: 她讲了一件关于她上班第一天的小轶事。

anew.example: After the fire, they built the whole village anew.
anew.zh: 火灾之后，他们重新建起了整个村庄。

angel.example: She painted a small angel with white wings above the door.
angel.zh: 她在门上画了一个长着白翅膀的小天使。

angle.example: The two walls meet at a sharp angle near the door.
angle.zh: 两堵墙在门附近以锐角相交。

angry.example: He was angry with himself for forgetting the meeting.
angry.zh: 他因为忘记开会而生自己的气。

anguish.example: She cried out in anguish when she heard the sad news.
anguish.zh: 听到那个悲伤的消息时，她痛苦地叫了出来。

animal.example: Wild animals need clean water and safe places to live.
animal.zh: 野生动物需要干净的水和安全的栖息地。

animate.example: A good teacher can animate a dull lesson with stories.
animate.zh: 好老师能用故事让枯燥的课变得生动。

ankle.example: She hurt her ankle while running down the stairs.
ankle.zh: 她跑下楼梯时伤到了脚踝。

annex.example: The school plans to annex the small building next door.
annex.zh: 学校计划把隔壁那栋小楼并入使用。

anniversary.example: They celebrated their tenth wedding anniversary at a small restaurant.
anniversary.zh: 他们在一家小餐馆庆祝了结婚十周年纪念日。

announce.example: The manager will announce the results of the test tomorrow.
announce.zh: 经理明天将宣布测试结果。

annoy.example: The loud music began to annoy the people in the hotel.
annoy.zh: 吵闹的音乐开始让旅馆里的人感到恼火。

annual.example: The company holds an annual meeting for all its staff.
annual.zh: 公司每年为全体员工举行一次会议。

anonymous.example: The gift came from an anonymous person who left no note.
anonymous.zh: 这份礼物来自一个没有留下字条的匿名者。

another.example: Would you like another cup of tea before you leave?
another.zh: 走之前你想再喝一杯茶吗？

answer.example: Please answer the phone if it rings while I am out.
answer.zh: 我不在的时候如果电话响了，请接一下。

ant.example: A small ant carried a piece of bread across the floor.
ant.zh: 一只小蚂蚁拖着一块面包穿过地板。

antagonism.example: There was some antagonism between the two teams at first.
antagonism.zh: 起初两队之间有些对立情绪。

antenna.example: The old radio has a long antenna on the top.
antenna.zh: 这台旧收音机顶部有一根长天线。

antibiotic.example: The doctor gave him an antibiotic for the throat infection.
antibiotic.zh: 医生给他开了抗生素治疗喉咙感染。

anticipate.example: We anticipate a busy week before the holiday begins.
anticipate.zh: 我们预计假期开始前会是很忙的一周。

antique.example: She bought an antique chair at the market last Sunday.
antique.zh: 上周日她在市场上买了一把古董椅子。

antonym.example: The word hot is an antonym of the word cold.
antonym.zh: hot 这个词是 cold 一词的反义词。

anxious.example: She felt anxious about the exam results all morning.
anxious.zh: 她整个上午都为考试成绩感到焦虑。

any.example: Do you have any questions about the lesson we just finished?
any.zh: 关于我们刚上完的这节课，你有什么问题吗？

anybody.example: Did anybody see my keys on the table this morning?
anybody.zh: 今天早上有人看到桌上的钥匙吗？

anyhow.example: It was raining, but we went out anyhow.
anyhow.zh: 当时下着雨，但我们还是出去了。

anything.example: I did not buy anything at the shop today.
anything.zh: 我今天在商店什么也没买。

anyway.example: It was late, but she decided to call him anyway.
anyway.zh: 时间很晚了，但她还是决定给他打电话。

anywhere.example: I cannot find my glasses anywhere in the house.
anywhere.zh: 我在屋里哪儿都找不到我的眼镜。

apart.example: The two houses stand a few meters apart on the hill.
apart.zh: 两座房子相距几米立在小山上。

apartment.example: They moved into a small apartment near the train station.
apartment.zh: 他们搬进了火车站附近的一间小公寓。

ape.example: A large ape sat quietly on a branch above us.
ape.zh: 一只大猿安静地坐在我们头顶的树枝上。

apology.example: He offered a sincere apology for arriving so late.
apology.zh: 他为来得太晚而诚恳地道歉。

app.example: This app helps me learn new words for ten minutes every day.
app.zh: 这个应用帮我每天花十分钟学新单词。

appal.example: The amount of food we waste appals me every day.
appal.zh: 我们每天浪费的食物量让我感到震惊。

apparatus.example: The lab keeps its delicate apparatus in a locked cabinet.
apparatus.zh: 实验室把精密的仪器放在上了锁的柜子里。

apparent.example: It soon became apparent that the plan would not work.
apparent.zh: 很快就明显看出这个计划行不通。

appeal.example: The idea of a quiet holiday appeals to me very much.
appeal.zh: 安静度假的想法非常吸引我。

appear.example: A small boat appeared on the horizon at noon.
appear.zh: 中午时一艘小船出现在地平线上。

appease.example: He tried to appease the angry customer with a free meal.
appease.zh: 他试图用一顿免费餐安抚那位生气的顾客。

appendix.example: The full data is given in the appendix at the back.
appendix.zh: 完整数据附在书后的附录里。

appetite.example: A long walk in the cold gave me a good appetite.
appetite.zh: 在寒冷中长时间散步让我胃口大开。

applaud.example: The audience applauded loudly when the song ended.
applaud.zh: 歌曲结束时观众热烈鼓掌。

apple.example: She cut the apple into four pieces for the children.
apple.zh: 她把苹果切成四块给孩子们。

appliance.example: Every kitchen appliance in the house is new and clean.
appliance.zh: 这间屋子里每一件厨房电器都是新的、干净的。

apply.example: You can apply for the job through the company website.
apply.zh: 你可以通过公司网站申请这份工作。

appoint.example: The board decided to appoint her as the new director.
appoint.zh: 董事会决定任命她为新的主管。

appraise.example: An expert came to appraise the painting before the sale.
appraise.zh: 出售前一位专家来给这幅画估价。

appreciate.example: I really appreciate all the help you gave me yesterday.
appreciate.zh: 我非常感谢你昨天给我的所有帮助。

apprentice.example: He worked as an apprentice in the shop for two years.
apprentice.zh: 他在这家店里当了两年学徒。

approach.example: As winter approaches, the days become shorter and colder.
approach.zh: 随着冬天临近，白天变得更短更冷。

appropriate.example: Please wear appropriate clothes for the job interview tomorrow.
appropriate.zh: 明天面试请穿合适的衣服。

appropriation.example: The school used its annual appropriation to buy new books.
appropriation.zh: 学校用年度拨款购买了新书。

approve.example: The manager will approve the budget at the meeting today.
approve.zh: 经理将在今天的会议上批准预算。

approximate.example: The approximate cost of the trip is two hundred dollars.
approximate.zh: 这次旅行的大致费用是两百美元。

April.example: The flowers in our garden usually open in early April.
April.zh: 我们花园里的花通常在四月初开放。

apron.example: She put on an apron before cooking the evening meal.
apron.zh: 做晚饭前她系上了围裙。

apt.example: Children are apt to forget things when they are tired.
apt.zh: 孩子们累了的时候容易忘事。

aptitude.example: She shows a real aptitude for learning foreign languages.
aptitude.zh: 她显示出学习外语的真正天赋。

arbitrary.example: The decision seemed arbitrary and no one could explain it.
arbitrary.zh: 这个决定显得很随意，没人能解释清楚。

arbitrate.example: A senior teacher was asked to arbitrate the small dispute.
arbitrate.zh: 一位资深教师被请来仲裁这个小纠纷。

arc.example: The ball flew in a high arc over the wall.
arc.zh: 球以高高的弧线飞过了墙。

arch.example: They walked through the stone arch into the old garden.
arch.zh: 他们穿过石拱门走进那座古老的园子。

architect.example: The architect drew a plan for the new public library.
architect.zh: 建筑师为新的公共图书馆画了一份设计图。

architecture.example: She studied architecture for five years before working here.
architecture.zh: 她在这里工作之前学了五年建筑学。

archive.example: The office keeps old records in a digital archive.
archive.zh: 办公室把旧记录保存在数字档案库里。

ardent.example: He is an ardent supporter of the local football team.
ardent.zh: 他是当地足球队的热心支持者。

area.example: This area of the city is quiet at night.
area.zh: 城市的这一片区域夜里很安静。

arena.example: The concert will be held in the big sports arena.
arena.zh: 演唱会将在大型体育馆里举行。

argue.example: They often argue about which film to watch on Friday.
argue.zh: 他们常常为周五看哪部电影而争论。

arise.example: Problems may arise if we do not plan the work carefully.
arise.zh: 如果我们不仔细安排工作，可能会出现问题。

aristocrat.example: The old house once belonged to a rich aristocrat.
aristocrat.zh: 这座老房子曾属于一位富有的贵族。

arithmetic.example: She is good at arithmetic and can add numbers quickly.
arithmetic.zh: 她擅长算术，能很快地把数字相加。

arm.example: He hurt his left arm while playing basketball last week.
arm.zh: 上周他打篮球时伤了左臂。

armor.example: The museum shows a suit of armor from long ago.
armor.zh: 博物馆展出了一套很久以前的盔甲。

army.example: He joined the army after he finished school.

around.example: They walked around the lake and stopped for a rest.
around.zh: 他们绕着湖走了一圈，然后停下来休息。

arouse.example: The strange noise aroused our interest and we went out.
arouse.zh: 奇怪的声音引起了我们的兴趣，我们走了出去。

arrange.example: She will arrange the chairs before the guests arrive.
arrange.zh: 客人到来之前她会把椅子摆好。

array.example: The shop offers a wide array of fresh fruit and vegetables.
array.zh: 这家店提供各种各样的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

arrest.example: The police arrested the man who took the bicycle.
arrest.zh: 警察逮捕了那个拿走自行车的人。

arrive.example: We usually arrive at the office before eight in the morning.
arrive.zh: 我们通常早上八点前到办公室。

arrogant.example: His arrogant manner made it hard for others to work with him.
arrogant.zh: 他傲慢的态度让别人很难与他共事。

arrow.example: A red arrow on the wall points toward the exit.
arrow.zh: 墙上一个红色箭头指向出口。

art.example: She has loved art since she was a small child.

artery.example: The main artery of the city is always busy in the morning.
artery.zh: 城市的主干道早上总是很繁忙。

article.example: I read an interesting article about bees in the newspaper.
article.zh: 我在报纸上读到一篇关于蜜蜂的有趣文章。

articulate.example: She is an articulate speaker who explains ideas very clearly.
articulate.zh: 她是一位口才很好的演讲者，能把想法讲得很清楚。

artifact.example: The museum bought an old artifact from a local family.
artifact.zh: 博物馆从当地一户人家手里买下一件古老的器物。

artificial.example: The garden has artificial flowers that look almost real.
artificial.zh: 花园里的人造花看起来几乎像真的。

artillery.example: The museum keeps a large piece of artillery near the gate.
artillery.zh: 博物馆在门附近陈列着一门大型火炮。

as.example: She works as a teacher in a small school near her home.
as.zh: 她在离家不远的一所小学校当老师。

ascend.example: The climbers slowly ascend the steep path to the top.
ascend.zh: 登山者沿着陡峭的小路慢慢向上攀登。

ascertain.example: We need to ascertain the exact time of the first train.
ascertain.zh: 我们需要查明首班列车的准确时间。

ascribe.example: She ascribes her success to hard work and good teachers.
ascribe.zh: 她把自己的成功归因于努力和好老师。

ash.example: He cleaned the ash from the fireplace with a small brush.
ash.zh: 他用一把小刷子清理壁炉里的灰。

ashamed.example: He felt ashamed of his rude words and said sorry.
ashamed.zh: 他为自己粗暴的话感到羞愧，并道了歉。

ashore.example: The sailors came ashore after a long week at sea.
ashore.zh: 在海上待了漫长的一周后，水手们上了岸。

aside.example: She stepped aside to let the old man pass.
aside.zh: 她让到一边，让那位老人过去。

ask.example: Do not be afraid to ask questions during the lesson.

asleep.example: The baby fell asleep in her arms within a few minutes.
asleep.zh: 婴儿几分钟内就在她怀里睡着了。

aspect.example: We should think about every aspect of the plan carefully.
aspect.zh: 我们应该仔细考虑这个计划的每一个方面。

aspire.example: Many young people aspire to work in this famous company.
aspire.zh: 许多年轻人渴望在这家有名的公司工作。

ass.example: The farmer loaded the ass with two heavy bags of grain.
ass.zh: 农夫把两袋沉重的粮食驮到驴背上。

assassinate.example: The novel tells how some men tried to assassinate the young king.
assassinate.zh: 这部小说讲述了几个人如何试图暗杀年轻的国王。

assault.example: The sudden loud music assaulted our ears when the door opened.
assault.zh: 门一打开，突然响起的震耳音乐便冲击着我们的耳朵。

assemble.example: The students assembled in the hall to hear the head teacher speak.
assemble.zh: 学生们在礼堂集合，听校长讲话。

assert.example: She asserted that the new plan would save both time and money.
assert.zh: 她断言新方案既能省时又能省钱。

assess.example: Teachers assess our progress at the end of every school term.
assess.zh: 老师在每个学期末评估我们的进步。

asset.example: A good memory is a great asset for anyone learning a new language.
asset.zh: 对学习新语言的人来说，好记性是一大财富。

assign.example: The manager assigned each worker a clear task for the morning.
assign.zh: 经理给每个工人分配了上午的明确任务。

assimilate.example: Children assimilate new words quickly when they hear them every day.
assimilate.zh: 孩子们每天听到新词，就能很快把它们吸收。

assist.example: A young student assisted the teacher with carrying the books.
assist.zh: 一名年轻学生帮老师搬书。

associate.example: Most people associate the smell of bread with a warm home.
associate.zh: 大多数人把面包的香味和温暖的家联系在一起。

assorted.example: The shop sells assorted sweets in small paper bags near the door.
assorted.zh: 这家店在门口卖装在纸袋里的各种糖果。

assortment.example: The box held a wide assortment of buttons, beads and ribbons.
assortment.zh: 盒子里装着各种各样的纽扣、珠子和丝带。

assume.example: I assume the train will arrive on time this morning.
assume.zh: 我假定火车今天早上会准时到站。

assure.example: The doctor assured me that the small cut would heal quickly.
assure.zh: 医生向我保证那个小伤口很快就会愈合。

astonish.example: The size of the old tree astonished every visitor in the garden.
astonish.zh: 这棵老树的大小让花园里的每位游客都感到惊讶。

astray.example: One wrong turn led the hikers astray in the thick forest.
astray.zh: 一个错误的转弯让徒步者在茂密的森林里迷了路。

astronaut.example: The astronaut described how the earth looks from space.
astronaut.zh: 这位宇航员描述了从太空看地球的样子。

astronomy.example: He reads books about astronomy because he loves the night sky.
astronomy.zh: 他喜欢夜空，所以常读天文学的书。

asylum.example: The old building was used as an asylum for people without homes.
asylum.zh: 这栋老建筑曾被用作无家可归者的收容所。

at.example: We met at the small coffee shop beside the river.
at.zh: 我们在河边那家小咖啡店见了面。

athlete.example: The young athlete trains for two hours before school every day.
athlete.zh: 这名年轻运动员每天上学前训练两个小时。

atlas.example: She found the small town in the atlas on the shelf.
atlas.zh: 她在书架上的地图集里找到了那个小镇。

atmosphere.example: The warm light and soft music gave the room a friendly atmosphere.
atmosphere.zh: 温暖的灯光和柔和的音乐给房间带来了友好的气氛。

atom.example: Every atom in a glass of water is far too small to see.
atom.zh: 一杯水里的每个原子都小得看不见。

atop.example: A small bird sat atop the fence and sang for a while.
atop.zh: 一只小鸟停在栅栏顶上，唱了一会儿歌。

atrocity.example: People around the world were shocked by the atrocities in the report.
atrocity.zh: 全世界的人都被报告中的暴行震惊了。

attach.example: Please attach your photo to the form before you send it.
attach.zh: 寄出之前请把照片附在表格上。

attack.example: Some insects attack the leaves of young plants in summer.
attack.zh: 有些昆虫在夏天会侵袭幼小植物的叶子。

attain.example: She worked hard for years to attain her goal of teaching.
attain.zh: 她多年努力，终于实现了教书的目标。

attempt.example: His first attempt at baking bread was a complete failure.
attempt.zh: 他第一次试着烤面包彻底失败了。

attend.example: More than a hundred people attended the free concert in the park.
attend.zh: 一百多人参加了公园的免费音乐会。

attention.example: The teacher asked for our attention before starting the new lesson.
attention.zh: 老师在开始新课前请我们集中注意力。

attic.example: We found an old wooden box in the attic above the stairs.
attic.zh: 我们在楼梯上方的阁楼里发现了一个旧木箱。

attitude.example: Her positive attitude helped the whole team through a hard week.
attitude.zh: 她积极的态度帮助整个团队度过了艰难的一周。

attorney.example: The attorney read the contract carefully before signing her name.
attorney.zh: 律师在签名前仔细阅读了合同。

attract.example: Bright flowers attract bees and butterflies to the small garden.
attract.zh: 鲜艳的花把蜜蜂和蝴蝶吸引到小花园里。

attribute.example: Scientists attribute the rising temperature to human activity.
attribute.zh: 科学家把气温上升归因于人类活动。

auction.example: An old painting was sold at the auction for a high price.
auction.zh: 一幅旧画在拍卖会上以高价售出。

audience.example: The audience clapped loudly when the young singer finished her song.
audience.zh: 年轻歌手唱完歌时，观众热烈鼓掌。

audio.example: The audio quality of the recording was clear and easy to follow.
audio.zh: 这段录音的音质清晰，很容易听懂。

audit.example: The company invited an outside team to audit its yearly accounts.
audit.zh: 公司请了一个外部团队来审计年度账目。

auditorium.example: The whole school gathered in the auditorium for the morning meeting.
auditorium.zh: 全校师生聚集在礼堂开晨会。

augment.example: He took a second job to augment his monthly income.
augment.zh: 他找了第二份工作来增加月收入。

August.example: The days are still very hot here in late August.
August.zh: 八月下旬这里白天仍然很热。

aunt.example: My aunt makes the best apple pie in our family.
aunt.zh: 我姑妈做的苹果派是我们家最好吃的。

authentic.example: This small restaurant serves authentic home cooking from the local area.
authentic.zh: 这家小餐馆提供地道的本地家常菜。

author.example: The author of this book will visit our school next Friday.
author.zh: 这本书的作者下周五将来我们学校。

authority.example: The local authority plans to build a new library this year.
authority.zh: 当地政府计划今年建一座新图书馆。

authorize.example: Only the head teacher can authorize a change to the timetable.
authorize.zh: 只有校长才有权批准更改课表。

auto.example: He drove his new auto slowly along the quiet country road.
auto.zh: 他开着新汽车沿着安静的乡间小路缓缓行驶。

autobiography.example: In her autobiography she describes her childhood in a small village.
autobiography.zh: 她在自传里描述了童年时在一个小村庄的生活。

automate.example: The factory used new machines to automate most of the packing.
automate.zh: 工厂用新机器使大部分包装工序实现了自动化。

autonomous.example: An autonomous vehicle can find its way without a human driver.
autonomous.zh: 自动驾驶汽车不需要人来驾驶也能找到路。

autumn.example: The leaves turn gold and red in the autumn wind.
autumn.zh: 秋风中树叶变成了金黄色和红色。

auxiliary.example: The hospital uses an auxiliary power line when the main one fails.
auxiliary.zh: 主电源出故障时，医院使用备用电力线路。

avail.example: All his efforts to open the jar availed him nothing.
avail.zh: 他费尽力气想打开那个罐子，却毫无用处。

available.example: Tickets are still available at the front desk of the hotel.
available.zh: 酒店前台的票现在还有。

avenge.example: The team wanted to avenge last year's defeat in the final.
avenge.zh: 这支队伍想为去年决赛的失利报仇。

avenue.example: Tall trees line both sides of the wide avenue near the park.
avenue.zh: 公园附近那条宽阔的大道两旁种着高大的树。

average.example: The average temperature in this city is about twenty degrees.
average.zh: 这座城市的气温平均在二十度左右。

avert.example: The driver turned quickly to avert a crash on the wet road.
avert.zh: 司机迅速转向，避免了在湿滑路面上撞车。

aviation.example: He has worked in aviation for over twenty years.
aviation.zh: 他从事航空工作已经二十多年了。

avoid.example: We left early to avoid the heavy traffic after the show.
avoid.zh: 我们提早离开，以免演出后遇上拥堵的交通。

await.example: A warm meal and a dry bed await you at the small hotel.
await.zh: 小旅馆里有热饭和干爽的床位等着你。

awake.example: The baby was still awake at midnight, watching the light.
awake.zh: 半夜时婴儿还醒着，看着灯光。

award.example: The school gave her an award for her work in the garden.
award.zh: 学校因为她打理花园的工作给了她一个奖。

aware.example: Are you aware that the shop closes early on Saturdays?
aware.zh: 你知道这家店周六提前关门吗？

away.example: The bird flew away as soon as we opened the window.
away.zh: 我们一开窗，鸟就飞走了。

awe.example: The children stood in awe before the huge old tree.
awe.zh: 孩子们满怀敬畏地站在那棵巨大的老树前。

awesome.example: The view from the top of the hill was truly awesome.
awesome.zh: 从山顶看到的景色真是令人惊叹。

awful.example: The awful smell from the kitchen made us open all the windows.
awful.zh: 厨房里难闻的气味让我们把窗户全打开了。

awkward.example: He felt awkward at the party because he knew no one.
awkward.zh: 他在聚会上感到很尴尬，因为谁也不认识。

ax.example: He used an ax to cut the dry branches into smaller pieces.
ax.zh: 他用斧头把干树枝砍成小块。

axis.example: The earth turns around its axis once every twenty-four hours.
axis.zh: 地球每二十四小时绕自己的轴转一圈。

baby.example: The baby smiled at her mother and reached for the toy.
baby.zh: 婴儿对妈妈笑了笑，伸手去够玩具。

baby boom.example: The small town built two new schools after a baby boom in the area.
baby boom.zh: 这一地区出现生育高峰后，小镇建了两所新学校。

bachelor.example: Her brother is still a bachelor and lives alone by the sea.
bachelor.zh: 她哥哥仍是单身汉，独自住在海边。

back.example: He put the heavy box back on the top shelf.
back.zh: 他把那个重箱子放回了最上层的架子上。

background.example: The photo shows a white house with green hills in the background.
background.zh: 照片里是一栋白色的房子，背景是绿色的山丘。

backup.example: Always keep a backup of your files on a small drive.
backup.zh: 务必将你的文件备份保存在一个小驱动器上。

backward.example: He took a step backward when the dog ran toward him.
backward.zh: 那只狗朝他跑来时，他往后退了一步。

backyard.example: The children play football in the backyard after school.
backyard.zh: 孩子们放学后在后院踢足球。

bacon.example: He cooked bacon and eggs for breakfast on Sunday morning.
bacon.zh: 星期天早上他做了培根和鸡蛋当早餐。

bacteria.example: Washing your hands well helps keep bacteria away from your food.
bacteria.zh: 好好洗手有助于让细菌远离食物。

bad.example: The weather was so bad that we stayed inside all day.
bad.zh: 天气太糟了，我们一整天都待在屋里。

badge.example: Every visitor must wear a name badge inside the building.
badge.zh: 每位来访者在楼内都必须佩戴姓名徽章。

badly.example: He badly wanted to finish the book before the weekend.
badly.zh: 他非常想在周末前读完这本书。

badminton.example: They play badminton in the park every Saturday morning.
badminton.zh: 他们每周六早上在公园打羽毛球。

baffle.example: The strange sound from the wall baffled everyone in the house.
baffle.zh: 墙里传出的怪声让屋里所有人都感到困惑。

bag.example: She put the bread and milk into a paper bag.
bag.zh: 她把面包和牛奶放进了一个纸袋。

baggage.example: Please keep your baggage with you at all times on the train.
baggage.zh: 在火车上请随时把行李带在身边。

bail.example: We had to bail water out of the small boat.
bail.zh: 我们不得不把小船里的水舀出去。

bait.example: He put a small piece of bread on the hook as bait.
bait.zh: 他在鱼钩上挂了一小块面包作饵。

bake.example: My mother likes to bake bread on cold winter afternoons.
bake.zh: 我妈妈喜欢在寒冷的冬日午后烤面包。

balance.example: It is hard to keep a balance between work and rest.
balance.zh: 在工作和休息之间保持平衡很难。

balcony.example: We had tea on the balcony and watched the sunset.
balcony.zh: 我们在阳台上喝茶，看日落。

bald.example: The old man with the bald head smiled at the children.
bald.zh: 那位秃头的老人对孩子们微笑。

ball.example: The children kicked the ball across the green field.
ball.zh: 孩子们把球踢过绿色的场地。

ballet.example: She has studied ballet since she was six years old.
ballet.zh: 她从六岁起就学习芭蕾舞。

balloon.example: The red balloon rose slowly into the clear blue sky.
balloon.zh: 红色的气球慢慢升上了晴朗的蓝天。

ballot.example: Members will choose the new club leader by secret ballot.
ballot.zh: 成员们将以无记名投票选出新的俱乐部负责人。

bamboo.example: Pandas eat bamboo for many hours every single day.
bamboo.zh: 熊猫每天要吃好几个小时的竹子。

ban.example: The school decided to ban mobile phones during lessons.
ban.zh: 学校决定禁止在上课时使用手机。

banana.example: He cut a banana into small pieces for his breakfast.
banana.zh: 他把一根香蕉切成小块当早餐。

band.example: A local band played music in the square on Saturday evening.
band.zh: 周六晚上，一支本地乐队在广场上演奏。

bandage.example: The nurse put a clean bandage around his hurt arm.
bandage.zh: 护士在他受伤的手臂上包了干净的绷带。

bang.example: The door closed with a loud bang and woke the baby.
bang.zh: 门砰的一声关上了，把婴儿吵醒了。

bank.example: She walked along the bank of the river to the bridge.

banking.example: He has worked in banking since he left university.
banking.zh: 他大学毕业后一直从事银行业。

banknote.example: He paid for the old book with a clean new banknote.
banknote.zh: 他用一张崭新的钞票买了那本旧书。

bankrupt.example: The small shop went bankrupt after two years of poor sales.
bankrupt.zh: 这家小店在两年生意惨淡后破产了。

banner.example: A long red banner hung above the door of the new shop.
banner.zh: 新店门口上方挂着一条长长的红色横幅。

banquet.example: The hotel prepared a fine banquet for the guests.
banquet.zh: 酒店为客人准备了一场丰盛的宴会。

bar.example: They met friends at a small bar near the river.
bar.zh: 他们在河边一家小酒吧见了朋友。

barbecue.example: We had a barbecue in the garden with our neighbours.
barbecue.zh: 我们和邻居在花园里烧烤。

barber.example: The barber cut his hair short and neat for summer.
barber.zh: 理发师把他的头发剪得又短又整齐，迎接夏天。

bare.example: He walked on the beach with bare feet and a wide smile.
bare.zh: 他光着脚走在海滩上，笑容满面。

bargain.example: This coat was a real bargain at half the usual price.
bargain.zh: 这件外套只要平时一半的价钱，真是划算。

barge.example: A long barge moved slowly down the quiet river.
barge.zh: 一艘长长的驳船缓缓驶过安静的河面。

bark.example: The dog began to bark loudly at the postman.
bark.zh: 狗开始对着邮递员大声叫。

barn.example: They keep hay and old tools in the wooden barn.
barn.zh: 他们把干草和旧工具放在木制谷仓里。

barometer.example: The barometer fell quickly, which meant that a storm was coming.
barometer.zh: 气压计迅速下降，说明暴风雨要来了。

barracks.example: The old barracks beside the field are now used as offices.
barracks.zh: 田边那些旧营房现在被用作办公室。

barrel.example: Rain water is collected in a large barrel behind the house.
barrel.zh: 屋后的大桶里收集着雨水。

barren.example: Nothing grows on the barren hill because the soil is dry.
barren.zh: 因为土壤干燥，贫瘠的小山上什么也长不出来。

barrier.example: A low stone wall acts as a barrier between the two gardens.
barrier.zh: 一道低矮的石墙成了两个花园之间的屏障。

base.example: The small base of the lamp is made of wood.
base.zh: 灯的底座是用木头做的。

baseball.example: The boys played baseball in the field until it got dark.
baseball.zh: 男孩们在场上打棒球，一直打到天黑。

basement.example: They store old boxes and bikes in the basement.
basement.zh: 他们把旧箱子和自行车存放在地下室里。

basic.example: Food and water are basic needs for all living things.
basic.zh: 食物和水是所有生物的基本需求。

basin.example: She put warm water in the basin and washed her face.
basin.zh: 她在盆里放了些温水洗脸。

basis.example: These two friends meet on a regular basis to play chess.
basis.zh: 这两个朋友定期见面下棋。

basket.example: He carried a basket full of fresh fruit from the garden.
basket.zh: 他从花园里提来一只装满新鲜水果的篮子。

basketball.example: The students play basketball after class on the school court.
basketball.zh: 学生们下课后在学校球场上打篮球。

bass.example: The bass sounds of the music shook the wooden floor.
bass.zh: 音乐低沉的声音震得木地板发颤。

bat.example: A small bat flew over our heads in the evening.
bat.zh: 傍晚时一只小蝙蝠从我们头顶飞过。

batch.example: She baked a batch of small cakes for the school sale.
batch.zh: 她为学校义卖烤了一批小蛋糕。

bath.example: He runs a warm bath every night before going to bed.
bath.zh: 他每晚睡觉前都放一缸温水洗澡。

bathe.example: Please bathe the dog before it comes into the house.
bathe.zh: 进屋之前请给狗洗个澡。

bathroom.example: The bathroom is at the end of the hallway on the left.
bathroom.zh: 浴室在走廊尽头左手边。

battalion.example: A battalion of helpers cleaned the park after the festival.
battalion.zh: 一大群帮手在节庆之后清理了公园。

batter.example: She made the batter for the cake with eggs and flour.
batter.zh: 她用鸡蛋和面粉做蛋糕面糊。

battery.example: The battery in my old watch needs to be changed.
battery.zh: 我旧手表的电池该换了。

battle.example: The two teams fought a close battle for the cup.
battle.zh: 两支队伍为奖杯展开了一场势均力敌的争夺。

bay.example: Small boats rested quietly in the bay near the fishing village.
bay.zh: 小船静静地停在渔村附近的海湾里。

be.example: It is not easy to be patient with a crying child.
be.zh: 对哭闹的孩子有耐心并不容易。

beach.example: We walked along the beach and looked for small shells.
beach.zh: 我们沿着海滩散步，寻找小贝壳。

bead.example: She dropped a small glass bead and it rolled under the table.
bead.zh: 她掉了一颗小玻璃珠，珠子滚到了桌子底下。

beak.example: The bird held a small twig in its yellow beak.
beak.zh: 那只鸟用黄色的喙衔着一根小树枝。

beam.example: A beam of sunlight came through the window and lit the floor.
beam.zh: 一束阳光透过窗户照在地板上。

bean.example: She added a cup of red beans to the hot soup.
bean.zh: 她往热汤里加了一杯红豆。

bear.example: I cannot bear the loud noise from the street.
bear.zh: 我无法忍受街上刺耳的噪音。

beard.example: He has grown a long grey beard over the winter.
beard.zh: 他一个冬天留起了长长的灰胡子。

bearing.example: His calm bearing made everyone feel safe and welcome.
bearing.zh: 他从容的举止让每个人都感到安心和受欢迎。

beast.example: The wild beast hid in the thick trees near the river.
beast.zh: 那头野兽躲在河边的密林里。

beat.example: Our team beat the other side by two goals.
beat.zh: 我们队以两个球战胜了对方。

beauty.example: The beauty of the old garden surprised every visitor.
beauty.zh: 这座老花园的美让每位来访者都感到惊讶。

because.example: We stayed at home because the rain was very heavy.
because.zh: 因为雨下得很大，我们待在家里。

beckon.example: She beckoned me to come closer to the window.
beckon.zh: 她招手示意我靠近窗户。

become.example: The small village has become a busy travel spot.
become.zh: 这个小村庄已经变成了繁忙的旅游景点。

bed.example: The children were sent to bed early that night.
bed.zh: 那天晚上孩子们早早就被送去睡觉了。

bee.example: A single bee flew slowly across the open window.
bee.zh: 一只蜜蜂慢慢地飞过敞开的窗户。

beef.example: We had beef and potatoes for dinner last night.
beef.zh: 昨晚我们晚餐吃了牛肉和土豆。

beer.example: He ordered a cold beer after the long walk.
beer.zh: 走了很长的路后，他点了一杯冰啤酒。

beetle.example: A black beetle crawled slowly across the stone floor.
beetle.zh: 一只黑色甲虫慢慢爬过石头地面。

before.example: Please wash your hands before you sit down to eat.
before.zh: 请在你坐下吃饭之前洗手。

beforehand.example: She packed her bags beforehand so the morning was calm.
beforehand.zh: 她事先收拾好了行李，所以早上很从容。

beg.example: He begged his father to let him go outside.
beg.zh: 他乞求父亲让他到外面去。

begin.example: The meeting will begin at nine in the morning.
begin.zh: 会议将在上午九点开始。

behalf.example: She spoke on behalf of the whole class at the meeting.
behalf.zh: 她代表全班在会上发言。

behave.example: The children behaved well during the long train journey.
behave.zh: 孩子们在漫长的火车旅途中表现很好。

behind.example: The cat hid behind the door and waited quietly.
behind.zh: 猫躲在门后静静地等着。

being.example: Every living being needs clean water and fresh air.
being.zh: 每一个生物都需要干净的水和新鲜的空气。

belief.example: Her belief in hard work helped her finish the course.
belief.zh: 她对努力工作的信念帮助她完成了课程。

believe.example: I believe the shop opens at nine every morning.
believe.zh: 我相信这家店每天早上九点开门。

bell.example: The school bell rang and the children ran outside.
bell.zh: 学校铃响了，孩子们跑了出去。

belly.example: The puppy rolled over and showed its soft belly.
belly.zh: 小狗翻过身，露出柔软的肚子。

belong.example: These old keys belong to the door upstairs.
belong.zh: 这些旧钥匙属于楼上那扇门。

beloved.example: She kept a photo of her beloved grandmother on the desk.
beloved.zh: 她把心爱的祖母的照片放在书桌上。

below.example: Write your name below the line on the paper.
below.zh: 在纸上这条线下面写上你的名字。

belt.example: He tightened his belt before climbing the steep hill.
belt.zh: 他在爬陡坡前系紧了腰带。

bench.example: We sat on a wooden bench and watched the birds.
bench.zh: 我们坐在木长椅上看着鸟儿。

bend.example: Bend your knees slowly when you lift the heavy box.
bend.zh: 搬重箱子时慢慢弯曲膝盖。

beneath.example: A small stream runs beneath the old stone bridge.
beneath.zh: 一条小溪在古老的石桥下流过。

benefit.example: Regular walking brings great benefit to your heart and mind.
benefit.zh: 经常散步对你的身心大有益处。

benevolent.example: The benevolent old woman gave food to the hungry cats.
benevolent.zh: 那位善良的老妇人给饥饿的猫喂食。

benign.example: The doctor told her the small growth was benign.
benign.zh: 医生告诉她那个小肿块是良性的。

berry.example: The birds ate every berry on the small tree.
berry.zh: 鸟儿把小树上的浆果都吃光了。

beset.example: The old project was beset by delays and money problems.
beset.zh: 这个旧项目受到延误和资金问题的困扰。

beside.example: She put the cup beside the plate on the table.
beside.zh: 她把杯子放在桌上盘子旁边。

besides.example: Besides English, she also teaches maths at the school.
besides.zh: 除了英语，她还在学校教数学。

besiege.example: Reporters besieged the young singer after the big show.
besiege.zh: 演出结束后，记者们围住了那位年轻歌手。

best.example: This is the best time of year to visit the garden.
best.zh: 这是一年中参观这座花园的最佳时节。

best-seller.example: Her first book became a best-seller within two months.
best-seller.zh: 她的第一本书在两个月内就成了畅销书。

bet.example: I bet it will rain before we reach the station.
bet.zh: 我打赌我们在到车站之前会下雨。

betray.example: He would never betray a friend who trusted him.
betray.zh: 他绝不会背叛信任他的朋友。

better.example: This coat is better for cold weather than that one.
better.zh: 这件外套比那件更适合冷天。

between.example: The bank stands between the library and the small park.
between.zh: 银行位于图书馆和小公园之间。

beverage.example: The shop sells tea, coffee and other hot beverages.
beverage.zh: 这家店卖茶、咖啡和其他热饮。

beware.example: Beware of the wet floor near the front door.
beware.zh: 小心前门附近湿滑的地面。

bewilder.example: The many small streets began to bewilder the visitors.
bewilder.zh: 众多的小街开始让游客们感到困惑。

beyond.example: The path goes beyond the hill and into the woods.
beyond.zh: 这条小路越过小山，伸进树林。

bias.example: A good judge decides without bias or personal feeling.
bias.zh: 好的法官不带偏见或个人情绪作判断。

Bible.example: An old Bible lay open on the wooden table.
Bible.zh: 一本旧圣经摊开在木桌上。

bibliography.example: The last pages of the book hold a long bibliography.
bibliography.zh: 书的最后几页是长长的参考书目。

bicycle.example: He rides his bicycle to work every sunny morning.
bicycle.zh: 每个晴朗的早晨他都骑自行车上班。

bid.example: She made a high bid for the old painting.
bid.zh: 她为那幅旧画出价很高。

big.example: They live in a big house near the quiet lake.
big.zh: 他们住在安静的湖边一栋大房子里。

bilateral.example: The two schools signed a bilateral agreement on exchange visits.
bilateral.zh: 两所学校签署了互访的双边协议。

bill.example: He paid the bill and left a small tip.
bill.zh: 他付了账单，留了一点小费。

billion.example: The company is worth more than a billion dollars today.
billion.zh: 这家公司如今价值超过十亿美元。

bin.example: Please put the empty bottles in the green bin.
bin.zh: 请把空瓶子放进绿色垃圾箱。

bind.example: They used strong rope to bind the boxes together.
bind.zh: 他们用结实的绳子把箱子捆在一起。

binoculars.example: He watched the birds through a pair of binoculars.
binoculars.zh: 他用一副双筒望远镜观察鸟儿。

biochemistry.example: She studied biochemistry and now works in a small lab.
biochemistry.zh: 她学过生物化学，现在在一家小实验室工作。

biography.example: He is reading a biography of a famous scientist.
biography.zh: 他正在读一位著名科学家的传记。

biology.example: Biology helps us understand how plants and animals live.
biology.zh: 生物学帮助我们了解动植物如何生活。

biotechnology.example: Modern biotechnology has changed the way farms grow food.
biotechnology.zh: 现代生物技术改变了农场种植食物的方式。

bird.example: A small bird built a nest in the old tree.
bird.zh: 一只小鸟在老树上筑了巢。

birth.example: The birth of her son changed her daily life.
birth.zh: 儿子的出生改变了她的日常生活。

birthday.example: We made a cake for her birthday last Saturday.
birthday.zh: 上周六我们为她的生日做了蛋糕。

biscuit.example: He ate a biscuit with his tea in the garden.
biscuit.zh: 他在花园里就着茶吃了一块饼干。

bishop.example: He moved his bishop across the board and took the rook.
bishop.zh: 他把象走过棋盘，吃掉了车。

bit.example: She was a bit tired after the long walk.
bit.zh: 走了很长的路后她有点累了。

bitch.example: The bitch kept a close watch over her three puppies.
bitch.zh: 那只母狗仔细看护着她的三只小狗。

bite.example: The little dog tried to bite the soft ball.
bite.zh: 小狗试着去咬那个软球。

bitter.example: The medicine left a bitter taste in my mouth.
bitter.zh: 这药在我嘴里留下了一股苦味。

bizarre.example: The shop sells a bizarre mix of old toys and clocks.
bizarre.zh: 这家店卖旧玩具和钟表等稀奇古怪的东西。

black.example: She wore a black coat and a red scarf.
black.zh: 她穿了一件黑外套，围了一条红围巾。

blackboard.example: The teacher wrote the new words on the blackboard.
blackboard.zh: 老师把生词写在黑板上。

blackmail.example: The manager denied that the letter was an attempt at blackmail.
blackmail.zh: 经理否认那封信是一次勒索企图。

blade.example: A single blade of grass grew between the stones.
blade.zh: 两块石头之间长出了一片草叶。

blame.example: Do not blame the child for the broken glass.
blame.zh: 不要为碎了的玻璃杯责怪孩子。

blank.example: Please write your name in the blank space below.
blank.zh: 请在下面的空白处写上你的名字。

blanket.example: She pulled a warm blanket over the sleeping child.
blanket.zh: 她把暖和的毛毯盖在睡着的孩子身上。

blast.example: A blast of cold wind blew the door open.

blaze.example: A warm blaze burned in the fireplace all evening.
blaze.zh: 壁炉里温暖的火焰整晚燃烧着。

bleach.example: She used bleach to clean the white kitchen floor.
bleach.zh: 她用漂白剂清洗白色的厨房地板。

bleak.example: The garden looked bleak and cold in the winter wind.
bleak.zh: 花园在冬风中显得萧瑟而寒冷。

bleed.example: The cut on her hand began to bleed again.
bleed.zh: 她手上的伤口又开始流血了。

blend.example: Blend the flour and milk together until smooth.
blend.zh: 把面粉和牛奶混合搅拌至顺滑。

bless.example: Her grandmother blessed the new house before they moved in.
bless.zh: 他们搬进去之前，她的祖母为新房子祝福。

blind.example: The blind man walked slowly with a white stick.
blind.zh: 那位盲人拄着白色手杖慢慢走着。

blink.example: She did not blink when the bright light flashed.
blink.zh: 亮光闪过时她没有眨眼。

bloc.example: The farmers formed a bloc to protect their shared interests.
bloc.zh: 农民们组成了一个集团来维护共同利益。

block.example: A fallen tree blocked the road for two hours.
block.zh: 一棵倒下的树把路堵了两个小时。

blog.example: She writes a blog about cooking and small gardens.
blog.zh: 她写一个关于烹饪和小花园的博客。

blond.example: The little girl has long blond hair and blue eyes.
blond.zh: 那个小女孩有长长的金发和蓝眼睛。

blood.example: The doctor took a small amount of blood from his arm.
blood.zh: 医生从他手臂上取了一点血。

bloom.example: The roses in the garden bloom every spring.
bloom.zh: 花园里的玫瑰每年春天开花。

blossom.example: The apple trees blossom in early spring every year.

blouse.example: She wore a white blouse and a dark skirt.
blouse.zh: 她穿了一件白衬衫和一条深色裙子。

blow.example: The wind began to blow hard across the field.
blow.zh: 风开始猛烈地吹过田野。

blue.example: The sky was clear and blue after the rain.

blueprint.example: The architect showed us the blueprint of the new house.
blueprint.zh: 建筑师给我们看了新房子的蓝图。

bluff.example: He said he knew the answer, but it was a bluff.
bluff.zh: 他说他知道答案，但那只是虚张声势。

blunder.example: The manager made a serious blunder in the report.
blunder.zh: 经理在报告中犯了一个严重的错误。

blunt.example: The knife was too blunt to cut the bread.
blunt.zh: 这把刀太钝了，切不动面包。

blur.example: Tears began to blur the words on the page.
blur.zh: 泪水开始使书页上的字变得模糊。

blush.example: She began to blush when everyone looked at her.
blush.zh: 每个人都看着她时，她开始脸红了。

board.example: He put the notice on the board near the door.
board.zh: 他把通知贴在了门边的公告板上。

boast.example: He likes to boast about his new car to friends.
boast.zh: 他喜欢向朋友们炫耀他的新车。

boat.example: They took a small boat across the quiet lake.
boat.zh: 他们乘一条小船横渡平静的湖面。

body.example: Regular exercise keeps your body strong and healthy.
body.zh: 经常锻炼让你的身体强壮健康。

boil.example: Please boil the water before you make the tea.
boil.zh: 泡茶之前请先把水烧开。

bold.example: It was a bold decision to leave his old job.
bold.zh: 辞掉旧工作是一个大胆的决定。

bolster.example: The new facts helped to bolster his earlier argument.
bolster.zh: 新的事实帮助支持了他先前的论点。

bolt.example: He pushed the bolt across the door before sleeping.
bolt.zh: 睡觉前他把门闩推上了。

bomb.example: The workers dug up an old bomb near the river.
bomb.zh: 工人们在河边挖出了一枚旧炸弹。

bond.example: A strong bond grew between the two old friends.
bond.zh: 两位老朋友之间形成了牢固的纽带。

bone.example: The dog buried a bone under the old tree.
bone.zh: 狗把一根骨头埋在老树下。

bonus.example: Every worker received a small bonus at the end of the year.
bonus.zh: 每个工人在年底都拿到了一笔小额奖金。

book.example: She read the whole book in one quiet evening.
book.zh: 她在一个安静的晚上读完了整本书。

boom.example: The small town saw a building boom last year.
boom.zh: 这个小镇去年经历了一轮建筑热潮。

boost.example: The good news gave her confidence a real boost.
boost.zh: 这个好消息让她的信心大增。

boot.example: He cleaned the mud off his boots at the door.
boot.zh: 他在门口把靴子上的泥擦掉了。

booth.example: We waited in the phone booth for ten minutes.
booth.zh: 我们在电话亭里等了十分钟。

border.example: A low wall marks the border of the two gardens.
border.zh: 一道矮墙标出了两个花园的边界。

bore.example: Long speeches always bore the students in the morning class.
bore.zh: 冗长的讲话总让早课上的学生感到厌烦。

boring.example: The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
boring.zh: 那部电影太无聊了，我睡着了。

born.example: She was born in a small village near the sea.
born.zh: 她出生在海边的一个小村庄。

borrow.example: May I borrow your pen for a moment, please?
borrow.zh: 我可以借你的笔用一下吗？

boss.example: My boss asked me to finish the report today.
boss.zh: 我的老板让我今天完成报告。

botany.example: She studies botany and knows the names of many plants.
botany.zh: 她学习植物学，知道许多植物的名字。

both.example: Both children helped their mother wash the dishes.
both.zh: 两个孩子都帮妈妈洗碗。

bother.example: Please do not bother your sister while she studies.
bother.zh: 你姐姐学习时请不要打扰她。

bottle.example: He filled the bottle with cold water before the trip.
bottle.zh: 出发前他把瓶子装满了凉水。

bottom.example: The key fell to the bottom of the bag.

bounce.example: The ball began to bounce down the stone steps.
bounce.zh: 球开始顺着石阶往下弹跳。

bound.example: Every member is bound by the rules of the club.
bound.zh: 每个成员都受俱乐部规则的约束。

boundary.example: The river forms the boundary between the two farms.
boundary.zh: 这条河形成两个农场之间的分界线。

bouquet.example: He gave her a bouquet of fresh red flowers.
bouquet.zh: 他送给她一束新鲜的红花。

bout.example: He missed a week of work after a bad bout of flu.
bout.zh: 得了一场重感冒后，他一周没上班。

bow.example: The actor gave a low bow after the play ended.
bow.zh: 演出结束后，演员深深地鞠了一躬。

bowel.example: The doctor explained how the bowel helps the body digest food.
bowel.zh: 医生解释了肠道如何帮助身体消化食物。

bowl.example: She put the hot soup into a large bowl.
bowl.zh: 她把热汤盛进一个大碗里。

box.example: He kept the old letters in a small box.
box.zh: 他把旧信件放在一个小盒子里。

boxing.example: He watched a boxing match on television last night.
boxing.zh: 他昨晚在电视上看了一场拳击比赛。

boy.example: The boy carried a heavy bag to the door.
boy.zh: 那个男孩提着一个沉甸甸的袋子走向门口。

boycott.example: Many customers decided to boycott the shop because of poor service.
boycott.zh: 由于服务差，许多顾客决定联合抵制这家店。

brace.example: The workers used a steel brace to hold the wall in place.
brace.zh: 工人们用一根钢支柱把墙固定住。

bracket.example: Please put the extra information in brackets at the end of the sentence.
bracket.zh: 请把额外的信息写在句子末尾的括号里。

brag.example: He likes to brag about his new car to anyone who listens.
brag.zh: 他喜欢向任何愿意听的人吹嘘他的新车。

brain.example: Reading books every day helps keep your brain active and healthy.
brain.zh: 每天读书有助于让大脑保持活跃和健康。

brake.example: The driver hit the brake quickly when a dog ran onto the road.
brake.zh: 一只狗跑到路上时，司机迅速踩下了刹车。

branch.example: A small bird landed on the branch and began to sing.
branch.zh: 一只小鸟落在树枝上，开始唱起歌来。

brand.example: This brand of coffee is popular among young people in our city.
brand.zh: 这个牌子的咖啡在我们城市的年轻人中很受欢迎。

brand-new.example: He bought a brand-new bicycle and rides it to work every day.
brand-new.zh: 他买了一辆崭新的自行车，每天骑着它去上班。

brandy.example: My uncle keeps a bottle of brandy for special family dinners.
brandy.zh: 我叔叔留着一瓶白兰地，专门在家里特别聚餐时喝。

brass.example: The door handle is made of brass and shines in the light.
brass.zh: 门把手是黄铜做的，在光线下闪闪发亮。

brave.example: It was brave of her to speak in front of the whole class.
brave.zh: 她敢在全班同学面前发言，真是勇敢。

breach.example: Sharing private information is a serious breach of trust between friends.
breach.zh: 泄露私人信息是对朋友之间信任的严重破坏。

bread.example: She bought fresh bread and milk on her way home from work.
bread.zh: 她下班回家的路上买了新鲜面包和牛奶。

break.example: Let us take a short break after two hours of study.
break.zh: 我们学习两个小时后休息一下吧。

breakdown.example: A sudden breakdown of the machine stopped the whole production line.
breakdown.zh: 机器突然发生故障，整条生产线都停了下来。

breakfast.example: We usually have breakfast at seven and leave home at eight.
breakfast.zh: 我们通常七点吃早餐，八点出门。

breakthrough.example: Scientists made an important breakthrough in the study of clean energy.
breakthrough.zh: 科学家在清洁能源研究方面取得了重要突破。

breast.example: She held the baby gently against her breast and sang softly.
breast.zh: 她把婴儿轻轻抱在胸前，柔声唱着歌。

breath.example: Take a deep breath and try to relax before the test.
breath.zh: 考试前深吸一口气，试着放松下来。

breathe.example: It is hard to breathe in such a small and crowded room.
breathe.zh: 在这么小又拥挤的房间里很难呼吸。

breed.example: This breed of dog is gentle and very good with children.
breed.zh: 这个品种的狗性情温和，很会跟孩子相处。

breeze.example: A cool breeze came through the window and moved the curtains.
breeze.zh: 一阵凉风吹进窗户，掀动了窗帘。

brew.example: My grandfather likes to brew tea in a small clay pot.
brew.zh: 我爷爷喜欢用小陶壶泡茶。

bribe.example: The manager refused the bribe and reported the matter to the police.
bribe.zh: 经理拒绝了贿赂，并把这件事报告给了警方。

brick.example: The old house was built with red brick and a wooden roof.
brick.zh: 这座老房子是用红砖和木屋顶建成的。

bride.example: The bride wore a simple white dress and carried a small bouquet.
bride.zh: 新娘穿着一条简单的白裙子，手里拿着一小束花。

bridegroom.example: The bridegroom waited at the front of the hall with a smile.
bridegroom.zh: 新郎微笑着在大厅前方等候。

bridge.example: A new bridge across the river will open to traffic next month.
bridge.zh: 一座横跨这条河的新桥将于下个月通车。

brief.example: The manager gave a brief talk about the new plan.
brief.zh: 经理就新计划作了简短的讲话。

briefcase.example: He put his laptop and papers into his black briefcase.
briefcase.zh: 他把笔记本电脑和文件放进了黑色的公事包里。

brigade.example: A brigade of volunteers helped clean the park on Sunday morning.
brigade.zh: 一队志愿者在周日早上帮忙打扫了公园。

bright.example: The room is bright because the windows face the morning sun.
bright.zh: 这个房间很明亮，因为窗户朝着早晨的太阳。

brilliant.example: She came up with a brilliant idea to save both time and money.
brilliant.zh: 她想出了一个既能省时又能省钱的绝妙主意。

bring.example: Please bring your notebook and a pen to every class.
bring.zh: 请每次上课都带上笔记本和一支笔。

brink.example: The company was on the brink of closing when new money arrived.
brink.zh: 新资金到位时，这家公司正处在倒闭的边缘。

brisk.example: A brisk walk in the morning helps me feel awake all day.
brisk.zh: 早上快走一会儿能让我一整天都精神。

broad.example: The river is very broad here, so the ferry takes ten minutes.
broad.zh: 这里的河面很宽，所以渡船要开十分钟。

broadcast.example: The station will broadcast the concert live on Saturday evening.
broadcast.zh: 电台将在周六晚上现场直播这场音乐会。

brochure.example: She picked up a travel brochure and read about the mountain village.
brochure.zh: 她拿起一本旅游小册子，读起了关于那个山村的内容。

broke.example: After paying the rent, he was completely broke for a week.
broke.zh: 交完房租后，他整整一个星期都身无分文。

broker.example: The broker helped us find a small flat near the station.
broker.zh: 经纪人帮我们找到了一套车站附近的小公寓。

bronze.example: The statue in the park is made of bronze and looks dark green.
bronze.zh: 公园里的那座雕像是青铜做的，看起来是深绿色。

brood.example: The hen gathered her brood under her wings at sunset.
brood.zh: 日落时，母鸡把一窝小鸡拢到翅膀下。

broom.example: She used a long broom to sweep the leaves off the path.
broom.zh: 她用一把长扫帚把小路上的叶子扫干净。

brother.example: My brother is two years older and studies at the same school.
brother.zh: 我哥哥比我大两岁，在同一所学校读书。

brow.example: He wiped the sweat from his brow and continued running.
brow.zh: 他擦了擦额头上的汗，继续往前跑。

brown.example: The leaves turn brown and fall from the trees in autumn.
brown.zh: 秋天，树叶变成褐色，从树上落下来。

browse.example: I like to browse the small bookshops on Sunday afternoons.
browse.zh: 我喜欢在周日下午逛逛那些小书店。

bruise.example: A dark bruise appeared on her arm after the fall.
bruise.zh: 摔倒之后，她的手臂上出现了一块深色的淤青。

brunch.example: We had brunch at a quiet cafe and then walked by the river.
brunch.zh: 我们在一家安静的咖啡馆吃了早午餐，然后沿着河边散步。

brush.example: Please brush your teeth twice a day, morning and night.
brush.zh: 请每天早晚各刷一次牙。

brutal.example: Some video games show brutal scenes that are not suitable for children.
brutal.zh: 有些电子游戏里有不适合儿童的残忍场面。

bubble.example: A soap bubble floated slowly across the room and then popped.
bubble.zh: 一个肥皂泡慢慢飘过房间，然后破了。

buck.example: He sold his old bike for twenty bucks and bought a new bag.
buck.zh: 他把旧自行车卖了二十块钱，买了一个新包。

bucket.example: He filled a bucket with water and washed the dirty floor.
bucket.zh: 他把桶里装满水，擦洗了脏污的地板。

buckle.example: She fastened the buckle on her bag before leaving the house.
buckle.zh: 出门前她扣好了包上的带扣。

bud.example: Small green buds appear on the trees early in spring.
bud.zh: 早春时，树上长出绿色的小芽。

Buddhism.example: Buddhism spread slowly across many countries along ancient trade routes.
Buddhism.zh: 佛教沿着古代商路缓慢传播到许多国家。

buddy.example: My buddy and I often play football after class on Fridays.
buddy.zh: 我和好朋友经常在周五下课后踢足球。

budget.example: We must keep the trip within our budget of five hundred dollars.
budget.zh: 我们必须把这次旅行控制在五百美元的预算之内。

buffalo.example: A buffalo stood quietly in the shallow water near the field.
buffalo.zh: 一头水牛静静地站在田边浅浅的水里。

buffer.example: The extra money acts as a buffer when prices go up.
buffer.zh: 物价上涨时，这笔额外的钱能起到缓冲作用。

buffet.example: The hotel offers a breakfast buffet with fruit, bread and juice.
buffet.zh: 这家酒店提供自助早餐，有水果、面包和果汁。

bug.example: A software bug caused the program to close without warning.
bug.zh: 一个软件错误导致程序毫无提示地关闭了。

build.example: They plan to build a new library on the empty land.
build.zh: 他们计划在这块空地上建一座新图书馆。

bulb.example: Please change the light bulb in the kitchen; it is broken.
bulb.zh: 请换一下厨房的灯泡，它坏了。

bulk.example: The bulk of the work was finished before the weekend.
bulk.zh: 大部分工作在周末之前就完成了。

bull.example: The farmer led the bull into the field beside the barn.
bull.zh: 农夫把公牛牵到谷仓旁边的地里。

bullet.example: A bullet is a small piece of metal fired from a gun.
bullet.zh: 子弹是从枪里发射出来的一小块金属。

bulletin.example: A notice was posted on the bulletin board near the main door.
bulletin.zh: 大门附近的公告栏上贴了一张通知。

bully.example: Some older students used to bully the younger boys after school.
bully.zh: 以前有些高年级学生放学后欺负低年级的男孩。

bump.example: He got a small bump on his head when he stood up.
bump.zh: 他站起来时头上撞出了一个小肿块。

bumper.example: The front bumper of the car was damaged in the parking lot.
bumper.zh: 这辆车的前保险杠在停车场被撞坏了。

bunch.example: She bought a bunch of yellow flowers for her mother's birthday.
bunch.zh: 她为妈妈的生日买了一束黄色的花。

bundle.example: He carried a bundle of old newspapers to the recycling bin.
bundle.zh: 他把一捆旧报纸拿到了回收箱那里。

burden.example: The heavy bag became a burden after two hours of walking.
burden.zh: 走了两个小时后，那个沉重的包成了负担。

bureau.example: The weather bureau warned that heavy rain would arrive by evening.
bureau.zh: 气象局警告说傍晚前会有大雨。

bureaucrat.example: The young bureaucrat spent the morning answering letters from citizens.
bureaucrat.zh: 那位年轻的官员整个上午都在回复市民的来信。

burglar.example: The burglar entered the house through an open kitchen window.
burglar.zh: 窃贼是从一扇没关的厨房窗户进入房子的。

burn.example: Be careful not to burn the bread under the hot grill.
burn.zh: 小心别让面包在滚烫的烤架下烤焦。

burst.example: The pipe burst, and water ran across the kitchen floor.
burst.zh: 管子爆裂了，水流满了厨房的地面。

bury.example: The children like to bury their toys in the warm sand.
bury.zh: 孩子们喜欢把玩具埋在暖暖的沙子里。

bus.example: I take the bus to work every morning at eight.
bus.zh: 我每天早上八点坐公共汽车去上班。

bush.example: A small cat was hiding under the bush in our garden.
bush.zh: 一只小猫躲在我们花园的灌木丛下。

business.example: He started a small business selling fresh bread and cakes.
business.zh: 他做起了小本生意，卖新鲜面包和蛋糕。

businessman.example: The businessman travelled to three cities in a single week.
businessman.zh: 这位商人一个星期内去了三座城市。

bust.example: A marble bust of the writer stood in the corner of the library.
bust.zh: 图书馆的角落里立着这位作家的半身像。

busy.example: The streets are very busy during the morning rush hour.
busy.zh: 早高峰时，街上非常繁忙。

but.example: I wanted to buy the coat, but it was too expensive for me.
but.zh: 我想买那件外套，但它对我来说太贵了。

butcher.example: The butcher cut the meat into thin slices for us.
butcher.zh: 肉商帮我们把肉切成了薄片。

butt.example: He put out the cigarette butt carefully before leaving the room.
butt.zh: 他离开房间前小心地把烟头掐灭了。

butter.example: Spread a little butter on the warm bread and enjoy it.
butter.zh: 在温热的面包上抹一点黄油，好好享用吧。

butterfly.example: A colourful butterfly landed on the flower and stayed there.
butterfly.zh: 一只色彩鲜艳的蝴蝶落在花上，停在那里不动。

button.example: Press the green button to start the machine again.
button.zh: 按下绿色按钮，重新启动机器。

buy.example: I need to buy some milk and eggs on the way home.
buy.zh: 我回家路上需要买些牛奶和鸡蛋。

buzz.example: The bees buzz around the garden from morning until evening.
buzz.zh: 蜜蜂从早到晚在花园里嗡嗡地飞。

by.example: The book was written by a teacher who lives in a small town.
by.zh: 这本书由一位住在小镇的老师所写。

bypass.example: Drivers can bypass the busy centre by taking the new road.
bypass.zh: 司机可以走新路绕开拥挤的市中心。

bystander.example: A bystander called the hospital when the old man fell.
bystander.zh: 老人摔倒时，一位旁观者打电话叫了医院。

cab.example: We took a cab from the station to the hotel.
cab.zh: 我们从车站打车去了酒店。

cabbage.example: My mother cooks cabbage with a little garlic and oil.
cabbage.zh: 我妈妈做卷心菜时只放一点蒜和油。

cabin.example: They spent the weekend in a small wooden cabin by the lake.
cabin.zh: 他们在一个湖边的小木屋里度过了周末。

cabinet.example: The cups are kept in the glass cabinet above the sink.
cabinet.zh: 杯子放在水槽上方的玻璃橱柜里。

cable.example: A long cable connects the computer to the printer on the desk.
cable.zh: 一根长电缆把电脑和桌上的打印机连接起来。

cafe.example: We met at a small cafe near the river and talked for hours.
cafe.zh: 我们约在河边一家小咖啡馆见面，聊了好几个小时。

cafeteria.example: Students can buy hot meals in the school cafeteria at noon.
cafeteria.zh: 学生中午可以在学校自助餐厅买到热饭。

cage.example: The bird flew out of the open cage and into the garden.
cage.zh: 鸟从打开的笼子里飞了出来，飞进了花园。

cake.example: She baked a chocolate cake for her sister's birthday party.
cake.zh: 她为妹妹的生日聚会烤了一个巧克力蛋糕。

calcium.example: Milk and cheese are good sources of calcium for growing children.
calcium.zh: 牛奶和奶酪是成长中的儿童补充钙的良好来源。

calculate.example: Please calculate the total cost of the trip before we book.
calculate.zh: 请在我们预订之前算出这次出行的总费用。

calendar.example: I marked the meeting on my calendar so I would remember.
calendar.zh: 我把会议标记在日历上，这样就不会忘记。

calf.example: The calf stayed close to its mother in the green field.
calf.zh: 那头小牛紧挨着妈妈，待在绿油油的田野里。

call.example: I will call you tomorrow morning after the meeting ends.
call.zh: 会议结束后，我明天早上给你打电话。

calling.example: Teaching is a calling that requires patience and real love.
calling.zh: 教书是一份需要耐心和真挚热爱的职业。

calm.example: Try to stay calm and speak slowly when you feel nervous.
calm.zh: 感到紧张时，尽量保持平静并慢慢说话。

calorie.example: A short walk can burn about a hundred calories for most people.
calorie.zh: 对大多数人来说，散一会儿步就能消耗大约一百卡路里。

camel.example: The camel walked slowly across the hot sand without water.
camel.zh: 骆驼没喝水，慢慢走过滚烫的沙地。

camera.example: She took her camera to the park to photograph the flowers.
camera.zh: 她带着相机去公园拍花。

camp.example: We set up camp near the river and cooked dinner outside.
camp.zh: 我们在河边扎营，在户外做了晚饭。

campaign.example: The school started a campaign to reduce paper waste.
campaign.zh: 学校发起了一场减少纸张浪费的活动。

campus.example: The new library is the quietest place on the whole campus.
campus.zh: 新图书馆是整个校园里最安静的地方。

can.example: She can speak three languages and often helps visitors at the museum.
can.zh: 她会说三种语言，经常在博物馆帮助参观者。

canal.example: Narrow boats still travel along the old canal through the city.
canal.zh: 窄船仍然沿着贯穿城市的旧运河航行。

cancel.example: They had to cancel the picnic because of the heavy rain.
cancel.zh: 因为大雨，他们不得不取消野餐。

cancer.example: Doctors are working hard to find better treatments for cancer.
cancer.zh: 医生们正在努力寻找治疗癌症的更好方法。

candidate.example: Each candidate gave a short speech before the students voted.
candidate.zh: 每位候选人都在学生投票前做了简短的演讲。

candle.example: She lit a candle when the lights went out during the storm.
candle.zh: 暴风雨中停电时，她点了一支蜡烛。

candy.example: The children were given a small bag of candy after lunch.
candy.zh: 午饭后，孩子们拿到了一小袋糖果。

cane.example: The old man walked slowly with a wooden cane in his hand.
cane.zh: 那位老人手里拿着一根木手杖，慢慢走着。

cannon.example: The old cannon stands in the square as a reminder of history.
cannon.zh: 那门旧大炮立在广场上，作为历史的见证。

canoe.example: We crossed the lake in a small canoe before sunset.
canoe.zh: 日落前我们乘一只小独木舟渡过了湖。

canteen.example: We ate lunch in the staff canteen on the second floor.
canteen.zh: 我们在二楼的工作人员食堂吃了午饭。

canvas.example: The artist painted a quiet river scene on a large canvas.
canvas.zh: 画家在一张大画布上画了一幅宁静的河景。

cap.example: He took off his cap when he entered the warm room.
cap.zh: 他走进温暖的房间时摘下了帽子。

capable.example: She is capable of finishing the report by herself.
capable.zh: 她有能力独自完成这份报告。

capacity.example: The hall has a capacity of five hundred people.
capacity.zh: 这个大厅能容纳五百人。

cape.example: She wore a red cape over her dress on the cold night.
cape.zh: 寒冷的夜里，她在裙子外面披了一件红色披肩。

capital.example: Every sentence should begin with a capital letter in English writing.
capital.zh: 在英文写作中，每个句子都应该以大写字母开头。

capsule.example: Take one capsule with water after each meal, the doctor said.
capsule.zh: 医生说，每餐后用水送服一粒胶囊。

captain.example: The captain told the passengers to stay calm during the storm.
captain.zh: 船长让乘客们在暴风雨中保持镇静。

caption.example: The picture has a short caption that explains where it was taken.
caption.zh: 这张照片有一行简短的说明，解释了拍摄地点。

captive.example: The birds were kept captive in small cages for many years.
captive.zh: 这些鸟被关在小笼子里很多年。

capture.example: The camera can capture every small detail of the moving scene.
capture.zh: 这台相机能捕捉到运动场景中的每一个小细节。

car.example: They parked the car outside the shop and went inside.
car.zh: 他们把车停在商店外面，然后走了进去。

caravan.example: A caravan of trucks carried food to the mountain villages.
caravan.zh: 一支卡车车队把食物运往山村。

carbohydrate.example: Rice and bread are rich in carbohydrate and give us energy.
carbohydrate.zh: 米饭和面包富含碳水化合物，能给我们能量。

carbon.example: Scientists study how much carbon the forest stores in its soil.
carbon.zh: 科学家研究这片森林的土壤里储存了多少碳。

card.example: She sent a birthday card to her friend in another city.
card.zh: 她给另一座城市的朋友寄了一张生日卡片。

cardboard.example: The books were packed in a strong cardboard box for moving.
cardboard.zh: 书被装进一个结实的硬纸板箱里，准备搬家。

cardinal.example: Honesty is a cardinal rule in any close friendship.
cardinal.zh: 诚实是任何亲密友谊中最重要的一条规则。

care.example: She takes good care of the plants on her balcony.
care.zh: 她把阳台上的植物照料得很好。

career.example: He began his career as a teacher in a small town.
career.zh: 他的职业生涯是从一个小镇上的教师开始的。

cargo.example: The ship carried a heavy cargo of grain and wood.
cargo.zh: 这艘船运载着大量谷物和木材货物。

carpenter.example: The carpenter repaired the broken leg of the old table.
carpenter.zh: 木匠修好了那张旧桌子断掉的桌腿。

carpet.example: They laid a soft carpet in the living room last week.
carpet.zh: 上周他们在客厅里铺了一块柔软的地毯。

carriage.example: The old carriage stood in the yard, covered with dust.
carriage.zh: 那辆旧马车停在院子里，落满了灰尘。

carrier.example: The mail carrier comes to our street every morning at nine.
carrier.zh: 邮递员每天早上九点来我们这条街。

carrot.example: She cut a carrot into small pieces for the soup.
carrot.zh: 她把一根胡萝卜切成小块放进汤里。

carry.example: He can carry two heavy bags up the stairs easily.
carry.zh: 他能轻松地把两个沉重的袋子搬上楼梯。

cart.example: He pulled the cart full of vegetables to the market.
cart.zh: 他把装满蔬菜的推车拉到市场去。

carton.example: She put the eggs back into the carton and closed it.
carton.zh: 她把鸡蛋放回纸盒里，然后盖上了盒子。

cartoon.example: My little brother watches a cartoon before he goes to bed.
cartoon.zh: 我弟弟睡觉前会看一部动画片。

carve.example: He likes to carve small birds out of soft wood.
carve.zh: 他喜欢用软木雕刻小鸟。

case.example: In this case, the best choice is to wait one day.
case.zh: 在这种情况下，最好的选择是等一天。

cash.example: I paid in cash because the shop does not take cards.
cash.zh: 我付了现金，因为这家店不收卡。

cashier.example: The cashier smiled and handed me the change and a receipt.
cashier.zh: 出纳员微笑着把零钱和收据递给我。

casino.example: The hotel has a small casino on the ground floor.
casino.zh: 这家酒店的一楼有一个小赌场。

cast.example: The tall tree cast a long shadow across the quiet road.
cast.zh: 那棵高树在安静的路上投下长长的影子。

castle.example: The old castle stands on a hill above the river.
castle.zh: 这座古堡矗立在河上方的山丘上。

casual.example: He wore casual clothes to the party instead of a suit.
casual.zh: 他穿着便装去参加聚会，没有穿西装。

casualty.example: The storm caused only one casualty, and it was a minor injury.
casualty.zh: 这场暴风雨只造成一人受伤，而且伤势很轻。

cat.example: The cat slept on the warm chair for the whole afternoon.
cat.zh: 那只猫在温暖的椅子上睡了整个下午。

catalog.example: The library catalog lists every book on the second floor.
catalog.zh: 图书馆的目录列出了二楼的所有藏书。

catastrophe.example: The flood was a catastrophe for the small farms near the river.
catastrophe.zh: 这场洪水对河边的那些小农场来说是一场大灾难。

catch.example: She ran fast to catch the bus before the door closed.
catch.zh: 她跑得很快，赶在车门关上之前上了公交车。

category.example: Please put each answer in the correct category on the form.
category.zh: 请把每个答案填在表格上正确的类别里。

cater.example: The small hotel can cater for groups of up to fifty people.
cater.zh: 这家小旅馆最多能为五十人的团体提供饮食和服务。

cathedral.example: The cathedral in the old town is famous for its windows.
cathedral.zh: 老城区的大教堂以其窗户而闻名。

Catholic.example: The town has a Catholic school and a small public library.
Catholic.zh: 这个小镇有一所天主教学校和一个小的公共图书馆。

cattle.example: The farmer keeps cattle in the field behind the barn.
cattle.zh: 农夫把牛养在谷仓后面的地里。

cauliflower.example: She added fresh cauliflower and carrots to the hot soup.
cauliflower.zh: 她把新鲜的花椰菜和胡萝卜加进热汤里。

cause.example: Heavy rain can cause problems for drivers on this road.
cause.zh: 大雨会给这条路上的司机带来麻烦。

caution.example: Drive with caution when the road is wet and busy.
caution.zh: 路面湿滑又拥挤时要小心驾驶。

cave.example: We found a cool cave behind the trees near the beach.
cave.zh: 我们在海滩附近的树林后面发现了一个凉爽的山洞。

cavity.example: The dentist found a small cavity in one of my teeth.
cavity.zh: 牙医在我的一颗牙上发现了一个小洞。

cease.example: The noise finally ceased after the workers went home.
cease.zh: 工人们回家之后，噪音终于停止了。

ceiling.example: A bright lamp hangs from the ceiling of the classroom.
ceiling.zh: 教室的天花板上挂着一盏明亮的灯。

celebrate.example: We will celebrate her birthday with a small dinner at home.
celebrate.zh: 我们会在家里用一顿小小的晚餐庆祝她的生日。

celebrity.example: The magazine fills its pages with photos of every celebrity.
celebrity.zh: 这本杂志的每一页都登满了名人的照片。

cell.example: Each cell in the body needs water and oxygen to work.
cell.zh: 身体里的每个细胞都需要水和氧气才能工作。

cell-phone.example: Please turn off your cell-phone before the film starts.
cell-phone.zh: 电影开始前请关掉你的手机。

cellar.example: The old house has a cool cellar under the kitchen.
cellar.zh: 这栋老房子厨房下面有一个凉爽的地窖。

Celsius.example: Water boils at one hundred degrees Celsius at sea level.
