Celsius.zh: 在海平面，水在一百摄氏度时沸腾。

cement.example: The workers mixed cement and sand to build the low wall.
cement.zh: 工人们把水泥和沙子混合起来砌这堵矮墙。

cemetery.example: We walked past the quiet cemetery on our way to the park.
cemetery.zh: 我们去公园的路上经过那片安静的墓地。

censor.example: The editor had to censor a few lines before the book appeared.
censor.zh: 书出版之前，编辑不得不删改了几行内容。

census.example: The national census counts every family and records basic information.
census.zh: 全国人口普查统计每一户人家并记录基本信息。

cent.example: I found a small coin worth one cent under the chair.
cent.zh: 我在椅子下面找到一枚面值一分的硬币。

center.example: The new shopping center has a large car park downstairs.
center.zh: 新的购物中心楼下有一个很大的停车场。

centigrade.example: The temperature dropped to five degrees centigrade during the night.
centigrade.zh: 夜间气温降到了五摄氏度。

centimeter.example: The plant grew about one centimeter in the past week.
centimeter.zh: 这株植物在过去一周里长高了一厘米左右。

century.example: This bridge has stood here for more than a century.
century.zh: 这座桥在这里已经矗立了一百多年。

ceramic.example: The shop sells ceramic bowls made by local artists.
ceramic.zh: 这家店出售当地艺人制作的陶瓷碗。

cereal.example: He eats cereal with milk and fruit every morning.
cereal.zh: 他每天早上吃加牛奶和水果的麦片。

ceremony.example: The award ceremony will begin at seven in the hall.
ceremony.zh: 颁奖典礼将于七点在大厅开始。

certain.example: I am certain that I left my keys on this table.
certain.zh: 我确定我把钥匙放在了这张桌子上。

certificate.example: She received a certificate after finishing the training course.
certificate.zh: 她完成培训课程后拿到了一张证书。

certify.example: The doctor can certify that he is well enough to travel.
certify.zh: 医生可以证明他身体状况良好，可以出行。

chain.example: The gate was held shut by a heavy metal chain.
chain.zh: 大门被一条沉重的金属链锁着。

chair.example: He pushed his chair back and stood up to speak.
chair.zh: 他把椅子往后一推，站起来发言。

chairman.example: The chairman opened the meeting and read the first item.
chairman.zh: 主席宣布会议开始，并宣读了第一项议题。

chalk.example: The teacher wrote the new words on the board with chalk.
chalk.zh: 老师用粉笔把新单词写在黑板上。

challenge.example: Learning a new language is a challenge that takes time.
challenge.zh: 学习一门新语言是一项需要时间的挑战。

chamber.example: The old building has a small chamber behind the main hall.
chamber.zh: 这栋老建筑在主厅后面有一个小房间。

champagne.example: They opened a bottle of champagne to celebrate the good news.
champagne.zh: 他们开了一瓶香槟来庆祝这个好消息。

champion.example: She became the champion after winning three matches in a row.
champion.zh: 她连赢三场比赛后成为了冠军。

chance.example: This is a good chance to practice your English with others.
chance.zh: 这是一个和别人一起练习英语的好机会。

chancellor.example: The chancellor of the university spoke to the new students.
chancellor.zh: 这所大学的校长对新学生讲了话。

change.example: The weather can change quickly in the mountains in spring.
change.zh: 春天山里的天气变化很快。

channel.example: This television channel shows old films every Sunday evening.
channel.zh: 这个电视频道每周日晚上播放老电影。

chant.example: The crowd began to chant the name of their favorite team.
chant.zh: 人群开始反复高喊他们最喜欢的球队的名字。

chaos.example: The kitchen was in chaos after the party last night.
chaos.zh: 昨晚聚会之后，厨房里一片狼藉。

chapel.example: A small chapel stands beside the garden at the edge of town.
chapel.zh: 小镇边上有一座小教堂，就在花园旁边。

chapter.example: I read one chapter of the book before going to sleep.
chapter.zh: 我睡前读了这本书的一章。

character.example: The main character in the story is a young teacher.
character.zh: 这个故事的主角是一位年轻的老师。

charge.example: The hotel adds a small charge for breakfast and parking.
charge.zh: 酒店会为早餐和停车加收一小笔费用。

charity.example: She gives a little money to charity every month.
charity.zh: 她每个月都捐一点钱给慈善机构。

charm.example: The old town has a quiet charm that visitors love.
charm.zh: 这座老城有一种安静的魅力，游客们很喜欢。

chart.example: The chart shows how sales changed over the past year.
chart.zh: 这张图表显示了过去一年销量的变化。

charter.example: The club wrote a charter that every member must follow.
charter.zh: 俱乐部制定了一份全体成员都必须遵守的章程。

chase.example: The dog ran across the field to chase a brown rabbit.
chase.zh: 那只狗跑过田地追赶一只棕色兔子。

chat.example: We sat in the kitchen and had a chat about school.
chat.zh: 我们坐在厨房里聊了聊学校的事。

cheap.example: This bag is cheap, but it still looks quite good.
cheap.zh: 这个包很便宜，但看起来还不错。

cheat.example: It is wrong to cheat in a test or a game.
cheat.zh: 在考试或比赛中作弊是不对的。

check.example: Please check your answers before you hand in the paper.
check.zh: 交卷之前请检查你的答案。

cheek.example: A tear ran down her cheek when she heard the news.
cheek.zh: 听到那个消息时，一滴泪水顺着她的脸颊流下来。

cheer.example: The good news made everyone cheer and laugh together.
cheer.zh: 这个好消息让大家一起欢呼大笑。

cheese.example: He cut a thin slice of cheese for his sandwich.
cheese.zh: 他切了一片薄薄的奶酪夹进三明治里。

chef.example: The chef prepared a simple meal with fresh vegetables.
chef.zh: 厨师用新鲜蔬菜做了一顿简单的饭。

chemistry.example: She studies chemistry and biology at the local college.
chemistry.zh: 她在当地的学院学习化学和生物。

cherish.example: I will always cherish the memories of that long summer.
cherish.zh: 我会永远珍爱那个漫长夏天的回忆。

chess.example: He taught me to play chess on a rainy afternoon.
chess.zh: 他在一个下雨的下午教我下国际象棋。

chest.example: He put his hand on his chest and took a deep breath.
chest.zh: 他把手放在胸口，深吸了一口气。

chew.example: Chew your food slowly so that you can enjoy it.
chew.zh: 慢慢咀嚼食物，这样才能好好享受。

chicken.example: We had chicken and rice for dinner on Sunday evening.
chicken.zh: 周日晚上我们吃了鸡肉和米饭。

chief.example: Our chief concern is the safety of the young children.
chief.zh: 我们最主要的关心是孩子们的安全。

child.example: Every child in the class received a small gift from the teacher.
child.zh: 班上的每个孩子都收到了老师的一份小礼物。

chill.example: There was a chill in the air when we left the house.
chill.zh: 我们出门时，空气里带着一丝寒意。

chimney.example: Smoke rose slowly from the chimney of the small house.
chimney.zh: 烟从那座小房子的烟囱里慢慢升起。

chin.example: He rested his chin on his hand and looked outside.
chin.zh: 他把下巴搁在手上，望向外面。

china.example: The shelf holds a set of fine china from her family.
china.zh: 架子上放着她家传下来的一套精美瓷器。

chip.example: A small chip broke off the edge of the blue cup.
chip.zh: 蓝色杯子的边缘崩掉了一小块。

chocolate.example: She gave him a bar of chocolate as a small gift.
chocolate.zh: 她送给他一块巧克力作为小礼物。

choice.example: You have a choice between tea and coffee this morning.
choice.zh: 今天早上你可以在茶和咖啡之间选一个。

choir.example: The school choir will sing at the ceremony on Friday.
choir.zh: 学校合唱团将在周五的典礼上演唱。

choke.example: The thick smoke made her choke, so she opened the window.
choke.zh: 浓烟呛得她喘不过气，于是她打开了窗户。

cholesterol.example: Too much fried food can raise the cholesterol level in your blood.
cholesterol.zh: 吃太多油炸食品会升高血液中的胆固醇水平。

choose.example: You may choose any seat you like in the front row.
choose.zh: 前排的任何座位你都可以随便选。

chop.example: He used a sharp knife to chop the onions very finely.
chop.zh: 他用一把快刀把洋葱剁得很碎。

chopstick.example: He picked up the noodles with wooden chopsticks and smiled.
chopstick.zh: 他用木筷子夹起面条，笑了起来。

chord.example: He played a soft chord on the piano and began to sing.
chord.zh: 他在钢琴上弹了一个柔和的和弦，然后开始唱歌。

chore.example: Washing the dishes is my least favorite chore at home.
chore.zh: 洗碗是我在家里最不喜欢的家务。

chorus.example: The whole class joined the chorus and sang the last line.
chorus.zh: 全班一起加入合唱，唱了最后一句。

Christ.example: The old painting shows Christ with a small group of followers.
Christ.zh: 这幅古画描绘的是基督和一小群追随者。

chronic.example: He has a chronic cough that gets worse in cold weather.
chronic.zh: 他有慢性咳嗽，天冷时会加重。

chronicle.example: The old book is a chronicle of daily life in the village.
chronicle.zh: 这本古书是一部记录村庄日常生活的编年史。

chunk.example: She cut a large chunk of bread and put it on the plate.
chunk.zh: 她切下一大块面包放在盘子里。

church.example: The old church on the hill is open every afternoon.
church.zh: 山上的那座老教堂每天下午开放。

cigar.example: An old man sat outside the shop and smoked a cigar.
cigar.zh: 一位老人坐在店外抽着雪茄。

cigaret.example: He put a cigaret in his pocket and left the room.
cigaret.zh: 他把一支香烟放进口袋，然后离开了房间。

cinema.example: We went to the cinema to see a new comedy film.
cinema.zh: 我们去电影院看了一部新的喜剧片。

circle.example: The children sat in a circle on the classroom floor.
circle.zh: 孩子们在教室地板上围坐成一个圆圈。

circuit.example: A loose wire broke the circuit and the lamp went out.
circuit.zh: 一根松动的电线断了电路，灯就灭了。

circulate.example: Fresh air circulates through the room when the window is open.
circulate.zh: 窗户打开时，新鲜空气会在房间里流通。

circumstance.example: Under these circumstances, we should wait until tomorrow morning.
circumstance.zh: 在这种情况下，我们应该等到明天早上。

circus.example: The children loved the circus, especially the funny little clowns.
circus.zh: 孩子们很喜欢马戏团，尤其是那些滑稽的小丑。

cite.example: The writer likes to cite old books in her short articles.
cite.zh: 这位作家喜欢在她的短文中引用旧书。

citizen.example: Every citizen can use the public library for free.
citizen.zh: 每位公民都可以免费使用公共图书馆。

city.example: The city is quiet on Sunday mornings in early summer.
city.zh: 初夏的周日早晨，这座城市很安静。

civic.example: The mayor praised the civic spirit of the many volunteers.
civic.zh: 市长赞扬了众多志愿者的市民精神。

civil.example: He remained civil to everyone, even during the long argument.
civil.zh: 即使在长时间的争论中，他对每个人都保持礼貌。

civilian.example: In that plain jacket he looked like an ordinary civilian.
civilian.zh: 穿着那件朴素的外套，他看起来像个普通平民。

claim.example: She claims that the small bag belongs to her sister.
claim.zh: 她声称那个小包是她妹妹的。

clamp.example: He used a metal clamp to hold the two boards together.
clamp.zh: 他用一个金属夹钳把两块木板夹在一起。

clan.example: The clan has lived in this quiet valley for many years.
clan.zh: 这个氏族在这个安静的山谷里住了很多年。

clap.example: The audience began to clap when the singer finished the song.
clap.zh: 歌手唱完歌时，观众开始鼓掌。

clarity.example: She spoke with such clarity that everyone understood the plan.
clarity.zh: 她讲得如此清楚，每个人都明白了这个计划。

clash.example: The two plans clash, so the team must choose one of them.
clash.zh: 这两个方案相互冲突，所以团队必须从中选一个。

clasp.example: She closed the clasp on her necklace and smiled at the mirror.
clasp.zh: 她扣上项链的扣子，对着镜子笑了。

class.example: Our class will visit the science museum next week.
class.zh: 我们班下周要去参观科学博物馆。

classic.example: This novel is a classic that students still read today.
classic.zh: 这部小说是一部经典，如今学生们仍在读。

classify.example: Scientists classify these animals by their size and diet.
classify.zh: 科学家按体型和食物对这些动物进行分类。

classmate.example: My classmate helped me with the difficult homework yesterday.
classmate.zh: 昨天我的同班同学帮我做了那道难题。

classroom.example: The classroom was bright and clean after the morning break.
classroom.zh: 上午课间休息后，教室里又明亮又干净。

clause.example: This clause in the contract explains how the payment works.
clause.zh: 合同里的这一条款说明了付款方式。

claw.example: The cat sharpened its claw on the wooden leg of the chair.
claw.zh: 猫在椅子的木腿上磨着爪子。

clay.example: The children made small animals from wet clay after school.
clay.zh: 放学后孩子们用湿黏土捏小动物。

clean.example: Please keep the kitchen clean after you finish cooking dinner.
clean.zh: 做完晚饭后请把厨房保持干净。

cleanse.example: Wash your face with warm water to cleanse the skin.
cleanse.zh: 用温水洗脸来清洁皮肤。

clear.example: The instructions are clear, so everyone can follow them easily.
clear.zh: 说明很清楚，所以每个人都能轻松照着做。

clear-cut.example: The board wanted a clear-cut plan before it approved the budget.
clear-cut.zh: 董事会希望先有一份明确的方案，然后才批准预算。

clearance.example: There is only a small clearance between the door and the floor.
clearance.zh: 门和地板之间只有很小的间隙。

clearing.example: We stopped for lunch in a small clearing near the river.
clearing.zh: 我们在河边一小块空地上停下来吃午饭。

clench.example: She had to clench her jaw to stay calm during the long wait.
clench.zh: 她不得不咬紧牙关，在漫长的等待中保持冷静。

clergy.example: Members of the local clergy helped the community rebuild after the storm.
clergy.zh: 当地的神职人员帮助社区在暴风雨后重建。

clerk.example: The clerk at the front desk handed me the room key.
clerk.zh: 前台的职员把房间钥匙递给了我。

clever.example: She is clever enough to solve the puzzle in a minute.
clever.zh: 她足够聪明，一分钟就能解开这个谜题。

cliché.example: The movie used every cliché that fans of the genre know.
cliché.zh: 这部电影把这一类型影迷都熟悉的陈词滥调全用上了。

click.example: Click the button twice to save your changes to the file.
click.zh: 点击按钮两次，把你的修改保存到文件中。

client.example: The client asked us to finish the design by next Friday.
client.zh: 客户要求我们在下周五之前完成设计。

cliff.example: We walked slowly along the cliff and watched the waves below.
cliff.zh: 我们沿着悬崖慢慢走，看着下面的海浪。

climate.example: The climate here is mild, with warm summers and cool winters.
climate.zh: 这里气候温和，夏天温暖，冬天凉爽。

climax.example: The story reaches its climax when the lost letter is found.
climax.zh: 故事在丢失的信被找到时达到高潮。

climb.example: They plan to climb the hill early tomorrow before the heat.
climb.zh: 他们打算明天一早趁天还没热去爬那座小山。

cling.example: Wet clothes cling to your skin on a hot, humid day.
cling.zh: 在又热又潮湿的日子里，湿衣服会紧贴皮肤。

clinic.example: She visited the clinic on Monday to have her ankle checked.
clinic.zh: 她星期一去诊所检查了脚踝。

clip.example: He used a clip to hold the papers together on his desk.
clip.zh: 他用一个夹子把桌上的文件夹在一起。

cloak.example: She wrapped a warm cloak around her shoulders before going outside.
cloak.zh: 她出门前往肩上裹了一件暖和的斗篷。

clock.example: The clock on the wall showed that it was already midnight.
clock.zh: 墙上的时钟显示，当时已经是午夜了。

clockwise.example: Turn the lid clockwise until it is tight and cannot move.
clockwise.zh: 顺时针转动盖子，直到拧紧不能动为止。

clog.example: Leaves clog the drain every autumn and cause small floods.
clog.zh: 每年秋天落叶都会堵住排水口，造成小面积积水。

clone.example: Scientists made a clone of the plant to study its growth.
clone.zh: 科学家培育了这株植物的克隆体来研究它的生长。

close.example: Please close the window before you leave the office tonight.
close.zh: 今晚离开办公室前请把窗户关上。

closet.example: She keeps her winter coats in the closet by the door.
closet.zh: 她把冬天的外套放在门边的壁橱里。

cloth.example: He wiped the table with a soft cloth and warm water.
cloth.zh: 他用一块软布和温水擦了桌子。

clothe.example: The charity helped clothe the children before the cold winter came.
clothe.zh: 慈善机构在寒冬到来前帮助孩子们添置衣物。

clothes.example: She packed some warm clothes for the trip to the mountains.
clothes.zh: 她为去山里的旅行收拾了几件暖和的衣服。

cloud.example: A dark cloud moved over the field and blocked the sun.
cloud.zh: 一片乌云飘过田野上方，遮住了太阳。

clown.example: The clown made the children laugh with a silly dance.
clown.zh: 小丑用滑稽的舞蹈逗得孩子们大笑。

club.example: She joined a reading club that meets every Thursday evening.
club.zh: 她加入了一个每周四晚上活动的读书俱乐部。

clue.example: The first clue was a small note left on the desk.
clue.zh: 第一条线索是留在桌上的一张小纸条。

clumsy.example: His clumsy attempt to fix the lamp broke the glass shade.
clumsy.zh: 他笨拙地想修好台灯，结果打碎了玻璃灯罩。

cluster.example: A cluster of bright stars appeared above the dark hills.
cluster.zh: 一簇明亮的星星出现在黑暗的群山之上。

clutch.example: She had to clutch the rail as the bus turned sharply.
clutch.zh: 公交车猛地转弯时，她不得不抓紧扶手。

coach.example: The coach told the team to rest before the final match.
coach.zh: 教练让队员们在决赛前好好休息。

coal.example: The old train once ran on coal and produced thick smoke.
coal.zh: 这列老火车曾靠煤运行，冒出浓浓的烟。

coalition.example: Several small groups formed a coalition to protect the forest.
coalition.zh: 几个小团体组成了一个联盟来保护这片森林。

coarse.example: The coarse cloth felt rough against my skin at first.
coarse.zh: 这块粗布起初贴在我皮肤上感觉很粗糙。

coast.example: They drove along the coast and stopped at a quiet bay.
coast.zh: 他们沿着海岸开车，在一个安静的海湾停下来。

coat.example: Hang your coat on the hook behind the kitchen door.
coat.zh: 把你的外套挂在厨房门后的钩子上。

cocaine.example: Doctors warn that cocaine can cause serious damage to the heart.
cocaine.zh: 医生警告说，可卡因会对心脏造成严重损害。

cock.example: The cock crowed at sunrise and woke the whole farm.
cock.zh: 公鸡在日出时打鸣，把整个农场都叫醒了。

cockpit.example: The pilot checked every screen in the cockpit before takeoff.
cockpit.zh: 起飞前，飞行员检查了驾驶舱里的每一块屏幕。

cocktail.example: He mixed a simple cocktail with juice and ice for the party.
cocktail.zh: 他为聚会用果汁和冰调了一杯简单的鸡尾酒。

coconut.example: We drank fresh coconut water after the long walk on the beach.
coconut.zh: 我们在海滩上走了很久之后喝了新鲜的椰子水。

code.example: The door opens only when you enter the correct code.
code.zh: 只有输入正确的密码，门才会打开。

coexist.example: Wild animals and farmers can coexist if both sides are careful.
coexist.zh: 如果双方都小心，野生动物和农民可以共存。

coffee.example: I drink a cup of coffee every morning before I start work.
coffee.zh: 我每天早上开始工作前都会喝一杯咖啡。

cognitive.example: Reading aloud can improve cognitive skills in young children.
cognitive.zh: 朗读可以提高幼儿的认知能力。

coherent.example: His report was clear and coherent from start to finish.
coherent.zh: 他的报告从头到尾清晰而连贯。

cohesion.example: A shared goal gave the group a strong sense of cohesion.
cohesion.zh: 共同的目标让这个团体有了很强的凝聚力。

coil.example: He wound the long rope into a tight coil.
coil.zh: 他把长绳绕成一个紧实的卷。

coin.example: She dropped a coin into the box and thanked the driver.
coin.zh: 她往箱子里投了一枚硬币，并向司机道谢。

coincide.example: Our holiday dates coincide, so we can travel together.
coincide.zh: 我们的假期时间正好重合，所以可以一起旅行。

cold.example: The water was too cold for swimming, so we stayed on shore.
cold.zh: 水太冷不能游泳，于是我们留在岸边。

collaborate.example: Two local schools collaborate to share books and teaching ideas.
collaborate.zh: 两所当地学校合作共享图书和教学想法。

collapse.example: The old wooden shelf may collapse if you put too much weight on it.
collapse.zh: 如果你在旧木架上放太重的东西，它可能会塌。

collar.example: He turned up his collar to keep the cold wind out.
collar.zh: 他把衣领竖起来挡寒风。

colleague.example: A colleague from my office helped me finish the report.
colleague.zh: 我办公室的一位同事帮我完成了报告。

collect.example: They collect old bottles and turn them into small lamps.
collect.zh: 他们收集旧瓶子，把它们做成小台灯。

collective.example: The decision was a collective effort by the whole team.
collective.zh: 这个决定是整个团队集体努力的结果。

college.example: She plans to study design at a college near her home.
college.zh: 她打算在家附近的一所学院学设计。

collide.example: Two cars may collide if the road stays icy tonight.
collide.zh: 如果今晚路面一直结冰，两辆车可能会相撞。

colon.example: Please put a colon before the list of items in the report.
colon.zh: 报告中请在项目列表前面加一个冒号。

colonel.example: The colonel reviewed the training plan with the young officers.
colonel.zh: 上校和年轻的军官们一起审阅了训练计划。

colony.example: A small colony of bacteria grew on the plate overnight.
colony.zh: 一小片菌落在培养皿上一夜之间长了出来。

color.example: The walls in this room change color in the afternoon light.
color.zh: 这个房间的墙壁在午后的光线下会变色。

column.example: She writes a weekly column about food for the local paper.
column.zh: 她为当地报纸写一个关于美食的每周专栏。

comb.example: He used a small comb to tidy his hair before the meeting.
comb.zh: 开会前他用一把小梳子整理了一下头发。

combat.example: The new medicine may help combat the spread of the virus.
combat.zh: 这种新药可能有助于对抗病毒的传播。

combine.example: Mix the flour and water and combine them into a soft dough.
combine.zh: 把面粉和水混合，揉成柔软的面团。

come.example: Please come to my office after lunch so we can talk.
come.zh: 午饭后请来我办公室，我们可以谈谈。

comedy.example: We watched a light comedy and laughed for the whole evening.
comedy.zh: 我们看了一部轻松的喜剧，笑了一整晚。

comet.example: The comet will pass near the earth later this year.
comet.zh: 这颗彗星今年晚些时候会从地球附近经过。

comfort.example: A cup of hot tea gave me some comfort after the long trip.
comfort.zh: 长途旅行之后，一杯热茶给了我一些安慰。

comic.example: He reads a comic on the train every morning.
comic.zh: 他每天早上在火车上看一本漫画。

comma.example: You should put a comma between the two short clauses.
comma.zh: 你应该在两个短句之间加一个逗号。

command.example: The manager gave a clear command and the team obeyed at once.
command.zh: 经理下了一条明确的命令，团队立刻服从了。

commemorate.example: The town built a small park to commemorate its first settlers.
commemorate.zh: 镇上建了一个小公园来纪念最早的定居者。

commence.example: The ceremony will commence at nine and end before noon.
commence.zh: 典礼将在九点开始，中午之前结束。

commend.example: The teacher will commend the students who helped clean the hall.
commend.zh: 老师将表扬那些帮忙打扫礼堂的学生。

comment.example: She left a short comment under the photo on the page.
comment.zh: 她在页面上那张照片下面留了一条简短的评论。

commerce.example: Online commerce has changed how small shops reach their customers.
commerce.zh: 网络商业改变了小商店接触顾客的方式。

commission.example: The artist received a commission to paint the new library wall.
commission.zh: 这位画家接到委托，为新图书馆的墙面作画。

commit.example: She was unwilling to commit herself to such a long project.
commit.zh: 她不愿为这么长的项目承担义务。

committee.example: The committee will meet on Friday to discuss the new rules.
committee.zh: 委员会将在星期五开会讨论新规定。

commodity.example: Clean water is a basic commodity that every town needs.
commodity.zh: 干净的水是每个城镇都需要的基本商品。

common.example: It is common to see long lines at the station on holidays.
common.zh: 节假日车站排长队是很常见的。

commonplace.example: Using a phone to pay has become commonplace in most cities.
commonplace.zh: 用手机付款在大多数城市已经变得很平常。

commonwealth.example: The two regions formed a commonwealth to share water and roads.
commonwealth.zh: 这两个地区组成联邦，共享水源和道路。

commune.example: They chose to commune with nature during a quiet weekend walk.
commune.zh: 他们在一个安静的周末散步中与自然交流。

communicate.example: Good teachers communicate ideas in ways that students can follow.
communicate.zh: 好的老师用学生能跟上的方式传达想法。

community.example: The whole community helped clean the park after the storm.
community.zh: 整个社区在暴风雨后帮忙清理公园。

commute.example: He commutes by train and reads a book on the way.
commute.zh: 他乘火车通勤，路上看一本书。

compact.example: This compact camera fits easily into a coat pocket.
compact.zh: 这台小巧的相机很容易放进外套口袋。

companion.example: My dog is a quiet companion on long evening walks.
companion.zh: 我的狗是漫长夜晚散步时安静的陪伴。

company.example: She works for a small company that builds garden tools.
company.zh: 她在一家生产园艺工具的小公司工作。

compare.example: Compare the two prices before you decide which one to buy.
compare.zh: 买之前先比较一下这两个价格，再决定买哪个。

compartment.example: He put his bag in the overhead compartment above the seat.
compartment.zh: 他把包放在座位上方的行李架隔间里。

compass.example: Without a compass, it is easy to lose your way in the forest.
compass.zh: 没有指南针，在森林里很容易迷路。

compassion.example: She treated every patient with patience and real compassion.
compassion.zh: 她以耐心和真诚的同情对待每一位病人。

compatible.example: This old printer is not compatible with my new computer.
compatible.zh: 这台旧打印机和我的新电脑不兼容。

compel.example: Heavy rain may compel the team to cancel the outdoor game.
compel.zh: 大雨可能迫使球队取消户外比赛。

compensate.example: The shop agreed to compensate the buyer for the broken lamp.
compensate.zh: 商店同意为那盏坏掉的灯赔偿买家。

compete.example: Small shops find it hard to compete with large online sellers.
compete.zh: 小商店很难与大型网络卖家竞争。

competent.example: She is a competent driver who stays calm in heavy traffic.
competent.zh: 她是个能干的司机，在拥挤的车流中也能保持冷静。

compile.example: The team will compile a list of books for the new library.
compile.zh: 团队将为新图书馆编纂一份书单。

complacent.example: We must not become complacent after one successful year.
complacent.zh: 成功了一年之后，我们绝不能变得自满。

complain.example: Several guests complain about the noise from the street below.
complain.zh: 几位客人抱怨下面街上的噪音。

complement.example: Fresh herbs and a little salt complement the soup nicely.
complement.zh: 新鲜香草和一点盐很好地补充了汤的味道。

complete.example: Please complete the form and return it to the front desk.
complete.zh: 请填好表格，然后交到前台。

complex.example: The problem is more complex than it first appears.
complex.zh: 这个问题比它乍看之下要复杂。

complexion.example: A few weeks of rest improved her complexion and her mood.
complexion.zh: 休息几周后，她的肤色和心情都变好了。

complicate.example: Do not complicate a simple task with too many extra steps.
complicate.zh: 不要用太多额外的步骤把简单的任务弄复杂。

compliment.example: He paid her a kind compliment about her clear writing.
compliment.zh: 他善意地称赞她文章写得清楚。

comply.example: All drivers must comply with the speed limit near schools.
comply.zh: 所有司机在学校附近都必须遵守限速规定。

component.example: The battery is the most expensive component of this device.
component.zh: 电池是这台设备最贵的组件。

compose.example: He tried to compose a short song for his daughter's birthday.
compose.zh: 他试着为女儿的生日写一首短歌。

composite.example: The table is made of a light composite material.
composite.zh: 这张桌子是用一种轻质复合材料制成的。

compound.example: Water is a simple compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
compound.zh: 水是一种由氢和氧组成的简单化合物。

comprehend.example: Young children cannot always comprehend why rules must exist.
comprehend.zh: 小孩子并不总能理解为什么必须有规则。

comprehensive.example: The report offers a comprehensive view of the whole project.
comprehensive.zh: 这份报告对整个项目给出了全面的看法。

compress.example: You can compress the folder to make the file smaller.
compress.zh: 你可以压缩这个文件夹，让文件变小。

comprise.example: The course will comprise ten lessons and two short tests.
comprise.zh: 这门课程将包含十节课和两次小测验。

compromise.example: Both sides agreed to a compromise after a long discussion.
compromise.zh: 经过长时间讨论，双方同意折中处理。

compulsory.example: Wearing a helmet is compulsory for every rider on site.
compulsory.zh: 在工地，每个骑车的人都必须戴头盔。

compute.example: We compute the total cost before we place the order.
compute.zh: 下订单之前我们先计算总费用。

comrade.example: An old comrade from my school days came to visit.
comrade.zh: 一位上学时的老伙伴来看我了。

conceal.example: She tried to conceal her surprise and kept on smiling.
conceal.zh: 她努力掩饰自己的惊讶，继续微笑着。

concede.example: He had to concede that the other plan was cheaper.
concede.zh: 他不得不承认另一个方案更便宜。

conceit.example: Her conceit made it hard for her to accept advice.
conceit.zh: 她的自负让她很难接受别人的建议。

conceive.example: It is hard to conceive how people lived without electricity.
conceive.zh: 很难想象人们没有电是怎么生活的。

concentrate.example: Please concentrate on one task and finish it before lunch.
concentrate.zh: 请专心做一件事，午饭前把它完成。

concept.example: The idea of sharing cars is a fairly new concept here.
concept.zh: 共享汽车的想法在这里还是个相当新的概念。

concern.example: The rising cost of food is a serious concern for families.
concern.zh: 食品价格上涨是家庭严重关切的问题。

concert.example: We went to a piano concert at the small hall downtown.
concert.zh: 我们去市中心的小礼堂听了一场钢琴音乐会。

concise.example: Her answer was concise and covered every point we asked.
concise.zh: 她的回答简洁，涵盖了我们问的每一点。

conclude.example: The meeting will conclude with a short question and answer session.
conclude.zh: 会议将以简短的问答环节结束。

concrete.example: The steps are made of concrete and stay cool in summer.
concrete.zh: 这些台阶是混凝土做的，夏天很凉。

concurrent.example: The two events are concurrent, so I can attend only one.
concurrent.zh: 两个活动同时举行，所以我只能参加一个。

condemn.example: Many people condemn wasting food when others go hungry.
condemn.zh: 许多人谴责在别人挨饿时浪费食物。

condense.example: Please condense your notes into a single page for the class.
condense.zh: 请把你的笔记压缩成一页交给全班。

condition.example: The old bike is in good condition after a careful repair.
condition.zh: 经过仔细修理，这辆旧自行车状况良好。

condolence.example: She sent a short letter of condolence to her neighbor.
condolence.zh: 她给邻居寄了一封简短的吊唁信。

conducive.example: A quiet room is conducive to study and careful thinking.
conducive.zh: 安静的房间有助于学习和认真思考。

conduct.example: The school will conduct a survey about lunch and travel.
conduct.zh: 学校将就午餐和出行进行一次调查。

confederation.example: The small clubs formed a confederation to share costs and staff.
confederation.zh: 这些小俱乐部组成了一个联盟，共享费用和人员。

confer.example: The judges will confer before they announce the final winner.
confer.zh: 评委们将在宣布最终获胜者之前商议一下。

conference.example: She will speak at a conference on clean energy next month.
conference.zh: 下个月她将在一个清洁能源会议上发言。

confess.example: He had to confess that he had forgotten the key.
confess.zh: 他不得不承认自己把钥匙忘了。

confide.example: She confided her worries to her closest friend after the long trip.
confide.zh: 长途旅行之后，她向最亲密的朋友倾诉了自己的烦恼。

confidence.example: Practice gave her the confidence to speak in front of the whole class.
confidence.zh: 练习给了她在全班面前讲话的信心。

configuration.example: The engineer changed the configuration of the machine to save energy.
configuration.zh: 工程师改变了机器的配置以节省能源。

confine.example: The doctor told him to confine his activities to light walking.
confine.zh: 医生嘱咐他把活动限制在轻度散步范围内。

confirm.example: Please confirm your booking by email before the end of the week.
confirm.zh: 请在周末之前用电子邮件确认你的预订。

conflict.example: The two reports are in conflict about the cause of the delay.
conflict.zh: 这两份报告对延误原因的说明相互矛盾。

conform.example: All new buildings must conform to the safety rules of the city.
conform.zh: 所有新建筑都必须符合本市的安全规定。

confront.example: She had to confront her fear of speaking to large crowds.
confront.zh: 她不得不面对自己在众人面前讲话的恐惧。

Confucian.example: The teacher explained several Confucian ideas about family and respect.
Confucian.zh: 老师讲解了儒家关于家庭和敬重的几种观念。

confuse.example: The similar names often confuse students who are new to the subject.
confuse.zh: 相似的名字常常让刚接触这门学科的学生感到困惑。

congratulate.example: We all congratulated her on passing the difficult exam with high marks.
congratulate.zh: 我们都祝贺她以高分通过了那场很难的考试。

congregate.example: People began to congregate in the square before the evening concert.
congregate.zh: 傍晚音乐会开始前，人们开始在广场上聚集。

congress.example: The medical congress brought together doctors from more than twenty countries.
congress.zh: 这次医学会议汇集了来自二十多个国家的医生。

conjunction.example: The new library was planned in conjunction with the local school.
conjunction.zh: 新图书馆是与当地学校联合规划建设的。

connect.example: This cable connects the printer to the computer on the desk.
connect.zh: 这根线把打印机连接到桌上的电脑。

connotation.example: For many buyers, the word cheap carries a negative connotation.
connotation.zh: 对许多买家来说，cheap 这个词带有负面含义。

conquer.example: He worked hard for years to conquer his fear of deep water.
conquer.zh: 他多年努力，终于克服了对深水的恐惧。

conscience.example: His conscience would not let him keep the money he had found.
conscience.zh: 他的良心不允许他留下捡到的钱。

conscientious.example: She is a conscientious worker who checks every detail twice.
conscientious.zh: 她是个很有责任心的员工，每个细节都要检查两遍。

conscious.example: He was conscious of the fact that everyone was watching him.
conscious.zh: 他意识到大家都在看着他。

consecutive.example: It rained for five consecutive days and the roads were flooded.
consecutive.zh: 连续下了五天雨，道路都被淹了。

consensus.example: After a long talk, the group reached a consensus on the plan.
consensus.zh: 经过长时间的讨论，小组就这个计划达成了一致。

consent.example: Her parents gave their consent for the school trip to the mountains.
consent.zh: 她父母同意了她参加去山区的学校旅行。

consequence.example: He missed the warning and had to accept the consequence of his choice.
consequence.zh: 他没有留意警告，只好承担自己选择的后果。

conservative.example: My grandfather is conservative about money and saves a little every month.
conservative.zh: 我祖父在花钱上很保守，每个月都存一点钱。

conserve.example: We should conserve water by turning off the tap while brushing teeth.
conserve.zh: 我们应该在刷牙时关掉水龙头来节约用水。

consider.example: Please consider the offer carefully before you give us an answer.
consider.zh: 请仔细考虑这个提议，再给我们答复。

considerable.example: The repair will take a considerable amount of time and money.
considerable.zh: 这次修理将花费相当多的时间和金钱。

considerate.example: It was considerate of you to bring an umbrella for the old man.
considerate.zh: 你为那位老人带了一把伞，真是体贴。

consist.example: The team consists of six players and one experienced coach.
consist.zh: 这个队由六名队员和一名经验丰富的教练组成。

consistent.example: His results were consistent with the data collected last year.
consistent.zh: 他的结果与去年收集的数据是一致的。

console.example: She tried to console him with kind words after the bad news.
console.zh: 听到坏消息后，她试着用好话安慰他。

consolidate.example: The two small companies decided to consolidate into a single firm.
consolidate.zh: 两家小公司决定合并成一家公司。

conspicuous.example: The bright red car was conspicuous among the rows of silver ones.
conspicuous.zh: 那辆鲜红色的车在一排排银色车中间很显眼。

conspire.example: Bad weather and a flat tyre conspired to make the journey miserable.
conspire.zh: 恶劣的天气和瘪掉的轮胎凑在一起，让这趟旅程苦不堪言。

constant.example: The constant noise from the street kept me awake all night.
constant.zh: 街上不断的噪音让我整夜睡不着。

constituent.example: Protein is a major constituent of every cell in the body.
constituent.zh: 蛋白质是身体每个细胞的主要成分。

constitute.example: These small changes constitute a real improvement in the design.
constitute.zh: 这些小改动构成了设计上的真正改进。

constitution.example: Regular exercise improved his weak constitution within a single year.
constitution.zh: 规律锻炼让他在一年内改善了虚弱的体质。

constrain.example: A tight budget will constrain what we can do this year.
constrain.zh: 紧张的预算会限制我们今年的作为。

construct.example: Workers will construct a new bridge across the narrow river.
construct.zh: 工人们将在狭窄的河上建造一座新桥。

consulate.example: She went to the consulate to renew her travel papers.
consulate.zh: 她去领事馆更新她的旅行证件。

consult.example: You should consult a doctor if the pain does not go away.
consult.zh: 如果疼痛不消失，你应该去看医生。

consume.example: Older machines consume much more power than modern ones do.
consume.zh: 旧机器比现代机器消耗多得多的电。

contact.example: Please contact me by phone if the package does not arrive.
contact.zh: 如果包裹没到，请打电话联系我。

contagious.example: Her laughter was so contagious that the whole room joined in.
contagious.zh: 她的笑声很有感染力，整个房间的人都跟着笑。

contain.example: The box contains old photos, letters and a few small gifts.
contain.zh: 盒子里装着旧照片、信件和几件小礼物。

contaminate.example: Waste from the factory may contaminate the river near the village.
contaminate.zh: 工厂的废物可能会污染村庄附近的河流。

contemplate.example: He sat by the window and contemplated his plans for the future.
contemplate.zh: 他坐在窗边，盘算着未来的计划。

contemporary.example: The museum shows contemporary art made by young local painters.
contemporary.zh: 博物馆展出当地年轻画家创作的当代艺术作品。

contempt.example: She looked at the unfair rule with contempt and refused to obey.
contempt.zh: 她蔑视这条不公平的规定，拒绝服从。

contend.example: Three teams will contend for the title in the final match.
contend.zh: 三支队伍将在决赛中争夺冠军。

content.example: The content of the report was clear and easy to follow.

contented.example: She gave a contented smile and settled into the warm chair.
contented.zh: 她露出满足的微笑，舒服地坐进温暖的椅子。

contest.example: He entered a writing contest and won second prize.
contest.zh: 他参加了一场写作比赛，获得了二等奖。

context.example: You can guess the meaning of the word from its context.
context.zh: 你可以从上下文猜出这个词的意思。

continent.example: This continent has many kinds of weather and a rich wildlife.
continent.zh: 这块大陆有多种气候和丰富的野生动物。

contingent.example: Our trip is contingent on the weather staying clear this weekend.
contingent.zh: 我们的旅行取决于这个周末天气是否晴朗。

continue.example: The rain continued for hours and the match was finally cancelled.
continue.zh: 雨持续了好几个小时，比赛最终取消了。

contract.example: They signed a contract for the repair of the old roof.
contract.zh: 他们签了一份修理旧屋顶的合同。

contraction.example: In English, the contraction of do not is written as don't.
contraction.zh: 在英语中，do not 的缩写形式写作 don't。

contractor.example: The contractor promised to finish the kitchen by the end of May.
contractor.zh: 承包商承诺在五月底前完成厨房的装修。

contradict.example: The new evidence seems to contradict what the first report said.
contradict.zh: 新证据似乎与第一份报告所说的相矛盾。

contrary.example: Contrary to what many people think, the test was quite easy.
contrary.zh: 与许多人的想法相反，这次考试相当容易。

contrast.example: The contrast between the quiet village and the busy city is huge.
contrast.zh: 安静的村庄与繁忙的城市之间的对比非常明显。

contribute.example: Everyone in the team contributed a few ideas to the new design.
contribute.zh: 团队里的每个人都为新设计贡献了几个想法。

contrive.example: She contrived a simple method to keep the drinks cool.
contrive.zh: 她想出一个简单的办法让饮料保持冰凉。

control.example: He lost control of the car on the icy road.
control.zh: 他在结冰的路上失去了对汽车的控制。

controversy.example: The plan caused a long controversy among the local residents.
controversy.zh: 这个计划在当地居民中引起了长期的争论。

convene.example: The chairman will convene a meeting to discuss the new rules.
convene.zh: 主席将召集一次会议来讨论新规定。

convenient.example: The shop is convenient because it is close to the bus stop.
convenient.zh: 这家店很方便，因为离公交站很近。

convention.example: It is a convention to shake hands when you meet someone new.

converge.example: The two roads converge near the old stone bridge.
converge.zh: 两条路在旧石桥附近汇合。

conversation.example: We had a long conversation about books over morning coffee.
conversation.zh: 我们早上喝咖啡时聊了很久的书。

converse.example: They sat by the fire and conversed quietly for an hour.
converse.zh: 他们坐在火炉边，安静地交谈了一个小时。

convert.example: They converted the old barn into a small and cozy house.
convert.zh: 他们把旧谷仓改造成了一栋舒适的小房子。

convey.example: Her smile conveyed more than words could ever say.
convey.zh: 她的微笑传达出了言语无法表达的东西。

convict.example: The judge did not convict him because the proof was weak.
convict.zh: 由于证据不足，法官没有判他有罪。

convince.example: The clear photos convinced everyone that the story was true.
convince.zh: 清晰的照片让大家相信这个故事是真的。

convoy.example: Trucks moved slowly in a convoy along the mountain road.
convoy.zh: 卡车沿着山路排成一队缓慢行驶。

cook.example: My father cooks dinner for the family every Sunday evening.
cook.zh: 我父亲每周日晚上为全家做晚饭。

cookie.example: She baked a batch of chocolate cookies for the school sale.
cookie.zh: 她烤了一批巧克力饼干，用于学校的义卖。

cool.example: A cool wind came through the window after the hot afternoon.
cool.zh: 炎热的午后过后，一阵凉风从窗口吹进来。

cooperate.example: The two teams cooperated closely to finish the project on time.
cooperate.zh: 两个团队密切合作，按时完成了项目。

coordinate.example: She will coordinate the work of the three small groups.
coordinate.zh: 她将协调三个小组的工作。

cop.example: A cop helped the lost child find her parents in the crowd.
cop.zh: 一名警察帮助走失的孩子在人群中找到了父母。

cope.example: He learned to cope with the pressure of a busy job.
cope.zh: 他学会了应付繁忙工作的压力。

copper.example: The old pot is made of copper and shines when polished.
copper.zh: 这个旧锅是铜制的，擦亮后很有光泽。

copy.example: Please make a copy of this page before you sign it.
copy.zh: 请在签字之前复印一份这一页。

copyright.example: The book is still under copyright so you cannot copy it.
copyright.zh: 这本书仍在版权保护期内，所以你不能复制它。

coral.example: The divers were careful not to touch the bright coral.
coral.zh: 潜水员小心地不去触碰那些鲜艳的珊瑚。

cord.example: He tied the box with a thin cord and carried it upstairs.
cord.zh: 他用一根细绳捆好盒子，然后搬上楼。

cordial.example: We received a cordial welcome from the staff at the hotel.
cordial.zh: 我们受到了酒店员工热忱的欢迎。

core.example: The core of the problem is a lack of clear communication.
core.zh: 问题的核心是缺少清楚的沟通。

cork.example: He pulled the cork out of the bottle with a small tool.
cork.zh: 他用一个小工具把瓶塞从瓶子里拔了出来。

corn.example: Farmers in this area grow corn and beans in the same field.
corn.zh: 这个地区的农民在同一块地里种玉米和豆子。

corner.example: There is a small cafe on the corner of the street.

cornerstone.example: Trust is the cornerstone of any good friendship or partnership.
cornerstone.zh: 信任是任何良好友谊或合作关系的基石。

corporal.example: The corporal checked the tents before the heavy rain began.
corporal.zh: 下士在暴雨来临前检查了帐篷。

corporation.example: The corporation employs more than two thousand people in this city.
corporation.zh: 这家公司在本市雇用了两千多名员工。

corps.example: A corps of volunteers helped clean the park after the festival.
corps.zh: 节庆过后，一支志愿者队伍帮助清理了公园。

corpse.example: The workers found the corpse of a small deer near the road.
corpse.zh: 工人们在路边发现了一只小鹿的尸体。

correct.example: Please correct any mistakes in your answers before handing them in.
correct.zh: 交卷之前请改正答案中的错误。

correlate.example: Hours of study correlate closely with the marks students receive.
correlate.zh: 学习时长与学生的得分密切相关。

correspond.example: The numbers on the map correspond to the names in the list.
correspond.zh: 地图上的数字与名单上的名字相对应。

corridor.example: A long corridor connects the office to the meeting room.
corridor.zh: 一条长走廊把办公室和会议室连起来。

corrode.example: Salt water can corrode the metal parts of the boat quickly.
corrode.zh: 盐水会很快腐蚀船上的金属部件。

corrupt.example: A computer virus can corrupt the files saved on your disk.
corrupt.zh: 电脑病毒会破坏你磁盘上保存的文件。

cosmetic.example: She keeps her cosmetics in a small bag beside the mirror.
cosmetic.zh: 她把化妆品放在镜子旁边的一个小包里。

cosmopolitan.example: This port is a cosmopolitan city with people from many nations.
cosmopolitan.zh: 这个港口是一座国际化城市，居民来自许多国家。

cosmos.example: Scientists study the cosmos to learn how stars are born.
cosmos.zh: 科学家研究宇宙，以了解恒星是如何诞生的。

cost.example: The cost of the ticket includes a free drink and a map.
cost.zh: 门票的费用包括一杯免费饮料和一张地图。

costume.example: She wore a bright costume for the school play last night.
costume.zh: 昨晚学校的话剧演出中她穿了一套鲜艳的服装。

cottage.example: They spent the summer in a small cottage near the lake.
cottage.zh: 他们在湖边的一间小屋里度过了夏天。

cotton.example: This shirt is made of soft cotton and feels very comfortable.
cotton.zh: 这件衬衫是柔软棉布做的，穿起来很舒服。

couch.example: He fell asleep on the couch while watching a film.
couch.zh: 他看电影时在沙发上睡着了。

cough.example: A dry cough kept her awake for most of the night.
cough.zh: 干咳让她大半夜都没睡着。

could.example: She could finish the whole task in less than an hour.
could.zh: 她能在一小时内完成整个任务。

council.example: The city council approved the plan for a new public library.
council.zh: 市议会批准了新建一座公共图书馆的计划。

counsel.example: My teacher gave me wise counsel about choosing a career.
counsel.zh: 老师就选择职业给了我很明智的忠告。

count.example: Please count the chairs before the guests arrive at noon.
count.zh: 请在中午客人到来之前数一下椅子。

countdown.example: The countdown to the race began ten seconds before the start.
countdown.zh: 比赛的倒计时在开始前十秒钟响起。

counter.example: The keys were left on the counter beside the front door.
counter.zh: 钥匙被放在前门旁边的柜台上。

counteract.example: A short walk after lunch can counteract the urge to sleep.
counteract.zh: 午饭后散散步可以抵消想睡觉的冲动。

counterfeit.example: The shop refused to sell the counterfeit bags at a low price.
counterfeit.zh: 这家店拒绝低价出售那些假冒的包。

counterpart.example: The manager met her counterpart from the other company yesterday.
counterpart.zh: 经理昨天会见了另一家公司与她职位相当的人。

country.example: Our country has a long history and many beautiful old towns.
country.zh: 我们的国家历史悠久，有许多美丽的古镇。

countryside.example: We spent the weekend walking in the quiet green countryside.
countryside.zh: 我们在安静翠绿的乡下散步度过了周末。

county.example: This county is known for its apples and small family farms.
county.zh: 这个县以苹果和小型家庭农场闻名。

coup.example: Winning that big order was a real coup for the team.
coup.zh: 赢得那笔大订单对团队来说是一次真正的妙举。

couple.example: A young couple moved into the house next to ours.
couple.zh: 一对年轻夫妇搬进了我们隔壁的房子。

coupon.example: She used a coupon to buy the coat at half price.
coupon.zh: 她用一张优惠券半价买下了那件外套。

courage.example: It took courage to admit the mistake in front of everyone.
courage.zh: 在大家面前承认错误需要勇气。

course.example: This online course teaches beginners how to write simple programs.
course.zh: 这门在线课程教初学者如何编写简单的程序。

court.example: The case will be heard in court early next month.
court.zh: 这起案件将于下月初在法庭上审理。

courtesy.example: He offered his seat to the old lady as a courtesy.
courtesy.zh: 他把座位让给那位老太太，以示礼貌。

courtyard.example: There is a small tree and a stone bench in the courtyard.
courtyard.zh: 院子里有一棵小树和一条石凳。

cousin.example: My cousin lives in another city and visits us every summer.
cousin.zh: 我的表弟住在另一个城市，每年夏天都来看我们。

cover.example: Please cover the food before you put it in the fridge.
cover.zh: 把食物放进冰箱前请先盖好。

cow.example: The farmer milks the cow early every morning before sunrise.
cow.zh: 农民每天清晨日出前给母牛挤奶。

coward.example: He felt like a coward for staying silent during the meeting.
coward.zh: 会上他保持沉默，觉得自己像个胆小鬼。

cowboy.example: The cowboy rode slowly across the field at sunset.
cowboy.zh: 日落时牛仔慢慢地骑马穿过田野。

cozy.example: The small room felt cozy with warm light and soft chairs.
cozy.zh: 这间小房间在暖光和软椅的映衬下显得很舒适。

crab.example: A crab walked sideways across the wet sand near the sea.
crab.zh: 一只螃蟹横着爬过海边的湿沙。

crack.example: There is a long crack in the ceiling above the window.
crack.zh: 窗户上方的天花板上有一道长长的裂缝。

crackdown.example: The school announced a crackdown on cheating during final exams.
crackdown.zh: 学校宣布严惩期末考试中的作弊行为。

cracker.example: He ate a few crackers with cheese while waiting for dinner.
cracker.zh: 等晚饭时他吃了几块配奶酪的饼干。

cradle.example: The baby slept quietly in the wooden cradle by the bed.
cradle.zh: 婴儿安静地睡在床边的木摇篮里。

craft.example: She learned the craft of making paper flowers from her aunt.
craft.zh: 她从姑妈那里学会了制作纸花的手艺。

cram.example: He tried to cram all the new words into one evening.
cram.zh: 他想在一个晚上把所有新单词都硬记下来。

crane.example: A tall crane lifted the heavy steel beams onto the truck.
crane.zh: 一台高高的起重机把沉重的钢梁吊上了卡车。

crash.example: The two cars crashed into each other at the busy corner.
crash.zh: 两辆汽车在繁忙的街角猛烈相撞。

crate.example: They loaded the fresh apples into a large wooden crate.
crate.zh: 他们把新鲜苹果装进一个大木箱里。

crave.example: After a long walk, she craved a cold drink and a rest.
crave.zh: 走了很长一段路后，她渴望喝杯冷饮、休息一下。

crawl.example: The baby crawled slowly across the soft carpet toward the door.
crawl.zh: 婴儿慢慢地爬过柔软的地毯，朝门口爬去。

crazy.example: My brother is crazy about football and watches every match.
crazy.zh: 我弟弟对足球很狂热，每场比赛都看。

cream.example: She added fresh cream to the soup and stirred it gently.
cream.zh: 她往汤里加了新鲜奶油，轻轻搅拌。

create.example: The new project will create hundreds of jobs in our town.
create.zh: 这个新项目将在我们镇上创造数百个就业机会。

creature.example: Many small creatures live under the rocks near the river.
creature.zh: 许多小生物生活在河边的岩石下面。

credential.example: Please bring your credentials to the office before the interview.
credential.zh: 请在面试前把你的证件带到办公室。

credible.example: Her story sounded credible, and everyone believed her at once.
credible.zh: 她的说法听起来很可信，大家立刻就相信了她。

credit.example: He paid for the meal with his credit card and left.
credit.zh: 他用信用卡付了饭钱就离开了。

creep.example: The cat creeps quietly along the wall and watches the birds.
creep.zh: 猫沿着墙悄悄地爬行，注视着那些鸟。

crew.example: The whole crew worked hard to keep the ship clean.
crew.zh: 全体船员努力保持船只清洁。

cricket.example: We could hear crickets singing in the garden all night.
cricket.zh: 我们整夜都能听见蟋蟀在花园里鸣叫。

crime.example: Stealing a bicycle is a crime, even a small one.
crime.zh: 偷自行车是犯罪，哪怕只是小事。

cripple.example: Heavy snow crippled the traffic in the whole city.
cripple.zh: 大雪使全城的交通陷入瘫痪。

crisis.example: The company faced a serious financial crisis last winter.
crisis.zh: 去年冬天这家公司面临严重的财务危机。

crisp.example: The fresh bread was still warm and wonderfully crisp outside.
crisp.zh: 新鲜面包还热着，外皮非常酥脆。

criterion.example: Price is not the only criterion when we choose a new car.
criterion.zh: 我们选新车时，价格不是唯一的标准。

criticize.example: The teacher criticized his essay but offered many useful suggestions.
criticize.zh: 老师批评了他的文章，但也提了很多有用的建议。

crocodile.example: A crocodile lay still on the bank of the muddy river.
crocodile.zh: 一条鳄鱼一动不动地趴在浑浊的河岸上。

crop.example: Farmers expect a good crop of rice after all this rain.
crop.zh: 经过这场雨水，农民们指望稻子能有好收成。

cross.example: Look both ways before you cross the busy street.
cross.zh: 过这条繁忙的马路前要朝两边看看。

crouch.example: She crouched down to pick up the coin from the floor.
crouch.zh: 她蹲下身去捡地板上的硬币。

crow.example: A black crow sat on the fence and called loudly.
crow.zh: 一只黑乌鸦停在篱笆上大声叫着。

crowd.example: A large crowd gathered in the square to watch the show.
crowd.zh: 一大群人聚集在广场上观看表演。

crown.example: The winner of the contest received a small gold crown.
crown.zh: 比赛的获胜者得到了一顶小小的金冠。

crucial.example: Getting enough sleep is crucial for students before a big exam.
crucial.zh: 大考前睡足觉对学生至关重要。

crude.example: The walls were made of rough, crude stone and mud.
crude.zh: 这些墙是用粗糙的石头和泥土砌成的。

cruel.example: It is cruel to leave a pet alone for days.
cruel.zh: 把宠物独自留在家好几天是很残忍的。

cruise.example: They took a short cruise along the coast in warm weather.
cruise.zh: 天气暖和时，他们沿着海岸做了一次短途巡航。

crumble.example: The old stone wall slowly crumbled into dust over the years.
crumble.zh: 这些年来，那堵旧石墙慢慢碎裂成尘土。

crunch.example: He crunched the dry leaves under his feet on the path.
crunch.zh: 在小径上，他脚下的干树叶嘎吱作响。

crush.example: The machine crushed the empty cans into a flat block.
crush.zh: 机器把空罐子压成一个扁平的块。

crust.example: The bread had a thick golden crust and a soft inside.
crust.zh: 这面包有一层厚厚的金黄色硬皮，里面很软。

cry.example: The little girl began to cry when her toy broke.
cry.zh: 小女孩的玩具坏了，她开始哭起来。

crystal.example: The clear water looked like liquid crystal in the sun.
crystal.zh: 清澈的水在阳光下看起来像液态水晶。

cub.example: The mother bear kept her cubs close to the den.
cub.zh: 母熊让她的幼崽待在洞穴附近。

cube.example: He dropped a small ice cube into his glass of water.
cube.zh: 他往自己的水杯里放了一小块冰块。

cucumber.example: She sliced a fresh cucumber and added it to the salad.
cucumber.zh: 她切了一根新鲜黄瓜，加进沙拉里。

cue.example: The actor waited for his cue and then walked on stage.
cue.zh: 演员等着他的提示，然后走上了舞台。

cuisine.example: This restaurant is famous for its simple local cuisine.
cuisine.zh: 这家餐馆以简单的本地菜肴闻名。

culminate.example: The long race will culminate in a huge celebration tonight.
culminate.zh: 这场漫长的比赛将在今晚的盛大庆祝中达到高潮。

cult.example: Some people treat the new diet as a kind of cult.
cult.zh: 有些人把这种新的饮食法当成一种狂热信仰。

cultivate.example: Farmers cultivate rice in these wet fields every spring.
cultivate.zh: 农民每年春天都在这些水田里种稻。

culture.example: Food is an important part of every culture in the world.
culture.zh: 食物是世界上每一种文化的重要组成部分。

cumulative.example: The cumulative effect of daily practice is easy to see.
cumulative.zh: 每天练习的累积效果很容易看出来。

cunning.example: The cunning fox found a way into the chicken house.
cunning.zh: 那只狡猾的狐狸找到了进鸡舍的办法。

cup.example: She poured hot tea into a small white cup for me.
cup.zh: 她给我把热茶倒进一个小白杯里。

cupboard.example: The plates are kept in the cupboard above the kitchen sink.
cupboard.zh: 盘子放在厨房水槽上方的碗柜里。

curb.example: The city hopes to curb traffic by improving public transport.
curb.zh: 这座城市希望通过改善公共交通来抑制交通流量。

cure.example: This medicine can cure the common cold in a few days.
cure.zh: 这种药几天就能治好普通感冒。

curfew.example: The town set a curfew for everyone after the heavy storm.
curfew.zh: 大风暴过后，镇上给所有人规定了宵禁。

curious.example: The children were curious about the strange box in the corner.
curious.zh: 孩子们对角落里那个奇怪的盒子很好奇。

curl.example: She used a warm iron to curl her hair for the party.
curl.zh: 为了聚会，她用温热的卷发棒把头发卷起来。

currency.example: The local currency lost some value against the dollar last year.
currency.zh: 去年当地货币对美元贬值了一些。

current.example: The current situation is much better than it was last year.
current.zh: 目前的情况比去年好多了。

curriculum.example: The school added computer science to its curriculum this year.
curriculum.zh: 学校今年把计算机科学加进了课程。

curse.example: He cursed under his breath when the bus left without him.
curse.zh: 公交车没等他就开走了，他低声咒骂了一句。

curtail.example: The company had to curtail its travel budget this year.
curtail.zh: 公司今年不得不缩减差旅预算。

curtain.example: She pulled the curtain closed to keep the room cool.
curtain.zh: 她拉上窗帘，让房间保持凉爽。

curve.example: The road makes a sharp curve near the old bridge.
curve.zh: 这条路在旧桥附近拐了一个急弯。

cushion.example: He put a soft cushion behind his back while reading.
cushion.zh: 看书时他在背后垫了一个软垫。

custody.example: The police kept the lost bag in custody until it was claimed.
custody.zh: 警方保管着那个丢失的包，直到有人来认领。

custom.example: It is a local custom to share food during the festival.
custom.zh: 节日期间分享食物是当地的一种风俗。

customer.example: The shop gives every customer a small bag of tea.
customer.zh: 这家店给每位顾客一小袋茶。

customs.example: We had to wait an hour at customs before our flight.
customs.zh: 登机前我们不得不在海关等了一个小时。

cut.example: Please cut the cake into eight equal pieces for the guests.
cut.zh: 请把蛋糕切成八等份给客人。

cute.example: Their new puppy is very cute and loves to play.
cute.zh: 他们的新小狗非常可爱，很喜欢玩。

cyberspace.example: Young people now spend much of their free time in cyberspace.
cyberspace.zh: 如今年轻人在网络空间里花掉很多空闲时间。

cycle.example: The seasons follow a regular cycle of about one year.
cycle.zh: 四季遵循大约一年的规律循环。

cylinder.example: The engine has four cylinders, each with a moving part.
cylinder.zh: 这台发动机有四个汽缸，每个里面都有一个活动部件。

cynical.example: He became cynical about the promises made by big companies.
cynical.zh: 他对大公司做出的承诺变得愤世嫉俗。

dad.example: My dad taught me how to ride a bike last summer.
dad.zh: 去年夏天我爸爸教我骑自行车。

daily.example: Reading the news has become part of my daily routine.
daily.zh: 看新闻已经成为我日常习惯的一部分。

dairy.example: This farm produces fresh dairy products for the nearby town.
dairy.zh: 这个农场为附近的镇子生产新鲜乳制品。

dam.example: A new dam was built across the river last year.
dam.zh: 去年在河上建了一座新水坝。

damage.example: The heavy rain caused serious damage to the old roof.
damage.zh: 大雨给旧屋顶造成了严重损坏。

damn.example: She did not damn the mistake but helped him fix it.
damn.zh: 她没有谴责这个错误，而是帮他改正。

damp.example: The walls of the old house felt cold and damp.
damp.zh: 老房子的墙壁摸上去又冷又潮湿。

dance.example: They learned a simple dance for the school party.
dance.zh: 他们为学校聚会学了一支简单的舞。

danger.example: The sign warns people of danger near the deep water.
danger.zh: 这块牌子提醒人们深水附近有危险。

dare.example: No one dared to tell him the truth about the plan.
dare.zh: 没有人敢把计划的真相告诉他。

dark.example: The room was too dark to read without a lamp.
dark.zh: 房间里太暗了，不开灯没法看书。

darling.example: She called her little son darling and kissed his cheek.
darling.zh: 她叫小儿子亲爱的，亲了亲他的脸颊。

dart.example: He threw the dart and hit the center of the board.

dash.example: She made a quick dash for the bus in the rain.
dash.zh: 她冒着雨快步冲向公交车。

data.example: The scientists collected data on rainfall for ten years.
data.zh: 科学家们收集了十年的降雨数据。

database.example: All the student records are stored in one central database.
database.zh: 所有学生记录都存储在一个中央数据库里。

date.example: Please write the date at the top of your paper.
date.zh: 请在试卷的顶端写上日期。

dating.example: The dating of the old letters took several weeks.
dating.zh: 给这些旧信件注明日期花了好几周。

daughter.example: Their daughter is studying art at a school in the city.
daughter.zh: 他们的女儿在城里一所学校学美术。

dawn.example: We left the house at dawn and walked to the lake.
dawn.zh: 我们黎明时离家，走到了湖边。

day.example: It was a warm day, perfect for a walk in the park.
day.zh: 那是温暖的一天，正适合去公园散步。

daylight.example: The room is bright with daylight in the early morning.
daylight.zh: 清晨，房间里洒满明亮的日光。

dazzle.example: The bright headlights dazzled him for a moment on the road.
dazzle.zh: 路上明亮的车头灯让他一时眼花。

dead.example: The phone battery is dead, so I cannot call you.
dead.zh: 手机电池没电了，所以我没法给你打电话。

deadline.example: The deadline for the report is next Friday at noon.
deadline.zh: 这份报告的最后期限是下周五中午。

deadlock.example: The two sides reached a deadlock after hours of talks.
deadlock.zh: 双方谈了数小时后陷入僵局。

deadly.example: The exam was deadly dull and lasted three hours.
deadly.zh: 这场考试极其乏味，持续了三个小时。

deaf.example: Her grandfather is deaf, so they talk with signs.
deaf.zh: 她祖父耳朵聋了，所以他们用手势交谈。

deal.example: The two companies signed a deal to share their technology.
deal.zh: 两家公司签署了一项共享技术的协议。

dealer.example: The car dealer offered us a lower price this week.
dealer.zh: 汽车经销商本周给了我们一个更低的价格。

dean.example: The dean of the college spoke to the new students.
dean.zh: 学院院长对新同学讲了话。

dear.example: She wrote a letter to her dear friend far away.
dear.zh: 她给远方的挚友写了一封信。

death.example: After the death of the old tree, the garden looked empty.
death.zh: 那棵老树枯死之后，花园看起来空荡荡的。

debate.example: The club held a debate about homework and school hours.
debate.zh: 社团围绕作业和上课时间举行了一场辩论。

debris.example: Workers cleared the debris from the road after the storm.
debris.zh: 风暴过后，工人们清除了路上的碎片。

debt.example: He worked two jobs to pay off his student debt.
debt.zh: 他打两份工来还清助学贷款债务。

debut.example: The young singer made her debut at a small theatre.
debut.zh: 这位年轻歌手在一家小剧院初次登台。

decade.example: The town has changed a lot over the past decade.
decade.zh: 过去十年里，这个镇子变化很大。

decay.example: Fruit left in the warm sun begins to decay quickly.
decay.zh: 留在暖阳下的水果很快就开始腐烂。

deceive.example: He tried to deceive us with a false address.
deceive.zh: 他试图用一个假地址欺骗我们。

December.example: The weather in December is usually cold and dry here.
December.zh: 这里十二月的天气通常又冷又干。

decent.example: He earns a decent salary and lives a quiet life.
decent.zh: 他挣着一份不错的薪水，过着安静的生活。

decide.example: We decided to walk home instead of waiting for the bus.
decide.zh: 我们决定走回家，不再等公交车。

decimal.example: Please round the answer to two decimal places.
decimal.zh: 请把答案保留到两位小数。

deck.example: We stood on the deck and watched the sun go down.
deck.zh: 我们站在甲板上看太阳落下。

declare.example: The company declared a holiday for all its workers.
declare.zh: 公司为全体员工宣布放假一天。

decline.example: Sales began to decline after the summer holiday ended.
decline.zh: 暑假结束后，销量开始下降。

decorate.example: They decorated the room with paper flowers and bright lights.
decorate.zh: 他们用纸花和明亮的灯装饰房间。

decrease.example: The number of visitors decreased sharply during the cold months.
decrease.zh: 寒冷的几个月里，游客数量大幅减少。

decree.example: The new decree limits the use of water in summer.
decree.zh: 新法令限制了夏季用水。

dedicate.example: She dedicated her free time to helping children learn to read.
dedicate.zh: 她把空闲时间用来帮助孩子们学习阅读。

deduce.example: From these facts we can deduce the cause of the problem.
deduce.zh: 从这些事实中我们可以推断问题的原因。

deduct.example: The shop will deduct the discount before you pay.
deduct.zh: 商店会在你付款前扣除折扣。

deed.example: His kind deed helped the whole family through the winter.
deed.zh: 他的善举帮助全家度过了冬天。

deem.example: The committee deemed the plan too expensive to carry out.
deem.zh: 委员会认为这个计划太贵，无法实施。

deep.example: The lake is very deep in the middle and quite cold.
deep.zh: 这湖中间非常深，而且相当冷。

deer.example: A young deer walked quietly out of the tall grass.
deer.zh: 一只小鹿悄悄从高高的草丛里走了出来。

default.example: The software uses a simple default when no choice is made.
default.zh: 没有做选择时，软件会使用一个简单的默认值。

defeat.example: Our team defeated them by two goals in the final match.
defeat.zh: 在决赛中我们队以两球击败了他们。

defect.example: The factory found a small defect in the new machine.
defect.zh: 工厂在新机器上发现了一个小缺陷。

defection.example: His defection from the club surprised all his old friends.
defection.zh: 他脱离俱乐部的举动让所有老朋友都很惊讶。

defective.example: The shop replaced the defective lamp without any extra charge.
defective.zh: 商店免费更换了那盏有缺陷的台灯。

defend.example: The walls were built to defend the town from floods.
defend.zh: 这些墙是为了保护镇子免受洪水而建的。

defer.example: We decided to defer the meeting until next Monday morning.
defer.zh: 我们决定把会议推迟到下周一上午。

deficient.example: The soil here is deficient in water and useful minerals.
deficient.zh: 这里的土壤缺少水分和有用的矿物质。

deficit.example: The city is trying to reduce its budget deficit this year.
deficit.zh: 这座城市今年正努力减少预算赤字。

define.example: The teacher asked us to define the word in our own way.
define.zh: 老师让我们用自己的话给这个词下定义。

definite.example: We need a definite answer before the end of the week.
definite.zh: 我们需要在本周末之前得到一个明确的答复。

defy.example: The old tree seemed to defy the strong winter wind.
defy.zh: 那棵老树似乎在藐视严冬的狂风。

degenerate.example: The old road slowly degenerated into a muddy path.
degenerate.zh: 那条旧路慢慢退化成了一条泥泞的小径。

degrade.example: The plastic bag will slowly degrade in the wet ground.
degrade.zh: 塑料袋会在潮湿的土地里慢慢降解。

degree.example: The temperature dropped to five degrees below zero last night.
degree.zh: 昨晚气温降到了零下五度。

delay.example: The flight had a two-hour delay because of heavy snow.
delay.zh: 因为大雪，航班延误了两个小时。

delegate.example: Each class sent one delegate to the school meeting.
delegate.zh: 每个班派了一名代表参加学校会议。

delete.example: Please delete the old files before you save the new ones.
delete.zh: 在保存新文件之前，请把旧文件删掉。

deliberate.example: Her choice of words was slow and clearly deliberate.
deliberate.zh: 她选词很慢，显然是经过斟酌的。

delicacy.example: Smoked salmon is a local delicacy that visitors always want to try.
delicacy.zh: 熏鲑鱼是当地人爱吃的精美食品，游客总想尝一尝。

delicate.example: She handled the delicate glass bowl with both hands and great care.
delicate.zh: 她用双手小心翼翼地捧着那只精致的玻璃碗。

delicious.example: My mother made a delicious soup with fresh vegetables from the garden.
delicious.zh: 我妈妈用园子里的新鲜蔬菜做了一锅美味的汤。

delight.example: The children shouted with delight when the snow began to fall.
delight.zh: 雪开始下起来时，孩子们高兴地欢呼起来。

deliver.example: The shop will deliver your new sofa to your home on Friday.
deliver.zh: 商店会在周五把你的新沙发送到家里。

delude.example: Do not delude yourself into thinking that the exam will be easy.
delude.zh: 别骗自己以为这场考试会很容易。

demand.example: The workers made a clear demand for better pay and shorter hours.
demand.zh: 工人们明确要求提高工资、缩短工时。

democracy.example: In a democracy, people choose their leaders through free and fair elections.
democracy.zh: 在民主制度下，人们通过自由公正的选举选择领导人。

demographic.example: The survey describes the demographic changes in the local population over ten years.
demographic.zh: 这项调查描述了当地人口十年间的人口统计变化。

demonstrate.example: The teacher will demonstrate how to use the new machine step by step.
demonstrate.zh: 老师会一步步示范怎样使用这台新机器。

denote.example: On this map, a small red star denotes the main train station.
denote.zh: 在这张地图上，一颗小红星表示火车站总站。

denounce.example: The group held a meeting to denounce the cruel treatment of animals.
denounce.zh: 该团体举行集会，谴责虐待动物的行为。

dense.example: The forest was so dense that sunlight could hardly reach the ground.
dense.zh: 森林非常茂密，阳光几乎照不到地面。

dent.example: A falling branch left a deep dent in the roof of my car.
dent.zh: 掉落的树枝在我的车顶上留下了一个深深的凹痕。

dental.example: She visits the dental clinic twice a year for a careful check.
dental.zh: 她每年去牙科诊所做两次仔细的检查。

dentist.example: The dentist told me to brush my teeth twice every day.
dentist.zh: 牙医叮嘱我每天刷两次牙。

deny.example: He could not deny that he had forgotten the meeting again.
deny.zh: 他无法否认自己又把会议忘了。

depart.example: The morning train will depart from platform three at eight o'clock.
depart.zh: 早班列车将在八点从三号站台发车。

department.example: She works in the sales department of a small furniture company.
department.zh: 她在一家小型家具公司的销售部工作。

depend.example: Our plan for the picnic will depend on the weather tomorrow.
depend.zh: 我们的野餐计划要看明天的天气而定。

depict.example: The painting depicts a quiet village beside a wide, slow river.
depict.zh: 这幅画描绘了一个宽阔平缓的河边宁静村庄。

deplete.example: Long hours of driving can deplete your energy and your attention.
deplete.zh: 长时间开车会耗尽你的体力和注意力。

deplore.example: Many parents deplore the amount of time children spend online.
deplore.zh: 许多家长对孩子上网时间之长深感遗憾。

deploy.example: The company plans to deploy the new software across all offices.
deploy.zh: 公司计划在所有办公室部署这款新软件。

deport.example: The court decided to deport the man after his visa had expired.
deport.zh: 法院裁定在签证过期后将这名男子驱逐出境。

deposit.example: You must pay a deposit of fifty dollars before we order the sofa.
deposit.zh: 在我们订购沙发之前，你得先付五十美元定金。

depot.example: The old bus depot at the end of the street is now a shop.
depot.zh: 街尽头那座旧公交车场现在成了一家商店。

depreciate.example: A new car will depreciate quickly during the first two years.
depreciate.zh: 新车在头两年会迅速贬值。

depress.example: Rainy weather and long nights always depress my mood a little.
depress.zh: 阴雨天气和漫长的夜晚总让我情绪有点低落。

deprive.example: Long working hours can deprive people of time with their families.
deprive.zh: 长时间工作会剥夺人们与家人相处的时间。

depth.example: The lake is famous for its great depth and clear blue water.
depth.zh: 这个湖以水深和清澈的蓝色湖水而闻名。

deputy.example: When the manager was away, her deputy answered all the calls.
deputy.zh: 经理不在时，她的副手接了所有电话。

derail.example: Heavy snow can derail a train and delay hundreds of passengers.
derail.zh: 大雪可能使火车脱轨，耽误数百名乘客。

deregulate.example: The city decided to deregulate the taxi market to increase competition.
deregulate.zh: 该市决定解除对出租车市场的管制以促进竞争。

derive.example: Many English words derive from Latin and ancient Greek roots.
derive.zh: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语和古希腊语词根。

descend.example: We watched the plane descend slowly through the grey evening clouds.
descend.zh: 我们看着飞机缓缓穿过傍晚灰蒙蒙的云层下降。

describe.example: Could you describe the man you saw near the library last night?
describe.zh: 你能描述一下昨晚在图书馆附近见到的那个男人吗？

desert.example: Few plants can survive in this hot and dry desert.
desert.zh: 在这片炎热干燥的沙漠里，很少有植物能存活。

desertion.example: The abandoned dog suffered from the desertion of its former owner.
desertion.zh: 这只被遗弃的狗因前主人的抛弃而受苦。

deserve.example: After such hard work, you really deserve a long and quiet holiday.
deserve.zh: 这么辛苦之后，你确实该好好休一个长假。

design.example: The design of this chair makes it comfortable and easy to move.
design.zh: 这款椅子的设计使它既舒适又便于搬动。

designate.example: The school designated this room as a quiet place for reading.
designate.zh: 学校把这个房间指定为安静的阅读场所。

desire.example: She had a strong desire to learn another language before she turned thirty.
desire.zh: 她强烈希望在三十岁前再学一门语言。

desk.example: There is a small lamp and two books on my desk.
desk.zh: 我的书桌上有一盏小台灯和两本书。

desktop.example: He keeps all his photos in one folder on the desktop.
desktop.zh: 他把所有照片都放在桌面上的一个文件夹里。

desolate.example: After the long winter, the garden looked grey and completely desolate.
desolate.zh: 漫长的冬天过后，花园一片灰暗，显得十分荒凉。

despair.example: He was in despair after losing his keys for the third time.
despair.zh: 第三次丢钥匙后，他陷入了绝望。

despatch.example: The office will despatch your parcel by express post this afternoon.
despatch.zh: 办公室今天下午会用快递把你的包裹寄出。

despise.example: She despises people who are rude to waiters and shop assistants.
despise.zh: 她看不起那些对服务员和店员粗暴无礼的人。

despite.example: Despite the heavy rain, the children walked to school on time.
despite.zh: 尽管下着大雨，孩子们还是准时走到了学校。

dessert.example: For dessert we had warm apple pie with a little ice cream.
dessert.zh: 我们的餐后甜点是热苹果派配一点冰淇淋。

destination.example: The small island is a popular destination for families in summer.
destination.zh: 这座小岛是夏天家庭出游的热门目的地。

destiny.example: He believed that hard work and patience could change his destiny.
destiny.zh: 他相信努力和耐心可以改变自己的命运。

destroy.example: The storm destroyed several old trees along the quiet village road.
destroy.zh: 暴风雨毁坏了安静村道旁的几棵老树。

detach.example: You can detach the small bag from the bicycle frame easily.
detach.zh: 你可以轻松地把这个小包从自行车架上取下来。

detail.example: Please explain the plan in detail so everyone can follow it.
detail.zh: 请详细说明这个计划，好让每个人都能跟上。

detain.example: The heavy traffic detained us for almost an hour this morning.
detain.zh: 今早的交通拥堵把我们耽误了将近一个小时。

detect.example: The machine can detect even a very small change in temperature.
detect.zh: 这台机器甚至能探测到极小的温度变化。

deter.example: The high price of the ticket may deter many young visitors.
deter.zh: 高昂的票价可能会吓住许多年轻游客。

detergent.example: Add a little detergent and wash the shirt in warm water.
detergent.zh: 加一点洗涤剂，用温水把衬衫洗干净。

deteriorate.example: His health began to deteriorate after months of poor sleep.
deteriorate.zh: 几个月睡眠不佳之后，他的健康开始恶化。

determine.example: The size of the room will determine how much furniture we buy.
determine.zh: 房间的大小将决定我们买多少家具。

detriment.example: He worked late every night, to the detriment of his health.
detriment.zh: 他每晚都工作到很晚，损害了自己的健康。

devastate.example: A sudden storm can devastate a small farm in just one night.
devastate.zh: 一场突如其来的暴风雨能在一夜之间毁掉一个小农场。

develop.example: The company plans to develop a new app for learning languages.
develop.zh: 公司计划开发一款学习语言的新应用。

deviate.example: Please do not deviate from the plan without telling the group first.
deviate.zh: 请不要事先不告诉团队就偏离计划。

device.example: This small device can measure the temperature of the whole room.
device.zh: 这个小装置能测量整个房间的温度。

devil.example: They say the devil is in the details when you plan a big event.
devil.zh: 人们说筹备大型活动时，魔鬼藏在细节里。

devise.example: The students devised a simple game to practise new words together.
devise.zh: 学生们设计了一个简单的游戏来一起练习新单词。

devote.example: She devotes two hours every morning to reading and writing.
devote.zh: 她每天上午投入两小时阅读和写作。

devour.example: The hungry children devoured the bread as soon as it arrived.
devour.zh: 饿坏了的孩子们一见到面包就狼吞虎咽地吃光了。

dew.example: In the early morning, dew covered every leaf in the garden.
dew.zh: 清晨，露水覆盖了园子里的每一片叶子。

diabetes.example: Her doctor told her that walking daily helps control diabetes.
diabetes.zh: 医生告诉她，每天散步有助于控制糖尿病。

diagnose.example: The doctor could not diagnose the problem without more tests.
diagnose.zh: 没有进一步检查，医生无法诊断这个问题。

diagram.example: The teacher drew a simple diagram to explain how the heart works.
diagram.zh: 老师画了一张简图来解释心脏是如何工作的。

dial.example: She had to dial the number twice because the line was busy.
dial.zh: 因为占线，她不得不拨了两次号码。

dialect.example: Older people in this village still speak a local dialect at home.
dialect.zh: 这个村子里的老人仍在家中说当地方言。

dialog.example: The application shows a short dialog between two friends in a shop.
dialog.zh: 这个应用展示了一段两个朋友在商店里的简短对话。

diameter.example: The table has a diameter of about one metre across the top.
diameter.zh: 这张桌子的桌面直径约一米。

diamond.example: The ring has a small diamond in the middle of a silver band.
diamond.zh: 这枚戒指的银戒圈中央镶着一颗小钻石。

diary.example: She writes a few lines in her diary before going to bed.
diary.zh: 她睡前会在日记里写几行字。

dictate.example: The teacher will dictate ten new words at the start of class.
dictate.zh: 老师会在上课开始时听写十个新单词。

dictionary.example: I always keep a small dictionary on my desk while reading.
dictionary.zh: 我读书时总在桌上放一本小词典。

die.example: The old tree died after three dry summers without much rain.
die.zh: 经历了三个少雨的干旱夏天后，那棵老树枯死了。

diesel.example: This old truck runs on diesel and is quite noisy.
diesel.zh: 这辆旧卡车烧柴油，噪音很大。

diet.example: A healthy diet with fresh vegetables helps you sleep and work better.
diet.zh: 搭配新鲜蔬菜的健康饮食有助于你睡得更好、工作更佳。

differ.example: The two brothers look alike, but their tastes differ a lot.
differ.zh: 这两兄弟长得很像，但品味大不相同。

differentiate.example: Young children often cannot differentiate between a fruit and a vegetable.
differentiate.zh: 幼儿常常分不清水果和蔬菜。

difficult.example: This question is difficult, so take your time and read it twice.
difficult.zh: 这道题很难，慢慢来，读两遍再说。

diffuse.example: The soft light diffuses through the thin curtains into the room.
diffuse.zh: 柔和的光线透过薄窗帘弥漫进房间。

dig.example: The children helped their father dig a hole for the new tree.
dig.zh: 孩子们帮父亲为新栽的树挖了一个坑。

digest.example: Some people find it hard to digest heavy food at night.
digest.zh: 有些人觉得晚上吃油腻的食物难以消化。

digit.example: Please write your phone number one digit in each small box.
digit.zh: 请把电话号码一个数字一个数字地写进每个小格子里。

dignity.example: He treated every guest with respect and simple human dignity.
dignity.zh: 他尊重每一位客人，待人有基本的尊严。

dilemma.example: She faced a real dilemma: study abroad or stay near her family.
dilemma.zh: 她面临真正的两难：出国留学还是留在家人身边。

diligent.example: A diligent student reviews her notes every evening before dinner.
diligent.zh: 一个用功的学生每天晚饭前都会复习笔记。

dilute.example: Dilute the juice with a little water before you give it to him.
dilute.zh: 给他喝之前先把果汁用一点水稀释一下。

dim.example: The room was dim, so we turned on another small lamp.
dim.zh: 房间很暗，所以我们又打开了一盏小灯。

dime.example: He found a shiny dime under the cushion of the old sofa.
dime.zh: 他在旧沙发的坐垫下找到了一枚亮闪闪的十分硬币。

dimension.example: We measured every dimension of the room before buying new furniture.
dimension.zh: 买新家具之前，我们量了房间的每个尺寸。

diminish.example: The noise from the street began to diminish as the evening went on.
diminish.zh: 随着夜幕降临，街上的噪音开始减弱。

dine.example: They like to dine in a quiet restaurant on their anniversary.
dine.zh: 他们喜欢在结婚纪念日去一家安静的餐厅用餐。

dinner.example: We usually have dinner together at seven and talk about the day.
dinner.zh: 我们通常七点一起吃晚饭，聊聊一天的事。

dinosaur.example: The museum has a huge model of a dinosaur in the hall.
dinosaur.zh: 博物馆大厅里有一具巨大的恐龙模型。

dioxide.example: Trees take in carbon dioxide and give out oxygen during the day.
dioxide.zh: 树木白天吸收二氧化碳，释放氧气。

dip.example: She dipped a piece of bread into the warm soup.
dip.zh: 她把一块面包浸到温热的汤里。

diploma.example: He received his diploma after three years of hard study.
diploma.zh: 经过三年的刻苦学习，他拿到了毕业证书。

diplomat.example: A good diplomat listens carefully before saying anything at a meeting.
diplomat.zh: 优秀的外交官在会议上开口之前会仔细倾听。

direct.example: The signs will direct visitors to the main hall and the shop.
direct.zh: 指示牌会把参观者引向大厅和商店。

directory.example: You can find the number in the local business directory online.
directory.zh: 你可以在网上的本地企业名录里找到这个号码。

dirt.example: He washed the dirt off his hands before sitting down for lunch.
dirt.zh: 他坐下吃午饭前把手上的污垢洗掉了。

disable.example: You can disable the alarm on the phone when you sleep.
disable.zh: 睡觉时你可以关闭手机上的闹钟。

disagree.example: I disagree with you about the best way to learn new words.
disagree.zh: 关于学习新单词的最好方法，我不同意你的看法。

disappear.example: The sun disappeared behind the trees and the air grew cool.
disappear.zh: 太阳消失在树后，空气变凉了。

disappoint.example: I do not want to disappoint my parents after all their help.
disappoint.zh: 父母帮了我这么多，我不想让他们失望。

disapprove.example: Her parents disapprove of the idea of a long trip alone.
disapprove.zh: 她父母不赞成她独自长途旅行的想法。

disarm.example: Her warm smile seemed to disarm even the most nervous guests.
disarm.zh: 她温暖的笑容似乎能缓和最紧张的客人。

disaster.example: The party was a disaster because we forgot to order any food.
disaster.zh: 那场聚会彻底失败了，因为我们忘了订吃的。

discard.example: Please discard the old papers and keep only the useful ones.
discard.zh: 请把旧文件丢掉，只留有价值的那些。

discern.example: It was hard to discern the letters on the old stone sign.
discern.zh: 很难辨认那块旧石牌上的字。

discharge.example: The factory must not discharge dirty water into the river.
discharge.zh: 这家工厂不得向河里排放污水。

discipline.example: Good discipline and a clear plan help students finish their work on time.
discipline.zh: 良好的纪律和清晰的计划能帮助学生按时完成作业。

disclose.example: The company refused to disclose the details of the new contract.
disclose.zh: 公司拒绝透露新合同的细节。

disco.example: They danced at a small disco near the beach until midnight.
disco.zh: 他们在海滩附近一家小迪斯科舞厅跳舞到午夜。

discord.example: There was some discord among the neighbors about the new fence.
discord.zh: 邻居们对这道新围栏有些意见不合。

discount.example: The shop gives a ten percent discount to students with a card.
discount.zh: 这家店给学生凭卡打九折。

discourage.example: Do not let one small mistake discourage you from trying again.
discourage.zh: 别让一个小错误使你气馁而不敢再试。

discourse.example: Her book is a long discourse on how children learn to read.
discourse.zh: 她的书是一篇关于儿童如何学习阅读的长篇论述。

discover.example: We discovered a quiet path behind the trees by the river.
discover.zh: 我们在河边树林后面发现了一条安静的小路。

discreet.example: He was discreet and never mentioned her name to anyone else.
discreet.zh: 他很谨慎，从没向别人提起过她的名字。

discrepancy.example: There is a small discrepancy between the two lists of numbers.
discrepancy.zh: 两份数字清单之间有一点小小的差异。

discriminate.example: A good teacher never discriminates between strong and weak students.
discriminate.zh: 好老师从不在成绩好和成绩差的学生之间区别对待。

discuss.example: We will discuss the problem at the meeting tomorrow morning.
discuss.zh: 我们会在明天上午的会上讨论这个问题。

disease.example: Washing your hands often helps prevent the spread of disease.
disease.zh: 经常洗手有助于防止疾病传播。

disguise.example: He wore a hat and glasses as a simple disguise.
disguise.zh: 他戴上帽子和眼镜，作为简单的伪装。

disgust.example: She looked at the dirty kitchen with obvious disgust.
disgust.zh: 她一脸明显的厌恶看着脏乱的厨房。

dish.example: This dish is made with rice, fresh fish and a little lemon.
dish.zh: 这道菜用米饭、鲜鱼和一点柠檬做成。

disintegrate.example: The old paper began to disintegrate as soon as we touched it.
disintegrate.zh: 我们一碰，那张旧纸就开始碎裂。

disk.example: Please save the file on the disk before you close the program.
disk.zh: 关闭程序前请把文件保存到磁盘上。

dislike.example: She has a strong dislike of loud music late at night.
dislike.zh: 她非常讨厌深夜的大声音乐。

dismantle.example: They had to dismantle the old shelf before moving the piano.
dismantle.zh: 搬钢琴之前，他们不得不把旧书架拆开。

dismay.example: To our dismay, the last bus had already left the station.
dismay.zh: 让我们沮丧的是，末班车已经离站了。

dismiss.example: The company did not dismiss anyone during the difficult winter months.
dismiss.zh: 在那段艰难的寒冬里，公司没有解雇任何人。

disorder.example: The books were in complete disorder after the children played there.
disorder.zh: 孩子们在那里玩过之后，书变得一片杂乱。

dispatch.example: The shop will dispatch your order within two working days.
dispatch.zh: 商店会在两个工作日内发出你的订单。

dispense.example: The machine can dispense hot water in just a few seconds.
dispense.zh: 这台机器几秒钟就能放出热水。

disperse.example: The crowd began to disperse quietly after the concert ended.
disperse.zh: 音乐会结束后，人群开始安静地散开。

displace.example: New machines have gradually displaced older tools in most workshops.
displace.zh: 新机器在多数车间里逐渐取代了旧工具。

display.example: The shop window displays a bright collection of summer clothes.
display.zh: 商店橱窗里陈列着一批色彩亮丽的夏装。

dispose.example: Please dispose of the empty bottles in the green bin outside.
dispose.zh: 请把空瓶子扔到外面的绿色垃圾桶里。

disposition.example: She has a cheerful disposition and rarely complains about anything at work.
disposition.zh: 她性情开朗，很少对工作上的事情抱怨。

dispute.example: The two neighbors had a long dispute about the fence between their gardens.
dispute.zh: 两个邻居为花园之间的栅栏争论了很久。

disregard.example: He showed complete disregard for the safety rules and was asked to leave.
disregard.zh: 他完全无视安全规定，因此被要求离开。

disrupt.example: Heavy rain may disrupt the train service between the two cities today.
disrupt.zh: 大雨可能会中断今天两座城市之间的列车服务。

dissent.example: One member expressed dissent, but the rest of the group agreed.
dissent.zh: 有一名成员表示异议，但小组其他人都同意了。

dissertation.example: She spent the whole summer writing her dissertation on modern teaching methods.
dissertation.zh: 她整个夏天都在写她那篇关于现代教学方法的论文。

dissident.example: A few dissident members voted against the plan at the monthly meeting.
dissident.zh: 在月度会议上，少数持不同意见的成员投票反对该计划。

dissolve.example: Stir the sugar in warm water until it dissolves completely.
dissolve.zh: 把糖放进温水里搅拌，直到它完全溶解。

distance.example: The distance between the two villages is about ten kilometers by road.
distance.zh: 两个村庄之间的距离沿公路大约十公里。

distil.example: They distil fresh water from the sea using a simple solar device.
distil.zh: 他们用一种简单的太阳能装置从海水中蒸馏出淡水。

distinct.example: There is a distinct difference between the two designs on the table.
distinct.zh: 桌上这两个设计之间存在明显的差别。

distinguish.example: Young children often cannot distinguish between a real coin and a toy.
distinguish.zh: 小孩子常常分不清真硬币和玩具硬币。

distort.example: The old mirror distorted his face and made everyone laugh.
distort.zh: 那面旧镜子把他的脸照得变了形，逗得大家直笑。

distract.example: Loud music can distract students while they are trying to study.
distract.zh: 学生们想学习的时候，吵闹的音乐会让他们分心。

distress.example: The loss of her notebook caused her great distress last week.
distress.zh: 上周丢失笔记本让她非常苦恼。

distribute.example: Volunteers will distribute food and water to the families in need.
distribute.zh: 志愿者将向有需要的家庭分发食物和水。

district.example: The old district near the river is full of small shops and cafes.
district.zh: 河边那个老城区到处都是小商店和咖啡馆。

disturb.example: Please do not disturb the baby while she is sleeping.
disturb.zh: 宝宝睡觉的时候请不要打扰她。

ditch.example: The workers dug a deep ditch along the side of the road.
ditch.zh: 工人们在路边挖了一条很深的沟。

dive.example: He dived into the cool water and swam to the other side.
dive.zh: 他跳进清凉的水里，游到了对岸。

diverse.example: The small town has a diverse mix of shops, parks and museums.
diverse.zh: 这个小镇有各式各样的商店、公园和博物馆。

divert.example: The road was closed, so workers diverted traffic to the next street.
divert.zh: 那条路封闭了，所以工人们把车流改到旁边一条街上。

divide.example: We divided the cake into eight equal pieces for the children.
divide.zh: 我们把蛋糕分成八块一样大的，分给孩子们。

dividend.example: In twelve divided by three, twelve is the dividend.
dividend.zh: 在十二除以三中，十二是被除数。

divine.example: The singer's voice sounded divine to everyone in the hall.
divine.zh: 在大厅里，所有人都觉得这位歌手的嗓音美极了。

divorce.example: Her parents decided to divorce after living apart for many years.
divorce.zh: 她的父母分居多年后决定离婚。

dizzy.example: The fast ride made me dizzy, so I sat down for a while.
dizzy.zh: 那个飞快的游乐项目让我头晕，所以我坐了一会儿。

do.example: She always does her homework before dinner on school nights.
do.zh: 上学的晚上她总是先做完作业再吃晚饭。

dock.example: The small boat waited at the dock until the wind calmed down.
dock.zh: 小船在码头等着，直到风停下来。

doctor.example: The doctor told him to rest and drink plenty of warm water.
doctor.zh: 医生让他休息，多喝温水。

doctrine.example: Many students study the doctrine of this famous philosopher.
doctrine.zh: 许多学生研究这位著名哲学家的学说。

document.example: Please save the document before you turn off the computer.
document.zh: 关电脑之前请先保存文档。

dodge.example: The cat dodged the falling leaves and ran across the yard.
dodge.zh: 猫躲开落下的叶子，跑过院子。

dog.example: Their dog barks loudly whenever the mail arrives in the morning.
dog.zh: 每天早上邮件送到时，他们的狗都会大声叫。

dogma.example: Good scientists question old ideas instead of accepting them as dogma.
dogma.zh: 优秀的科学家会质疑旧观念，而不是把它们当作教条接受。

dole.example: After losing his job, he lived on the dole for a year.
dole.zh: 失业之后，他靠救济金生活了一年。

doll.example: The little girl carried her favorite doll everywhere she went.
doll.zh: 那个小女孩走到哪里都带着她最喜欢的洋娃娃。

dollar.example: This notebook costs only one dollar at the shop near school.
dollar.zh: 这个笔记本在学校附近那家店里只要一美元。

dolphin.example: We watched a dolphin jump out of the water near our boat.
dolphin.zh: 我们看着一只海豚在我们的船边跃出水面。

domain.example: Music was her domain, and she knew every song by heart.
domain.zh: 音乐是她的领域，她熟知每一首歌。

dome.example: The old building has a round dome on top of its main hall.
dome.zh: 那座老建筑的主厅上方有一个圆形穹顶。
