domestic.example: The airline offers cheap domestic flights between several large cities.
domestic.zh: 这家航空公司提供几座大城市之间的廉价国内航班。

dominate.example: Large companies tend to dominate the market for cheap phones.
dominate.zh: 大公司往往在廉价手机市场上占据主导地位。

donate.example: Many people donate clothes and books to the local children's center.
donate.zh: 很多人向当地的儿童中心捐赠衣物和书籍。

donkey.example: The farmer loaded the donkey with bags of fresh vegetables.
donkey.zh: 农夫把一袋袋新鲜蔬菜装到驴背上。

doom.example: The broken engine seemed to doom the trip before it began.
doom.zh: 发动机坏了，似乎注定这次旅行还没开始就要失败。

door.example: Please close the door quietly when you leave the reading room.
door.zh: 离开阅览室时请轻轻把门关上。

dormitory.example: The students share a small dormitory on the third floor.
dormitory.zh: 学生们合住三楼的一间小宿舍。

dose.example: The nurse measured a small dose of medicine for the child.
dose.zh: 护士给孩子量了一小剂药。

dot.example: A tiny black dot on the map marks the old well.
dot.zh: 地图上的一个小黑点标出了那口老井。

double.example: We ordered a double portion of rice because we were hungry.
double.zh: 我们因为饿了，点了双份米饭。

doubt.example: I doubt that the shop will open before nine tomorrow.
doubt.zh: 我怀疑那家店明天九点前不会开门。

dough.example: Let the dough rest for an hour before you shape it.
dough.zh: 面团先醒一个小时再塑形。

dove.example: A white dove landed on the wall and looked at us.
dove.zh: 一只白鸽落在墙上，看着我们。

down.example: She walked down the stairs slowly with a heavy box.
down.zh: 她抱着一个沉重的箱子慢慢走下楼梯。

downgrade.example: They had to downgrade the hotel rating after the bad reviews.
downgrade.zh: 在收到差评之后，他们不得不降低这家酒店的评级。

download.example: You can download the whole book and read it offline.
download.zh: 你可以把整本书下载下来离线阅读。

downstairs.example: The kitchen is downstairs, next to the small dining room.
downstairs.zh: 厨房在楼下，就在小餐厅旁边。

downtown.example: We took the bus downtown to buy new shoes and books.
downtown.zh: 我们坐公交车去市中心买新鞋和书。

downward.example: The path makes a sharp downward turn near the river.
downward.zh: 这条小路在河边急转向下。

doze.example: He dozed in the warm chair while the rain fell outside.
doze.zh: 外面下着雨，他在温暖的椅子里打起了瞌睡。

dozen.example: She bought a dozen eggs and a bottle of milk.
dozen.zh: 她买了一打鸡蛋和一瓶牛奶。

draft.example: I wrote a first draft of the report on my way home.
draft.zh: 我在回家的路上写好了报告的初稿。

drag.example: They had to drag the heavy box up the narrow stairs.
drag.zh: 他们不得不把那个沉重的箱子拖上狭窄的楼梯。

dragon.example: The children drew a green dragon with a long tail.
dragon.zh: 孩子们画了一条长尾巴的绿龙。

drain.example: Rain water drains away through a narrow pipe behind the house.
drain.zh: 雨水从房后一根细管里排走。

drama.example: She studies drama and hopes to act on stage someday.
drama.zh: 她学戏剧，希望有一天能登台演出。

drastic.example: The garden needed drastic changes after many years of neglect.
drastic.zh: 荒废多年之后，这个花园需要彻底改变。

draw.example: He likes to draw small animals in the margins of his notes.
draw.zh: 他喜欢在笔记的空白处画小动物。

drawback.example: The main drawback of this plan is the high cost.
drawback.zh: 这个计划的主要缺点是成本太高。

drawer.example: My keys are in the top drawer of the desk.
drawer.zh: 我的钥匙在书桌最上面的抽屉里。

dread.example: Many students dread the long exam at the end of term.
dread.zh: 很多学生害怕期末那场很长的考试。

dream.example: She had a strange dream about flying over a quiet lake.
dream.zh: 她做了一个奇怪的梦，梦见自己飞过一片安静的湖。

dress.example: She dressed the children quickly and made them breakfast.
dress.zh: 她很快给孩子们穿好衣服，又给他们做了早饭。

dressing.example: He poured a little olive oil dressing over the fresh salad.
dressing.zh: 他在新鲜沙拉上淋了一点橄榄油调味汁。

drift.example: The small boat drifted slowly toward the other side of the lake.
drift.zh: 小船慢慢漂向湖的另一边。

drill.example: The teacher used a short drill to practice the new words.
drill.zh: 老师用一个小练习来操练这些新单词。

drink.example: You should drink more water when the weather is hot.
drink.zh: 天气热的时候你应该多喝水。

drip.example: Water dripped from the old pipe onto the kitchen floor.
drip.zh: 水从旧管子上滴到厨房地板上。

drive.example: My father drives me to school when it rains heavily.
drive.zh: 下大雨的时候我父亲开车送我去学校。

drop.example: Be careful not to drop the glass on the hard floor.
drop.zh: 小心别把玻璃杯掉在硬地板上。

dropout.example: The school started a program to help every dropout return to class.
dropout.zh: 学校启动了一个项目，帮助每个退学的学生重返课堂。

drought.example: The long drought left the fields dry and the river low.
drought.zh: 长期干旱让田地干裂，河水也变浅了。

drown.example: The loud music drowned out the sound of the rain.
drown.zh: 响亮的音乐盖住了雨声。

drug.example: The doctor gave him a drug to reduce the pain.
drug.zh: 医生给了他一种减轻疼痛的药。

drum.example: Someone played a drum at the back of the small hall.
drum.zh: 有人在小礼堂后面敲鼓。

drunk.example: He was too drunk to walk home by himself.
drunk.zh: 他醉得没法自己走回家。

dry.example: Hang the wet clothes outside so they can dry quickly.
dry.zh: 把湿衣服挂到外面，这样它们很快就能干。

dual.example: This small phone has a dual camera on its back.
dual.zh: 这款小手机背面有双摄像头。

dub.example: They will dub the film into three languages for young viewers.
dub.zh: 他们会把这部电影配成三种语言，给年轻观众看。

dubious.example: I felt dubious about the offer because the price seemed too low.
dubious.zh: 我对这个报价心存疑虑，因为价格似乎太低了。

duck.example: A duck swam across the pond with five little ones behind.
duck.zh: 一只鸭子游过池塘，后面跟着五只小鸭子。

due.example: The rent is due on the first day of each month.
due.zh: 房租在每月第一天到期。

dull.example: The old knife was too dull to cut the bread.
dull.zh: 那把旧刀太钝了，切不动面包。

dumb.example: He was struck dumb by the unexpected news from his friend.
dumb.zh: 听到朋友带来的意外消息，他一时说不出话来。

dump.example: They took the old chairs to the dump outside town.
dump.zh: 他们把旧椅子运到城外的垃圾场。

duplicate.example: Please keep a duplicate of every important file on this disk.
duplicate.zh: 请在这张盘上为每个重要文件留一份副本。

durable.example: These shoes are durable enough for long walks in the hills.
durable.zh: 这双鞋很耐穿，走山路也够用。

duration.example: The duration of the flight is about four hours in good weather.
duration.zh: 天气好的话，这次飞行大约持续四个小时。

during.example: Please turn off your phone during the whole class.
during.zh: 整堂课期间请关掉手机。

dusk.example: The birds grow quiet at dusk and return to their nests.
dusk.zh: 鸟儿在黄昏时安静下来，回到自己的巢里。

dust.example: There was a thick layer of dust on the old shelf.
dust.zh: 旧架子上积了一层厚厚的灰尘。

duty.example: It is our duty to keep the shared kitchen clean.
duty.zh: 保持公用厨房清洁是我们的责任。

dwarf.example: The huge tree seemed to dwarf the little house beside it.
dwarf.zh: 那棵大树让旁边的小房子显得格外矮小。

dwell.example: Many small animals dwell in the woods behind our village.
dwell.zh: 许多小动物住在我们村子后面的树林里。

dye.example: She used a natural dye to color the cloth blue.
dye.zh: 她用一种天然染料把布染成蓝色。

dynamic.example: The city has a dynamic market where prices change every day.
dynamic.zh: 这个城市有一个活跃的市场，价格每天都在变。

dynasty.example: The museum shows many objects from the last dynasty.
dynasty.zh: 博物馆里展出许多来自最后一个朝代的物品。

each.example: Each student must bring a notebook and a pen to class.
each.zh: 每个学生都必须带一个笔记本和一支笔来上课。

eager.example: The children were eager to open their gifts after dinner.
eager.zh: 孩子们吃完饭就急着要拆礼物。

eagle.example: An eagle circled high above the field and then flew away.
eagle.zh: 一只鹰在田野上空盘旋，然后飞走了。

ear.example: He whispered the answer into her ear during the game.
ear.zh: 游戏进行时他在她耳边低声说出答案。

early.example: We left early to avoid the heavy traffic on Monday.
early.zh: 我们早早出发，避开周一的拥堵。

earn.example: She works hard to earn enough money for her studies.
earn.zh: 她努力工作，为学业挣够钱。

earnest.example: He made an earnest effort to finish the work on time.
earnest.zh: 他认真地努力，想按时完成工作。

earth.example: The earth under the trees stays cool even in summer.
earth.zh: 即使在夏天，树下的泥土也是凉的。

earthquake.example: A small earthquake shook the town, but nothing was damaged.
earthquake.zh: 一场小地震震动了小镇，但没有造成损坏。

ease.example: She passed the test with ease after weeks of careful study.
ease.zh: 经过几周的认真学习，她轻松通过了考试。

east.example: The sun rises in the east and lights up the valley.
east.zh: 太阳从东方升起，照亮了山谷。

Easter.example: Many shops close for a few days around Easter each year.
Easter.zh: 每年复活节前后，很多商店会关几天门。

easy.example: This recipe is easy to follow even for young cooks.
easy.zh: 这个食谱即使对年轻的厨师来说也很容易照着做。

easy-going.example: Our new neighbor is easy-going and gets along with everyone.
easy-going.zh: 我们的新邻居很随和，和谁都合得来。

eat.example: We usually eat dinner together at half past six.
eat.zh: 我们通常六点半一起吃晚饭。

eccentric.example: The old man has an eccentric habit of talking to his plants.
eccentric.zh: 那位老人有个古怪的习惯，喜欢跟自己的植物说话。

echo.example: Our voices made a clear echo in the empty hall.
echo.zh: 我们的声音在空荡荡的大厅里产生了清晰的回声。

eclipse.example: Many people gathered outside to watch the solar eclipse.
eclipse.zh: 很多人聚到外面观看日食。

ecology.example: She is studying ecology and hopes to protect wild rivers.
ecology.zh: 她在学习生态学，希望保护野生河流。

economics.example: He read a short book on economics before the new term.
economics.zh: 新学期开始前，他读了一本关于经济学的薄书。

economy.example: The local economy depends on farming and small tourism.
economy.zh: 当地经济依靠农业和小规模旅游业。

ecosystem.example: A small pond is a complete ecosystem with plants and insects.
ecosystem.zh: 一个小池塘就是包含植物和昆虫的完整生态系统。

edge.example: She sat on the edge of the chair and waited quietly.
edge.zh: 她坐在椅子边上，静静地等着。

edible.example: Only a few of the mushrooms in this forest are edible.
edible.zh: 这片森林里只有少数几种蘑菇可以食用。

edit.example: I need an hour to edit the article before we print it.
edit.zh: 我需要一个小时把文章编辑好，然后再付印。

editorial.example: The newspaper printed an editorial about the new library.
editorial.zh: 报纸刊登了一篇关于新图书馆的社论。

educate.example: Schools should educate children to think for themselves.
educate.zh: 学校应该教育孩子独立思考。

effect.example: Too much noise has a bad effect on young children.
effect.zh: 噪音过大对幼儿有不良影响。

efficient.example: The new machine is more efficient and uses less power.
efficient.zh: 新机器效率更高，用电也更少。

effort.example: She made a real effort to speak slowly and clearly.
effort.zh: 她真的很努力地放慢语速、说得清楚。

egg.example: He boiled an egg and ate it with some bread.
egg.zh: 他煮了一个鸡蛋，就着面包吃了。

eggplant.example: We added eggplant and tomatoes to the soup last night.
eggplant.zh: 昨晚我们在汤里放了茄子和西红柿。

ego.example: His ego was hurt when nobody praised his drawing.
ego.zh: 没人夸他的画，他的自尊心受到了伤害。

eight.example: There are eight small chairs around the table in the kitchen.
eight.zh: 厨房的桌子周围有八把小椅子。

eighteen.example: She turns eighteen next month and can then drive alone.
eighteen.zh: 她下个月满十八岁，之后就能独自开车了。

eighth.example: Our flat is on the eighth floor of a quiet building.
eighth.zh: 我们的住处在一栋安静楼房的第八层。

eighty.example: My grandfather still walks two kilometers every day at eighty.
eighty.zh: 我祖父八十岁了，每天还走两公里。

either.example: You can take either path, because both lead to the lake.
either.zh: 你走哪条小路都行，两条都通向湖边。

eject.example: The machine will eject the disk after the copy finishes.
eject.zh: 复制完成后，机器会把光盘弹出来。

elaborate.example: She wrote an elaborate plan for the school garden project.
elaborate.zh: 她为学校的花园项目写了一份详尽的计划。

elapse.example: Ten years had elapsed since the two friends last met.
elapse.zh: 两位朋友上次见面到现在已经过去十年了。

elastic.example: The waistband is elastic, so the trousers fit many sizes.
elastic.zh: 裤腰有弹性，所以这条裤子适合很多尺码。

elbow.example: He hurt his elbow when he fell off the bicycle.
elbow.zh: 他从自行车上摔下来时伤了手肘。

elder.example: My elder sister taught me how to ride a bicycle.
elder.zh: 我姐姐教我怎样骑自行车。

elect.example: The members will elect a new leader at the meeting.
elect.zh: 成员们将在会议上选出一位新领导。

electoral.example: The electoral process must be clear and fair to everyone.
electoral.zh: 选举过程必须对每个人来说都清晰而公平。

electricity.example: The storm cut off electricity to the whole village for hours.
electricity.zh: 暴风雨使整个村庄断电了好几个小时。

electron.example: An electron carries a negative charge and moves around the nucleus.
electron.zh: 电子带负电荷，围绕原子核运动。

elegant.example: She wore an elegant dress to the opening of the gallery.
elegant.zh: 她穿着一件优雅的连衣裙去参加画廊开幕式。

element.example: Trust is an important element of any successful team.
element.zh: 信任是任何成功团队的重要要素。

elementary.example: The children learn basic facts in elementary science classes.
elementary.zh: 孩子们在初级科学课上学习基本常识。

elephant.example: The elephant used its trunk to pick up a small branch.
elephant.zh: 大象用鼻子捡起了一根小树枝。

elevate.example: The new lift will elevate visitors to the top floor quickly.
elevate.zh: 新电梯将很快把访客送到顶层。

eleven.example: She finished the whole task in eleven minutes without a break.
eleven.zh: 她一口气用十一分钟完成了整个任务。

elicit.example: The teacher asked a few questions to elicit more details.
elicit.zh: 老师问了几个问题以引出更多细节。

eligible.example: Only students with a valid card are eligible for the discount.
eligible.zh: 只有持有有效卡的学生才有资格享受折扣。

eliminate.example: We must eliminate errors from the report before sending it.
eliminate.zh: 我们必须在寄出报告前消除其中的错误。

elite.example: A small elite of experienced players led the training session.
elite.zh: 一小群经验丰富的精英球员带领了这次训练。

eloquent.example: Her eloquent speech moved the audience to long applause.
eloquent.zh: 她雄辩的演讲让观众长时间鼓掌。

else.example: If this plan fails, we will try something else tomorrow.
else.zh: 如果这个计划失败，我们明天再试试别的办法。

elsewhere.example: The shop was closed, so we looked elsewhere for the book.
elsewhere.zh: 商店关门了，所以我们去别处找那本书。

email.example: Please send me an email with the final details tomorrow morning.
email.zh: 请明天早上把最终细节用电子邮件发给我。

emancipate.example: The new law helped emancipate many workers from unfair contracts.
emancipate.zh: 新法律帮助许多工人从不公平的合同中解放出来。

embargo.example: The government placed an embargo on the export of certain goods.
embargo.zh: 政府对某些商品的出口实施了禁运。

embark.example: They will embark on a new project next month.
embark.zh: 他们下个月将着手一个新项目。

embarrass.example: Please do not embarrass him by asking about the mistake.
embarrass.zh: 请不要问他那个错误，以免让他难堪。

embassy.example: She went to the embassy to renew her travel documents.
embassy.zh: 她去大使馆更新旅行证件。

embed.example: The video is embedded in the page so visitors can watch it.
embed.zh: 视频被嵌入页面，以便访客观看。

embody.example: The design embodies the simple style of the whole building.
embody.zh: 这个设计体现了整栋建筑的简洁风格。

embrace.example: She gave her old friend a warm embrace at the station.
embrace.zh: 她在车站热情地拥抱了老朋友。

embroidery.example: The cushion was decorated with fine embroidery in bright colours.
embroidery.zh: 这个靠垫上装饰着色彩鲜艳的精美刺绣。

emerge.example: New evidence began to emerge as the investigation continued.
emerge.zh: 随着调查继续，新证据开始浮现。

emergency.example: Call this number at once in case of a medical emergency.
emergency.zh: 遇到医疗紧急情况时请立即拨打这个号码。

emigrate.example: Many families chose to emigrate in search of better work.
emigrate.zh: 许多家庭为了寻找更好的工作而选择移居国外。

eminent.example: An eminent scientist gave a talk at our school last week.
eminent.zh: 一位著名科学家上周在我们学校做了讲座。

emit.example: The lamp emits a soft light that is easy on the eyes.
emit.zh: 这盏灯发出柔和的光，对眼睛很友好。

emotion.example: He spoke about his childhood with strong emotion in his voice.
emotion.zh: 他谈到童年时声音里带着强烈的情感。

emperor.example: The emperor ordered a new road to be built across the valley.
emperor.zh: 皇帝下令在山谷中修建一条新路。

emphasis.example: The teacher put great emphasis on clear handwriting and neat work.
emphasis.zh: 老师非常强调字迹清楚和作业整洁。

empire.example: The old empire covered a large area for several centuries.
empire.zh: 这个古老的帝国在几个世纪里占据了广阔的土地。

empirical.example: The claim is based on empirical data from many careful tests.
empirical.zh: 这一说法基于来自许多细致测试的经验数据。

employ.example: The factory employs about two hundred people from the town.
employ.zh: 这家工厂雇用了镇上大约两百人。

empty.example: The room was empty except for a chair and a desk.
empty.zh: 房间里除了把椅子和一张桌子外空无一物。

emulate.example: Young players often try to emulate their favourite sports stars.
emulate.zh: 年轻球员常常努力效法他们最喜欢的体育明星。

enable.example: This tool will enable students to check their answers quickly.
enable.zh: 这个工具将使学生能够快速核对答案。

enact.example: The council decided to enact a new rule about street parking.
enact.zh: 委员会决定就路边停车颁布一项新规定。

enclose.example: Please enclose a copy of your ticket with the application form.
enclose.zh: 请随申请表附上一份车票复印件。

encounter.example: We had a strange encounter with a fox on the way home.
encounter.zh: 我们在回家路上与一只狐狸有过一次奇怪的相遇。

encourage.example: Her parents always encourage her to ask questions in class.
encourage.zh: 她的父母总是鼓励她在课堂上提问。

encyclopedia.example: He looked up the animal in an old encyclopedia at the library.
encyclopedia.zh: 他在图书馆的一本旧百科全书里查了这种动物。

end.example: The film will end with a quiet scene by the sea.
end.zh: 这部电影将以海边一个安静的场景结束。

endanger.example: Litter can endanger wildlife in rivers and along the coast.
endanger.zh: 乱扔垃圾会危及河流和海岸边的野生动物。

endeavor.example: We will endeavor to answer all letters within a week.
endeavor.zh: 我们将努力在一周内回复所有来信。

endorse.example: Several doctors endorse the idea of walking every day.
endorse.zh: 几位医生赞同每天步行的想法。

endow.example: The rich family decided to endow the school with a library.
endow.zh: 这个富裕的家庭决定捐赠给学校一座图书馆。

endure.example: She had to endure long hours of waiting at the airport.
endure.zh: 她不得不忍受在机场漫长的等待。

enemy.example: Fear can be an enemy of good judgment in hard times.
enemy.zh: 在困难时期，恐惧可能是良好判断力的敌人。

energy.example: Children need plenty of energy to play and learn all day.
energy.zh: 孩子们需要充足的精力来整天玩耍和学习。

enforce.example: The school will enforce the new rules from next Monday.
enforce.zh: 学校将从下周一开始执行新规定。

engage.example: The speaker managed to engage the whole class in discussion.
engage.zh: 演讲者成功地让全班参与讨论。

engine.example: The engine made a strange noise, so we stopped the car.
engine.zh: 发动机发出奇怪的声音，所以我们停下了车。

engineer.example: A young engineer designed the bridge in only two years.
engineer.zh: 一位年轻的工程师仅用两年就设计出了这座桥。

enhance.example: A little light can enhance the beauty of the old room.
enhance.zh: 一点灯光就能增添这个旧房间的美感。

enjoy.example: We really enjoy walking by the river on warm evenings.
enjoy.zh: 我们真的很喜欢在温暖的傍晚沿河散步。

enlarge.example: They plan to enlarge the kitchen by knocking down a wall.
enlarge.zh: 他们打算拆掉一面墙来扩大厨房。

enlighten.example: The guide helped enlighten us about the history of the town.
enlighten.zh: 导游帮助我们了解了这座小镇的历史。

enlist.example: The club hopes to enlist more volunteers for the weekend.
enlist.zh: 俱乐部希望为周末招募更多志愿者。

enormous.example: The new hall can hold an enormous number of people.
enormous.zh: 这个新大厅能容纳非常多的人。

enough.example: We have enough time to walk to the station.
enough.zh: 我们有足够的时间走到车站。

enquire.example: She called the office to enquire about the opening hours.
enquire.zh: 她打电话到办公室询问营业时间。

enrich.example: Reading widely can enrich your vocabulary and your writing.
enrich.zh: 广泛阅读可以丰富你的词汇和写作。

enrol.example: Each term, many adults enrol in the local evening course.
enrol.zh: 每学期都有许多成年人报名参加当地的夜校课程。

ensue.example: A short silence ensued after the question was asked.
ensue.zh: 问题提出后，短暂的沉默随之而来。

ensure.example: Please check the list to ensure that nothing is missing.
ensure.zh: 请核对清单，以确保没有遗漏。

entail.example: The job will entail a lot of travel and late hours.
entail.zh: 这份工作将需要大量出差和熬夜。

enter.example: Please enter your name in the box and click the button.
enter.zh: 请在方框里输入你的名字，然后点击按钮。

enterprise.example: The small enterprise now employs twenty people in the town.
enterprise.zh: 这家小企业现在在镇上雇用了二十个人。

entertain.example: They often entertain friends with simple meals at home.
entertain.zh: 他们经常在家里用简单的饭菜招待朋友。

enthusiasm.example: The children showed great enthusiasm for the new art project.
enthusiasm.zh: 孩子们对这个新的艺术项目表现出极大的热情。

entire.example: She read the entire book in a single quiet afternoon.
entire.zh: 她在一个安静的下午读完了整本书。

entitle.example: This ticket will entitle you to a free drink.
entitle.zh: 这张票将使你有权获得一杯免费饮料。

entity.example: The two companies remain a single legal entity today.
entity.zh: 这两家公司如今仍是同一个法律实体。

entrepreneur.example: The young entrepreneur started her first shop at nineteen.
entrepreneur.zh: 这位年轻的企业家十九岁就开了自己的第一家店。

entrust.example: You can entrust the keys to the neighbour while you travel.
entrust.zh: 你旅行时可以把钥匙托付给邻居。

envelop.example: Thick fog began to envelop the whole valley before dawn.
envelop.zh: 黎明前，浓雾开始笼罩整个山谷。

envelope.example: She sealed the letter in a plain white envelope.
envelope.zh: 她把信装进一个普通的白色信封里封好。

environment.example: We should all work to protect the natural environment.
environment.zh: 我们都应该努力保护自然环境。

envisage.example: I cannot envisage a city without parks or trees.
envisage.zh: 我无法想象一座没有公园和树木的城市。

envoy.example: An envoy was sent to discuss the trade agreement.
envoy.zh: 一位使节被派去讨论贸易协定。

envy.example: She felt a little envy when her friend won the prize.
envy.zh: 当朋友得奖时，她感到有点羡慕。

epic.example: The poem is a long epic about a journey across the sea.
epic.zh: 这首诗是一部关于横渡大海之旅的长篇史诗。

epidemic.example: Health workers worked hard to stop the epidemic from spreading further.
epidemic.zh: 医务人员努力阻止流行病进一步传播。

episode.example: The final episode of the series will air next Sunday.
episode.zh: 这部剧的最后一集将于下周日播出。

epoch.example: The invention of the printing press began a new epoch.
epoch.zh: 印刷机的发明开启了一个新纪元。

equal.example: All members have an equal chance to speak at meetings.
equal.zh: 所有成员在会议上都有平等的发言机会。

equate.example: Do not equate a high price with better quality.
equate.zh: 不要把高价格等同于更好的质量。

equator.example: The equator divides the earth into two equal halves.
equator.zh: 赤道把地球分成相等的两半。

equip.example: The school will equip each classroom with a new screen.
equip.zh: 学校将为每间教室配备一块新屏幕。

equity.example: The company tries to treat all workers with equity.
equity.zh: 公司努力公平对待所有员工。

equivalent.example: One mile is roughly equivalent to one and a half kilometres.
equivalent.zh: 一英里大致相当于一点五公里。

era.example: We now live in an era of fast digital change.
era.zh: 我们现在生活在一个数字快速变化的时代。

eradicate.example: The village worked hard to eradicate the weeds from the field.
eradicate.zh: 村民们努力根除田里的杂草。

erase.example: He used a soft cloth to erase the marks on the board.
erase.zh: 他用一块软布擦掉了黑板上的痕迹。

erect.example: Workers will erect a small stage in the square today.
erect.zh: 工人们今天将在广场上搭起一个小舞台。

erode.example: Waves slowly erode the rocks along this part of the coast.
erode.zh: 海浪慢慢侵蚀着这段海岸的岩石。

err.example: Even careful people sometimes err when they are in a hurry.
err.zh: 即使是细心的人，在匆忙时有时也会犯错。

errand.example: I have a quick errand to run before the shops close.
errand.zh: 在商店关门前我有一件小事要办。

erupt.example: The crowd erupted in cheers when the winner appeared.
erupt.zh: 获胜者出现时，人群爆发出欢呼声。

escalate.example: Small delays can escalate into serious problems if ignored.
escalate.zh: 小小的延误如果被忽视，可能会逐步升级为严重问题。

escape.example: The bird found a way to escape from the open cage.
escape.zh: 那只鸟找到了从敞开的笼子里逃走的方法。

escort.example: A guard was asked to escort the guests to the main hall.
escort.zh: 一名保安被要求护送客人到主厅。

especially.example: I love fresh fruit, especially peaches in the summer months.
especially.zh: 我喜欢新鲜水果，尤其是夏天的桃子。

essay.example: She wrote a short essay about her favourite season.
essay.zh: 她写了一篇关于自己最喜欢季节的短文。

essence.example: The essence of the plan is to save time and money.
essence.zh: 这个计划的实质是节省时间和金钱。

establish.example: They hope to establish a small library in the village.
establish.zh: 他们希望在村里建立一个小图书馆。

estate.example: He left his whole estate to his two children.
estate.zh: 他把全部财产留给了两个孩子。

esteem.example: She is held in high esteem by her students.

esthetic.example: The garden was planned for both practical and esthetic reasons.
esthetic.zh: 这座花园的设计兼顾实用和审美。

estimate.example: Experts estimate that the repairs will take about three weeks.
estimate.zh: 专家估计维修大约需要三周。

eternal.example: The poem speaks of eternal love and lasting friendship.
eternal.zh: 这首诗讲述了永恒的爱和长久的友谊。

ethic.example: A strong work ethic helped her finish the course early.
ethic.zh: 强烈的职业道德帮助她提前完成了课程。

ethnic.example: The city is home to people from many ethnic groups.
ethnic.zh: 这座城市居住着许多不同种族群体的人。

etiquette.example: Good table etiquette matters when you eat with new friends.
etiquette.zh: 和新朋友一起吃饭时，良好的餐桌礼仪很重要。

euro.example: The book costs twenty euros in most local shops.
euro.zh: 这本书在大多数本地商店售价二十欧元。

evacuate.example: The staff had to evacuate the building when the alarm rang.
evacuate.zh: 警报响起时，员工们不得不撤离大楼。

evade.example: The cat tried to evade the dog by hiding under the car.
evade.zh: 猫试图躲在车下避开那只狗。

evaluate.example: Teachers evaluate the students' progress at the end of term.
evaluate.zh: 教师在学期末评估学生的进步。

evaporate.example: The water in the bowl will evaporate in the sun.
evaporate.zh: 碗里的水在阳光下会蒸发。

eve.example: We finished all the preparations on the eve of the festival.
eve.zh: 我们在节日的前夕完成了所有准备工作。

even.example: The surface must be even before you paint it.

evening.example: We usually take a short walk after dinner in the evening.
evening.zh: 我们通常在晚饭后傍晚散步一会儿。

event.example: The school sports event will take place on Saturday morning.
event.zh: 学校的体育赛事将于周六上午举行。

eventually.example: After many tries, she eventually passed the driving test.
eventually.zh: 经过多次尝试，她终于通过了驾驶考试。

ever.example: Have you ever seen such a beautiful sunset over the sea?
ever.zh: 你曾在海上见过如此美丽的日落吗？

every.example: Every student in the class received a copy of the new book.
every.zh: 班上每个学生都拿到了一本新书。

everybody.example: Everybody in the room stood up and clapped loudly.
everybody.zh: 房间里的每个人都站起来大声鼓掌。

everyday.example: These are everyday words that you will hear often.
everyday.zh: 这些是你经常会听到的日常词汇。

everyone.example: Everyone agreed that the new plan was much simpler.
everyone.zh: 大家都认为新计划简单得多。

everything.example: She packed everything she needed into one small bag.
everything.zh: 她把自己需要的一切都装进了一个小包里。

everywhere.example: There were small flowers everywhere along the country path.
everywhere.zh: 乡间小路上到处都有小花。

evident.example: It was evident from her smile that she felt happy.
evident.zh: 从她的笑容明显可以看出她很开心。

evil.example: The old story teaches that evil is often hidden behind a kind smile.
evil.zh: 这个古老的故事告诉我们，邪恶常常隐藏在友善的微笑背后。

evoke.example: The old song can evoke memories of my childhood.
evoke.zh: 这首老歌能唤起我对童年的回忆。

evolve.example: The small idea slowly evolved into a full business plan.
evolve.zh: 这个小小的想法慢慢发展成了一个完整的商业计划。

exact.example: Please tell me the exact time when the train leaves.
exact.zh: 请告诉我火车出发的确切时间。

exaggerate.example: Do not exaggerate the size of the fish you caught.
exaggerate.zh: 不要夸大你钓到的鱼的大小。

examine.example: The doctor will examine your eyes and check your sight.
examine.zh: 医生会检查你的眼睛并检查视力。

example.example: This is a good example of simple and clear writing.
example.zh: 这是一个简洁明了写作的好例子。

exceed.example: The final cost must not exceed the agreed budget.
exceed.zh: 最终费用不得超过约定的预算。

excel.example: She always excels at solving problems under pressure.
excel.zh: 她总是擅长在压力下解决问题。

excellent.example: The food was excellent and the service was very friendly.
excellent.zh: 食物非常出色，服务也非常友好。

except.example: The shop opens every day except Sunday and public holidays.
except.zh: 这家商店除周日和公共假日外每天营业。

exception.example: Everyone must follow the rules, and there is no exception for anyone.
exception.zh: 每个人都必须遵守规则，任何人都没有例外。

excerpt.example: The teacher read a short excerpt from the novel to the class.
excerpt.zh: 老师给全班朗读了这部小说的一个短小段落。

excess.example: Too much sugar is harmful, so avoid eating it in excess.
excess.zh: 吃太多糖有害，所以要避免过量食用。

exchange.example: The two students agreed to exchange books before the weekend.
exchange.zh: 两个学生约定在周末前交换书本。

excite.example: The good news will excite the children when they hear it.
excite.zh: 孩子们听到这个好消息会很兴奋。

exclaim.example: She could not help but exclaim when she saw the beautiful garden.
exclaim.zh: 她看到美丽的花园时忍不住叫出声来。

exclude.example: The teacher decided to exclude that question from the final test.
exclude.zh: 老师决定把那个问题从期末考试中排除。

excursion.example: Our class went on a one-day excursion to the nearby hills.
excursion.zh: 我们班去附近的山里进行了一次一日游。

excuse.example: Please excuse me for being late to the meeting this morning.
excuse.zh: 请原谅我今天早上开会迟到了。

execute.example: The team worked hard to execute the plan within three months.
execute.zh: 团队努力在三个月内执行这个计划。

exempt.example: Students with a medical note are exempt from the sports test.
exempt.zh: 有医生证明的学生可以免于体育测试。

exercise.example: Regular exercise helps you stay healthy and sleep better at night.
exercise.zh: 经常锻炼有助于保持健康，晚上睡得更好。

exert.example: Good teachers exert a strong influence on the lives of students.
exert.zh: 好老师对学生的人生产生很大影响。

exhaust.example: The long walk through the city began to exhaust the older visitors.
exhaust.zh: 穿过城市的长途步行开始让年长的游客疲惫不堪。

exhibit.example: The local museum will exhibit these old paintings for two months.
exhibit.zh: 当地博物馆将展出这些旧画两个月。

exile.example: The writer spent many years in exile before returning home.
exile.zh: 这位作家流亡多年后才回到家乡。

exist.example: Many small shops still exist along this quiet old street.
exist.zh: 这条安静的老街上仍然存在许多小店铺。

exit.example: Please leave the building through the side exit near the stairs.
exit.zh: 请从楼梯旁的侧门出口离开大楼。

exotic.example: The garden is full of exotic plants from warm southern countries.
exotic.zh: 花园里满是来自南方温暖国家的异国植物。

expand.example: The company plans to expand its business into two new cities.
expand.zh: 公司计划把业务扩展到两座新城市。

expect.example: We expect the train to arrive within the next ten minutes.
expect.zh: 我们预计火车会在接下来的十分钟内到达。

expedition.example: The scientists set off on an expedition to study the desert.
expedition.zh: 科学家们出发进行探险，去研究那片沙漠。

expel.example: The school may expel students who break the rules repeatedly.
expel.zh: 学校可能会开除屡次违反规定的学生。

expend.example: They expend a lot of energy on small tasks every day.
expend.zh: 他们每天在琐碎的事情上耗费大量精力。

expense.example: The repair cost was a big expense for the young family.
expense.zh: 这笔修理费对这个年轻家庭来说是一大笔开支。

experience.example: She has ten years of experience in teaching young children.
experience.zh: 她有十年教幼儿的经验。

experiment.example: The students did a simple experiment to test how water flows.
experiment.zh: 学生们做了一个简单的实验来测试水的流动。

expert.example: He is an expert on old maps and often helps museums.
expert.zh: 他是古地图方面的专家，经常帮助博物馆。

expertise.example: The project needs technical expertise that our small team lacks.
expertise.zh: 这个项目需要我们的团队所缺乏的技术专长。

expire.example: My library card will expire at the end of this month.
expire.zh: 我的借书证将在本月底到期。

explain.example: Could you explain these instructions to me in simple words?
explain.zh: 你能用简单的话给我解释一下这些说明吗？

explicit.example: The teacher gave explicit instructions about how to write the report.
explicit.zh: 老师就如何写报告给出了明确的指示。

explode.example: The old battery can explode if it gets too hot.
explode.zh: 旧电池如果变得太热可能会爆炸。

exploit.example: Some companies exploit young workers by paying very low wages.
exploit.zh: 一些公司通过支付极低的工资来剥削年轻工人。

explore.example: We spent the afternoon exploring the small streets of the old town.
explore.zh: 我们用一下午的时间探索老城区的小巷。

exponent.example: She is a leading exponent of this simple style of painting.
exponent.zh: 她是这种简约绘画风格的主要倡导者。

export.example: The country began to export more fruit to nearby markets.
export.zh: 该国开始向附近的市场出口更多水果。

expose.example: Do not expose your skin to strong sun for too long.
expose.zh: 不要让你的皮肤在强烈的阳光下暴露太久。

exposition.example: The book offers a clear exposition of how plants grow.
exposition.zh: 这本书对植物如何生长作了清晰的阐述。

express.example: Words cannot express how grateful we are for your help.
express.zh: 言语无法表达我们对你的帮助多么感激。

expressway.example: Traffic moves quickly on the new expressway during the morning.
expressway.zh: 早间时段新高速公路上的车流移动得很快。

exquisite.example: She wore an exquisite dress covered with tiny silver flowers.
exquisite.zh: 她穿着一条缀满银色小花的精致连衣裙。

extend.example: The city plans to extend the bus line to the airport.
extend.zh: 该市计划把公交线路延伸到机场。

extent.example: We were surprised by the extent of the damage to the roof.
extent.zh: 屋顶损坏的程度让我们感到惊讶。

exterior.example: The exterior of the old house needs a fresh coat of paint.
exterior.zh: 这栋老房子的外部需要重新刷一层漆。

external.example: The phone needs an external battery to work in cold weather.
external.zh: 这款手机在寒冷天气里需要外接电池才能工作。

extinct.example: Many kinds of birds became extinct after their forests were cut down.
extinct.zh: 许多鸟类在森林被砍伐后灭绝了。

extinguish.example: Please extinguish your cigarette before you enter the building.
extinguish.zh: 进楼之前请把香烟熄灭。

extra.example: We had to pay an extra fee for the larger room.
extra.zh: 我们不得不为更大的房间额外付一笔费用。

extract.example: The dentist had to extract one of my back teeth.
extract.zh: 牙医不得不拔掉我的一颗后牙。

extraordinary.example: She has an extraordinary memory for names and small details.
extraordinary.zh: 她对名字和小细节有非凡的记忆力。

extravagant.example: He is too extravagant and spends far more than he earns.
extravagant.zh: 他太奢侈了，花的钱远远超过他挣的。

extreme.example: The desert can reach extreme heat in the middle of summer.
extreme.zh: 沙漠在盛夏时会达到极端的炎热。

eye.example: Keep an eye on the soup while it cooks.
eye.zh: 汤煮着的时候你要留意看着。

eyebrow.example: He raised one eyebrow when he heard the strange story.
eyebrow.zh: 他听到那个奇怪的故事时挑起了一边眉毛。

eyesight.example: Reading in dim light can slowly damage your eyesight.
eyesight.zh: 在昏暗的灯光下阅读会慢慢损害你的视力。

fable.example: The old fable teaches children to be honest and kind.
fable.zh: 这个古老的寓言教导孩子们要诚实善良。

fabric.example: This soft fabric feels cool against the skin in summer.
fabric.zh: 这种柔软的布料在夏天贴皮肤感觉很凉爽。

fabricate.example: The worker had to fabricate a small part for the old machine.
fabricate.zh: 工人必须为这台旧机器制造一个小零件。

fabulous.example: Her story about the trip sounds almost fabulous but it is true.
fabulous.zh: 她关于那次旅行的讲述听起来几乎难以置信，但却是真的。

face.example: She had to face a difficult choice between two jobs.
face.zh: 她不得不在两份工作之间面对一个艰难的选择。

facet.example: Money is only one facet of a happy and healthy life.
facet.zh: 金钱只是幸福健康生活的一个方面。

facility.example: The new sports facility is open to all local residents.
facility.zh: 新的体育设施向所有当地居民开放。

fact.example: It is a fact that plants need light and water to grow.
fact.zh: 植物需要阳光和水才能生长，这是事实。

faction.example: A small faction inside the club wanted to change its rules.
faction.zh: 俱乐部内部的一个小派系想改变它的规则。

factor.example: Cost is an important factor when we choose a new car.
factor.zh: 我们选购新车时，价格是一个重要因素。

factory.example: My uncle has worked in the same factory for twenty years.
factory.zh: 我叔叔在同一家工厂工作了二十年。

faculty.example: The faculty of law moved into a larger building last year.
faculty.zh: 法学院去年搬进了一栋更大的楼。

fade.example: The bright colors of the curtain will fade in strong sunlight.
fade.zh: 窗帘鲜亮的颜色在强烈的阳光下会褪色。

fail.example: If you fail the test, you can try again next month.
fail.zh: 如果这次考试不及格，你下个月可以再试一次。

faint.example: The smell of smoke made her feel faint for a moment.
faint.zh: 烟味让她有一瞬间觉得要昏倒。

fair.example: The teacher tries to be fair to every student in class.
fair.zh: 老师努力对班上每个学生都公平。

fairly.example: The exam was fairly easy, so most students finished early.
fairly.zh: 考试相当容易，所以大多数学生提前做完了。

fairy.example: The child believed a kind fairy lived in the garden.
fairy.zh: 那个孩子相信花园里住着一位善良的仙女。

faith.example: She has great faith in her team and in their plan.
faith.zh: 她对她的团队和他们的计划非常有信心。

fake.example: The bag looks real, but it is actually a cheap fake.
fake.zh: 这个包看起来像真的，但实际上是一件廉价假货。

fall.example: Leaves fall from the trees when autumn arrives each year.
fall.zh: 每年秋天到来时，树叶会从树上落下。

false.example: The news report gave us a completely false idea of the event.
false.zh: 那篇新闻报道让我们对事件产生了完全错误的认识。

fame.example: The young singer found fame after one short video online.
fame.zh: 那位年轻歌手在一段短视频走红之后一举成名。

familiar.example: Her face looks familiar, but I cannot remember her name.
familiar.zh: 她的脸看起来很熟悉，但我记不起她的名字。

family.example: My whole family gets together for dinner every Sunday.
family.zh: 每个星期天我们全家都会聚在一起吃晚饭。

famine.example: The long dry summer led to a serious famine in the region.
famine.zh: 漫长的干旱夏季导致该地区发生了严重的饥荒。

fan.example: She is a big fan of quiet jazz and old films.
fan.zh: 她是安静爵士乐和老电影的忠实爱好者。

fancy.example: They had dinner at a fancy restaurant to celebrate her birthday.
fancy.zh: 他们在一家高档餐厅吃晚饭庆祝她的生日。

fantasy.example: The boy lives in a fantasy world of dragons and magic.
fantasy.zh: 这个男孩生活在一个有龙和魔法的幻想世界里。

far.example: The station is not far from our house, only ten minutes on foot.
far.zh: 车站离我们家不远，步行只有十分钟。

fare.example: The bus fare went up again at the start of the year.
fare.zh: 公交车费在年初又涨了。

farewell.example: The students held a small farewell party for their teacher.
farewell.zh: 学生们为他们的老师举办了一个小型告别会。

farm.example: My grandparents grow vegetables on a small farm outside town.
farm.zh: 我的祖父母在城外的一个小农场种蔬菜。

farther.example: The second shop is farther from the station than the first.
farther.zh: 第二家店比第一家离车站更远。

fascinate.example: Old maps and strange animals fascinate the children in this class.
fascinate.zh: 古地图和奇怪的动物让这个班的孩子着迷。

fascist.example: The novel describes life under a fascist government many years ago.
fascist.zh: 这部小说描写了许多年前一个法西斯政府统治下的生活。

fashion.example: Short skirts came back into fashion again this spring.
fashion.zh: 短裙今年春天又流行起来了。

fast.example: He can run very fast, but he cannot swim at all.
fast.zh: 他跑得很快，但完全不会游泳。

fasten.example: Please fasten your seat belt before the car starts moving.
fasten.zh: 请在汽车开动之前系好安全带。

fat.example: This soup contains very little fat and no added sugar.
fat.zh: 这种汤含脂肪很少，也没有加糖。

fatal.example: One small mistake in the plan proved fatal to the whole project.
fatal.zh: 计划中的一个小错误被证明对整个项目是致命的。

fate.example: No one knows the fate of the old letters in that box.
fate.zh: 没人知道那个盒子里的旧信件命运如何。

father.example: My father taught me how to ride a bicycle when I was six.
father.zh: 我父亲在我六岁时教我骑自行车。

fatigue.example: She felt great fatigue after working for twelve hours.
fatigue.zh: 连续工作十二个小时后，她感到极度疲劳。

fault.example: It was my fault that we missed the last train.
fault.zh: 我们错过末班车是我的错。

favor.example: Could you do me a favor and close the window?
favor.zh: 你能帮我个忙，把窗户关一下吗？

fax.example: Please fax the signed form to our office before Friday.
fax.zh: 请在周五之前把签好的表格传真到我们办公室。

fear.example: Many people fear speaking in front of a large group.
fear.zh: 很多人害怕在一大群人面前讲话。

feasible.example: It is feasible to finish the work in two weeks.
feasible.zh: 在两周内完成这项工作是可行的。

feast.example: The whole village prepared a great feast for the harvest.
feast.zh: 全村人准备了一场盛大的丰收宴席。

feat.example: Climbing that steep wall was a real feat for the team.
feat.zh: 爬上那面陡壁对这支队伍来说真是一项壮举。

feather.example: A single white feather floated down and landed on my hand.
feather.zh: 一片白色的羽毛飘落下来，落在我的手上。

feature.example: The main feature of this phone is its very long battery life.
feature.zh: 这款手机的主要特点是电池续航时间非常长。

February.example: The days are still short and cold here in February.
February.zh: 这里的二月白天仍然很短，天气很冷。

federal.example: Federal law sets the basic rules for food safety in the country.
federal.zh: 联邦法律规定了这个国家食品安全的基本规则。

federation.example: The small clubs formed a federation to share coaches and costs.
federation.zh: 这些小俱乐部组成了一个联盟，共享教练和费用。

fee.example: There is a small fee for using the swimming pool.
fee.zh: 使用游泳池需要付一小笔费用。

feeble.example: The old man gave a feeble wave from the window.
feeble.zh: 那位老人从窗口无力地挥了挥手。

feed.example: Please feed the cat twice a day and give it fresh water.
feed.zh: 请每天喂猫两次，并给它新鲜的水。

feedback.example: The teacher gave useful feedback on my first written report.
feedback.zh: 老师对我的第一份书面报告给出了有用的反馈。

feel.example: I feel much better after a short walk in the park.
feel.zh: 在公园里散了一会儿步后我感觉好多了。

fellow.example: My fellow students helped me carry the heavy boxes upstairs.
fellow.zh: 我的同学们帮我把沉重的箱子搬上楼。

female.example: The female bird is usually less colorful than the male.
female.zh: 雌鸟通常没有雄鸟那么色彩鲜艳。

feminine.example: The room has a soft, feminine style with light colors.
feminine.zh: 这个房间色调明亮，有一种柔和的女性风格。

fence.example: A low wooden fence runs around the whole garden.
fence.zh: 一道低矮的木栅栏环绕着整个花园。

ferry.example: We took the ferry across the river to reach the island.
ferry.zh: 我们乘渡船过河到达那座岛。

fertile.example: The soil near the river is fertile and good for farming.
fertile.zh: 河边的土壤肥沃，适合耕种。

festival.example: The town holds a music festival every summer by the lake.
festival.zh: 这个小镇每年夏天都会在湖边举办音乐节。

fetch.example: Could you fetch a glass of water for our guest?
fetch.zh: 你能给我们的客人去拿一杯水吗？

fever.example: The child has a high fever and should stay in bed.
fever.zh: 这个孩子发高烧，应该卧床休息。

few.example: Only a few people came to the meeting on such a cold day.
few.zh: 在这么冷的一天，只有几个人来参加会议。

fiber.example: Fruit and vegetables are rich in fiber and vitamins.
fiber.zh: 水果和蔬菜富含纤维和维生素。

fiction.example: She prefers reading fiction to watching films at night.
fiction.zh: 晚上她更喜欢读小说而不是看电影。

field.example: The children played football in the field behind the school.
field.zh: 孩子们在学校后面的场地上踢足球。

fierce.example: A fierce wind blew all night and shook the windows.
fierce.zh: 一阵猛烈的风刮了一整夜，震得窗户直响。

fifteen.example: There are fifteen students waiting outside the music room.
fifteen.zh: 有十五个学生在音乐室外等候。

fifth.example: Our office is on the fifth floor of this old building.
fifth.zh: 我们办公室在这栋旧楼的五层。

fifty.example: The hall can hold about fifty people for a small concert.
fifty.zh: 这个大厅能容纳大约五十人举行小型音乐会。

fight.example: She had to fight hard to keep her small shop open.
fight.zh: 她不得不努力奋斗才让自己的小店继续开下去。

figure.example: The final figure in the report was much higher than expected.
figure.zh: 报告中的最终数字比预期高得多。

file.example: Please save the file before you close the computer.
file.zh: 关电脑之前请保存文件。

fill.example: Please fill the bottle with clean water before we leave.
fill.zh: 我们出发前请把瓶子装满干净的水。

film.example: We watched a short film about life in the desert.
film.zh: 我们看了一部关于沙漠生活的短片。

filter.example: This machine can filter dust from the air in minutes.
filter.zh: 这台机器能在几分钟内过滤掉空气中的灰尘。

final.example: This is your final chance to change the answer.
final.zh: 这是你修改答案的最后机会。

finance.example: The bank agreed to finance the new school building.
finance.zh: 银行同意为新建的学校大楼提供资金。

find.example: I cannot find my keys anywhere in this small room.
find.zh: 在这个小房间里我到处都找不到我的钥匙。

fine.example: He had to pay a fine for parking in the wrong place.
fine.zh: 他因为停错地方而不得不交罚款。

finger.example: She pointed her finger at the map to show the way.
finger.zh: 她用手指指着地图指路。

fingerprint.example: The door opens with a fingerprint instead of a key.
fingerprint.zh: 这扇门用指纹而不是钥匙打开。

finish.example: Please finish your homework before you go out to play.
finish.zh: 出去玩之前请先把作业做完。

finite.example: The earth has a finite supply of clean water.
finite.zh: 地球上的清洁水资源是有限的。

fire.example: We lit a small fire to keep warm in the cold night.
fire.zh: 我们在寒冷的夜里点了一小堆火取暖。

fireman.example: The fireman showed the class how to use the hose.
fireman.zh: 消防员向全班演示如何使用水龙带。

fireplace.example: We sat by the fireplace and talked until the fire went out.
fireplace.zh: 我们坐在壁炉旁聊天，直到炉火熄灭。

fireworks.example: The children watched the fireworks light up the night sky.
fireworks.zh: 孩子们看着烟火照亮夜空。

firm.example: She works for a small firm that designs websites for local shops.
firm.zh: 她在一家为本地商店设计网站的小公司工作。

first.example: He finished first in the race and won a small prize.
first.zh: 他在比赛中第一个到达终点，赢得了一个小奖品。

fiscal.example: The company reported strong sales in the last fiscal year.
fiscal.zh: 公司在上一财政年度报告了强劲的销售。

fish.example: We caught three fish in the river and cooked them for dinner.
fish.zh: 我们在河里抓了三条鱼，晚饭时煮了。

fist.example: He closed his fist and knocked on the heavy wooden door.
fist.zh: 他握紧拳头，敲了敲那扇沉重的木门。

fit.example: These shoes do not fit me, so I need a larger size.
fit.zh: 这双鞋不合我的脚，所以我需要大一号。

five.example: There are five apples left on the kitchen table.
five.zh: 厨房桌上还剩五个苹果。

fix.example: My father can fix a broken chair in a few minutes.
fix.zh: 我父亲几分钟就能修好一把坏椅子。

flag.example: A red flag waved on the roof during the strong wind.
flag.zh: 大风中，一面红旗在屋顶上飘扬。

flame.example: The small flame of the candle moved gently in the dark room.
flame.zh: 蜡烛的小火苗在黑暗的房间里轻轻摇动。

flank.example: The horse had a white mark on its left flank.
flank.zh: 那匹马的左侧腹有一块白斑。

flap.example: The bird began to flap its wings and rose into the air.
flap.zh: 那只鸟开始拍打翅膀，飞向空中。

flare.example: She lit a flare so the search team could find her.
flare.zh: 她点燃了一支信号弹，好让搜救队找到她。

flash.example: A bright flash of lightning lit the whole garden for a second.
flash.zh: 一道明亮的闪电把整个花园照亮了一秒钟。

flat.example: The land around the village is flat and easy to walk on.
flat.zh: 村子周围的土地很平坦，走起来很轻松。

flatter.example: He tried to flatter his boss to get a longer holiday.
flatter.zh: 他试图奉承老板，以获得更长的假期。

flavor.example: This soup has a rich flavor of tomatoes and fresh herbs.
flavor.zh: 这汤有浓郁的番茄和新鲜香草味。

flaw.example: The only flaw in the plan is the lack of time.
flaw.zh: 这个计划唯一的缺点是时间不够。

flee.example: The family had to flee their home when the river rose.
flee.zh: 河水上涨时，一家人不得不逃离家园。

fleet.example: A fleet of small boats returned to the harbor at sunset.
fleet.zh: 一支小船队日落时返回港口。

flesh.example: The fruit is sweet, and its flesh is soft and juicy.
flesh.zh: 这种水果很甜，果肉柔软多汁。

flexible.example: This rope is flexible enough to bend around the tree.
flexible.zh: 这根绳子很柔韧，能绕着树弯曲。

flight.example: Our flight to the island was delayed by heavy rain.
flight.zh: 我们飞往岛上的航班因大雨延误。

fling.example: Do not fling your wet towel onto the clean bed.
fling.zh: 别把湿毛巾扔到干净的床上。

flip.example: Please flip the pancake before it turns dark brown.
flip.zh: 请把煎饼翻个面，别让它煎得焦黑。

flirt.example: She did not mean to flirt and was just being friendly.
flirt.zh: 她并非有意调情，只是表现得友好。

float.example: A few leaves float slowly down the river every autumn.
float.zh: 每年秋天都有几片叶子顺着河慢慢漂流。

flock.example: A flock of birds flew over the field at dawn.
flock.zh: 黎明时一群鸟飞过田野。

flood.example: Heavy rain caused a flood that covered the whole road.
flood.zh: 大雨引发了洪水，淹没了整条路。

floor.example: She cleaned the kitchen floor after dinner last night.
floor.zh: 昨晚饭后她打扫了厨房地板。

flour.example: We need flour, eggs and milk to make this cake.
flour.zh: 我们需要面粉、鸡蛋和牛奶来做这个蛋糕。

flourish.example: Small shops began to flourish after the new road opened.
flourish.zh: 新路开通后，小商店开始兴旺起来。

flow.example: The river flows slowly through the green valley.
flow.zh: 河水缓缓流过绿色的山谷。

flower.example: A yellow flower opened beside the path this morning.
flower.zh: 今早路边开了一朵黄花。

fluctuate.example: Prices at the market fluctuate with the seasons every year.
fluctuate.zh: 市场上的价格每年随季节波动。

fluent.example: She is fluent in two languages and studies a third.
fluent.zh: 她能流利地说两种语言，还在学第三种。

fluid.example: Drink plenty of fluid when you exercise in hot weather.
fluid.zh: 天热运动时要多喝液体。

flush.example: Her cheeks began to flush when everyone looked at her.
flush.zh: 大家看她时，她的脸开始发红。

flutter.example: The curtains flutter gently whenever the window is open.
flutter.zh: 窗户一开，窗帘就轻轻飘动。

fly.example: Birds fly south before the cold winter arrives.
fly.zh: 鸟儿在寒冬到来前飞往南方。

foam.example: The waves left white foam along the edge of the beach.
foam.zh: 海浪在沙滩边留下一片白色的泡沫。

focus.example: Try to focus on one task at a time.
focus.zh: 试着一次只专注于一件事。

foe.example: He treats every rival as a foe instead of a friend.
foe.zh: 他把每个对手都当成敌人而不是朋友。

fog.example: Thick fog covered the road, so we drove very slowly.
fog.zh: 浓雾笼罩着道路，所以我们开得很慢。

foil.example: Wrap the fish in foil before you put it in the oven.
foil.zh: 把鱼用锡箔包好，再放进烤箱。

fold.example: Please fold the map and put it back in the bag.
fold.zh: 请把地图折好，放回包里。

folk.example: Older folk in the village still remember that old song.
folk.zh: 村里上了年纪的人仍然记得那首老歌。

folklore.example: The story is part of local folklore and has many versions.
folklore.zh: 这个故事是当地民间传说的一部分，有许多版本。

follow.example: Please follow me and I will show you the way.
follow.zh: 请跟着我，我来给你指路。

fond.example: She is very fond of small animals and often feeds them.
fond.zh: 她非常喜欢小动物，经常喂它们。

food.example: We bought enough food for the whole family for a week.
food.zh: 我们买了够全家吃一星期的食物。

fool.example: Do not fool yourself into thinking the work is easy.
fool.zh: 别骗自己以为这份工作很容易。

foot.example: He hurt his foot while playing football in the park.
foot.zh: 他在公园踢足球时伤了脚。

football.example: The boys play football in the park after school.
football.zh: 男孩们放学后在公园踢足球。

footprint.example: We found a large footprint in the soft mud.
footprint.zh: 我们在软泥里发现了一个大脚印。

for.example: She bought a small gift for her sister's birthday.
for.zh: 她为妹妹的生日买了一件小礼物。

forbid.example: The rules forbid visitors from feeding the animals.
forbid.zh: 规定禁止游客给动物喂食。

force.example: The storm may force the team to cancel the match.
force.zh: 暴风雨可能迫使球队取消比赛。

forecast.example: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow afternoon.
forecast.zh: 天气预报说明天下午会下雨。

forehead.example: She put her hand on his forehead to check his temperature.
forehead.zh: 她把手放在他额头上量体温。

foreign.example: He enjoys reading foreign novels in his free time.
foreign.zh: 他空闲时喜欢读外国小说。

foremost.example: Safety is the foremost concern when we plan the trip.
foremost.zh: 我们计划这次旅行时，安全是最重要的事。

foresee.example: We cannot foresee every problem that may appear later.
foresee.zh: 我们无法预见以后可能出现的每个问题。

foresight.example: Thanks to her foresight, the team had enough water.
foresight.zh: 幸亏她有远见，队里带了足够的水。

forest.example: They walked through the forest and listened to the birds.
forest.zh: 他们穿过森林，听着鸟叫。

foretell.example: No one can foretell what the weather will be next month.
foretell.zh: 没人能预告下个月的天气会怎样。

forever.example: I will remember that kind old teacher forever.
forever.zh: 我会永远记得那位善良的老教师。

forfeit.example: If you break the rules, you may forfeit your turn.
forfeit.zh: 如果你违反规则，可能会失去你的回合。

forge.example: Someone tried to forge his signature on the old letter.
forge.zh: 有人试图在那封旧信上伪造他的签名。

forget.example: Do not forget to lock the door when you leave.

forgive.example: She decided to forgive him for the honest mistake.
forgive.zh: 她决定原谅他那个无心的错误。

fork.example: He ate the salad with a small fork and a knife.
fork.zh: 他用一把小叉子和一把刀吃沙拉。

form.example: Please fill in this form and return it to the desk.
form.zh: 请填好这张表格，然后交回服务台。

formal.example: He wore a formal suit to the important meeting.
formal.zh: 他穿正式西装去参加那个重要会议。

format.example: Please save the file in a simple text format.
format.zh: 请把文件保存为简单的文本格式。

former.example: The former owner of the shop now lives by the sea.
former.zh: 这家店以前的店主现在住在海边。

formidable.example: The mountain is a formidable challenge for new climbers.
formidable.zh: 这座山对新登山者来说是个巨大的挑战。

formula.example: The teacher wrote the formula on the board twice.
formula.zh: 老师把公式在黑板上写了两遍。

formulate.example: The team will formulate a clear plan before starting work.
formulate.zh: 团队会在开始工作前制订一个明确的计划。

fort.example: The old fort is now a quiet museum for visitors.
fort.zh: 那座古老的堡垒现在是一座安静的博物馆。

forth.example: The little girl ran back and forth along the path.
forth.zh: 小女孩沿着小路来回跑。

forthcoming.example: The forthcoming book will explain how plants grow.
forthcoming.zh: 即将出版的书会讲解植物如何生长。

fortify.example: A good breakfast will fortify you for a long walk.
fortify.zh: 一顿丰盛的早餐能让你有力气走很远的路。

fortnight.example: They stayed at the lake for a fortnight last summer.
fortnight.zh: 去年夏天他们在湖边住了两星期。

fortune.example: He made a small fortune by selling handmade toys.
fortune.zh: 他靠卖手工玩具赚了一小笔钱。

forty.example: There are forty students in our class this year.
forty.zh: 今年我们班有四十名学生。

forum.example: The online forum is a good place to share ideas.
forum.zh: 这个网络论坛是分享想法的好地方。

forward.example: Please move forward a little so others can pass.
forward.zh: 请往前走一点，好让别人过去。

fossil.example: The children found a small fossil in the gray rock.
fossil.zh: 孩子们在灰色岩石里发现了一块小化石。

foster.example: Good teachers foster curiosity in every student they meet.
foster.zh: 好老师会培养他们遇到的每个学生的好奇心。

foul.example: The water in the old pool smelled foul and looked dark.
foul.zh: 旧水池里的水闻起来很臭，看起来发黑。

found.example: The school was founded more than a hundred years ago.
found.zh: 这所学校创建于一百多年前。

foundation.example: A strong foundation is necessary for any new building.
foundation.zh: 任何新建筑都需要牢固的地基。

fountain.example: Water rose from the fountain in the middle of the square.
fountain.zh: 水从广场中央的喷泉中涌起。

four.example: We need four chairs and one small table for the meeting.
four.zh: 会议需要四把椅子和一张小桌子。

fourteen.example: She was fourteen when she first learned to swim.
fourteen.zh: 她第一次学游泳时十四岁。

fox.example: A red fox walked quietly across the snowy field.
fox.zh: 一只红狐狸悄悄走过雪地。

fraction.example: Only a small fraction of the students missed the class.
fraction.zh: 只有一小部分学生缺课。

fracture.example: He fell off the bike and suffered a small fracture.
fracture.zh: 他从自行车上摔下来，受了轻微的骨折。

fragile.example: This glass is fragile, so please carry it with care.
fragile.zh: 这个玻璃杯很易碎，请小心拿。

fragment.example: She found a fragment of an old cup in the garden.
fragment.zh: 她在花园里发现了一个旧杯子的碎片。

fragrant.example: The garden is full of fragrant flowers in early summer.
fragrant.zh: 初夏时花园里满是芬芳的花。

frame.example: He put the photo in a wooden frame and hung it up.
frame.zh: 他把照片放进木框里，挂了起来。

framework.example: The new plan gives us a clear framework for our work.
framework.zh: 新计划为我们的工作提供了清晰的框架。

franchise.example: She bought a franchise and opened a small coffee shop.
franchise.zh: 她买下特许经营权，开了一家小咖啡店。

frank.example: To be frank, I do not agree with your first idea.
frank.zh: 坦率地说，我不同意你的第一个想法。

frantic.example: She made a frantic search for her lost keys.
frantic.zh: 她发疯似地寻找丢失的钥匙。

fraud.example: The man was charged with fraud after selling fake tickets.
fraud.zh: 那人因出售假票而被控欺诈。

free.example: The museum is free for students every Sunday morning.
free.zh: 博物馆每周日上午对学生免费。

freeway.example: Traffic on the freeway was slow during the morning rush.
freeway.zh: 早高峰时高速公路上车流缓慢。

freeze.example: Water will freeze into ice at zero degrees.

freight.example: The train carries freight across the country every night.
freight.zh: 这列火车每晚运送货物穿越全国。

frequent.example: He is a frequent visitor to the small town library.
frequent.zh: 他是小镇图书馆的常客。

fresh.example: We bought fresh bread and fruit at the morning market.
fresh.zh: 我们在早市买了新鲜的面包和水果。

freshman.example: Every freshman must attend the welcome meeting on Monday.
freshman.zh: 每位大一新生都必须参加周一的欢迎会。

friction.example: The rough surface creates a lot of friction when you rub it.
friction.zh: 粗糙的表面摩擦时会产生很大的摩擦力。

Friday.example: We will meet again next Friday at the same place.
Friday.zh: 我们下星期五在同一个地方再见。

friend.example: My best friend helped me move to the new flat.
friend.zh: 我最好的朋友帮我搬进了新公寓。

fright.example: The loud noise gave the little cat a terrible fright.
fright.zh: 那声巨响把小猫吓坏了。

fringe.example: They live on the fringe of the city, near the hills.
fringe.zh: 他们住在城市边缘，靠近群山。

frog.example: A green frog jumped from the rock into the water.
frog.zh: 一只绿青蛙从岩石上跳进水里。

from.example: She walked home from the station in the rain.

front.example: A small garden is in front of the old house.
front.zh: 老房子前面有一个小花园。

frontier.example: The small town sits near the frontier and has few visitors.
frontier.zh: 小镇位于边境附近，访客很少。

frost.example: Thin frost covered the grass on the cold morning.
frost.zh: 寒冷的早晨，薄霜覆盖着草地。

frown.example: She gave a slight frown when she heard the news.
frown.zh: 听到这个消息时，她微微皱了皱眉。

fruit.example: Fresh fruit is a healthy snack for children after school.
fruit.zh: 新鲜水果是孩子们放学后的健康零食。

frustrate.example: The heavy rain frustrated our plan to visit the garden.
frustrate.zh: 大雨破坏了我们去参观花园的计划。

fry.example: She will fry the eggs in a little butter.
fry.zh: 她会用一点黄油煎鸡蛋。

fuck.example: She told him to stop using that rude word and never say fuck again.
fuck.zh: 她让他别再讲那个粗话，永远别再说那个脏字。

fuel.example: The car needs fuel before we start the long journey.
fuel.zh: 我们开始长途旅行前，车需要加油。

fulfil.example: She worked hard to fulfil her dream of becoming a nurse.
fulfil.zh: 她努力工作，以实现当护士的梦想。

full.example: The bus was full, so we waited for the next one.
full.zh: 公交车满了，所以我们等了下一班。

fun.example: The children had a lot of fun at the beach.
fun.zh: 孩子们在海滩上玩得很开心。

function.example: The main function of this button is to start the machine.
function.zh: 这个按钮的主要功能是启动机器。

fund.example: They raised enough money to fund a new school library.
fund.zh: 他们筹到足够的钱，为学校新建一座图书馆提供资金。

fundamental.example: Trust is fundamental to any good friendship or team.
fundamental.zh: 信任对任何良好的友谊或团队都至关重要。

funeral.example: Many friends came to the quiet funeral to show respect.
funeral.zh: 许多朋友来到安静的葬礼上表达敬意。

fur.example: The cat has soft white fur and bright green eyes.
fur.zh: 这只猫有柔软的白毛和明亮的绿眼睛。

furnace.example: The old furnace keeps the whole house warm in winter.
furnace.zh: 旧火炉在冬天让整座房子保持温暖。

furnish.example: They will furnish the new flat with simple wooden tables.
furnish.zh: 他们会用简单的木桌为新公寓配家具。

furniture.example: The room was empty except for one piece of furniture.
furniture.zh: 除了唯一的家具，房间里空荡荡的。

further.example: We need further information before we make a decision.
further.zh: 我们需要更多信息才能做决定。

furthermore.example: The plan is cheap; furthermore, it saves a lot of time.
furthermore.zh: 这个计划成本低；此外，它还节省大量时间。

fury.example: He shouted in fury when he saw the broken window.
fury.zh: 看到破窗户时，他愤怒地喊叫。

fuse.example: A blown fuse left the whole kitchen without light.
fuse.zh: 保险丝烧断后，整个厨房都没了灯光。

fusion.example: The dish is a fusion of sweet and spicy flavors.
fusion.zh: 这道菜融合了甜味和辣味。

fuss.example: Please do not make a fuss about such a small problem.
fuss.zh: 请不要为这么小的问题大惊小怪。

futile.example: All their efforts to repair the old car were completely futile.
futile.zh: 他们为修好那辆旧车付出的一切努力都完全白费了。

future.example: No one can say for sure what the future will bring.
future.zh: 没人能确切说出未来会带来什么。

gadget.example: He bought a clever little gadget that cuts fruit in seconds.
gadget.zh: 他买了一个聪明的小玩意儿，几秒钟就能切好水果。

gain.example: She gained a lot of useful experience during her summer job.
gain.zh: 她在暑期工作中积累了很多有用的经验。

galaxy.example: Our galaxy contains billions of stars that shine at night.
galaxy.zh: 我们的星系包含数十亿颗在夜里闪光的恒星。

gallery.example: We spent the afternoon in a quiet gallery full of old paintings.
gallery.zh: 我们在一间挂满旧画的安静画廊里度过了下午。

gallon.example: The old car uses about a gallon of fuel every twenty miles.
gallon.zh: 这辆旧车大约每二十英里消耗一加仑燃料。

gamble.example: Putting all his money into one shop was a big gamble.
gamble.zh: 把他所有的钱都投进一家店是一场大冒险。

game.example: The children played a simple game with a ball and two chairs.
game.zh: 孩子们用一只球和两把椅子玩了一个简单的游戏。

gang.example: A gang of workers repaired the road outside our house last week.
gang.zh: 上周一队工人在我们房子外面修路。

gaol.example: The old gaol by the river is now a quiet local museum.
gaol.zh: 河边那座旧监狱如今成了一座安静的本地博物馆。

gap.example: There is a small gap between the door and the floor.
gap.zh: 门和地板之间有一道小缝隙。

garage.example: He parked the car in the garage and closed the door.
garage.zh: 他把车停进车库，然后关上了门。

garbage.example: Please take the garbage out before the truck arrives.
garbage.zh: 请在垃圾车来之前把垃圾拿出去。

garden.example: My grandmother grows tomatoes and flowers in her small garden.
garden.zh: 我祖母在她的小花园里种西红柿和花。

garlic.example: Add a little garlic to the soup for a stronger taste.
garlic.zh: 往汤里加一点大蒜，味道会更浓。

garment.example: Each garment in the shop is made of soft cotton.
garment.zh: 店里的每件衣服都是用柔软的棉布做的。

gas.example: The kitchen smells of gas, so please open the window.
gas.zh: 厨房里有煤气味，请把窗户打开。

gasoline.example: The price of gasoline went up again at the local station.
gasoline.zh: 当地加油站的汽油价格又上涨了。

gasp.example: She gasped in surprise when she saw the huge cake.
gasp.zh: 看到那个巨大的蛋糕时，她惊讶得喘了口气。

gate.example: A wooden gate leads from the garden to the quiet street.
gate.zh: 一扇木门从花园通向那条安静的街道。

gather.example: We gather in the kitchen every evening to share the news.
gather.zh: 我们每天晚上都在厨房聚在一起聊新闻。

gauge.example: The gauge on the wall shows how much water is left.
gauge.zh: 墙上的计量表显示还剩多少水。

gay.example: The garden was full of gay colors in early spring.
gay.zh: 早春时花园里满是艳丽的色彩。

gaze.example: He stood at the window and gazed at the falling snow.
gaze.zh: 他站在窗前凝视着飘落的雪。

gear.example: The bike would not move because one gear was broken.
gear.zh: 自行车动不了，因为有一个齿轮坏了。

gender.example: The form asks for your name, age and gender.
gender.zh: 这张表格要求填写你的姓名、年龄和性别。

gene.example: Scientists found a gene that may affect how tall a person grows.
gene.zh: 科学家发现了一种可能影响人身高的基因。

general.example: The general idea of the plan is easy to understand.
general.zh: 这个计划的大体思路很容易理解。

generate.example: The new solar panels generate enough power for the whole house.
generate.zh: 新的太阳能板能为整座房子产生足够的电力。

generation.example: This generation of students learns with computers from an early age.
generation.zh: 这一代学生从小就借助电脑学习。

generous.example: My neighbour is generous with her time and always helps others.
generous.zh: 我的邻居乐于付出时间，总是帮助别人。

genius.example: The young painter was called a genius by everyone who saw her work.
genius.zh: 看过她作品的人都称这位年轻画家为天才。

genre.example: This book mixes two popular genres: history and travel writing.
genre.zh: 这本书混合了两种流行的类型：历史与游记。

gentle.example: She spoke in a gentle voice to calm the crying child.
gentle.zh: 她用温和的声音说话，让哭闹的孩子安静下来。

gentleman.example: An old gentleman offered his seat to a woman with bags.
gentleman.zh: 一位老先生把座位让给了一位提着袋子的女士。

genuine.example: Her surprise was genuine when we gave her the small gift.
genuine.zh: 我们把小礼物送给她时，她的惊讶是真实的。

geography.example: We studied the geography of the river and its wide valleys.
geography.zh: 我们学习了这条河及其宽阔河谷的地理情况。

geology.example: He studied geology to learn how mountains are formed.
geology.zh: 他学地质学，以了解山是如何形成的。

geometry.example: In geometry class we learned how to measure the area of a circle.
geometry.zh: 在几何课上，我们学习了如何测量圆的面积。

germ.example: Washing your hands well helps stop germs from spreading.
germ.zh: 认真洗手有助于阻止细菌传播。

gesture.example: She made a small gesture with her hand to ask for quiet.
gesture.zh: 她用手做了个小手势，请大家安静。

get.example: You can get a free map at the front desk.
get.zh: 你可以在前台拿一张免费地图。

ghost.example: The children told a funny story about a ghost in the old house.
ghost.zh: 孩子们讲了一个关于老房子里有鬼的搞笑故事。

giant.example: A giant tree stands in the middle of the old park.
giant.zh: 一棵巨大的树矗立在老公园的中央。

gift.example: He gave her a small gift to thank her for the help.
gift.zh: 他送了她一份小礼物，感谢她的帮助。

giggle.example: The girls began to giggle when the teacher dropped his pen.
giggle.zh: 老师把笔掉了，女孩们开始咯咯笑起来。

girl.example: The girl next door walks to school with her brother.
girl.zh: 隔壁的女孩和她的弟弟一起走路去上学。

give.example: Please give this letter to your teacher tomorrow morning.
give.zh: 请明天早上把这封信交给你的老师。

given.example: The team finished the whole task well within the given time.
given.zh: 这个团队在规定时间内很好地完成了整个任务。

glacier.example: The glacier moves slowly down the valley each year.
glacier.zh: 这条冰川每年缓慢地沿着山谷向下移动。

glad.example: I am glad to hear that your exam went well.
glad.zh: 听到你考试顺利，我很高兴。

glamor.example: The old hotel still keeps the glamor of a hundred years ago.
glamor.zh: 这家老酒店仍保留着一百年前的魅力。

glance.example: She glanced at her watch and hurried to the door.
glance.zh: 她瞥了一眼手表，匆匆走向门口。

gland.example: The doctor explained how the small gland controls growth.
gland.zh: 医生解释了这个小腺体如何控制生长。

glare.example: The glare of the sun on the water hurt my eyes.
glare.zh: 水面上太阳的强光刺痛了我的眼睛。

glass.example: He poured a glass of cold water after the long walk.
glass.zh: 走了很长的路后，他倒了一杯冷水。

gleam.example: A small gleam of light came through the crack in the door.
gleam.zh: 一道微弱的光从门缝里透进来。

glide.example: The boat glided quietly across the calm surface of the lake.
glide.zh: 小船静静地滑过平静的湖面。

glimpse.example: I caught a glimpse of the sea between the tall buildings.
glimpse.zh: 我在高楼之间瞥见了大海。

glitter.example: The lights on the tree glittered brightly in the dark room.
glitter.zh: 树上的灯在黑暗的房间里闪闪发亮。

globe.example: The teacher pointed to the globe and asked us to find the river.
globe.zh: 老师指着地球仪，让我们找到那条河。

gloom.example: The gloom of the rainy afternoon made everyone feel sleepy.
gloom.zh: 阴雨下午的昏暗让每个人都想睡觉。

glory.example: The team enjoyed the glory of winning the final match.
glory.zh: 这支队伍享受着赢得决赛的荣耀。

glossary.example: A short glossary at the end of the book explains difficult words.
glossary.zh: 书末的简短词汇表解释了难词。

glove.example: He put on a warm glove before going out into the snow.
glove.zh: 他出门去雪地里之前戴上了一只暖和的手套。

glow.example: The small lamp gave a warm glow to the whole room.
glow.zh: 那盏小灯给整个房间带来了温暖的光。

glue.example: She used glue to fix the broken handle of the cup.
glue.zh: 她用胶水粘好了杯子坏掉的把手。

go.example: We usually go to the park on Sunday mornings.
go.zh: 我们通常星期天早上去公园。

goal.example: My main goal this year is to read more books.
goal.zh: 我今年的主要目标是多读些书。

goat.example: The farmer kept a goat and some chickens in the yard.
goat.zh: 农夫在院子里养了一只山羊和一些鸡。

god.example: The ancient statue of a god was found near the river.
god.zh: 一尊古老的神像在河边被发现。

gold.example: The ring is made of gold and has a small stone.
gold.zh: 这枚戒指是金子做的，上面镶着一颗小石头。

golf.example: He plays golf with his friends every Saturday morning.
golf.zh: 他每个星期六早上都和朋友打高尔夫球。

good.example: This is a good place to rest after a long walk.
good.zh: 这是走了长路之后休息的好地方。

goodbye.example: She waved goodbye to her friends and got on the bus.
goodbye.zh: 她向朋友们挥手告别，然后上了公交车。

goodness.example: Her goodness and patience made her loved by everyone.
goodness.zh: 她的善良和耐心让她受到所有人的喜爱。

goods.example: The truck brought goods to the shop early in the morning.
goods.zh: 卡车一大早就把货物送到了商店。

goose.example: A white goose swam across the pond with her young.
goose.zh: 一只白鹅带着小鹅游过池塘。

gorge.example: The river runs through a deep gorge between two hills.
gorge.zh: 这条河从两座小山之间的深峡谷中流过。

gorgeous.example: The view from the top of the hill was gorgeous at sunset.
gorgeous.zh: 日落时从山顶看到的景色非常绚丽。

gospel.example: He treated the coach's advice as gospel and never questioned it.
gospel.zh: 他把教练的建议当作真理，从不质疑。

gossip.example: They often gossip about small things while waiting for the bus.
gossip.zh: 他们等公交车时常常聊些小事。

govern.example: The same rules govern every game played in this hall.
govern.zh: 同样的规则适用于在这个大厅里进行的每一场比赛。

gown.example: The doctor wore a white gown over her clothes in the lab.
gown.zh: 医生在实验室里在衣服外面穿了一件白袍。

grab.example: He grabbed his bag and ran to catch the early train.
grab.zh: 他抓起包就跑，去赶早班火车。

grace.example: She moved across the stage with great grace and confidence.
grace.zh: 她以优雅和自信走过舞台。

grade.example: My brother is in the fifth grade at a small school.
grade.zh: 我弟弟在一所小学校上五年级。

gradual.example: There was a gradual change in the weather over the week.
gradual.zh: 一周里天气逐渐发生了变化。

graduate.example: She will graduate from college next summer after four years.
graduate.zh: 她将在四年之后于明年夏天大学毕业。

grain.example: A few grains of rice fell on the table during dinner.
grain.zh: 吃饭时有几粒米掉在了桌上。

gram.example: The recipe asks for one hundred grams of sugar.
gram.zh: 这个食谱需要一百克糖。

grammar.example: Good grammar makes your writing clearer and easier to read.
grammar.zh: 良好的语法让你的文章更清楚、更易读。

grand.example: The old hall has a grand entrance with tall stone steps.
grand.zh: 这座老礼堂有一个带高石阶的宏伟入口。

grandchild.example: Their youngest grandchild visits them every weekend in summer.
grandchild.zh: 他们最小的孙辈夏天每个周末都来看他们。

grandparent.example: Each grandparent took turns telling stories to the children.
grandparent.zh: 每位祖父母轮流给孩子们讲故事。

grant.example: The school granted her request to join the evening class.
grant.zh: 学校批准了她参加晚班的申请。

grape.example: She put a bunch of grapes on the table for lunch.
grape.zh: 她把一串葡萄放在桌上供午餐时吃。

graph.example: The graph shows how the temperature changed during the day.
graph.zh: 这张图表显示了一天中温度的变化。

grasp.example: It took me a while to grasp the main idea of the story.
grasp.zh: 我花了一会儿才理解这个故事的主要意思。

grass.example: The children played on the soft grass behind the house.
grass.zh: 孩子们在屋后的柔软草地上玩耍。

grateful.example: I am grateful for all the help you gave me.
grateful.zh: 我感谢你给我的所有帮助。

gratitude.example: She expressed her gratitude with a short hand-written note.
gratitude.zh: 她用一张简短的手写便条表达了感激之情。

grave.example: The doctor spoke in a grave voice about the test results.
grave.zh: 医生用严肃的语气谈了检查结果。

gravitation.example: The law of gravitation explains why objects fall toward the earth.
gravitation.zh: 引力定律解释了物体为什么会向地面下落。

gravity.example: Gravity makes the ball fall back to the ground.

gray.example: The sky turned gray before the heavy rain began.
gray.zh: 大雨开始前天空变成了灰色。

graze.example: A few cows grazed quietly in the field near the river.
graze.zh: 几头奶牛在河边的田里安静地吃草。

grease.example: He wiped the thick grease off the kitchen stove with a cloth.
grease.zh: 他用布擦掉了厨房炉子上厚厚的油脂。

great.example: It was a great honor to meet such a famous writer.
great.zh: 能见到这样一位著名作家是极大的荣幸。

greed.example: His greed for money made him forget what mattered most.
greed.zh: 他对金钱的贪婪让他忘了最重要的东西。

green.example: The hills look green again after the spring rain.

greenhouse.example: The tomatoes grow well in the greenhouse during cold months.
greenhouse.zh: 寒冷的日子里，西红柿在温室里长得很好。

greet.example: The host came to the door and greeted every guest warmly.
greet.zh: 主人来到门口，热情地问候每一位客人。

grid.example: The map is divided into a simple grid of small squares.
grid.zh: 地图被分成由小方格组成的简单网格。

grief.example: He could not hide his grief when he heard the sad news.
grief.zh: 听到那个悲伤的消息时，他无法掩饰自己的悲痛。

grill.example: He put the fish on the grill and waited for it to cook.
grill.zh: 他把鱼放在烤架上，等着它烤熟。

grim.example: The report gave a grim description of the storm damage.
grim.zh: 报告对暴风雨造成的破坏作了令人不安的描述。

grin.example: The boy gave a wide grin when he saw the gift.
grin.zh: 男孩看到礼物时咧嘴大笑。

grind.example: She used a small machine to grind the coffee beans each morning.
grind.zh: 她每天早上用一台小机器磨咖啡豆。

grip.example: She held the rail with a firm grip as the bus moved.
grip.zh: 公交车开动时，她紧紧抓住扶手。

groan.example: The tired worker let out a long groan as he sat down.
groan.zh: 疲惫的工人坐下时发出了一声长长的呻吟。

grocer.example: The grocer on the corner sells fresh fruit and warm bread.
grocer.zh: 街角的食品商出售新鲜水果和热面包。

groove.example: A deep groove in the wood showed where the door had rubbed.
groove.zh: 木头上的深凹槽显示出门摩擦过的地方。

grope.example: She had to grope for the light switch in the dark room.
grope.zh: 她不得不在黑暗的房间里摸索电灯开关。

gross.example: The gross weight of the box is about ten kilos.
gross.zh: 这个箱子的总重量大约是十公斤。

ground.example: The ground was still wet from the rain last night.
ground.zh: 地面因为昨晚的雨还是湿的。

group.example: Our group met every Friday to plan the school trip.
group.zh: 我们小组每周五见面，筹划学校的旅行。

grow.example: These plants grow quickly in warm weather and soft soil.
grow.zh: 这些植物在温暖的天气和松软的土壤里长得很快。

guarantee.example: The shop guarantees that every watch it sells works well.
guarantee.zh: 这家店保证它卖出的每只手表都运转良好。

guard.example: A guard stood at the gate and checked every visitor's name.
guard.zh: 一名守卫站在门口，核对每位来访者的名字。

guess.example: Can you guess how many people came to the party?
guess.zh: 你能猜到有多少人来参加聚会吗？

guest.example: Every guest received a small gift at the front desk.
guest.zh: 每位客人在前台都收到了一份小礼物。

guide.example: A local guide showed us the oldest streets of the town.
guide.zh: 一位当地导游带我们看了镇上最古老的街道。

guideline.example: The new guideline tells students how to use the lab safely.
guideline.zh: 新的准则告诉学生如何安全地使用实验室。

guilt.example: He felt a strong sense of guilt after breaking the promise.
guilt.zh: 违背诺言后，他感到强烈的内疚。

guitar.example: She plays the guitar every evening after finishing her homework.
guitar.zh: 她每天傍晚做完作业后弹吉他。

gulf.example: A small boat sailed slowly across the quiet gulf at dawn.
gulf.zh: 黎明时一只小船缓慢地驶过安静的海湾。

gum.example: He chewed a piece of gum while waiting for the bus.
gum.zh: 他等公交车时嚼着一块口香糖。

gun.example: The starter raised the gun to signal the beginning of the race.
gun.zh: 发令员举起发令枪，示意比赛开始。

gut.example: It takes real guts to admit a mistake in front of everyone.
gut.zh: 在众人面前承认错误需要真正的勇气。

guy.example: The guy at the desk helped me find the right room.
guy.zh: 柜台的那个小伙子帮我找到了正确的房间。

gym.example: We play basketball in the gym when it rains.
gym.zh: 下雨时我们在体育馆里打篮球。

habit.example: Reading before bed is a habit I want to keep.
habit.zh: 睡前阅读是我想保持的习惯。

habitat.example: The forest is a natural habitat for many kinds of birds.
habitat.zh: 这片森林是许多种鸟类的天然栖息地。

hack.example: He used a small axe to hack away the dry branches.
hack.zh: 他用一把小斧头砍掉干枯的树枝。

hacker.example: A clever hacker found a small weakness in the old website.
hacker.zh: 一名聪明的黑客在旧网站里发现了一个小漏洞。

hail.example: Heavy hail damaged the young plants in the garden.
hail.zh: 大颗的冰雹打坏了花园里的幼苗。

hair.example: Her long hair moved in the wind as she walked.
hair.zh: 她走路时，长发在风中飘动。

half.example: Half of the cake was gone before dinner started.
half.zh: 晚饭开始前，蛋糕已经没了一半。

halfway.example: The train stopped halfway between the two small towns for an hour.
halfway.zh: 火车在两个小镇之间的中途停了一个小时。

hall.example: She left her umbrella in the hall and walked into the warm kitchen.
hall.zh: 她把伞放在门厅，然后走进温暖的厨房。

halt.example: The heavy rain brought the outdoor game to a sudden halt.
halt.zh: 大雨使户外比赛突然停了下来。

ham.example: He made a simple sandwich with ham, cheese and fresh bread.
ham.zh: 他用火腿、奶酪和新鲜面包做了一个简单的三明治。

hamburger.example: The children ordered a hamburger and a cold drink after the game.
hamburger.zh: 比赛结束后，孩子们点了一个汉堡和一杯冷饮。

hammer.example: He used a small hammer to fix the wooden chair in the kitchen.
hammer.zh: 他用一把小锤子修好了厨房里的木椅。

hamper.example: Heavy traffic can hamper the delivery of fresh food to the shops.
hamper.zh: 交通拥堵会妨碍新鲜食品送到商店。

hand.example: She raised her hand to ask a question during the class.
hand.zh: 她举起手，在课上问了一个问题。

handbook.example: This small handbook explains how to use every machine in the office.
handbook.zh: 这本小手册说明了办公室每台机器的用法。

handicap.example: Lack of money can be a serious handicap for young students.
handicap.zh: 缺钱对年轻学生来说可能是个严重的障碍。

handicraft.example: The old woman sells her handicraft at the market every Saturday.
handicraft.zh: 那位老妇人每周六在市场卖她的手工艺品。

handle.example: The handle of the cup is too small for my hand.
handle.zh: 这杯子的把手对我的手来说太小了。

handsome.example: Her brother is a tall and handsome young man with a kind smile.
handsome.zh: 她哥哥是个高大英俊、笑容和善的年轻人。

handwriting.example: Her handwriting is so clear that everyone can read it easily.
handwriting.zh: 她的笔迹非常清楚，每个人都能轻松读懂。

handy.example: A small torch is handy when the power goes out at night.
handy.zh: 晚上停电时，手电筒很方便。

hang.example: Please hang your coat on the hook behind the door.
hang.zh: 请把你的外套挂在门后的钩子上。

happen.example: Nobody knew what would happen next, so everyone waited in silence.
happen.zh: 没人知道接下来会发生什么，所以大家都安静地等着。

happy.example: The children were very happy to see the first snow of winter.
happy.zh: 孩子们看到冬天的第一场雪非常高兴。

harass.example: Loud music from the next room began to harass the tired writer.
harass.zh: 隔壁吵闹的音乐开始困扰那位疲惫的作家。

harbor.example: Several small boats waited in the quiet harbor until the storm ended.
harbor.zh: 几条小船在安静的港口里等待，直到暴风雨结束。

hard.example: The exam was hard, but she finished every question before the bell.
hard.zh: 这次考试很难，但她在铃响前答完了每一道题。

hardly.example: I could hardly hear his voice over the noise of the traffic.
hardly.zh: 在交通的噪音中，我几乎听不见他的声音。

hardship.example: The family lived through years of hardship after the factory closed.
hardship.zh: 工厂关闭后，这家人经历了多年的艰难生活。

hardware.example: The shop sells tools, nails and other hardware for the home.
hardware.zh: 这家店出售工具、钉子和其他家用五金。

hardy.example: These hardy plants can grow well even in cold, dry weather.
hardy.zh: 这些耐寒的植物即使在寒冷干燥的天气里也能长得很好。

harm.example: Too much sugar can do real harm to your teeth and health.
harm.zh: 吃太多糖会对你的牙齿和健康造成真正的伤害。

harmony.example: The two families have lived in harmony for more than twenty years.
harmony.zh: 这两家人和睦相处了二十多年。

harness.example: The farmer put a harness on the horse before the long ride.
harness.zh: 长途骑行前，农夫给马套上了马具。

harsh.example: His harsh words made the young worker feel very small.
harsh.zh: 他严厉的话让那位年轻工人感到很自卑。

harvest.example: The farmers worked late to bring in the autumn harvest.
harvest.zh: 农民们干到很晚，把秋天的收获收进来。

haste.example: In his haste to catch the bus, he left his bag at home.
haste.zh: 他匆忙赶公交车，把包落在了家里。

hat.example: She wore a wide hat to keep the sun off her face.
hat.zh: 她戴了一顶宽檐帽，遮挡脸上的阳光。

hatch.example: The eggs will hatch in about three weeks if kept warm.
hatch.zh: 如果保持温暖，这些蛋大约三周后就会孵化。

hate.example: I hate waiting in long lines at the busy post office.
hate.zh: 我讨厌在繁忙的邮局排长队等待。

haul.example: The truck had to haul the heavy boxes up the steep road.
haul.zh: 卡车不得不把沉重的箱子拖上陡峭的路。

haunt.example: The memory of that day still haunts her late at night.
haunt.zh: 那天的事到深夜仍萦绕在她心头。

have.example: They have two small dogs and a large garden behind the house.
have.zh: 他们有两只小狗，房子后面还有一个大花园。

haven.example: The small library became a quiet haven for students after school.
haven.zh: 放学后，这家小图书馆成了学生们安静的避风港。

havoc.example: The storm caused havoc in the village and damaged many roofs.
havoc.zh: 暴风雨给村子造成严重破坏，毁坏了许多屋顶。

hawk.example: A hawk circled high above the field, looking for small animals.
hawk.zh: 一只鹰在田野上空盘旋，寻找小动物。

hay.example: The farmer stored dry hay in the barn for the winter.
hay.zh: 农夫把干草储存在谷仓里过冬。

hazard.example: Wet leaves on the path are a hazard for older walkers.
hazard.zh: 小路上湿滑的落叶对年长的行人是个危险。

haze.example: A soft haze covered the hills in the early morning light.
haze.zh: 清晨的光线中，一层薄雾笼罩着山丘。

he.example: He closed the window and turned off the light before leaving.
he.zh: 他关好窗户，关了灯才离开。

head.example: She turned her head to look at the clock on the wall.
head.zh: 她转过头去看墙上的钟。

headache.example: I have a bad headache, so I will go to bed early.
headache.zh: 我头痛得厉害，所以我要早点睡。

heading.example: Each chapter begins with a clear heading in large black letters.
heading.zh: 每一章都以黑色大字的清晰标题开头。

headline.example: The news of the storm was the headline in every morning paper.
headline.zh: 暴风雨的消息成了每份晨报的大标题。

headmaster.example: The headmaster spoke to the students at the start of the term.
headmaster.zh: 开学时，校长对学生们讲了话。

headquarters.example: The company moved its headquarters to a larger building near the park.
headquarters.zh: 公司把总部搬到了公园附近一栋更大的楼里。

heal.example: The small cut on his hand took about a week to heal.
heal.zh: 他手上那个小伤口大约花了一周才愈合。

health.example: Fresh food and daily walks are good for your health.
health.zh: 新鲜的食物和每天散步对你的健康有好处。

heap.example: A heap of dry leaves lay near the gate after the wind.
heap.zh: 起风后，门边堆着一堆干树叶。

hear.example: I can hear the rain on the roof from my warm room.
hear.zh: 我在温暖的房间里能听到屋顶上的雨声。

heart.example: Her heart beat fast as she walked onto the stage.
heart.zh: 她走上舞台时心跳得很快。

heartfelt.example: Please accept my heartfelt thanks for all your kind help.
heartfelt.zh: 请接受我对你所有热心帮助的衷心感谢。

heat.example: The heat from the fire made the small room very warm.
heat.zh: 火的热量让这个小房间变得非常暖和。

heave.example: They had to heave the heavy box onto the back of the truck.
heave.zh: 他们不得不用力把沉重的箱子抬到卡车后面。

heaven.example: The quiet garden felt like heaven after a long, noisy day.
heaven.zh: 在漫长喧闹的一天之后，这座安静的花园感觉像天堂。

heavy.example: This box is too heavy for one person to carry upstairs.
heavy.zh: 这个箱子太重了，一个人搬不上楼。

hectare.example: The farm covers about forty hectares of rich, flat land.
hectare.zh: 这个农场占地约四十公顷肥沃平坦的土地。

hectic.example: The week before the holiday was hectic for everyone in the shop.
hectic.zh: 假期前的那一周，店里每个人都很忙乱。

hedge.example: A thick green hedge runs along the side of the garden.
hedge.zh: 一排茂密的绿色树篱沿着花园的一侧延伸。

heel.example: My left heel hurts after walking so far in new shoes.
heel.zh: 穿新鞋走了这么远，我左脚后跟疼。

height.example: The tower is famous for its great height and fine view.
height.zh: 这座塔以巨大的高度和美丽的景色闻名。

heir.example: The old man left his land to his only heir.
heir.zh: 老人把土地留给了他唯一的继承人。

helicopter.example: A helicopter flew over the valley to look for the lost walkers.
helicopter.zh: 一架直升机飞过山谷，寻找迷路的徒步者。

hell.example: Waiting in the crowded station all night was pure hell for us.
hell.zh: 在拥挤的车站等了一整夜，对我们来说简直是地狱。

hello.example: She smiled and said hello to the new student at the door.
hello.zh: 她微笑着向门口的新同学问好。

helmet.example: You should wear a helmet when you ride a bicycle on the road.
helmet.zh: 在路上骑自行车时你应该戴头盔。

help.example: Can you help me carry these books to the reading room?
help.zh: 你能帮我把这些书搬到阅览室吗？

hemisphere.example: Summer comes in December in the southern hemisphere of the earth.
hemisphere.zh: 在南半球，夏天在十二月到来。

hen.example: The brown hen laid three eggs in the warm corner of the barn.
hen.zh: 那只棕色的母鸡在谷仓温暖的角落里下了三个蛋。

hence.example: The road was closed, hence we had to take a longer way.
hence.zh: 路被封了，因此我们不得不绕更远的路。

henceforth.example: Henceforth, all visitors must sign their names at the front desk.
henceforth.zh: 今后，所有来访者都必须在前台签名。

her.example: Her new coat is hanging on the chair by the window.
her.zh: 她的新外套挂在窗边的椅子上。

herald.example: The first warm day is often a herald of spring.
herald.zh: 第一个温暖的日子常常是春天的先兆。

herb.example: She grows several kinds of herb in pots on the kitchen sill.
herb.zh: 她在厨房窗台上的花盆里种了几种香草。

herd.example: A herd of cows moved slowly across the green field at sunset.
herd.zh: 夕阳下，一群牛慢慢穿过绿色的田野。
