here.example: Please wait here while I find the key to the office.
here.zh: 请在这里等一下，我去找办公室的钥匙。

hereby.example: I hereby confirm that the report was checked and found correct.
hereby.zh: 我特此确认，这份报告已经过核对，内容无误。

heritage.example: The old town is part of the cultural heritage of the whole country.
heritage.zh: 这座古镇是全国文化遗产的一部分。

hero.example: The young doctor became a hero after helping so many sick people.
hero.zh: 那位年轻医生帮助了那么多病人，成了英雄。

heroin.example: Doctors say heroin is one of the most dangerous drugs in the world.
heroin.zh: 医生说海洛因是世界上最危险的毒品之一。

hers.example: This blue umbrella is hers, and the black one is mine.
hers.zh: 这把蓝伞是她的，那把黑的是我的。

herself.example: She painted the whole room herself over the long weekend.
herself.zh: 那个长周末她一个人把整个房间刷了。

hesitate.example: Do not hesitate to ask if you need more help with this.
hesitate.zh: 如果这方面你需要更多帮助，请不要犹豫，直接问。

hi.example: He waved and said hi to the friends across the street.
hi.zh: 他挥挥手，向街对面的朋友们打招呼。

hibernate.example: Bears hibernate in caves during the cold months of the year.
hibernate.zh: 熊在一年中寒冷的月份里在洞穴中冬眠。

hide.example: The children love to hide behind the tall grass in the garden.
hide.zh: 孩子们喜欢躲在花园里高高的草丛后面。

hierarchy.example: Every large company needs a clear hierarchy of jobs and duties.
hierarchy.zh: 每个大公司都需要一个清晰的职位与职责等级体系。

high.example: The high wall around the garden keeps out the cold wind.
high.zh: 花园周围的高墙挡住了冷风。

high-tech.example: The factory uses high-tech machines to check every part it makes.
high-tech.zh: 这家工厂用高科技机器检查它生产的每一个零件。

highlight.example: The teacher used a yellow pen to highlight the key words.
highlight.zh: 老师用黄色笔标出了关键词。

highway.example: The new highway cuts the drive to the coast in half.
highway.zh: 这条新公路把去海边的车程缩短了一半。

hijack.example: The police stopped two men who tried to hijack a truck on the highway.
hijack.zh: 警方拦住了两名试图在公路上劫持卡车的男子。

hike.example: We plan to hike up the green hill early on Sunday morning.
hike.zh: 我们打算周日清晨徒步爬上那座绿色的小山。

hill.example: A small white house stands alone on the top of the hill.
hill.zh: 一座白色小屋孤零零地立在山顶上。

him.example: She called him twice, but he did not hear the phone.
him.zh: 她给他打了两次电话，但他没听到。

himself.example: He fixed the broken chair himself with a few simple tools.
himself.zh: 他用几件简单的工具自己修好了那把坏椅子。

hinder.example: Thick fog may hinder the arrival of the early morning flight.
hinder.zh: 大雾可能会妨碍清晨航班的到达。

hinge.example: The door moves easily because the hinge was oiled yesterday.
hinge.zh: 因为铰链昨天上了油，门开起来很轻。

hint.example: She gave me a small hint about the answer to the puzzle.
hint.zh: 她给了我一点关于谜题答案的提示。

hip.example: He hurt his hip when he slipped on the wet floor.
hip.zh: 他在湿滑的地板上滑倒，伤到了臀部。

hire.example: They decided to hire a car for the trip to the hills.
hire.zh: 他们决定租一辆车去山里旅行。

his.example: His old bicycle still works well after many years of use.
his.zh: 他的旧自行车用了这么多年还能正常骑。

history.example: She is reading a book about the history of modern art.
history.zh: 她正在读一本关于现代艺术史的书。

hit.example: The ball hit the window but luckily the glass did not break.
hit.zh: 球打中了窗户，幸好玻璃没有碎。

hitherto.example: The plan has worked well hitherto, with no serious problems.
hitherto.zh: 这个计划迄今运行良好，没有出现严重问题。

hive.example: Bees flew in and out of the wooden hive all afternoon.
hive.zh: 整个下午，蜜蜂在木蜂箱里飞进飞出。

hobby.example: Taking photos of birds has become his favorite hobby.
hobby.zh: 拍鸟已经成了他最喜欢的爱好。

hockey.example: Our school team won the hockey match on Saturday afternoon.
hockey.zh: 我们校队在周六下午的曲棍球比赛中获胜。

hoist.example: The workers used a rope to hoist the flag to the top.
hoist.zh: 工人们用绳子把旗子升到顶端。

hold.example: Please hold this bag while I open the door for you.
hold.zh: 我帮你开门的时候，请拿着这个包。

hole.example: A small hole in the roof let the rain into the room.
hole.zh: 屋顶上的一个小洞让雨水漏进了房间。

holiday.example: We spent the whole holiday walking by the sea and resting.
holiday.zh: 我们整个假期都在海边散步、休息。

hollow.example: The old tree is hollow inside, so birds nest in it.
hollow.zh: 这棵老树里面是空的，所以鸟儿在里面做窝。

holy.example: For many people, this quiet mountain is a holy place.
holy.zh: 对许多人来说，这座安静的山是一个神圣的地方。

home.example: After a long trip, it feels good to come home.
home.zh: 长途旅行之后，回家的感觉真好。

homeland.example: He wrote a song about his homeland and the people he loved.
homeland.zh: 他写了一首关于祖国和他所爱之人的歌。

homework.example: She finished her homework before dinner and then read a book.
homework.zh: 她在晚饭前做完了作业，然后读了一本书。

homogeneous.example: The mixture looks homogeneous because the two liquids blend so well.
homogeneous.zh: 这种混合物看起来是同质的，因为两种液体混合得非常好。

homosexual.example: The survey asked how homosexual people feel about life in the city.
homosexual.zh: 这项调查询问了同性恋者在城市生活的感受。

honest.example: An honest answer is always better than a quick lie.
honest.zh: 诚实的回答总比随口说谎好。

honey.example: She likes to put a spoon of honey in her morning tea.
honey.zh: 她喜欢在早茶里放一勺蜂蜜。

honeymoon.example: The couple spent their honeymoon in a small town by the sea.
honeymoon.zh: 这对夫妇在海边的一个小镇度过了蜜月。

honor.example: It is a great honor to work with such an honest team.
honor.zh: 能与这样一支诚实的团队合作是极大的荣誉。

hook.example: Hang your wet towel on the hook beside the bathroom door.
hook.zh: 把你的湿毛巾挂在浴室门旁的钩子上。

hop.example: The little bird would hop from branch to branch in the morning.
hop.zh: 早晨，那只小鸟在树枝间跳来跳去。

hope.example: I hope the weather stays fine for our walk tomorrow.
hope.zh: 我希望明天的天气保持晴好，方便我们去散步。

horizon.example: The sun went down below the horizon and the sky turned red.
horizon.zh: 太阳落到地平线以下，天空变红了。

horn.example: The driver sounded his horn twice to warn the walkers.
horn.zh: 司机按了两次喇叭，提醒行人。

horror.example: She looked at the broken vase in horror and said nothing.
horror.zh: 她惊恐地看着碎掉的花瓶，一句话也没说。

horse.example: The horse walked slowly along the path beside the quiet river.
horse.zh: 那匹马沿着安静的河边小路慢慢地走。

horsepower.example: This old car has only fifty horsepower but runs very well.
horsepower.zh: 这辆旧车只有五十马力，但跑得很好。

hose.example: He used a long hose to water the plants in the garden.
hose.zh: 他用一根长水管给花园里的植物浇水。

hospitable.example: The local people were so hospitable that we felt at home.
hospitable.zh: 当地人非常热情好客，让我们感到像在家里一样。

hospital.example: She stayed in the hospital for a week after the operation.
hospital.zh: 手术后她在医院住了一周。

host.example: Our host made tea and showed us around the small house.
host.zh: 主人给我们泡了茶，还带我们参观了这座小房子。

hostage.example: The film tells how a young clerk was held hostage for one day.
hostage.zh: 这部电影讲述一位年轻职员被扣为人质一天的故事。

hostess.example: The hostess welcomed every guest with a warm smile at the door.
hostess.zh: 女主人在门口用温暖的笑容迎接每位客人。

hostile.example: He gave me a hostile look but said nothing at all.
hostile.zh: 他敌意地看了我一眼，却什么也没说。

hot.example: The soup is still too hot to drink, so wait a moment.
hot.zh: 汤还太烫，喝不了，稍等一下。

hotdog.example: The young skater likes to hotdog when the crowd is watching.
hotdog.zh: 那个年轻滑手在观众看着的时候就喜欢卖弄。

hotel.example: They found a small hotel near the station and stayed one night.
hotel.zh: 他们在车站附近找到一家小旅馆，住了一晚。

hound.example: The old hound slept by the fire after a long walk.
hound.zh: 长途散步后，那只老猎犬在炉火旁睡着了。

hour.example: It took us almost an hour to walk to the train station.
hour.zh: 我们花了将近一个小时走到火车站。

house.example: Their house has a red roof and a small garden in front.
house.zh: 他们的房子有红色的屋顶，前面有个小花园。

household.example: The whole household worked together to prepare the evening meal.
household.zh: 全家人一起动手准备晚饭。

housewife.example: As a housewife, she plans the meals and keeps the house tidy.
housewife.zh: 作为家庭主妇，她安排三餐，把家里收拾得干干净净。

housework.example: She does the housework every morning before the children wake up.
housework.zh: 她每天早上都在孩子们醒来之前做家务。

hover.example: A small bird hovered above the flowers for a few seconds.
hover.zh: 一只小鸟在花丛上方盘旋了几秒钟。

how.example: She showed me how to make bread at home.
how.zh: 她给我演示了在家怎样做面包。

however.example: The room is small; however, it is very bright and clean.
however.zh: 房间很小，然而它非常明亮干净。

howl.example: The wind howled all night and kept us awake.
howl.zh: 风整夜呼啸，让我们一直醒着。

huddle.example: The children huddled together under a blanket to keep warm.
huddle.zh: 孩子们挤在一条毯子下取暖。

hug.example: She gave her little sister a warm hug at the door.
hug.zh: 她在门口给了妹妹一个温暖的拥抱。

huge.example: A huge tree stands in the middle of the quiet garden.
huge.zh: 一棵巨大的树矗立在安静的花园中央。

hum.example: She hummed a soft song while washing the dishes.
hum.zh: 她一边洗碗一边轻轻哼着歌。

human.example: Every human needs clean water and fresh air to live.
human.zh: 每个人都需要干净的水和新鲜空气才能生存。

humane.example: It is more humane to treat animals with care and respect.
humane.zh: 用关心和尊重对待动物更为人道。

humble.example: He stayed humble even after winning the big prize.
humble.zh: 即使得了大奖，他依然保持谦逊。

humid.example: The air in the room felt warm and humid after the rain.
humid.zh: 雨后房间里的空气又暖又潮湿。

humiliate.example: He did not want to humiliate his friend in front of others.
humiliate.zh: 他不想在别人面前让朋友难堪。

humor.example: Her gentle humor made the long meeting much easier to bear.
humor.zh: 她温和的幽默让漫长的会议好受多了。

hundred.example: More than a hundred people came to the small evening market.
hundred.zh: 一百多人来到了这个小夜市。

hunger.example: After the long hike, we felt a deep hunger for a warm meal.
hunger.zh: 长途徒步之后，我们很想吃一顿热饭。

hunt.example: We hunted for the lost keys all over the house.
hunt.zh: 我们满屋子寻找丢失的钥匙。

hurdle.example: Language was the biggest hurdle for her in the new job.
hurdle.zh: 在新工作中，语言是她最大的障碍。

hurl.example: The boy hurled the ball across the wide field.
hurl.zh: 男孩把球用力扔过宽阔的场地。

hurricane.example: The hurricane damaged many roofs and trees along the coast.
hurricane.zh: 飓风毁坏了沿海的许多屋顶和树木。

hurry.example: We had to hurry to catch the early bus this morning.
hurry.zh: 今天早上我们不得不赶紧去赶早班公交车。

hurt.example: My feet hurt after walking in those old shoes all day.
hurt.zh: 穿着那双旧鞋走了一整天，我的脚很疼。

husband.example: Her husband cooks dinner for the family every Friday evening.
husband.zh: 她丈夫每周五晚上都为家人做晚饭。

hut.example: They stayed in a small wooden hut near the lake.
hut.zh: 他们住在湖边一间小木屋里。

hybrid.example: This flower is a hybrid of two common garden plants.
hybrid.zh: 这种花是两种常见园林植物的杂交品种。

hydrogen.example: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen, as we learn in class.
hydrogen.zh: 正如我们在课上学到的，水由氢和氧组成。

hygiene.example: Good hygiene helps us stay healthy during the cold season.
hygiene.zh: 良好的卫生习惯有助于我们在寒冷季节保持健康。

hyphen.example: Write your last name with a hyphen between the two parts.
hyphen.zh: 写姓氏时，在两部分之间加一个连字符。

hypocrisy.example: People quickly saw through the hypocrisy of his kind words.
hypocrisy.zh: 人们很快看穿了他那些好话的虚伪。

hypothesis.example: The team tested a simple hypothesis with a small experiment.
hypothesis.zh: 团队用一个小实验检验了一个简单的假设。

hysterical.example: She became hysterical with laughter when she saw the funny photo.
hysterical.zh: 看到那张滑稽的照片，她笑得歇斯底里。

I.example: I always drink a cup of warm water before breakfast.
I.zh: 我总是在早饭前喝一杯温水。

ice.example: The children put some ice in their juice on the hot day.
ice.zh: 天热的时候，孩子们在果汁里放了些冰。

ice-cream.example: We bought ice-cream for everyone after the school concert.
ice-cream.zh: 学校音乐会结束后，我们给大家买了冰淇淋。

iceberg.example: Only a small part of an iceberg stays above the water.
iceberg.zh: 冰山只有一小部分露在水面上。

icon.example: Click the small icon at the top to open the menu.
icon.zh: 点击顶部的小图标即可打开菜单。

idea.example: That is a clever idea for saving time every morning.
idea.zh: 那是个每天早上节省时间的好主意。

ideal.example: This quiet street is an ideal place for a morning walk.
ideal.zh: 这条安静的街是早晨散步的理想场所。

identify.example: Can you identify the bird singing outside our window?
identify.zh: 你能认出在我们窗外唱歌的那只鸟吗？

identity.example: He showed his card to prove his identity at the desk.
identity.zh: 他在前台出示卡片以证明自己的身份。

ideology.example: The book explains the ideology behind the new education plan.
ideology.zh: 这本书解释了新教育计划背后的思想体系。

idiom.example: Our teacher explained this common English idiom in class today.
idiom.zh: 今天老师在课上讲解了这个常见的英语习语。

idiot.example: He felt like an idiot after forgetting the simple question.
idiot.zh: 忘记那个简单的问题后，他觉得自己真笨。

idle.example: The machines stood idle for a week during the repair.
idle.zh: 维修期间这些机器闲置了一个星期。

idol.example: The young singer became an idol for many school students.
idol.zh: 这位年轻歌手成了许多学生的偶像。

if.example: I will bring an umbrella if the sky looks dark later.
if.zh: 如果晚些时候天看起来阴了，我就带把伞。

ignite.example: A single spark can ignite the dry grass very quickly.
ignite.zh: 一个火花就能很快点燃干草。

ignorant.example: I was completely ignorant of the new rule until today.
ignorant.zh: 直到今天，我对这条新规定完全一无所知。

ignore.example: You should not ignore the small warning signs on the road.
ignore.zh: 你不应该忽视路上那些小的警示标志。

ill.example: She stayed home because she felt ill in the morning.
ill.zh: 她早上觉得不舒服，所以留在家里。

illegal.example: It is illegal to park your car on this narrow street.
illegal.zh: 在这条窄街上停车是违法的。

illicit.example: Buying illicit copies of software can bring serious trouble.
illicit.zh: 购买非法拷贝的软件会带来严重麻烦。

illiterate.example: He grew up poor and remained illiterate until his later years.
illiterate.zh: 他从小贫穷，直到晚年仍不识字。

illuminate.example: Soft lamps illuminate the whole room on winter evenings.
illuminate.zh: 冬日的夜晚，柔和的灯光照亮整个房间。

illusion.example: The mirror on the wall creates an illusion of more space.
illusion.zh: 墙上的镜子营造出空间更大的错觉。

illustrate.example: The teacher used a simple drawing to illustrate her point.
illustrate.zh: 老师用一幅简单的图来说明她的观点。

image.example: The image on the screen was clear even in bright light.
image.zh: 即使在强光下，屏幕上的图像也很清晰。

imagine.example: Imagine living in a quiet house beside a small lake.
imagine.zh: 想象一下住在一个小湖边安静的房子里。

imitate.example: Young children often imitate the way their parents speak.
imitate.zh: 幼儿常常模仿父母说话的方式。

immediate.example: The cool water brought immediate relief from the summer heat.
immediate.zh: 凉水立刻带走了夏日的暑热。

immense.example: The old library has an immense collection of rare books.
immense.zh: 这座老图书馆收藏了大量珍本书籍。

immerse.example: She immersed herself in her study and forgot the time.
immerse.zh: 她全神贯注于学习，忘记了时间。

immigrate.example: His family decided to immigrate to a warmer country last year.
immigrate.zh: 他家去年决定移居到一个更温暖的国家。

imminent.example: Dark clouds told us that heavy rain was imminent.
imminent.zh: 乌云告诉我们，大雨即将来临。

immune.example: A good sleep keeps your body immune to many small illnesses.
immune.zh: 良好的睡眠能让身体不易患上许多小病。

impact.example: The new road had a big impact on our small town.
impact.zh: 这条新路对我们小镇影响很大。

impair.example: Too little sleep can impair your memory and your mood.
impair.zh: 睡眠太少会损害你的记忆力和情绪。

impart.example: She tried to impart her love of music to her students.
impart.zh: 她努力把自己对音乐的热爱传授给学生。

impatient.example: The children grew impatient while waiting for the slow bus.
impatient.zh: 孩子们等那趟慢吞吞的公交车，等得不耐烦了。

imperative.example: It is imperative that we finish this work before Friday.
imperative.zh: 我们必须在周五之前完成这项工作。

imperial.example: The old palace still shows the imperial style of building.
imperial.zh: 这座古老的宫殿仍显出帝王的建筑风格。

impetus.example: The good news gave fresh impetus to the whole team.
impetus.zh: 这个好消息给整个团队带来了新的动力。

implement.example: The school will implement the new reading plan next month.
implement.zh: 学校下个月将实施新的阅读计划。

implementation.example: The implementation of the new plan will take three months.
implementation.zh: 新计划的实施将需要三个月。

implicit.example: Her words carried an implicit warning about the coming changes.
implicit.zh: 她的话里含蓄地暗示了即将到来的变化。

imply.example: His quiet smile seemed to imply that he already knew.
imply.zh: 他安静的笑容似乎暗示着他已经知道了。

import.example: The company imports coffee from several warm southern regions.
import.zh: 这家公司从几个温暖的南方地区进口咖啡。

important.example: It is important to write down the key points carefully.

impose.example: The city will impose a small tax on plastic bags.
impose.zh: 该市将对塑料袋征收一小笔税。

impossible.example: It is impossible to finish this book in one day.
impossible.zh: 一天之内读完这本书是不可能的。

impress.example: Her careful work did impress everyone in the office.
impress.zh: 她细致的工作确实给办公室的每个人留下了印象。

imprison.example: He let the fear of failure imprison his own dreams.
imprison.zh: 他让对失败的恐惧囚禁了自己的梦想。

impromptu.example: She gave a short impromptu speech at the end of dinner.
impromptu.zh: 晚宴结束时，她做了个简短的即席发言。

improve.example: Reading every day will improve your writing in a few months.
improve.zh: 每天阅读会在几个月内提高你的写作水平。

impulse.example: On a sudden impulse, she bought a ticket for the concert.
impulse.zh: 一时冲动，她买了一张音乐会的票。

in.example: The keys are in the top drawer of my desk.
in.zh: 钥匙在我书桌最上面的抽屉里。

inaugurate.example: The city will inaugurate the new library next spring.
inaugurate.zh: 这座城市将于明年春天为新图书馆举行启用仪式。

inborn.example: Some people believe that a love of music is inborn.
inborn.zh: 有些人认为对音乐的热爱是天生的。

incentive.example: A small reward can be a strong incentive for children.
incentive.zh: 小小的奖励对孩子来说可能是很强的激励。

inch.example: The old car inched forward through the busy market street.
inch.zh: 那辆旧车在热闹的集市街道上慢慢向前挪动。

incidence.example: The incidence of colds rises sharply in the winter months.
incidence.zh: 冬季几个月里感冒的发生率急剧上升。

incident.example: A small incident at the gate delayed the whole group.
incident.zh: 门口发生的一件小事耽误了整个队伍。

incline.example: I incline to agree with her simple and clear plan.
incline.zh: 我倾向于同意她那个简单清晰的计划。

include.example: The price includes breakfast and a free map of the city.
include.zh: 价格包括早餐和一张免费的城市地图。

income.example: Her monthly income covers the rent and most of the food.
income.zh: 她每月的收入够付房租和大部分伙食费。

incorporate.example: The new design incorporates ideas from several older buildings.
incorporate.zh: 这个新设计融入了好几座老建筑的构想。

increase.example: The number of visitors increased quickly after the new garden opened.
increase.zh: 新花园开放后，游客数量迅速增加。

incredible.example: The view from the top of the hill was incredible.
incredible.zh: 从山顶看到的景色令人难以置信。

incumbent.example: It is incumbent on every member to keep the room clean.
incumbent.zh: 保持房间整洁是每个成员的义务。

incur.example: Late payment may incur a small extra charge each month.
incur.zh: 逾期付款可能每月产生一小笔额外费用。

indebted.example: I am deeply indebted to my teacher for her patient help.
indebted.zh: 我非常感谢老师耐心的帮助。

indeed.example: The garden is small but indeed very beautiful in spring.
indeed.zh: 这个花园虽小，但春天的确非常美丽。

indefinite.example: They agreed to wait for an indefinite period of time.
indefinite.zh: 他们同意无限期地等待。

independent.example: She became independent and found a job in another city.
independent.zh: 她变得独立，并在另一座城市找到了工作。

index.example: You can find the word in the index at the back.
index.zh: 你可以在后面的索引里找到这个词。

indicate.example: The dark sky seemed to indicate that rain was coming.
indicate.zh: 阴暗的天空似乎表明要下雨了。

indict.example: The newspaper did not indict any person by name.
indict.zh: 该报没有点名指控任何人。

indifferent.example: He seemed indifferent to the praise and kept on working quietly.
indifferent.zh: 他对赞扬似乎漠不关心，继续安静工作。

indigenous.example: These plants are indigenous to the warm hills of this region.
indigenous.zh: 这些植物原产于这一地区温暖的山丘。

indignant.example: She was indignant about the unfair treatment of her friend.
indignant.zh: 她因朋友受到不公平对待而愤慨。

indispensable.example: A good dictionary is indispensable for careful language learners.
indispensable.zh: 对认真的语言学习者来说，一本好词典不可缺少。

individual.example: Each individual in the class chose a book to read.
individual.zh: 班上的每个人都选了一本书来读。

indoor.example: Bad weather moved the game to an indoor court.
indoor.zh: 天气不好，比赛改到了室内球场。

induce.example: Nothing could induce him to change his careful daily plan.
induce.zh: 什么也不能诱使他改变自己细致的每日计划。

indulge.example: On cold evenings, she indulges in a long warm bath.
indulge.zh: 寒冷的晚上，她会尽情享受一个长长的热水澡。

industry.example: The film industry in this area has grown very fast.
industry.zh: 这个地区的电影产业发展得非常快。

inertia.example: The heavy box kept moving forward because of its inertia.
inertia.zh: 由于惯性，这个沉重的箱子继续向前移动。

inevitable.example: Some small mistakes are inevitable when we learn a new skill.
inevitable.zh: 学一项新技能时，有些小错是不可避免的。

infant.example: The infant slept quietly in the soft light of the room.
infant.zh: 婴儿在房间柔和的光线里安静地睡着。

infect.example: The virus can infect people through a simple handshake.
infect.zh: 这种病毒可以通过简单的握手传染给人。

infer.example: From her smile we could infer that she had passed.
infer.zh: 从她的微笑我们可以推断她通过了。

inferior.example: The cheaper cloth felt inferior to the one she chose.
inferior.zh: 这种便宜的布料摸起来不如她选的那种好。

infinite.example: The night sky seems to hold an infinite number of stars.
infinite.zh: 夜空似乎拥有无数颗星星。

inflate.example: The children helped to inflate the big balloon by the door.
inflate.zh: 孩子们帮忙给门口的大气球充了气。

inflict.example: The long delay inflicted a lot of stress on the passengers.
inflict.zh: 长时间延误给乘客带来了很大压力。

influence.example: His old teacher had a deep influence on his choice.
influence.zh: 他的老师对他的选择有很深的影响。

influenza.example: She stayed in bed for a week because of influenza.
influenza.zh: 因为流感，她在床上躺了一个星期。

inform.example: Please inform the office if you plan to arrive late.
inform.zh: 如果你打算晚到，请通知办公室。

infrastructure.example: The city is spending more money on roads and other infrastructure.
infrastructure.zh: 这座城市正在道路和其他基础设施上投入更多资金。

infringe.example: Do not infringe the rights of others when you share files.
infringe.zh: 共享文件时不要侵犯他人的权利。

ingenious.example: She found an ingenious way to save space in the kitchen.
ingenious.zh: 她想出了一个在厨房里节省空间的巧妙办法。

ingredient.example: Flour is the main ingredient in this simple bread recipe.
ingredient.zh: 面粉是这个简单面包食谱中的主要原料。

inhabit.example: Many small animals inhabit the quiet woods behind our house.
inhabit.zh: 许多小动物栖息在我们屋后的安静树林里。

inherent.example: There is an inherent risk in any long mountain walk.
inherent.zh: 任何长途山路步行都有固有的风险。

inherit.example: She will inherit the old family house from her aunt.
inherit.zh: 她将从姑妈那里继承那栋老房子。

inhibit.example: Cold weather can inhibit the growth of these small plants.
inhibit.zh: 寒冷的天气会抑制这些小植物的生长。

initial.example: My initial plan was to walk, but I took the bus.
initial.zh: 我最初打算走路，但后来坐了公交车。

initiate.example: They decided to initiate a small reading group at school.
initiate.zh: 他们决定在学校发起一个小的读书小组。

inject.example: The nurse will inject the medicine into your arm soon.
inject.zh: 护士很快会把药注射到你的手臂里。

injure.example: He injured his knee while playing football on Saturday.
injure.zh: 周六踢足球时他伤了膝盖。

ink.example: The ink on the old letter had faded to brown.
ink.zh: 那封旧信上的墨水已经褪成了褐色。

inland.example: They drove inland to visit a quiet town in the hills.
inland.zh: 他们开车去内陆，探访山间一个安静的小镇。

inmate.example: The two inmates of the tiny flat became good friends.
inmate.zh: 这个小公寓里的两位同住者成了好朋友。

inn.example: We spent one night at a small inn near the river.
inn.zh: 我们在河边一家小客栈住了一晚。

inner.example: The inner room stays cool even on the hottest days.
inner.zh: 即使在最热的日子，里面的房间也很凉爽。

innocent.example: The child looked innocent as she asked her simple question.
innocent.zh: 那孩子问出那个简单问题时，看上去天真无邪。

innovate.example: Small teams often innovate faster than large ones do.
innovate.zh: 小团队往往比大团队创新得更快。

innumerable.example: The little shop sells innumerable small gifts and toys.
innumerable.zh: 这家小店出售无数的小礼品和玩具。

input.example: Your input would help us improve this simple plan.
input.zh: 你的意见会帮助我们改进这个简单的计划。

inquire.example: She called the office to inquire about the new course schedule.
inquire.zh: 她打电话到办公室询问新课程的安排。

insane.example: Driving that old car without brakes seems completely insane to me.
insane.zh: 开着那辆没有刹车的旧车，在我看来完全是疯了。

insect.example: A small insect landed on the leaf and stayed there quietly.
insect.zh: 一只小昆虫落在叶子上，静静地待在那里。

insert.example: Please insert the key into the lock and turn it slowly.
insert.zh: 请把钥匙插进锁里，然后慢慢转动。

inside.example: The children waited inside the house until the rain stopped.
inside.zh: 孩子们在屋里等到雨停。

insight.example: Her book gives useful insight into how young children learn language.
insight.zh: 她的书对幼儿如何学习语言提供了有用的见解。

insist.example: He will insist on paying for dinner whenever we meet.
insist.zh: 每次见面他都坚持要付晚餐的钱。

inspect.example: Workers inspect every machine before the factory starts its daily run.
inspect.zh: 工人在工厂每天开工前检查每一台机器。

inspire.example: Her quiet courage inspired the whole team to keep working.
inspire.zh: 她那份沉静的勇气鼓舞了整个团队继续努力。

instal.example: The workers will instal the new lights in the hall tomorrow.
instal.zh: 工人们明天会在大厅里安装新的灯。

instalment.example: They are paying for the car in monthly instalments over three years.
instalment.zh: 他们用三年时间按月分期付款买这辆车。

instance.example: In this instance, the best choice is to wait and see.
instance.zh: 在这种情况下，最好的选择是等着看看。

instant.example: The moment she heard the news, her face changed in an instant.
instant.zh: 一听到这个消息，她的脸色瞬间就变了。

instead.example: The shop was closed, so we went to a cafe instead.
instead.zh: 商店关门了，所以我们改去了一家咖啡馆。

instinct.example: Birds follow their instinct and fly south before the cold arrives.
instinct.zh: 鸟类依循本能，在寒冷来临前飞往南方。

institute.example: The institute offers free evening classes to local school teachers.
institute.zh: 该学院为当地学校教师提供免费的夜校课程。

institution.example: This old library is an important institution in our small town.
institution.zh: 这座老图书馆是我们小镇上一个重要的机构。

instruct.example: The teacher instructed the students to read the chapter at home.
instruct.zh: 老师指示学生在家读这一章。

instrument.example: The doctor used a small instrument to check my eyes carefully.
instrument.zh: 医生用一种小仪器仔细检查了我的眼睛。

insulate.example: Thick walls insulate the house from cold winds in winter.
insulate.zh: 厚厚的墙壁在冬天为房子隔绝寒风。

insult.example: He did not mean to insult you with that silly remark.
insult.zh: 他并不是想用那句蠢话侮辱你。

insure.example: We insure our house against flood and storm damage every year.
insure.zh: 我们每年都为房子投保水灾和风暴损失险。

intact.example: The old letter was still intact after fifty years in the drawer.
intact.zh: 这封旧信在抽屉里放了五十年，仍然完好无损。

intake.example: Doctors say a daily intake of fresh fruit helps your health.
intake.zh: 医生说每天摄入新鲜水果对健康有益。

intangible.example: Trust between people is an intangible value that money cannot buy.
intangible.zh: 人与人之间的信任是金钱买不到的无形价值。

integral.example: Good sleep is an integral part of a healthy daily routine.
integral.zh: 良好的睡眠是健康日常安排中不可或缺的一部分。

integrate.example: The school helps new students integrate into class life quickly.
integrate.zh: 学校帮助新同学很快融入班级生活。

integrity.example: Everyone trusted him because of his honesty and personal integrity.
integrity.zh: 由于他诚实并且为人正直，大家都很信任他。

intellect.example: Her sharp intellect made her the best student in class.
intellect.zh: 她敏锐的智力使她在班上成为最优秀的学生。

intellectual.example: The club attracts intellectual people who enjoy long talks about books.
intellectual.zh: 这个俱乐部吸引着喜欢长时间谈论书籍的有才智的人。

intelligent.example: Our new dog is intelligent enough to open the kitchen door.
intelligent.zh: 我们新养的狗聪明得能打开厨房的门。

intelligible.example: His explanation was clear and intelligible even to young listeners.
intelligible.zh: 他的解释清楚易懂，连年幼的听众也能明白。

intend.example: We intend to visit the museum on Saturday morning if it rains.
intend.zh: 如果下雨，我们打算周六上午去参观博物馆。

intense.example: The heat was so intense that we stayed indoors all afternoon.
intense.zh: 天气热得厉害，我们整个下午都待在室内。

intensive.example: She joined an intensive course to improve her spoken English.
intensive.zh: 她参加了一个密集课程来提高英语口语。

interact.example: Children learn to interact with each other through simple group games.
interact.zh: 孩子们通过简单的集体游戏学会相互交流。

intercourse.example: Regular social intercourse helps people build trust and friendship.
intercourse.zh: 经常性的社交往来有助于人们建立信任和友谊。

interest.example: He lost interest in the game after the first hour.
interest.zh: 第一个小时过后他就对这场比赛失去了兴趣。

interfere.example: Please do not interfere while the workers are repairing the road.
interfere.zh: 工人们在修路时请不要妨碍他们。

interim.example: She took an interim job while looking for a full-time position.
interim.zh: 她在寻找全职工作期间做了一份临时工作。

interior.example: The interior of the old house was warm and simply furnished.
interior.zh: 这座老房子的内部温暖而且布置简朴。

intermediate.example: This book is for intermediate learners who already know basic grammar.
intermediate.zh: 这本书适合已经掌握基础语法的中级学习者。

intermittent.example: The intermittent rain kept us from finishing the garden work.
intermittent.zh: 断断续续的雨让我们没能完成花园里的活。

internal.example: The company holds internal meetings every Friday to share progress.
internal.zh: 公司每周五召开内部会议，分享进展。

international.example: The city hosts an international film festival every autumn.
international.zh: 这座城市每年秋天举办国际电影节。

Internet.example: I found the answer on the Internet after a short search.
Internet.zh: 我在因特网上简短搜索后找到了答案。

interpret.example: Can you interpret what this old poem really means?
interpret.zh: 你能解释这首古老的诗真正是什么意思吗？

interrogate.example: The manager interrogated the staff about the missing money for hours.
interrogate.zh: 经理就丢失的钱盘问了员工好几个小时。

interrupt.example: Please do not interrupt me while I am on the phone.
interrupt.zh: 我打电话时请不要打断我。

interval.example: Buses leave the station at an interval of twenty minutes.
interval.zh: 公交车每隔二十分钟从车站发出一班。

intervene.example: The teacher had to intervene before the argument became worse.
intervene.zh: 老师不得不在争吵变得更严重之前介入。

interview.example: She has an interview with a local company next Monday.
interview.zh: 她下周一和一家本地公司有一场面试。

intimate.example: They have been intimate friends since their first year at school.
intimate.zh: 他们从在学校的第一年起就是亲密的朋友。

intimidate.example: His loud voice did not intimidate the young worker at all.
intimidate.zh: 他大声的说话一点儿也没有吓住那个年轻工人。

into.example: She walked into the kitchen and poured herself a glass of water.
into.zh: 她走进厨房，给自己倒了一杯水。

intricate.example: The carpet has an intricate pattern of flowers and small birds.
intricate.zh: 这块地毯有花朵和小鸟组成的复杂图案。

intrigue.example: The old map intrigued the children and they studied it for hours.
intrigue.zh: 这张旧地图引起了孩子们的兴趣，他们研究了几个小时。

intrinsic.example: Reading has an intrinsic value beyond passing any examination.
intrinsic.zh: 阅读具有超越通过考试的固有价值。

introduce.example: Let me introduce you to my sister before dinner starts.
introduce.zh: 晚饭开始前让我把你介绍给我姐姐。

intrude.example: I do not want to intrude, but may I ask a question?
intrude.zh: 我不想打扰，不过我可以问一个问题吗？

intuition.example: Her intuition told her that something was wrong at home.
intuition.zh: 她的直觉告诉她家里出了什么事。

invade.example: Weeds slowly invade the garden if nobody pulls them out.
invade.zh: 如果没人把杂草拔掉，它们会慢慢侵入花园。

invalid.example: Your ticket is invalid after the date printed on it.
invalid.zh: 你的票在打印的日期之后就无效了。

invaluable.example: Her advice was invaluable when I planned the whole trip.
invaluable.zh: 我规划整趟旅行时，她的建议非常宝贵。

invariably.example: He invariably arrives ten minutes early for every morning meeting.
invariably.zh: 每次晨会他都无一例外地提前十分钟到。

invent.example: Nobody knows who invented the first simple water clock.
invent.zh: 没人知道是谁发明了第一台简易水钟。

inventory.example: The shop checks its inventory at the end of each month.
inventory.zh: 这家店在每月月底清点存货。

invert.example: If you invert the cup, the water will run out.
invert.zh: 如果你把杯子倒过来，水就会流出来。

invest.example: They decided to invest their savings in a small local business.
invest.zh: 他们决定把积蓄投资到一家本地小企业。

investigate.example: Engineers will investigate the cause of the strange noise.
investigate.zh: 工程师将调查这种奇怪噪音的原因。

invisible.example: The bird was almost invisible against the grey winter sky.
invisible.zh: 那只鸟在灰蒙蒙的冬日天空下几乎看不见。

invite.example: We plan to invite our neighbours for tea on Sunday.
invite.zh: 我们打算周日请邻居来喝茶。

involve.example: The job involves a lot of travel to other cities.
involve.zh: 这份工作需要经常去其他城市出差。

inward.example: He took a deep inward breath before speaking to the crowd.
inward.zh: 他深深吸了一口气，然后才向人群讲话。

iron.example: She used a hot iron to press the shirt flat.
iron.zh: 她用热熨斗把衬衫烫平。

irony.example: The irony is that the writer forgot his own book at home.
irony.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，这位作家把自己的书忘在了家里。

irrational.example: It seems irrational to buy a new phone every single year.
irrational.zh: 每年都买一部新手机似乎是不合理的。

irregular.example: Her working hours are irregular, so she rarely eats on time.
irregular.zh: 她的工作时间不规律，所以她很少按时吃饭。

irrespective.example: The course is open to everyone, irrespective of age or job.
irrespective.zh: 这门课对所有人开放，不论年龄或职业。

irrigate.example: Farmers irrigate their fields with water from the small river.
irrigate.zh: 农民用小河里的水灌溉田地。

irritate.example: The loud music from next door began to irritate everyone.
irritate.zh: 隔壁传来的吵闹音乐开始让大家恼火。

island.example: A small island sits in the middle of the quiet lake.
island.zh: 平静的湖中央有一座小岛。

isle.example: We rowed to a tiny isle and ate lunch on its shore.
isle.zh: 我们划船到一个小岛，在岸边吃了午饭。

isolate.example: The snowstorm isolated the village from the rest of the country.
isolate.zh: 暴风雪使这个村庄与国内其他地方隔绝。

issue.example: The main issue at the meeting was the rising cost of rent.
issue.zh: 会上主要的问题是不断上涨的房租。

it.example: It was already dark when we finally reached the hotel.
it.zh: 我们终于到旅馆时天已经黑了。

item.example: Each item on the list costs less than ten dollars.
item.zh: 清单上的每一项都不到十美元。

its.example: The cat licked its paws and then fell asleep by the window.
its.zh: 猫舔了舔爪子，然后在窗边睡着了。

itself.example: The old machine stopped by itself in the middle of the night.
itself.zh: 那台旧机器半夜自己停了下来。

ivory.example: She kept her rings in a small ivory box on the shelf.
ivory.zh: 她把戒指放在架子上一个象牙制的小盒子里。

jack.example: He used a jack to lift the car and change the tyre.
jack.zh: 他用千斤顶把车顶起来，换了轮胎。

jacket.example: He hung his jacket on the chair and sat down.
jacket.zh: 他把外套挂在椅子上，然后坐了下来。

jail.example: The man was sent to jail for stealing money from the shop.
jail.zh: 这名男子因从商店偷钱而被送进监狱。

jam.example: She spread strawberry jam on a slice of warm bread.
jam.zh: 她把草莓酱涂在一片热面包上。

January.example: The new term begins in January and ends in early June.
January.zh: 新学期一月开始，六月初结束。

jar.example: She filled a glass jar with honey and sealed it.
jar.zh: 她把蜂蜜装进一个玻璃罐里，然后封好。

jargon.example: The report was full of technical jargon that confused most readers.
jargon.zh: 这份报告充满专业术语，让大多数读者感到困惑。

jaw.example: He hurt his jaw while eating a hard piece of bread.
jaw.zh: 他在吃一块硬面包时伤了颌部。

jazz.example: They played soft jazz in the cafe all evening.
jazz.zh: 他们整晚都在咖啡馆里放轻柔的爵士乐。

jealous.example: She felt a little jealous when her friend won the prize.
jealous.zh: 朋友得奖时，她感到有点嫉妒。

jeans.example: He wears blue jeans and a white shirt to work.
jeans.zh: 他穿着蓝色牛仔裤和白衬衫去上班。

jeep.example: The jeep climbed the steep dirt road without any trouble.
jeep.zh: 吉普车毫不费力地爬上了陡峭的土路。

jelly.example: The children ate fruit jelly with cream after lunch.
jelly.zh: 孩子们午饭后吃了带奶油的水果果冻。

jeopardize.example: Missing too many classes may jeopardize your chance to pass.
jeopardize.zh: 缺课太多可能会危害你通过考试的机会。

jerk.example: He gave the rope a quick jerk and the box moved.
jerk.zh: 他猛拉了一下绳子，箱子移动了。

jet.example: A jet of hot water came out of the small pipe.
jet.zh: 一股热水从小管子里喷了出来。

jetlag.example: After the long flight, she slept all day because of jetlag.
jetlag.zh: 长途飞行之后，因为时差反应她睡了一整天。

jewel.example: She kept every jewel in a locked wooden box.
jewel.zh: 她把每件珠宝都放在一个上锁的木盒里。

job.example: He found a new job at a small book shop.
job.zh: 他在一家小书店找到了一份新工作。

jockey.example: The jockey rode the brown horse past the finish line.
jockey.zh: 骑师骑着那匹棕马冲过终点线。

jog.example: I jog along the river every morning before breakfast.
jog.zh: 我每天早饭前沿河慢跑。

join.example: Would you like to join us for a walk after dinner?
join.zh: 晚饭后你愿意和我们一起散步吗？

joint.example: The two families bought a joint gift for the teacher.
joint.zh: 两个家庭合起来给老师买了一份礼物。

joke.example: He told a funny joke and everybody laughed loudly.
joke.zh: 他讲了一个有趣的笑话，大家都大声笑了。

jolly.example: Our neighbour is a jolly man who laughs at everything.
jolly.zh: 我们的邻居是个快活的人，什么事都能让他发笑。

journal.example: She writes in her journal every night before going to bed.
journal.zh: 她每晚睡觉前都在日记里写点东西。

journalism.example: He studied journalism and now writes for a city newspaper.
journalism.zh: 他学的是新闻学，现在为一家城市报纸撰稿。

journey.example: The journey to the mountain village took almost five hours.
journey.zh: 去那个山村的路程花了将近五个小时。

joy.example: Her face was full of joy when she opened the gift.
joy.zh: 她打开礼物时脸上满是喜悦。

judge.example: The judge listened carefully to both sides before making a decision.
judge.zh: 法官在作出决定前仔细听取了双方的意见。

judicial.example: The country is making changes to its judicial system this year.
judicial.zh: 该国今年正在改革其司法制度。

judiciary.example: An independent judiciary protects the rights of ordinary people.
judiciary.zh: 独立的司法系统保护普通人的权利。

juice.example: She squeezed an orange and drank the fresh juice slowly.
juice.zh: 她挤了一个橙子，慢慢喝下新鲜的果汁。

July.example: We moved into our new flat in July last year.
July.zh: 我们去年七月搬进了新公寓。

jump.example: The dog tried to jump over the low garden wall.
jump.zh: 那只狗试图跳过花园里那道矮墙。

junction.example: Turn left at the junction where the two roads meet.
junction.zh: 在两条路交汇的路口向左转。

June.example: Our classes finish in June and start again in September.
June.zh: 我们的课程六月结束，九月再开始。

jungle.example: Many rare plants grow deep in the warm wet jungle.
jungle.zh: 许多稀有植物生长在温暖潮湿的丛林深处。

junior.example: She is a junior member of the team and learns quickly.
junior.zh: 她是团队里的初级成员，学得很快。

junk.example: He cleared the junk out of the garage last weekend.
junk.zh: 他上周末把车库里的杂物清理掉了。

jurisdiction.example: This case falls outside the jurisdiction of the local court.
jurisdiction.zh: 这个案子不属于地方法院的管辖范围。

jury.example: The jury listened to every witness before reaching a decision.
jury.zh: 陪审团在作出裁决前听取了每位证人的证词。

just.example: It is just a small mistake, so please do not worry.
just.zh: 这不过是个小错误，所以请不要担心。

justice.example: People expect fairness and justice from the courts.
justice.zh: 人们期望法院给予公平和正义。

justify.example: Nothing can justify treating a kind neighbour so rudely.
justify.zh: 没有任何理由可以说明如此无礼地对待一位善良的邻居是正当的。

juvenile.example: The library has a special corner for juvenile readers.
juvenile.zh: 图书馆有一个专门的角落供少年读者使用。

keen.example: She is keen to learn Spanish before her trip next year.
keen.zh: 她很渴望在明年旅行前学会西班牙语。

keep.example: Please keep the window closed while the air conditioner is on.
keep.zh: 开空调时请把窗户关着。

kettle.example: The kettle is boiling, so we can make tea now.
kettle.zh: 水壶开了，所以我们现在可以泡茶了。

key.example: I left the house key on the kitchen table.
key.zh: 我把房门钥匙放在厨房桌子上了。

keyboard.example: He spilled tea on the keyboard and two keys stopped working.
keyboard.zh: 他把茶洒在键盘上，有两个键不能用了。

kick.example: The small boy kicked the ball into the garden.
kick.zh: 那个小男孩把球踢进了花园。

kid.example: The kid next door asked me to fix his toy car.
kid.zh: 隔壁那孩子请我修他的玩具车。

kidnap.example: The story is about a prince who was kidnapped as a baby.
kidnap.zh: 这个故事讲的是一个婴儿时被拐走的王子。

kidney.example: He drinks plenty of water to keep his kidneys healthy.
kidney.zh: 他大量喝水以保持肾脏健康。

kill.example: The heavy frost killed the young plants in the garden.
kill.zh: 严霜冻死了花园里的幼苗。

kilogram.example: The baby gained one kilogram in his first two months.
kilogram.zh: 这个婴儿在头两个月里体重增加了一公斤。

kilometer.example: The school is about one kilometer from our front door.
kilometer.zh: 学校距离我们的前门大约一公里。

kin.example: In that village, most families are kin to one another.
kin.zh: 在那个村子里，大多数家庭彼此都是亲戚。

kind.example: She is always kind to the new students in her class.
kind.zh: 她对她班上的新同学总是很和善。

kindergarten.example: She takes her son to kindergarten on her way to work.
kindergarten.zh: 她上班顺路送儿子去幼儿园。

king.example: The king ruled the land for more than thirty years.
king.zh: 这位国王统治这片土地三十多年。

kingdom.example: The kingdom was known for its rich green valleys.
kingdom.zh: 这个王国以富饶的绿色山谷闻名。

kiss.example: She gave her child a quick kiss on the forehead.
kiss.zh: 她在孩子额头上轻轻吻了一下。

kit.example: He keeps a small tool kit in the back of his car.
kit.zh: 他在车后备箱里放着一套小工具。

kitchen.example: The kitchen smells of fresh bread every Sunday morning.
kitchen.zh: 每个周日早晨厨房里都飘着新鲜面包的香味。

kite.example: The children flew a red kite on the windy hill.
kite.zh: 孩子们在起风的山坡上放一只红色风筝。

knee.example: He fell and hurt his knee while running down the hill.
knee.zh: 他跑下山时摔倒，伤了膝盖。

kneel.example: She had to kneel down to tie her shoe.
kneel.zh: 她不得不跪下来系鞋带。

knife.example: He used a sharp knife to cut the bread into slices.
knife.zh: 他用一把快刀把面包切成片。

knight.example: The story tells of a brave knight and his long journey.
knight.zh: 这个故事讲述一位勇敢的骑士和他漫长的旅程。

knit.example: My grandmother likes to knit warm sweaters for the family.
knit.zh: 我奶奶喜欢给家人织暖和的毛衣。

knob.example: Turn the knob on the left to open the door.
knob.zh: 转动左边的把手就能把门打开。

knock.example: Please knock on the door before you come into the room.

knot.example: He tied the rope in a tight knot around the post.
knot.zh: 他把绳子紧紧地打了个结系在柱子上。

know.example: I know the answer, but I cannot remember where I read it.
know.zh: 我知道答案，却想不起是在哪里读到的。

knowhow.example: It takes years to gain the knowhow for this kind of work.
knowhow.zh: 做这类工作需要多年才能掌握其中的诀窍。

label.example: Read the label on the bottle before you take the medicine.
label.zh: 服药前请先读瓶子上的标签。

labor.example: The job requires hard labor and a lot of patience.
labor.zh: 这份工作需要辛苦的劳动和很大的耐心。

laboratory.example: The students did a simple experiment in the laboratory.
laboratory.zh: 学生们在实验室里做了一个简单的实验。

lace.example: The dress had delicate lace around the collar and sleeves.
lace.zh: 那条连衣裙的领口和袖口镶着精致的花边。

lack.example: The garden failed because of a lack of rain.
lack.zh: 由于缺少雨水，花园没有长好。

lad.example: A young lad offered to carry her bags to the door.
lad.zh: 一个年轻小伙子主动帮她把包提到门口。

ladder.example: He climbed the ladder to fix the light on the ceiling.
ladder.zh: 他爬上梯子修天花板上的灯。

lady.example: An elderly lady asked me for directions to the station.
lady.zh: 一位老太太向我问去车站的路。

lag.example: The old computer tends to lag when I open large files.
lag.zh: 我打开大文件时，这台旧电脑往往会出现延迟。

lake.example: We walked around the lake and watched the ducks.
lake.zh: 我们绕着湖散步，看湖里的鸭子。

lamb.example: The lamb stayed close to its mother in the field.
lamb.zh: 小羊在田里紧紧跟着它的母亲。

lame.example: The horse was lame and could not walk very far.
lame.zh: 那匹马瘸了，走不了太远。

lamp.example: A small lamp on the desk gave enough light to read.
lamp.zh: 桌上的一盏小灯提供了足够读书的光线。

land.example: The farmer bought a large piece of land near the river.
land.zh: 那位农民在河边买了一大块土地。

landlord.example: The landlord promised to fix the heating before winter.
landlord.zh: 房东答应在冬天之前修好暖气。

landmark.example: The old tower is a famous landmark in our small town.
landmark.zh: 那座古塔是我们小镇上有名的地标。

landscape.example: The view from the hill shows a wide green landscape.
landscape.zh: 从山上望去，是一片开阔的绿色风景。

lane.example: They walked down a narrow lane lined with old trees.
lane.zh: 他们沿着一条两旁长满老树的小巷走去。

language.example: Learning a new language takes time and daily practice.
language.zh: 学一门新语言需要时间和每天的练习。

lap.example: The child sat on her mother's lap and listened to a story.
lap.zh: 孩子坐在母亲膝上听故事。

laptop.example: He opened his laptop and started writing the report.
laptop.zh: 他打开笔记本电脑，开始写报告。

large.example: They live in a large house with a garden at the back.
large.zh: 他们住在一幢后面带花园的大房子里。

laser.example: The printer uses a laser to produce clear, sharp text.
laser.zh: 这台打印机用激光打印出清晰锐利的文字。

lash.example: She lowered her lashes and smiled at the good news.
lash.zh: 她垂下睫毛，听到这个好消息笑了。

lass.example: The lass carried a basket of apples to the market.
lass.zh: 那个少女提着一篮苹果去集市。

last.example: This is the last chance to sign up for the course.
last.zh: 这是报名参加这门课程的最后机会。

late.example: She arrived late and missed the start of the film.
late.zh: 她来晚了，错过了电影的开头。

lately.example: He has been very busy lately and looks tired.
lately.zh: 他最近非常忙，看上去很疲倦。

latitude.example: The city lies at a latitude where winters are mild.
latitude.zh: 这座城市位于冬季温和的纬度上。

latter.example: Of the two plans, the latter seems easier to follow.
latter.zh: 两个方案中，后一个似乎更容易执行。

laugh.example: The joke made everyone laugh out loud at the table.
laugh.zh: 那个笑话让桌旁的人都大笑起来。

launch.example: The company plans to launch a new product next month.
launch.zh: 公司计划下个月推出一款新产品。

laundry.example: She does the laundry every Sunday morning before breakfast.
laundry.zh: 她每周日早晨早饭前洗衣服。

lavatory.example: The lavatory on this floor is at the end of the hall.
lavatory.zh: 这层楼的厕所在走廊尽头。

lavish.example: They held a lavish party with music, flowers and fine food.
lavish.zh: 他们办了一场有音乐、鲜花和美食的奢华聚会。

law.example: The new law protects old trees in the city parks.
law.zh: 新法律保护城市公园里的老树。

lawn.example: He cuts the lawn every Saturday with an old mower.
lawn.zh: 他每周六用一台旧割草机修剪草坪。

lawsuit.example: The company faced a lawsuit over the damaged goods.
lawsuit.zh: 那家公司因货物受损而面临诉讼。

lawyer.example: Her lawyer read the contract carefully before she signed it.
lawyer.zh: 她的律师在她签字前仔细读了合同。

lay.example: Please lay the clean towels on the shelf by the door.
lay.zh: 请把干净的毛巾放在门边的架子上。

layer.example: A thick layer of dust covered the old wooden shelf.
layer.zh: 一层厚厚的灰尘盖住了那个旧木架。

layman.example: The book explains science in words a layman can follow.
layman.zh: 这本书用门外汉也能看懂的话讲解科学。

layoff.example: The factory announced a layoff of fifty workers last week.
layoff.zh: 工厂上周宣布临时解雇五十名工人。

layout.example: The layout of the new office makes the space feel larger.
layout.zh: 新办公室的布局让空间显得更大。

lazy.example: He was too lazy to wash the dishes after dinner.
lazy.zh: 他太懒了，晚饭后不愿洗碗。

lead.example: She will lead the team through the difficult project.
lead.zh: 她将带领团队完成这个艰难的项目。

leader.example: She was chosen as the leader of the small research team.
leader.zh: 她被选为这个小型研究团队的负责人。

leaf.example: A single leaf fell onto the page of my book.
leaf.zh: 一片叶子落在我书的书页上。

leaflet.example: A volunteer handed me a leaflet about saving water.
leaflet.zh: 一位志愿者递给我一张关于节水的传单。

league.example: Their team finished second in the local football league.
league.zh: 他们的球队在本地足球联赛中获得第二名。

leak.example: A small leak in the roof let rain into the room.
leak.zh: 屋顶上的一处小漏洞让雨水渗进了房间。

lean.example: He had to lean forward to hear her quiet voice.
lean.zh: 他不得不向前倾身，才能听见她轻声说话。

leap.example: The cat made a quick leap onto the high shelf.
leap.zh: 猫敏捷地一跃跳上了高架子。

learn.example: Children learn new words quickly when they read every day.
learn.zh: 孩子们每天读书，学新词很快。

lease.example: They signed a two-year lease for the small apartment.
lease.zh: 他们为那套小公寓签了两年租约。

least.example: This is the least expensive option we could find.
least.zh: 这是我们能找到的最便宜的选择。

leather.example: He wore a brown leather jacket on the cold morning.
leather.zh: 那个寒冷的早晨，他穿了一件棕色皮夹克。

leave.example: We should leave early to avoid the morning traffic.
leave.zh: 我们该早些出发，以避开早高峰的车流。

lecture.example: The professor gave a lecture on the history of music.
lecture.zh: 教授作了一场关于音乐史的讲座。

left.example: The post office is on the left side of the street.

leg.example: He hurt his leg while playing football with friends.
leg.zh: 他和朋友踢足球时伤了腿。

legacy.example: The garden is a lasting legacy from the first owner.
legacy.zh: 这座花园是第一位主人留下的长久遗产。

legal.example: The contract is legal and both sides must follow it.
legal.zh: 这份合同是合法的，双方都必须遵守。

legend.example: According to an old legend, a kind spirit lives in the lake.
legend.zh: 根据一个古老的传说，湖里住着一个善良的精灵。

legislate.example: Many countries legislate to limit the amount of plastic waste.
legislate.zh: 许多国家通过立法来限制塑料垃圾的数量。

legitimate.example: She had a legitimate reason for missing the morning meeting.
legitimate.zh: 她缺席上午的会议有正当理由。

leisure.example: He spends his leisure time reading and walking in the park.
leisure.zh: 他把空闲时间用来读书和在公园散步。

lemon.example: She added a slice of lemon to her glass of tea.
lemon.zh: 她往自己的那杯茶里加了一片柠檬。

lend.example: Could you lend me your pen for a few minutes?
lend.zh: 能把你的笔借我用几分钟吗？

length.example: The length of the table is about two meters.
length.zh: 这张桌子的长度大约是两米。

lenient.example: The teacher was lenient and gave us extra time.
lenient.zh: 老师很宽容，多给了我们一些时间。

lens.example: He cleaned the lens of his camera with a soft cloth.
lens.zh: 他用一块软布擦拭相机的镜头。

lesbian.example: In the story, a lesbian couple opened a small bookshop.
lesbian.zh: 故事里，一对女同性恋伴侣开了一家小书店。

less.example: This bag weighs less than the one I bought last year.
less.zh: 这个包比我去年买的那个轻。

lesson.example: She learned an important lesson from her first mistake.
lesson.zh: 她从自己的第一个错误中学到了重要的一课。

lest.example: Speak quietly lest you wake the sleeping baby.
lest.zh: 说话轻一点，以免吵醒睡着的宝宝。

let.example: Let me help you carry those heavy boxes upstairs.
let.zh: 让我帮你把那些重箱子搬上楼吧。

letter.example: She wrote a long letter to her friend in another city.
letter.zh: 她给另一个城市的朋友写了一封长信。

level.example: The water level in the river rose after the heavy rain.
level.zh: 大雨过后，河里的水位上升了。

lever.example: He used a long piece of wood as a lever to move the rock.
lever.zh: 他用一根长木头当杠杆去挪动那块石头。

levy.example: The city plans to levy a small tax on hotel rooms.
levy.zh: 该市计划对酒店客房征收一小笔税。

liable.example: Drivers are liable for any damage they cause on the road.
liable.zh: 司机应对自己在路上造成的任何损害负责。

liar.example: Nobody trusts a liar, even when he tells the truth.
liar.zh: 没人相信说谎的人，即使他说的是真话。

liberal.example: Her grandparents are liberal with praise when she does well.
liberal.zh: 她做得好时，祖父母总是慷慨地夸奖她。

liberate.example: The new machine can liberate workers from heavy manual labor.
liberate.zh: 这台新机器能把工人从繁重的体力劳动中解放出来。

liberty.example: Children need some liberty to make their own choices.
liberty.zh: 孩子需要一些自由来自己做选择。

library.example: The library stays open until nine on weekday evenings.
library.zh: 图书馆在工作日晚上开到九点。

license.example: You need a license to drive a car in this country.
license.zh: 在这个国家开车需要驾照。

lick.example: The dog began to lick the water from the bowl.
lick.zh: 那条狗开始舔碗里的水。

lid.example: She lifted the lid of the pot to check the soup.

lie.example: The dog likes to lie on the cool floor in summer.
lie.zh: 夏天那条狗喜欢躺在凉凉的地板上。

lieutenant.example: The new lieutenant was responsible for organizing the daily schedule.
lieutenant.zh: 这位新来的副官负责安排每天的日程。

life.example: She moved to the country for a quieter life.
life.zh: 她搬到乡下，想过更安静的生活。

lift.example: The box was too heavy for her to lift alone.
lift.zh: 这个箱子太重，她一个人举不起来。

light.example: The soft light from the lamp filled the small room.
light.zh: 柔和的灯光充满了这间小屋。

lighting.example: The lighting in this room is too bright for reading.
lighting.zh: 这个房间的照明对阅读来说太亮了。

lightning.example: The lightning flashed across the sky just before the rain.
lightning.zh: 就在下雨前，闪电划过天空。

like.example: I like to walk by the river after work.
like.zh: 我喜欢下班后在河边散步。

likely.example: It is likely to rain again this afternoon.
likely.zh: 今天下午可能还会下雨。

likewise.example: He folded his napkin, and she did likewise.
likewise.zh: 他叠好餐巾，她也照样做了。

lily.example: A white lily stood in a tall glass vase by the door.
lily.zh: 门边的高玻璃花瓶里插着一枝白百合。

limb.example: After the long run, every limb in her body ached.
limb.zh: 长跑之后，她四肢都酸痛。

lime.example: She squeezed a little lime juice into her glass of water.
lime.zh: 她往水杯里挤了一点酸橙汁。

limelight.example: The young singer enjoyed the limelight after her first show.
limelight.zh: 首场演出之后，这位年轻歌手享受着众人的注目。

limit.example: The teacher set a strict limit on how long we could talk.
limit.zh: 老师严格限制了我们讲话的时长。

limp.example: The flowers looked limp after a week without water.
limp.zh: 一周没浇水，那些花看起来都蔫软了。

line.example: Please stand in line and wait for your turn.
line.zh: 请排队等候，轮到你再来。

linen.example: She spread a clean linen cloth over the wooden table.
linen.zh: 她把一块干净的亚麻布铺在木桌上。

liner.example: The liner carried more than a thousand passengers across the sea.
liner.zh: 那艘班轮载着一千多名乘客横渡大海。

linger.example: A few guests lingered in the garden after the party ended.
linger.zh: 聚会结束后，有几位客人在花园里逗留。

linguistic.example: Her linguistic skills helped her learn three new languages quickly.
linguistic.zh: 她的语言能力帮她很快学会了三门新语言。

link.example: Click the link to open the full article in your browser.
link.zh: 点击这个链接，在浏览器里打开全文。

lion.example: The lion rested in the shade of a tall tree.
lion.zh: 狮子在高大的树荫下休息。

lip.example: She bit her lower lip while thinking about the answer.
lip.zh: 她思考答案时咬着下唇。

lipstick.example: She put on some red lipstick before the dinner party.
lipstick.zh: 晚宴前她涂了一点红色口红。

liquid.example: Pour the liquid slowly into the glass bowl.
liquid.zh: 把液体慢慢倒进玻璃碗里。

liquor.example: He kept a bottle of liquor in the cupboard for guests.
liquor.zh: 他在柜子里放了一瓶酒，用来招待客人。

list.example: Please write your name on the list by the door.
list.zh: 请把名字写在门边的名单上。

listen.example: I like to listen to quiet music while I work.
listen.zh: 我喜欢一边工作一边听安静的音乐。

liter.example: This bottle holds one liter of fresh milk.
liter.zh: 这个瓶子能装一升鲜牛奶。

literal.example: The literal meaning of the phrase is quite different from its usual one.
literal.zh: 这个短语的字面意思和它通常的意思很不一样。

literary.example: She joined a literary club that meets every Thursday evening.
literary.zh: 她加入了一个每周四晚上活动的文学社。

litter.example: Please do not drop litter on the path through the park.
litter.zh: 请不要在穿过公园的小路上乱丢垃圾。

little.example: There is little time left before the train leaves.
little.zh: 火车开走之前剩下的时间不多了。

live.example: They live in a small village near the lake.
live.zh: 他们住在湖边的一个小村庄里。

livelihood.example: The small shop provides a livelihood for the whole family.
livelihood.zh: 这家小店养活了一家人。

lively.example: The children were lively and full of questions all morning.
lively.zh: 整个上午孩子们都活蹦乱跳，问题不断。

liver.example: The doctor said his liver was healthy after the check-up.
liver.zh: 医生说检查之后他的肝脏是健康的。

livestock.example: The farm keeps livestock in the fields behind the barn.
livestock.zh: 这个农场把家畜养在谷仓后面的田里。

living.example: The cost of living has risen again this year.
living.zh: 今年的生活成本又上涨了。

living-room.example: We sat in the living-room and talked until midnight.
living-room.zh: 我们坐在起居室里聊到半夜。

load.example: The workers helped load the boxes onto the small truck.
load.zh: 工人们帮忙把箱子装上那辆小卡车。

loaf.example: She bought a fresh loaf of bread on her way home.
loaf.zh: 她在回家路上买了一条新鲜面包。

loan.example: The bank agreed to give them a loan to buy a small house.
loan.zh: 银行同意给他们一笔贷款，用来买一栋小房子。

lobby.example: We waited in the hotel lobby until the taxi arrived.
lobby.zh: 我们在酒店大堂等到出租车来。

local.example: The local shop sells fresh bread and vegetables every morning.
local.zh: 这家本地商店每天早上出售新鲜面包和蔬菜。

locate.example: The school is located near the park, so children can walk there.
locate.zh: 学校位于公园附近，所以孩子们可以步行去那里。

lock.example: Do not forget to lock the front door when you leave.
lock.zh: 离开时别忘了锁上前门。

locomotive.example: The old steam locomotive pulled six carriages through the mountain village.
locomotive.zh: 那台老式蒸汽机车拉着六节车厢穿过山村。

lodge.example: They spent the night in a small wooden lodge near the lake.
lodge.zh: 他们在湖边一间小木屋里过了一夜。

lofty.example: The lofty mountains around the town are covered with snow in winter.
lofty.zh: 小镇周围的高山在冬天被积雪覆盖。

log.example: The captain kept a detailed log of the ship's journey across the sea.
log.zh: 船长详细记录了这艘船的海上航行日志。

logic.example: There is a clear logic in the way she explains difficult ideas.
logic.zh: 她解释难题的方式有清晰的逻辑。

logistics.example: The company's logistics team makes sure every order arrives on time.
logistics.zh: 公司的物流团队确保每个订单都按时送达。

logo.example: The company put its new logo on every box and business card.
logo.zh: 公司把新标志印在每个盒子和名片上。

lonely.example: He felt lonely in the big city until he made new friends.
lonely.zh: 在交到新朋友之前，他在大城市里感到孤单。

long.example: The long bridge across the river was built many years ago.
long.zh: 横跨这条河的长桥是很多年前建成的。

longevity.example: Good food and regular exercise are said to improve longevity.
longevity.zh: 人们说良好的饮食和规律的运动有助于长寿。

longitude.example: The ship's position is given by its latitude and longitude on the map.
longitude.zh: 这艘船的位置由地图上的纬度和经度确定。

look.example: She gave me a quick look and then turned away.
look.zh: 她很快看了我一眼，然后转过身去。

loom.example: My grandmother still uses an old wooden loom to make cloth at home.
loom.zh: 我奶奶还在家里用一架旧木织布机织布。

loop.example: He tied the rope in a loop around the wooden post.
loop.zh: 他把绳子在木柱上绕成一个圈。

loophole.example: The old stone wall still has a narrow loophole for light and air.
loophole.zh: 这面古老的石墙上仍有一个狭窄的换气孔，用来透光和通风。

loose.example: This shirt is too loose, so I need a smaller size.
loose.zh: 这件衬衫太宽松了，所以我需要小一号的。

loot.example: The police found the loot hidden in an old building near the river.
loot.zh: 警方在河边一栋旧楼里找到了被藏起来的赃物。

lord.example: The lord of the castle owned most of the land around the village.
lord.zh: 城堡的领主拥有村庄周围的大部分土地。

lorry.example: A heavy lorry blocked the narrow road for almost an hour.
lorry.zh: 一辆重型卡车把窄路堵了将近一个小时。

lose.example: Be careful not to lose your keys on the way home.
lose.zh: 小心别在回家的路上把钥匙弄丢了。

lot.example: She spends a lot of time reading books about plants.
lot.zh: 她花很多时间读关于植物的书。

lotion.example: She put some lotion on her dry hands before going to bed.
lotion.zh: 她睡前在干燥的手上涂了一些润肤露。

lottery.example: He bought a lottery ticket and dreamed of winning a new house.
lottery.zh: 他买了一张彩票，梦想着赢一栋新房子。

loud.example: The music was so loud that we could not talk.
loud.zh: 音乐太响了，我们没法交谈。

lounge.example: We waited in the hotel lounge until our room was ready.
lounge.zh: 我们在酒店休息室等着，直到房间准备好。

love.example: I love walking in the quiet woods after the rain.
love.zh: 我喜欢雨后到安静的树林里散步。

low.example: The water level in the river is very low this year.
low.zh: 今年河里的水位非常低。

loyal.example: He has been a loyal friend to me for many years.
loyal.zh: 多年来他一直是我忠实的朋友。

lubricate.example: You should lubricate the moving parts of the machine every month.
lubricate.zh: 你应该每个月给机器的运动部件加润滑油。

luck.example: With a little luck, we will finish the work before dark.
luck.zh: 如果运气好一点，我们会在天黑前完成工作。

lucrative.example: Selling handmade gifts online turned out to be a lucrative business.
lucrative.zh: 在网上卖手工礼物结果成了一门赚钱的生意。

luggage.example: Please keep your luggage with you at all times in the station.
luggage.zh: 在车站里请随时把行李带在身边。

luminous.example: The luminous hands of the clock were easy to read in the dark.
luminous.zh: 钟表上发光的指针在黑暗中很容易看清。

lump.example: He put a lump of sugar into his tea and stirred it slowly.
lump.zh: 他往茶里放了一块方糖，慢慢搅拌。

lunar.example: The lunar calendar is still used to decide the date of some festivals.
lunar.zh: 农历仍被用来确定一些节日的日期。

lunch.example: We had lunch in a small cafe near the market.
lunch.zh: 我们在市场附近的一家小咖啡馆吃了午饭。

lung.example: Smoking can do great harm to your lungs and your heart.
lung.zh: 吸烟会对你的肺和心脏造成很大伤害。

lure.example: The bright lights of the city can lure young people away from home.
lure.zh: 城市的明亮灯光会把年轻人从家乡诱惑走。

luxury.example: For many families, a foreign holiday is still a luxury.
luxury.zh: 对许多家庭来说，出国度假仍是一种奢侈。

lyric.example: She wrote the lyrics for the song and her brother wrote the music.
lyric.zh: 她为这首歌写了歌词，她哥哥写了曲子。

machine.example: This machine can wash a large load of clothes in twenty minutes.
machine.zh: 这台机器二十分钟就能洗一大堆衣服。

mad.example: The little boy was mad at his friend for losing the ball.
mad.zh: 小男孩因为朋友弄丢了球而生他气。

madam.example: Excuse me, madam, may I help you carry those heavy bags?
madam.zh: 打扰一下，女士，我可以帮您提那些重袋子吗？

magazine.example: She reads a science magazine every month to learn new things.
magazine.zh: 她每个月读一本科学杂志来学习新东西。

magic.example: The children watched the magic show with open mouths and wide eyes.
magic.zh: 孩子们张大嘴巴、睁大眼睛看魔术表演。

magistrate.example: The magistrate listened carefully to both sides before making a fair decision.
magistrate.zh: 治安法官在做出公正裁决前仔细听取了双方的意见。

magnet.example: A magnet can pull small pieces of iron toward it from a short distance.
magnet.zh: 磁铁能在短距离内把小块铁吸向自己。

magnificent.example: From the top of the hill we saw a magnificent view of the valley.
magnificent.zh: 从山顶上我们看到了山谷的壮丽景色。

magnify.example: A good lens can magnify small letters so that they become easy to read.
magnify.zh: 好的镜片能放大小的字母，使它们容易阅读。

magnitude.example: Nobody understood the magnitude of the problem until the reports came in.
magnitude.zh: 直到报告送来，人们才明白问题有多严重。

maid.example: A maid came to clean the room and change the bed sheets.
maid.zh: 一位女仆来打扫房间并更换床单。

maiden.example: The ship set out on its maiden voyage across the wide ocean.
maiden.zh: 这艘船开始了跨越广阔海洋的处女航。

mail.example: I check my mail every morning before I start work.
mail.zh: 我每天早上开始工作前都会查看邮件。

main.example: The main reason he moved to the town was to find work.
main.zh: 他搬到这个镇上的主要原因是找工作。

mainland.example: They took a boat from the island to the mainland the next morning.
mainland.zh: 第二天早上他们坐船从岛上回到大陆。

mainstream.example: Solar power has become part of mainstream energy use in many countries.
mainstream.zh: 太阳能已成为许多国家主流能源使用的一部分。

maintain.example: It is not easy to maintain a good friendship over many years.
maintain.zh: 多年来维持一段好的友谊并不容易。

majesty.example: The majesty of the mountains made everyone in the group silent.
majesty.zh: 群山的雄伟让队伍里的每个人都安静下来。

major.example: The major cause of the accident was the icy road near the bridge.
major.zh: 这起事故的主要原因是桥附近结冰的路面。

make.example: She likes to make bread for the family every Sunday morning.
make.zh: 她喜欢每个周日早上为家人做面包。

makeup.example: Her makeup was simple, but it made her look bright and fresh.
makeup.zh: 她的妆容很简单，却让她显得明亮清新。

male.example: The male birds have brighter colours than the female ones.
male.zh: 雄鸟的颜色比雌鸟更鲜艳。

malice.example: She spoke about her old friend without any malice or anger.
malice.zh: 她谈起老朋友时没有任何恶意或怒气。

malignant.example: The doctor said the small growth was not malignant and could be removed easily.
malignant.zh: 医生说这个小肿块不是恶性的，很容易切除。

mall.example: The long mall was lined with tall trees and small stone seats.
mall.zh: 这条长长的林荫道两旁是高大的树木和小石凳。

malpractice.example: The doctor was accused of malpractice after the patient's condition got worse.
malpractice.zh: 在病人病情恶化后，这名医生被指控医疗失当。

mammal.example: The whale is a mammal that lives in the sea but breathes air.
mammal.zh: 鲸鱼是一种生活在海里但呼吸空气的哺乳动物。

man.example: The old man sat by the river and fed the birds every day.
man.zh: 那位老人每天坐在河边喂鸟。

manage.example: She manages a small shop with five workers and two delivery vans.
manage.zh: 她经营一家小店，有五名员工和两辆送货车。

mandate.example: The council gave the team a mandate to finish the project by June.
mandate.zh: 委员会授权该团队在六月前完成这个项目。

maneuver.example: The driver had to maneuver carefully to park the car in the narrow space.
maneuver.zh: 司机不得不小心操作，才把车停进狭窄的空位。

manifest.example: His love for music was manifest in the way he played the piano.
manifest.zh: 他对音乐的热爱在他弹钢琴的方式中显而易见。

manipulate.example: He tried to manipulate the numbers to make the report look better.
manipulate.zh: 他试图操纵数据，让报告看起来更好。

mankind.example: For centuries, mankind has looked at the stars and asked questions.
mankind.zh: 几个世纪以来，人类一直仰望星空并提出问题。

manner.example: He answered every question in a calm and polite manner.
manner.zh: 他以平静而礼貌的方式回答了每个问题。

mansion.example: The old mansion at the end of the street has a large garden.
mansion.zh: 街尽头那座老宅邸有一个大花园。

manual.example: Read the manual carefully before you use the new washing machine.
manual.zh: 使用新洗衣机前请仔细阅读说明书。

manufacture.example: The factory manufactures parts for bicycles and sells them to shops.
manufacture.zh: 这家工厂生产自行车零件，并把它们卖给商店。

manuscript.example: The writer sent his manuscript to three publishers before one accepted it.
manuscript.zh: 这位作家把手稿寄给了三家出版社，才有一家接受。

many.example: Many of the students walk to school instead of taking the bus.
many.zh: 许多学生步行上学，而不坐公交车。

map.example: He opened the map and found a shorter way to the station.
map.zh: 他打开地图，找到了一条去车站的更短的路。

mar.example: A few dark clouds marred the beautiful view from the hotel window.
mar.zh: 几朵乌云破坏了从酒店窗户看到的美丽景色。

marathon.example: He ran his first marathon last year and finished in four hours.
marathon.zh: 他去年跑了第一次马拉松，四小时完赛。

marble.example: The steps of the old building are made of smooth white marble.
marble.zh: 这座老建筑的台阶是用光滑的白色大理石做的。

March.example: The weather usually gets warmer in March and the flowers start to open.
March.zh: 天气通常在三月变暖，花儿开始开放。

margin.example: Write your notes in the margin next to the printed text.
margin.zh: 把笔记写在印刷文字旁边的空白处。

marine.example: Scientists study marine life in the deep water near the coast.
marine.zh: 科学家研究海岸附近深水中的海洋生物。

maritime.example: This old town has a long maritime history of fishing and trade.
maritime.zh: 这座古镇有着悠久的渔业与贸易海运历史。

mark.example: Please mark the correct answer with a small circle on the paper.
mark.zh: 请在纸上用一个小圆圈标出正确答案。

market.example: The farmers sell fresh vegetables at the market every Saturday morning.
market.zh: 农民们每周六早上在市场卖新鲜蔬菜。

marry.example: They plan to marry next spring and move into a small house.
marry.zh: 他们打算明年春天结婚，然后搬进一栋小房子。

marsh.example: Many birds build their nests in the marsh near the river.
marsh.zh: 许多鸟在河边的沼泽里筑巢。

marshal.example: A guide helped marshal the visitors into a straight line.
marshal.zh: 一位向导帮着把参观者排成一条直线。

martyr.example: The story of the martyr has been told by local people for years.
martyr.zh: 这个烈士的故事被当地人讲述了很多年。

marvel.example: Visitors often marvel at the clear water of the mountain lake.
marvel.zh: 游客常常惊叹于山间湖水的清澈。

Marxism.example: Marxism is studied by many students in universities around the world.
Marxism.zh: 世界上许多大学的学生都在学习马克思主义。

masculine.example: The room was decorated in dark colours and had a masculine feel.
masculine.zh: 房间用深色装饰，有一种阳刚的感觉。

mask.example: The doctor put on a mask before entering the patient's room.
mask.zh: 医生在进入病人房间前戴上了口罩。

mass.example: A huge mass of warm air brought heavy rain to the coast.
mass.zh: 一大团暖空气给沿海地区带来了大雨。

massacre.example: The museum shows old photographs of the massacre that happened here.
massacre.zh: 博物馆展出了当年发生在这里的那场屠杀的旧照片。

massage.example: After the long walk, she gave her tired feet a gentle massage.
massage.zh: 长途步行后，她给疲惫的双脚做了一次轻柔的按摩。

master.example: It takes years of practice to master a musical instrument.
master.zh: 掌握一种乐器需要多年的练习。

masterpiece.example: The painting is considered a masterpiece of colour and light.
masterpiece.zh: 这幅画被认为是色彩与光线的杰作。

mat.example: Please wipe your shoes on the mat before you come inside.
mat.zh: 进来之前请在垫子上擦一下鞋。

match.example: Our team won the match by two goals in the last minute.
match.zh: 我们队在最后一分钟以两球的优势赢得了比赛。

mate.example: He and his mate fixed the old boat together over the summer.
mate.zh: 他和伙伴整个夏天一起修那艘旧船。

material.example: This soft material is good for making shirts and light summer dresses.
material.zh: 这种柔软的布料适合做衬衫和轻便的夏装。

maternal.example: Her maternal grandmother taught her how to cook and sew.
maternal.zh: 她的外祖母教她做饭和缝纫。

math.example: He finds math easy because he practises a little every day.
math.zh: 他觉得数学容易，因为他每天练习一点。

matter.example: It does not matter if you arrive a few minutes late.

mature.example: The young trees will mature in about ten years and give good shade.
mature.zh: 这些小树大约十年后就会长成，并提供良好的树荫。

maximum.example: The maximum number of people in the small hall is fifty.
maximum.zh: 这个小厅最多能容纳五十人。

may.example: You may borrow my book if you return it tomorrow.
may.zh: 如果你明天还回来，你可以借我的书。

maybe.example: Maybe we should take an umbrella in case it rains later.
maybe.zh: 也许我们该带把伞，以防稍后下雨。

mayor.example: The mayor opened the new library and spoke to the children.
mayor.zh: 市长为新图书馆揭幕，并对孩子们讲话。

me.example: My friend asked me to help him carry the heavy boxes upstairs.
me.zh: 我朋友让我帮他把那些重箱子搬上楼。

meadow.example: The cows were eating grass in the green meadow beside the river.
meadow.zh: 牛在河边绿色的草地上吃草。

meal.example: We had a simple meal of soup and bread after the long walk.
meal.zh: 长途步行后，我们吃了一顿有汤和面包的简单饭菜。

mean.example: I do not know what this sign means on the map.
mean.zh: 我不知道地图上这个标记是什么意思。

meaning.example: I looked up the meaning of the new word in my dictionary.
meaning.zh: 我在字典里查了这个生词的意思。

means.example: The bicycle is a cheap means of transport in this small town.
means.zh: 在这个小镇上，自行车是一种便宜的交通工具。

meantime.example: Dinner will be ready in an hour; in the meantime, we can walk.
meantime.zh: 晚饭一小时后就好；在此期间，我们可以去散散步。

meanwhile.example: She cleaned the kitchen; meanwhile, he fixed the broken chair.
meanwhile.zh: 她打扫厨房，与此同时，他修那把坏椅子。

measure.example: Please measure the window before you buy the new curtains.
measure.zh: 买新窗帘前请先量一下窗户。

meat.example: The soup tastes better with a little meat and fresh vegetables.
meat.zh: 汤里加一点肉和新鲜蔬菜味道更好。

mechanic.example: The mechanic found a small leak in the pipe under the car.
mechanic.zh: 技工发现车底下的管子上有个小漏洞。

mechanize.example: The farm began to mechanize its work and bought two new machines.
mechanize.zh: 农场开始使作业机械化，买了两台新机器。

medal.example: She won a gold medal for running the fastest in the race.
medal.zh: 她在比赛中跑得最快，赢得了一枚金牌。

mediate.example: A friend tried to mediate between the two neighbours and settle the quarrel.
mediate.zh: 一位朋友试图在两位邻居之间调解，平息这场争吵。

medical.example: He needs medical help, so please call a doctor right away.
medical.zh: 他需要医疗帮助，请马上叫医生。

Medicare.example: Medicare helps older people pay for some of their medical costs.
Medicare.zh: 联邦医疗保险帮助老年人支付部分医疗费用。

medication.example: The doctor told him to take the medication twice a day after meals.
medication.zh: 医生让他每天饭后服两次药。

medicine.example: This medicine tastes bitter, but it will help your cough.
medicine.zh: 这药很苦，但对你的咳嗽有帮助。

medieval.example: The town still has a medieval wall and several old stone gates.
medieval.zh: 这座小镇仍有中世纪的城墙和几座古老的石门。

medium.example: He is of medium height and has short dark hair.
medium.zh: 他中等身高，留着深色短发。

meet.example: Let us meet at the cafe near the station at five.
meet.zh: 我们五点在车站附近的咖啡馆见面吧。

meeting.example: The meeting will start at nine and last about an hour.
meeting.zh: 会议九点开始，大约持续一个小时。

melody.example: She played a simple melody on the piano and everyone listened.
melody.zh: 她在钢琴上弹了一支简单的曲子，大家都在听。

melon.example: We cut a sweet melon and shared it after dinner.
melon.zh: 我们切开一个甜瓜，晚饭后一起分享。

melt.example: The snow began to melt as soon as the sun came out.
melt.zh: 太阳一出来，雪就开始融化。

member.example: Every member of the team must wear the same blue shirt.
member.zh: 队里的每个成员都必须穿同样的蓝衬衫。

memorandum.example: The manager wrote a short memorandum about the new office rules.
memorandum.zh: 经理写了一份关于办公室新规定的简短备忘录。

memorial.example: The small park was built as a memorial to the local doctor.
memorial.zh: 这个小公园是为纪念当地那位医生而建的。

memory.example: My memory of that summer is still clear after many years.
memory.zh: 许多年后，我对那个夏天的记忆仍然清晰。

menace.example: The broken tree was a menace to people walking on the path.
menace.zh: 那棵断树对在小路上行走的人来说是个威胁。

mend.example: He mended the old wooden chair with a few nails and glue.
mend.zh: 他用几颗钉子和胶水修好了那把旧木椅。

mental.example: Reading a little every day is good exercise for your mental health.
mental.zh: 每天读一点书对你的心理健康是很好的锻炼。

mention.example: She mentioned that the shop would close early that afternoon.
mention.zh: 她提到那家店那天下午会提前关门。

mentor.example: A good mentor helps you see your own strengths and weaknesses.
mentor.zh: 好的导师能帮你看清自己的长处和短处。

menu.example: The waiter handed us the menu and waited quietly by the table.
menu.zh: 服务员把菜单递给我们，然后安静地站在桌边等候。

merchandise.example: The shop sells sports merchandise and outdoor clothing at low prices.
merchandise.zh: 这家店以低价出售体育用品和户外服装。

merchant.example: The merchant sold cloth and spices in the busy town market.
merchant.zh: 那位商人在热闹的镇集市上卖布和香料。

mercury.example: The old thermometer broke, and the silver mercury ran across the floor.
mercury.zh: 旧温度计碎了，银色的水银流到了地板上。

mercy.example: The kind woman showed mercy to the thin stray cat.
mercy.zh: 那位好心的妇人对那只瘦弱的流浪猫心怀怜悯。

mere.example: The mere thought of the long exam made him feel nervous.
mere.zh: 仅仅是想到那场漫长的考试，他就感到紧张。

merge.example: The two small companies merged into one larger company last year.
merge.zh: 去年那两家小公司合并成了一家更大的公司。

merit.example: Your plan has some merit, but it still needs more work.
merit.zh: 你的计划有些可取之处，但还需要进一步完善。

merry.example: The children were merry and laughed together all afternoon.
merry.zh: 孩子们很快乐，整个下午都在一起笑。

mess.example: The kitchen was a terrible mess after the party ended.
mess.zh: 聚会结束后，厨房乱得一塌糊涂。

message.example: She left a short message on his phone this morning.
message.zh: 她今天早上在他手机上留了一条简短的消息。

metabolism.example: Regular exercise and enough sleep can improve your metabolism.
metabolism.zh: 规律运动和充足睡眠可以改善你的新陈代谢。

metal.example: The box is made of thin metal and feels quite light.
metal.zh: 这个盒子是用薄金属做的，感觉很轻。

metaphor.example: The poem uses a metaphor to compare life to a long journey.
metaphor.zh: 这首诗用隐喻把人生比作一段漫长的旅程。

meter.example: The room is about four meters long and three meters wide.
meter.zh: 这个房间大约四米长、三米宽。

method.example: This method of cooking rice keeps every grain separate and soft.
method.zh: 这种煮米饭的方法能让每粒米都分开又松软。

meticulous.example: She kept meticulous notes of every test she ran in the lab.
meticulous.zh: 她一丝不苟地记录了在实验室做的每一项测试。

metro.example: He takes the metro to work every morning at eight.
metro.zh: 他每天早上八点坐地铁去上班。

metropolitan.example: The metropolitan area has grown quickly over the past ten years.
metropolitan.zh: 过去十年里，这个大都市区发展得很快。

microphone.example: Please speak into the microphone so everyone in the room can hear.
microphone.zh: 请对着麦克风说话，好让房间里的每个人都能听见。

microscope.example: Under the microscope, the leaf showed hundreds of tiny holes.
microscope.zh: 在显微镜下，这片叶子显示出许多细小的孔。

microwave.example: He heated his lunch in the microwave for two minutes.
microwave.zh: 他用微波炉把午饭热了两分钟。

midday.example: The sun was hottest at midday, so we stayed inside.
midday.zh: 中午阳光最强，所以我们待在屋里。

middle.example: There is a small round table in the middle of the room.
middle.zh: 房间中央有一张小圆桌。

middle-class.example: The film describes the daily life of an ordinary middle-class family.
middle-class.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个普通中产阶级家庭的日常生活。

midnight.example: The last train arrived just before midnight, and we walked home.
midnight.zh: 末班火车在午夜前到达，我们走回了家。

midst.example: In the midst of the storm, all the lights went out.
midst.zh: 暴风雨正猛的时候，所有的灯都灭了。

midwife.example: The midwife stayed with the young mother through the whole night.
midwife.zh: 助产士陪那位年轻的母亲度过了整夜。

might.example: She might come to the meeting if she finishes her work early.
might.zh: 如果她提早做完工作，可能会来参加会议。

migrate.example: Many birds migrate south when the weather turns cold.
migrate.zh: 天气转冷时，许多鸟会向南方迁徙。

mild.example: The winter here is mild, with very little snow.
mild.zh: 这里的冬天很温和，几乎不下雪。

mile.example: The nearest shop is about a mile from our house.
mile.zh: 最近的商店离我们家大约一英里。

milestone.example: Passing that exam was an important milestone in her studies.
milestone.zh: 通过那场考试是她学业上的一个重要里程碑。

militant.example: His militant attitude made it hard for the group to agree.
militant.zh: 他好斗的态度让小组很难达成一致。

military.example: He collects old military maps as a quiet weekend hobby.
military.zh: 他把收集旧军用地图当作安静的周末爱好。

militia.example: The village once formed a small militia to protect the fields.
militia.zh: 这个村子曾组建一支小型民兵组织来保护田地。

milk.example: He poured a glass of milk and sat by the window.
milk.zh: 他倒了一杯牛奶，坐在窗边。

mill.example: The old mill by the river still grinds grain for local farmers.
mill.zh: 河边的老磨坊仍在为当地农民磨谷物。

millimeter.example: The thin line on the paper is only one millimeter wide.
millimeter.zh: 纸上那条细线只有一毫米宽。

million.example: More than a million people visit the park every summer.
million.zh: 每年夏天有超过一百万人参观这个公园。

mind.example: I do not mind waiting if you need a few more minutes.
mind.zh: 如果你还需要几分钟，我不介意等。

mindset.example: A positive mindset helps you deal with small problems calmly.
mindset.zh: 积极的心态能帮你平静地应对小问题。

mine.example: The old mine was closed because it was no longer safe.
mine.zh: 那座老矿因为不再安全而关闭了。

mineral.example: This spring water is rich in minerals from the nearby hills.
mineral.zh: 这种泉水富含来自附近山丘的矿物质。

mingle.example: The guests mingled in the garden and talked about the music.
mingle.zh: 客人们在花园里相互交谈，谈论着音乐。

miniature.example: He built a miniature garden inside a small wooden box.
miniature.zh: 他在一只小木盒里做了一个微缩花园。

minimum.example: We need a minimum of five people to start the game.
minimum.zh: 我们至少需要五个人才能开始游戏。

minister.example: The new minister answered questions about the city's public transport.
minister.zh: 新部长回答了关于城市公共交通的问题。

minor.example: The plan needs a few minor changes before we start the work.
minor.zh: 在开始工作之前，这个计划还需要几处小改动。

mint.example: She picked fresh mint from the garden to make her tea.
mint.zh: 她从花园里摘了新鲜薄荷来泡茶。

minus.example: Ten minus four is six, as everyone in the class knows.
minus.zh: 十减四等于六，这是班上每个人都知道的。

minute.example: Please wait a minute while I find the right key.
minute.zh: 请等一分钟，我找一下合适的钥匙。

miracle.example: It would be a miracle if we finished all this work today.
miracle.zh: 如果我们今天能完成所有工作，那真是个奇迹。

mirror.example: She looked in the mirror and fixed her hair quickly.
mirror.zh: 她照了照镜子，很快把头发整理好。

miserable.example: He felt miserable after losing the game he had practiced for.
miserable.zh: 输掉那场他一直练习的比赛后，他感到很痛苦。

misfortune.example: The family had a misfortune when their car broke down far away.
misfortune.zh: 他们的车在很远的地方抛锚，家里遭了件不幸的事。

mislead.example: The advertisement may mislead people about the quality of the product.
mislead.zh: 这则广告可能会在产品质量上误导人们。

miss.example: I missed the last bus and had to walk home.
miss.zh: 我错过了末班公交车，只好走回家。

missile.example: The children threw paper missiles across the room during the break.
missile.zh: 课间休息时，孩子们把纸折的飞镖扔过了整个教室。

missing.example: One page is missing from the back of this old book.
missing.zh: 这本旧书的后半部分少了一页。

mission.example: Their mission was to deliver the letters before noon.
mission.zh: 他们的任务是中午之前把信送到。

missionary.example: The missionary learned the local language before he began teaching.
missionary.zh: 那位传教士在开始教书之前先学会了当地语言。

mist.example: A thin mist covered the fields early in the morning.
mist.zh: 清晨的薄雾笼罩着田野。

mistake.example: Everyone makes a mistake now and then while learning something new.
mistake.zh: 每个人学新东西时都会时不时犯个错误。

mister.example: The boy politely called the old man mister when he asked for help.
mister.zh: 那个男孩在寻求帮助时礼貌地称那位老人为先生。

mistress.example: The mistress of the house welcomed every guest at the door.
mistress.zh: 女主人站在门口迎接每一位客人。

misunderstand.example: Please do not misunderstand me; I really support your new plan.
misunderstand.zh: 请不要误解我，我真的很支持你的新计划。

mix.example: Mix the flour and the sugar in a large bowl.
mix.zh: 把面粉和糖放进一个大碗里搅拌均匀。

moan.example: She moaned about the noise from the building site all week.
moan.zh: 她整周都在抱怨工地传来的噪音。

mobile.example: The hospital sends a mobile team to visit nearby villages.
mobile.zh: 医院派出一支流动队伍去邻近的村庄。

mobilize.example: The teacher managed to mobilize the whole class for the clean-up.
mobilize.zh: 老师成功动员全班同学参加清扫活动。

mock.example: Do not mock other people's mistakes; it only makes them feel worse.
mock.zh: 不要嘲笑别人的错误，那只会让他们更难受。

mode.example: Please switch your phone to silent mode during the film.
mode.zh: 看电影时请把手机调到静音模式。

model.example: They built a small model of the bridge out of wood.
model.zh: 他们用木头做了一座小桥的模型。

moderate.example: He does moderate exercise three times a week after work.
moderate.zh: 他每周下班后做三次适度的运动。

modern.example: The new library is a fine example of modern design.
modern.zh: 新图书馆是现代设计的优秀范例。

modest.example: He is modest about his success and rarely talks about it.
modest.zh: 他对自己的成功很谦虚，很少谈起。

modify.example: We had to modify the plan after the weather changed.
modify.zh: 天气变化后，我们不得不修改计划。

moist.example: The cake stays moist if you keep it in a closed box.
moist.zh: 如果把蛋糕放在密封的盒子里，它会保持湿润。

mold.example: She poured the hot liquid into a mold and let it cool.
mold.zh: 她把热液体倒进模子里，让它冷却。

molecule.example: A water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
molecule.zh: 一个水分子包含两个氢原子和一个氧原子。

mom.example: My mom makes the best soup in the whole world.
mom.zh: 我妈妈做的汤是世界上最好喝的。

moment.example: For a moment nobody spoke, and then everyone began to laugh.
moment.zh: 有一瞬间谁也没说话，随后大家都笑了起来。

momentum.example: The project gained momentum after its first small success.
momentum.zh: 这个项目在取得第一次小成功后势头更足了。

monarchy.example: In a monarchy, the head of state is a king or queen.
monarchy.zh: 在君主政体下，国家元首是国王或女王。

Monday.example: We will meet again on Monday to talk about the results.
Monday.zh: 我们星期一再见，讨论一下结果。

money.example: She saved enough money to buy a new laptop last month.
money.zh: 她攒够了钱，上个月买了一台新笔记本电脑。

monitor.example: The nurse monitored his heart rate through the whole night.
monitor.zh: 护士整夜监测他的心率。

monkey.example: The monkey took the fruit and climbed quickly up the tree.
monkey.zh: 猴子拿了水果，迅速爬上了树。

monopoly.example: The company had a monopoly on the local bus service.
monopoly.zh: 这家公司垄断了当地的公交服务。

monotony.example: He changed jobs because the monotony of the work bored him.
monotony.zh: 他换了工作，因为那份工作的单调让他厌烦。

monster.example: The story is about a friendly monster who lives in a cave.
monster.zh: 这个故事讲的是一个住在山洞里的友善怪物。

month.example: We plan to move to the new office next month.
month.zh: 我们打算下个月搬到新办公室。

monument.example: They built a monument to remember the people who helped the town.
monument.zh: 他们建了一座纪念碑，以纪念那些帮助过这座小镇的人。
