mood.example: She was in a good mood after hearing the news.
mood.zh: 听到那个消息后，她心情很好。

moon.example: The moon was bright and the sky was full of stars.
moon.zh: 月亮很亮，天空布满了星星。

mop.example: She used a mop to clean the kitchen floor after dinner.
mop.zh: 晚饭后她用拖把擦了厨房的地板。

moral.example: The story has a clear moral about honesty and hard work.
moral.zh: 这个故事有一个关于诚实和勤奋的明确寓意。

morale.example: The team's morale improved after they won two games in a row.
morale.zh: 连赢两场比赛后，队伍的士气提高了。

more.example: We need more time to finish this task properly.
more.zh: 我们需要更多时间才能把这项任务做好。

moreover.example: The room was small; moreover, it was far from the station.
moreover.zh: 这个房间很小，而且离车站很远。

morning.example: I go for a short walk every morning before breakfast.
morning.zh: 我每天早上吃早饭前都会去散一会儿步。

mortal.example: Every mortal must accept that life is short and uncertain.
mortal.zh: 每个凡人都必须接受生命短暂而无常这一事实。

mortgage.example: They took out a mortgage to buy their first small house.
mortgage.zh: 他们办了抵押贷款，买下了他们的第一所小房子。

mosquito.example: A mosquito kept me awake for most of the night.
mosquito.zh: 一只蚊子让我大半夜都没睡着。

most.example: Most of the students finished the exercise before lunch.
most.zh: 大多数学生在午饭前完成了练习。

motel.example: We stayed in a small motel beside the road for one night.
motel.zh: 我们在路边的一家小汽车旅馆住了一晚。

mother.example: My mother taught me how to cook simple meals at home.
mother.zh: 我母亲教我在家做简单的饭菜。

motion.example: She made a small motion with her hand to ask for quiet.
motion.zh: 她用手做了个小动作，示意大家安静。

motivate.example: Good teachers motivate students to ask their own questions.
motivate.zh: 好的老师会激励学生提出自己的问题。

motive.example: No one understood his motive for giving away all those books.
motive.zh: 没人明白他把那些书全都送人的动机。

motor.example: The small motor makes very little noise when it is running.
motor.zh: 这个小马达运转时几乎不发出声音。

motorway.example: Traffic on the motorway was slow because of the heavy rain.
motorway.zh: 由于大雨，高速公路上的车流很慢。

mount.example: The pressure on the team began to mount as the deadline neared.
mount.zh: 随着截止日期临近，队伍承受的压力开始增加。

mountain.example: We walked up the mountain and enjoyed the wide view.
mountain.zh: 我们沿着山路爬上山，欣赏着开阔的景色。

mounting.example: The mounting of the new display took the staff several hours.
mounting.zh: 装配新展架花了员工好几个小时。

mourn.example: The whole village mourned the loss of its oldest teacher.
mourn.zh: 全村人都为失去最年长的老师而哀悼。

mouse.example: A small mouse ran across the kitchen floor and hid.
mouse.zh: 一只小老鼠跑过厨房地板，躲了起来。

mouth.example: He opened his mouth to say something but then stopped.
mouth.zh: 他张开嘴想说点什么，却又停住了。

move.example: They decided to move to a smaller flat near the park.
move.zh: 他们决定搬到公园附近一间更小的公寓。

movie.example: We watched a funny movie together on Friday night.
movie.zh: 星期五晚上我们一起看了一部有趣的电影。

mow.example: He has to mow the lawn every weekend in summer.
mow.zh: 夏天他每个周末都得修剪草坪。

much.example: There is not much sugar left in the glass jar.

mud.example: His shoes were covered with mud after the long walk.
mud.zh: 走了很长的路之后，他的鞋上沾满了泥。

mug.example: He poured hot coffee into a large mug and sat down.
mug.zh: 他把热咖啡倒进一个大杯子里，然后坐了下来。

mule.example: The mule carried two heavy bags up the narrow path.
mule.zh: 那头骡子驮着两个沉甸甸的袋子走上狭窄的小路。

multilateral.example: The school joined a multilateral exchange program with three other schools.
multilateral.zh: 这所学校加入了与另外三所学校合作的多边交流项目。

multiple.example: The test has multiple choice questions at the end of each part.
multiple.zh: 这个测试在每个部分末尾都有多项选择题。

multitude.example: A multitude of small details made the plan hard to follow.
multitude.zh: 众多细小的细节让这个计划难以理解。

municipal.example: The municipal library opens at nine every morning except Sunday.
municipal.zh: 市立图书馆每天早上九点开门，星期天除外。

murder.example: The new detective novel begins with a murder in an old house.
murder.zh: 这本新侦探小说以一座老房子里的一桩谋杀案开头。

murmur.example: She murmured a few words of comfort to the crying child.
murmur.zh: 她对哭泣的孩子低声说了几句安慰的话。

muscle.example: He stretched his leg muscles before the long run.
muscle.zh: 长跑之前他拉伸了腿部肌肉。

museum.example: The museum displays old tools used by local farmers.
museum.zh: 这家博物馆展出当地农民用过的旧工具。

mushroom.example: She added fresh mushrooms to the soup and stirred it slowly.
mushroom.zh: 她把新鲜蘑菇加进汤里，慢慢地搅拌。

music.example: Soft music was playing in the background during dinner.
music.zh: 晚饭时背景里放着轻柔的音乐。

must.example: You must show your ticket before you enter the hall.
must.zh: 进大厅之前你必须出示门票。

mute.example: He stayed mute during the whole meeting and said nothing.
mute.zh: 整个会议期间他一直沉默，什么也没说。

mutter.example: He muttered something under his breath and walked away.
mutter.zh: 他低声嘟囔了些什么，然后走开了。

mutual.example: Their friendship is based on mutual trust and honest talk.
mutual.zh: 他们的友谊建立在相互信任和坦诚交流之上。

my.example: My brother taught me how to ride a bike last summer.
my.zh: 去年夏天我哥哥教我学会了骑自行车。

myself.example: I finished the whole project by myself last night.
myself.zh: 昨晚我一个人完成了整个项目。

mystery.example: The mystery of the missing keys was never solved.
mystery.zh: 钥匙不见了这件事始终是个谜。

myth.example: It is a myth that you can learn a language in a week.
myth.zh: 所谓一周就能学会一门语言，只是一种虚构的说法。

nail.example: He used a hammer to drive the nail into the wall.
nail.zh: 他用锤子把钉子钉进墙里。

naive.example: It was naive of him to trust a stranger with his money.
naive.zh: 他把钱托付给一个陌生人，真是太天真了。

naked.example: The room looked naked without any furniture or pictures on the walls.
naked.zh: 那个房间没有家具，墙上也没有画，显得空荡荡的。

name.example: Please write your name and address at the top of the page.
name.zh: 请把你的姓名和地址写在这一页的顶部。

namely.example: Only one student passed the exam, namely the girl in the back row.
namely.zh: 只有一个学生通过了考试，即后排那个女孩。

nap.example: He takes a short nap every afternoon after lunch.
nap.zh: 他每天午饭后都会小睡一会儿。

napkin.example: She folded the cloth napkin and placed it beside the plate.
napkin.zh: 她把布餐巾折好，放在盘子旁边。

narrate.example: The old man began to narrate the story of his childhood.
narrate.zh: 老人开始讲述他童年的故事。

narrow.example: The narrow street was too small for two cars to pass.
narrow.zh: 这条狭窄的街道太窄了，两辆车无法通过。

nasty.example: There was a nasty smell coming from the old fridge.
nasty.zh: 旧冰箱里散发出一股难闻的气味。

nation.example: The whole nation watched the match on television last night.
nation.zh: 昨晚全国的人都在电视上观看那场比赛。

nationwide.example: The company plans to open new stores nationwide next year.
nationwide.zh: 这家公司计划明年在全国开设新店。

native.example: She speaks English like a native, though she grew up abroad.
native.zh: 她英语说得像本地人，尽管她是在国外长大的。

nature.example: Walking in nature helps me relax after a busy week at work.
nature.zh: 在大自然中散步能帮我在一周忙碌工作后放松。

naughty.example: The naughty child hid his sister's shoes behind the door.
naughty.zh: 那个顽皮的孩子把妹妹的鞋藏在了门后。

navigate.example: The captain had to navigate the boat through the narrow channel.
navigate.zh: 船长必须驾驶小船穿过那条狭窄的航道。

navy.example: My uncle served in the navy for many years before he retired.
navy.zh: 我叔叔在海军服役多年后才退休。

near.example: There is a small park near our house where children play.
near.zh: 我们家附近有一个小公园，孩子们在那里玩耍。

nearby.example: We found a nearby cafe and stopped for a quick lunch.
nearby.zh: 我们找到了附近的一家咖啡馆，停下来匆匆吃了午饭。

neat.example: His desk is always neat, with every paper in its place.
neat.zh: 他的书桌总是很整洁，每张纸都在该在的位置。

necessary.example: It is necessary to bring your passport when you travel abroad.
necessary.zh: 出国旅行时有必要带上护照。

necessity.example: Clean water is a basic necessity that many people still lack.
necessity.zh: 干净的水是许多人仍然缺乏的基本必需品。

neck.example: She wore a red scarf around her neck on the cold morning.
neck.zh: 那个寒冷的早晨，她脖子上围着一条红围巾。

necklace.example: He gave his mother a silver necklace for her birthday.
necklace.zh: 他送给妈妈一条银项链作为生日礼物。

need.example: We need more chairs for the guests who are coming tonight.
need.zh: 今晚有客人来，我们需要更多椅子。

needle.example: She threaded the needle carefully before mending the torn shirt.
needle.zh: 她小心地把线穿过针眼，然后修补那件破了的衬衫。

negate.example: A single careless mistake can negate all the work we did.
negate.zh: 一个粗心的错误就能抵消我们做的所有工作。

neglect.example: He was so busy that he began to neglect his own health.
neglect.zh: 他太忙了，开始忽视自己的健康。

negligent.example: The company was negligent about keeping the kitchen clean.
negligent.zh: 这家公司对保持厨房清洁疏于管理。

negligible.example: The difference between the two prices is negligible, so buy either.
negligible.zh: 两种价格之间的差别可以忽略，所以买哪个都行。

negotiate.example: Both sides met again to negotiate a better price for the goods.
negotiate.zh: 双方再次会面，为这批货物商谈一个更好的价格。

neighbor.example: Our neighbor often brings us fresh vegetables from her garden.
neighbor.zh: 我们的邻居常从她的菜园里给我们带新鲜蔬菜。

neither.example: Neither of the two answers was correct, so she tried again.
neither.zh: 两个答案都不正确，于是她又试了一次。

nephew.example: My nephew loves to draw animals and show them to everyone.
nephew.zh: 我侄子喜欢画动物，还喜欢拿给大家看。

nerve.example: It took a lot of nerve to speak in front of everyone.
nerve.zh: 在众人面前讲话需要很大的勇气。

nest.example: The birds built a small nest in the tree outside my window.
nest.zh: 鸟儿在我窗外的树上筑了一个小巢。

net.example: The fishermen pulled the heavy net out of the water.
net.zh: 渔民们把沉重的网从水里拉了出来。

network.example: The office network was slow because too many people were online.
network.zh: 办公室网络很慢，因为上网的人太多了。

neutral.example: He stayed neutral and refused to take either side in the argument.
neutral.zh: 他保持中立，拒绝在争论中支持任何一方。

never.example: I have never seen such a beautiful sunset in my whole life.
never.zh: 我这辈子从没见过这么美的日落。

nevertheless.example: The road was long and steep; nevertheless, we reached the top.
nevertheless.zh: 路又长又陡，尽管如此，我们还是到达了山顶。

new.example: She bought a new computer because her old one stopped working.
new.zh: 她买了一台新电脑，因为旧的那台不工作了。

news.example: The good news is that your test results are completely normal.
news.zh: 好消息是你的检查结果完全正常。

newspaper.example: My father reads the newspaper every morning before he leaves home.
newspaper.zh: 我父亲每天早上出门前都会看报纸。

next.example: The next train to the airport leaves in twenty minutes.
next.zh: 去机场的下一班火车二十分钟后开。

nice.example: It was a nice day, so we walked along the river.
nice.zh: 那天天气很好，所以我们沿着河边散步。

nickel.example: He put a nickel into the machine and waited for the candy.
nickel.zh: 他把一枚五分镍币放进机器，等着糖果出来。

nickname.example: Everyone at school calls him by his nickname, not his real name.
nickname.zh: 学校里的每个人都叫他的绰号，而不是他的真名。

niece.example: My niece is learning to play the piano this year.
niece.zh: 我侄女今年在学弹钢琴。

night.example: The stars were bright in the sky on that clear night.
night.zh: 那个晴朗的夜晚，天上的星星很亮。

nightmare.example: I had a terrible nightmare and woke up feeling very afraid.
nightmare.zh: 我做了一个可怕的噩梦，醒来时非常害怕。

nil.example: Our profits were nil after a very difficult year.
nil.zh: 经历了艰难的一年，我们的利润为零。

nine.example: There are nine small chairs around the wooden table.
nine.zh: 木桌周围有九把小椅子。

nineteen.example: She was nineteen when she moved to the city alone.
nineteen.zh: 她独自搬到这座城市时十九岁。

ninety.example: He scored ninety points on the final math test.
ninety.zh: 他在期末数学考试中考了九十分。

ninth.example: Our office is on the ninth floor of that tall building.
ninth.zh: 我们的办公室在那栋高楼的第九层。

nitrogen.example: Plants need nitrogen from the soil to grow strong and green.
nitrogen.zh: 植物需要从土壤中吸收氮才能长得健壮翠绿。

no.example: There is no milk left in the fridge, so we need more.
no.zh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了，所以我们需要再买一些。

noble.example: Helping others without reward is a noble thing to do.
noble.zh: 不求回报地帮助别人是一件高尚的事。

nobody.example: Nobody knew the answer, so the teacher explained it again.
nobody.zh: 没有人知道答案，于是老师又解释了一遍。

nod.example: She gave a small nod to show that she understood.
nod.zh: 她轻轻点了点头，表示她明白了。

noise.example: The noise from the street kept me awake all night.
noise.zh: 街上的噪音让我整夜没睡着。

nominal.example: He is the nominal head of the team, but others decide.
nominal.zh: 他是这个小组名义上的负责人，但做决定的是别人。

nominate.example: The class will nominate two students to represent them at the meeting.
nominate.zh: 全班将提名两名学生代表他们参加会议。

none.example: None of the shops were open when we arrived that morning.
none.zh: 我们那天早上到的时候，没有一家商店开门。

nonetheless.example: The plan was risky; nonetheless, they decided to try it.
nonetheless.zh: 这个计划有风险，尽管如此，他们还是决定试一试。

nonsense.example: Stop talking nonsense and tell me what really happened.
nonsense.zh: 别胡说八道了，告诉我到底发生了什么。

noodle.example: She added fresh vegetables to the noodle soup and stirred.
noodle.zh: 她往面条汤里加了新鲜蔬菜，然后搅了搅。

noon.example: The shop closes at noon and opens again at two.
noon.zh: 这家店中午关门，两点再开。

nor.example: He could not find his keys, nor could he find his phone.
nor.zh: 他找不到钥匙，也找不到手机。

norm.example: Working from home has become the norm for many people.
norm.zh: 在家工作已成为许多人的常态。

normal.example: It is normal to feel tired after such a long journey.
normal.zh: 经过这么长的旅程后感到疲倦是正常的。

north.example: The birds fly north when the warm weather finally arrives.
north.zh: 天气终于变暖时，鸟儿就向北飞去。

northeast.example: The wind blew from the northeast and brought cold air.
northeast.zh: 风从东北方吹来，带来了冷空气。

northwest.example: They drove northwest through the hills to reach the lake.
northwest.zh: 他们向西北穿过丘陵，到达那个湖。

nose.example: The cold air made my nose red and my eyes water.
nose.zh: 冷空气让我的鼻子发红，眼睛也流眼泪。

not.example: She did not finish her homework because she felt unwell.
not.zh: 她没有完成作业，因为她感觉不舒服。

note.example: He left a short note on the table before going out.
note.zh: 他出门前在桌上留了一张便条。

notebook.example: I always carry a small notebook to write down new words.
notebook.zh: 我总是随身带一个小笔记本，用来记下新单词。

noteworthy.example: Her improvement in maths this term is really noteworthy.
noteworthy.zh: 她这学期数学的进步确实值得注意。

nothing.example: There was nothing in the box except a few old papers.
nothing.zh: 盒子里除了几张旧纸什么都没有。

notice.example: I did not notice the small sign on the door.
notice.zh: 我没有注意到门上的那个小标牌。

notify.example: Please notify the office if your address changes this year.
notify.zh: 如果你今年地址有变，请通知办公室。

notion.example: He has no notion of how much work this project needs.
notion.zh: 他完全不知道这个项目需要多少工作。

notorious.example: That old road is notorious for its sharp turns and fog.
notorious.zh: 那条老路因急转弯和大雾而出名。

notwithstanding.example: Notwithstanding the heavy rain, the match went on as planned.
notwithstanding.zh: 尽管下着大雨，比赛还是按计划进行了。

noun.example: A noun is a word that names a person, place or thing.
noun.zh: 名词是用来表示人、地点或事物的词。

nourish.example: Fresh fruit and vegetables nourish the body and keep it strong.
nourish.zh: 新鲜的水果和蔬菜滋养身体，让人保持强壮。

novel.example: She stayed up late reading an interesting novel about life at sea.
novel.zh: 她熬夜读一本关于海上生活的有趣小说。

novelist.example: The young novelist wrote three books before she turned thirty.
novelist.zh: 这位年轻的小说家在三十岁前写了三本书。

novelty.example: The novelty of the new game wore off after a week.
novelty.zh: 新游戏的新奇感一个星期后就消失了。

November.example: The weather turns cold here every year in November.
November.zh: 这里每年十一月天气就变冷了。

now.example: We should leave now if we want to catch the bus.
now.zh: 如果我们想赶上那班公交车，现在就该出发了。

nowadays.example: Nowadays, most people pay for things with their phones.
nowadays.zh: 如今，大多数人用手机付款。

nowhere.example: The keys were nowhere in the room, so we searched outside.
nowhere.zh: 钥匙在房间里哪儿都找不到，于是我们去外面找。

nuclear.example: The plant uses nuclear energy to produce electricity for the town.
nuclear.zh: 这座电厂利用核能为镇上发电。

nude.example: The gallery shows a famous nude painted more than a century ago.
nude.zh: 美术馆展出一幅一百多年前画的著名裸体画。

nuisance.example: The flies around the fruit were a real nuisance in summer.
nuisance.zh: 夏天水果周围的苍蝇真是讨厌。

numb.example: My fingers went numb after holding the cold metal bar.
numb.zh: 握住冰冷的金属杆之后，我的手指麻木了。

number.example: Please write your phone number clearly at the bottom of the form.
number.zh: 请把你的电话号码清楚地写在表格底部。

numerical.example: Please arrange these files in numerical order before you file them.
numerical.zh: 请按数字顺序整理这些文件，然后再归档。

numerous.example: Numerous studies show that regular walking improves heart health.
numerous.zh: 许多研究表明，经常散步对心脏健康有益。

nurse.example: The nurse checked his temperature and gave him some water.
nurse.zh: 护士给他量了体温，还给了他一些水。

nursery.example: The children spend their mornings at the nursery near the park.
nursery.zh: 孩子们上午都在公园附近的托儿所度过。

nurture.example: Good teachers nurture curiosity and help students think for themselves.
nurture.zh: 好老师培养好奇心，帮助学生独立思考。

nut.example: A small nut fell from the tree onto the path.
nut.zh: 一颗小坚果从树上掉到了小路上。

nutrition.example: Good nutrition is important for children who are still growing.
nutrition.zh: 良好的营养对仍在成长的孩子很重要。

o'clock.example: The meeting will start at nine o'clock tomorrow morning.
o'clock.zh: 会议将于明天上午九点开始。

oak.example: The old oak in the garden gives shade on hot days.
oak.zh: 花园里那棵老橡树在热天提供阴凉。

oar.example: He pulled hard on the oar to turn the small boat.
oar.zh: 他用力划桨，把小船转了个方向。

oath.example: The witness raised his hand and took an oath to tell the truth.
oath.zh: 证人举手宣誓说出真相。

obese.example: The doctor warned him that being obese could harm his heart.
obese.zh: 医生警告他，肥胖可能会损害他的心脏。

obey.example: All drivers must obey the traffic rules on this busy road.
obey.zh: 在这条繁忙的路上，所有司机都必须遵守交通规则。

object.example: He picked up a small round object from the grass.
object.zh: 他从草地上捡起一个圆圆的小物体。

objection.example: She raised an objection to the plan because it cost too much.
objection.zh: 她对那个计划提出异议，因为花费太高。

objective.example: Our main objective is to finish the report before Friday.
objective.zh: 我们的主要目标是在周五前完成报告。

oblige.example: The rules oblige every visitor to show a photo card at the gate.
oblige.zh: 规定要求每位来访者在门口出示带照片的证件。

obscene.example: The amount of money spent on the party seemed obscene to many.
obscene.zh: 在许多人看来，这场聚会花掉的钱多得离谱。

obscure.example: The meaning of the old poem is obscure to most readers.
obscure.zh: 这首古诗的含义对大多数读者来说晦涩难懂。

observatory.example: We visited the observatory on the hill and looked at stars.
observatory.zh: 我们参观了山上的天文台，还看了星星。

observe.example: Scientists observe the birds closely to learn about their habits.
observe.zh: 科学家仔细观察这些鸟，以了解它们的习性。

obsess.example: He tends to obsess over small details and forget the main point.
obsess.zh: 他容易纠结于小细节，却忘了重点。

obstacle.example: Lack of money was the biggest obstacle to finishing the project.
obstacle.zh: 缺钱是完成这个项目的最大障碍。

obstruct.example: A fallen tree began to obstruct the path through the forest.
obstruct.zh: 一棵倒下的树开始挡住穿过森林的小路。

obtain.example: You can obtain a copy of the form from the front desk.
obtain.zh: 你可以从前台领取一份表格。

obvious.example: It was obvious from her face that she had good news.
obvious.zh: 从她脸上明显看出她有好消息。

occasion.example: On this occasion, the teacher let us leave early.
occasion.zh: 这一次，老师让我们提前离开了。

occupation.example: Please write your name, age and occupation on the form.
occupation.zh: 请在表格上写下你的姓名、年龄和职业。

occupy.example: Books and papers occupy most of the space on his desk.
occupy.zh: 书和文件占据了他书桌上的大部分空间。

occur.example: These problems often occur when the software is not updated.
occur.zh: 软件没有更新时，这些问题经常发生。

ocean.example: The ocean looked calm and blue from the top of the hill.
ocean.zh: 从山顶看，海洋平静而湛蓝。

October.example: We plan to visit the old castle in October.
October.zh: 我们计划十月去参观那座古堡。

odd.example: It was odd that nobody answered the phone all morning.
odd.zh: 奇怪的是，整个上午都没人接电话。

odds.example: The odds of winning the game are small, but we will try.
odds.zh: 赢下这场比赛的可能性很小，但我们还是要试一试。

odor.example: A strong odor of fresh bread came from the kitchen.
odor.zh: 厨房里飘来一股浓烈的新面包香味。

of.example: The cover of the book was torn and needed repair.
of.zh: 这本书的封面破了，需要修补。

off.example: Please turn off the lights when you leave the room.
off.zh: 离开房间时请把灯关掉。

offend.example: I did not mean to offend you with that careless remark.
offend.zh: 我不是有意用那句无心的话冒犯你。

offer.example: They offered to help us move the heavy boxes upstairs.
offer.zh: 他们主动提出帮我们把重箱子搬到楼上。

office.example: Her office is on the second floor near the main stairs.
office.zh: 她的办公室在二楼，靠近主楼梯。

officer.example: A police officer helped the lost child find his parents.
officer.zh: 一位警官帮助走失的孩子找到了父母。

official.example: An official from the city came to check the new library.
official.zh: 市里的一位官员来检查新图书馆。

offset.example: The extra income helped offset the rising cost of food.
offset.zh: 额外的收入帮助抵消了食品价格的上涨。

offspring.example: Many animals protect their offspring until they can find food alone.
offspring.zh: 许多动物会保护自己的后代，直到它们能独自觅食。

often.example: We often walk to the market on Saturday mornings.
often.zh: 我们常在星期六早上去市场。

oil.example: Add a little oil to the pan before you cook the eggs.
oil.zh: 煎鸡蛋之前，往锅里加一点油。

okay.example: It is okay to ask for help when you feel stuck.
okay.zh: 当你感到卡住时，向别人求助是可以的。

old.example: The old house at the end of the road is empty.
old.zh: 路尽头那所老房子空着。

old-fashioned.example: My grandfather still uses an old-fashioned phone with a dial.
old-fashioned.zh: 我祖父还在用一台带拨号盘的老式电话。

olive.example: The olive tree in the yard gives us fruit every autumn.
olive.zh: 院子里的橄榄树每年秋天都给我们结出果实。

Olympic.example: She trained for years to compete in the Olympic games.
Olympic.zh: 她训练多年，参加奥运会比赛。

omit.example: You can omit the last question if you have no time.
omit.zh: 如果没有时间，你可以省略最后一道题。

on.example: The book was lying on the table next to the window.
on.zh: 那本书放在窗边的桌子上。

once.example: I have visited this small town only once in my life.
once.zh: 我这辈子只去过这个小镇一次。

one.example: She bought only one apple at the market this morning.
one.zh: 今天早上她在市场上只买了一个苹果。

oneself.example: It is important to give oneself enough time to rest.
oneself.zh: 给自己留出足够的休息时间很重要。

ongoing.example: The ongoing project will need more time and careful planning.
ongoing.zh: 这项正在进行的工程还需要更多时间和周密的计划。

onion.example: He cut the onion into small pieces before cooking the soup.
onion.zh: 煮汤之前，他把洋葱切成了小块。

online.example: She bought the tickets online and printed them at home.
online.zh: 她在网上买了票，并在家里打印出来。

only.example: This is the only copy of the book we have.
only.zh: 这是我们手头唯一的一本书。

onset.example: The onset of winter brought cold winds and heavy snow.
onset.zh: 冬天的到来带来了寒风和大雪。

onto.example: The cat jumped onto the table and knocked over a cup.
onto.zh: 猫跳上桌子，把杯子碰倒了。

onward.example: From that day onward, he walked to work every morning.
onward.zh: 从那天起，他每天早上都步行去上班。

opaque.example: The bathroom window is made of opaque glass for privacy.
opaque.zh: 浴室的窗户用不透明玻璃制成，以保护隐私。

open.example: Please open the window because the room feels too warm.
open.zh: 请把窗户打开，房间里太热了。

opera.example: We went to the opera and enjoyed the beautiful music.
opera.zh: 我们去看了歌剧，很欣赏那优美的音乐。

operate.example: This machine is easy to operate with a single button.
operate.zh: 这台机器用一个按钮就能轻松操作。

operative.example: The new rules will become operative at the start of next month.
operative.zh: 新规定将从下月初开始生效。

opinion.example: In my opinion, this plan is better than the old one.
opinion.zh: 在我看来，这个方案比旧的好。

opportunity.example: She took every opportunity to practice speaking English with visitors.
opportunity.zh: 她抓住每一个机会和来访者练习说英语。

oppose.example: Many residents oppose the plan to build a new road.
oppose.zh: 许多居民反对修建新路的计划。

opposite.example: The post office is opposite the bank on the main street.
opposite.zh: 邮局在主干道上，正对着银行。

oppress.example: The sadness in the house seemed to oppress everyone who visited.
oppress.zh: 屋里的悲伤气氛似乎压得每个来访的人都喘不过气。

opt.example: Most students opt for the morning class because it is easier.
opt.zh: 大多数学生选择上午的课，因为那更容易。

optic.example: The optic nerve carries signals from the eye to the brain.
optic.zh: 视神经把信号从眼睛传到大脑。

optimism.example: Her optimism gave the whole team hope during the difficult weeks.
optimism.zh: 在艰难的那几周里，她的乐观给了整个团队希望。

optimum.example: The optimum temperature for this plant is around twenty degrees.
optimum.zh: 这种植物最适宜的温度大约是二十度。

or.example: You can take the bus or walk to the station.
or.zh: 你可以坐公交车，也可以步行去车站。

oral.example: Students must pass a short oral exam before the course ends.
oral.zh: 课程结束前，学生必须通过一次简短的口试。

orange.example: She peeled an orange and shared it with her sister.
orange.zh: 她剥了一个橘子，和妹妹分着吃。

orbit.example: The small satellite moves in a steady orbit around the earth.
orbit.zh: 这颗小卫星沿着稳定的轨道绕地球运行。

orchestra.example: The school orchestra played three songs at the evening concert.
orchestra.zh: 学校管弦乐队在晚间的音乐会上演奏了三首曲子。

ordeal.example: Waiting for the test results was a long and tiring ordeal.
ordeal.zh: 等待考试结果是一段漫长又累人的煎熬。

order.example: Please put these books back in the correct order on the shelf.
order.zh: 请把这些书按正确的顺序放回书架上。

ordinary.example: It looked like an ordinary day until the letter arrived.
ordinary.zh: 在信送到之前，那看起来是平常的一天。

ore.example: Workers dug the ore out of the ground and loaded it.
ore.zh: 工人们把矿石从地里挖出来并装车。

organ.example: The heart is an important organ that pumps blood around the body.
organ.zh: 心脏是把血液泵送到全身的重要器官。

organic.example: This farm grows organic vegetables without using any chemicals.
organic.zh: 这个农场种植有机蔬菜，不使用任何化学药剂。

organism.example: Every living organism needs water and food to grow.
organism.zh: 每个生物都需要水和食物才能生长。

organize.example: She had to organize the files before the meeting began.
organize.zh: 会议开始前，她得把文件整理好。

orient.example: The map helped us orient ourselves in the new city.
orient.zh: 这张地图帮我们在陌生的城市里辨明方向。

oriental.example: The shop sells oriental rugs and handmade silk cloth.
oriental.zh: 这家店出售东方地毯和手工丝绸布料。

orientation.example: New students attend an orientation to learn about the school.
orientation.zh: 新生参加入学介绍会，了解学校的情况。

origin.example: The origin of this custom is still unknown to most people.
origin.zh: 这种习俗的起源对大多数人来说仍然未知。

ornament.example: A small glass ornament hung from the top of the tree.
ornament.zh: 树顶挂着一个玻璃小饰物。

orphan.example: The orphan was raised by a kind family in the village.
orphan.zh: 这个孤儿由村里一户善良的人家抚养长大。

orthodox.example: He follows the orthodox method rather than trying anything new.
orthodox.zh: 他遵循传统的方法，而不去尝试新东西。

other.example: Some people like tea while other people prefer coffee.
other.zh: 有些人喜欢茶，而另一些人更喜欢咖啡。

otherwise.example: Write down the address, otherwise you will forget it later.
otherwise.zh: 把地址记下来，否则你以后会忘记。

ought to.example: You ought to drink more water when the weather is hot.
ought to.zh: 天气热的时候你应该多喝水。

ounce.example: Add one ounce of sugar to the mixture and stir well.
ounce.zh: 往混合物里加一盎司糖，充分搅拌。

our.example: Our teacher gave us an extra week to finish the report.
our.zh: 老师多给了我们一周时间完成报告。

ours.example: That small green car near the gate is ours.
ours.zh: 门口那辆绿色的小车是我们的。

ourselves.example: We painted the whole room ourselves to save some money.
ourselves.zh: 为了省点钱，我们自己把整个房间刷了漆。

out.example: The children ran out of the house when the rain stopped.
out.zh: 雨停后，孩子们从屋里跑了出去。

outbreak.example: The sudden outbreak of flu kept many students at home.
outbreak.zh: 流感的突然爆发让许多学生留在了家里。

outcome.example: Nobody could guess the outcome of the final game.
outcome.zh: 谁也猜不到决赛的结果。

outdated.example: The old computer is too outdated to run the new program.
outdated.zh: 这台旧电脑太过时了，运行不了新程序。

outdoor.example: They had an outdoor dinner in the garden last night.
outdoor.zh: 昨晚他们在花园里吃了顿户外晚餐。

outer.example: The outer walls of the house are painted light grey.
outer.zh: 房子的外墙刷成了浅灰色。

outfit.example: She wore a simple outfit to the interview this morning.
outfit.zh: 今天上午面试时，她穿了一套简单的衣服。

outgoing.example: His outgoing nature makes it easy for him to meet people.
outgoing.zh: 他外向的性格让他很容易结识别人。

outing.example: The class went on an outing to the lake last Friday.
outing.zh: 上周五全班去湖边郊游了。

outlaw.example: The new rule will outlaw the sale of these plastic bags.
outlaw.zh: 新规定将取缔这类塑料袋的销售。

outlet.example: Coloring is a good outlet for stress after a long day.
outlet.zh: 忙碌一天后，涂色是释放压力的好方式。

outline.example: He wrote a short outline before starting the full essay.
outline.zh: 在写整篇文章之前，他先写了一个简短的大纲。

outlook.example: The outlook for the weekend is warm and mostly sunny.
outlook.zh: 周末的天气展望是温暖、大部晴朗。

output.example: The factory hopes to double its output within two years.
output.zh: 这家工厂希望在两年内把产量翻一番。

outrage.example: The decision to close the park caused outrage among local residents.
outrage.zh: 关闭公园的决定引起了当地居民的愤怒。

outset.example: She warned us about the risks at the very outset.
outset.zh: 一开始她就提醒过我们其中的风险。

outside.example: The children are playing outside in the warm afternoon sun.
outside.zh: 孩子们正在午后温暖的阳光下在外面玩。

outskirts.example: They live on the outskirts of the city near a forest.
outskirts.zh: 他们住在城市近郊，靠近一片森林。

outstanding.example: Her work on the project was outstanding and won an award.
outstanding.zh: 她在这个项目中的表现很杰出，还获了奖。

outward.example: The outward signs of wear were easy to see on the old car.
outward.zh: 这辆旧车外观上的磨损痕迹很容易看出来。

oval.example: The mirror has an oval shape and a wooden frame.
oval.zh: 这面镜子是椭圆形的，配着木框。

oven.example: Bake the cake in the oven for about thirty minutes.
oven.zh: 把蛋糕放进烤箱烤大约三十分钟。

over.example: A bridge was built over the river many years ago.
over.zh: 很多年前，河上架起了一座桥。

overall.example: The overall cost of the trip was lower than expected.
overall.zh: 这次旅行的总花费比预期的低。

overcoat.example: He put on a thick overcoat before going out into the snow.
overcoat.zh: 他穿上厚大衣，才走进雪里。

overcome.example: She worked hard to overcome her fear of speaking in public.
overcome.zh: 她努力克服了当众讲话的恐惧。

overdue.example: The library books are long overdue and must be returned today.
overdue.zh: 这些图书馆的书早就过期了，今天必须还回去。

overflow.example: Heavy rain made the river overflow and flood the lower road.
overflow.zh: 大雨让河水溢出，淹没了下面的路。

overhaul.example: The old engine needs a full overhaul before we use it.
overhaul.zh: 这台旧发动机在使用前需要彻底检修。

overhead.example: A plane flew overhead, and the children stopped to watch.
overhead.zh: 一架飞机从头顶飞过，孩子们停下来看。

overhear.example: I happened to overhear their quiet talk in the next room.
overhear.zh: 我碰巧听到了他们在隔壁房间低声交谈。

overlap.example: The two meetings overlap by half an hour on Tuesday.
overlap.zh: 星期二这两个会议有半小时重叠。

overlook.example: From the hill you can overlook the whole fishing village.
overlook.zh: 从山上可以俯瞰整个渔村。

overnight.example: The weather changed overnight, and the roads became icy.
overnight.zh: 天气一夜之间变了，路面结起了冰。

override.example: The manager can override the system and approve the request.
override.zh: 经理可以越过系统直接批准这个申请。

overseas.example: She plans to study overseas for one year after graduation.
overseas.zh: 她打算毕业后到国外学习一年。

oversee.example: A senior teacher will oversee the new reading program this term.
oversee.zh: 这学期将由一位资深教师监督新的阅读计划。

oversight.example: The missing page was an oversight, and it was fixed quickly.
oversight.zh: 漏掉那一页是个疏忽，很快就补上了。

overstate.example: It is easy to overstate the benefits of a new phone.
overstate.zh: 人们很容易夸大一部新手机的好处。

overt.example: There was no overt sign of trouble during the meeting.
overt.zh: 会议期间没有任何明显的麻烦迹象。

overtake.example: Slow cars should not overtake on this narrow mountain road.
overtake.zh: 在这条狭窄的山路上，慢车不应该超车。

overthrow.example: The young team hoped to overthrow the champions in the final match.
overthrow.zh: 这支年轻的队伍希望在决赛中推翻卫冕冠军。

overtime.example: He worked overtime all week to finish the report on time.
overtime.zh: 为了按时完成报告，他整周都在加班。

overturn.example: The wind was strong enough to overturn the small boat.
overturn.zh: 风大得足以把小船掀翻。

overwhelm.example: Too many messages can overwhelm a person in a single morning.
overwhelm.zh: 一个上午收到太多消息会让人不知所措。

owe.example: I owe you ten dollars for the coffee I bought yesterday.
owe.zh: 我欠你十美元，是昨天买咖啡的钱。

owl.example: An owl sat in the tree and watched the field quietly.
owl.zh: 一只猫头鹰停在树上，静静地望着田野。

own.example: They own a small house near the beach and visit often.
own.zh: 他们在海边有一栋小房子，经常去那里。

ox.example: The farmer used an ox to pull the heavy wooden cart.
ox.zh: 农夫用一头牛来拉那辆沉重的木车。

oxide.example: Rust is an oxide that forms on iron in wet air.
oxide.zh: 铁锈是铁在潮湿空气中形成的氧化物。

oxygen.example: Plants release oxygen into the air during the day.
oxygen.zh: 白天植物会把氧气释放到空气中。

ozone.example: The ozone layer protects the earth from harmful rays.
ozone.zh: 臭氧层保护地球免受有害射线的伤害。

pace.example: He walked at a slow pace so the children could follow.
pace.zh: 他走得很慢，好让孩子们跟上。

pack.example: She began to pack her clothes the night before the trip.
pack.zh: 出发前一晚，她开始收拾衣服。

package.example: A small package arrived at the door this afternoon.
package.zh: 今天下午门口送来一个小包裹。

packet.example: He opened a packet of biscuits and shared it with us.
packet.zh: 他打开一包饼干，和我们一起分着吃。

pact.example: The two neighbors made a pact to share the garden tools.
pact.zh: 两位邻居约定共用园艺工具。

pad.example: She wrote the number on a pad beside the telephone.
pad.zh: 她把号码写在电话旁的便笺本上。

paddy.example: The farmers grow rice in the paddy fields near the river.
paddy.zh: 农民们在河边的稻田里种水稻。

page.example: Please turn to page thirty and read the second paragraph.
page.zh: 请翻到第三十页，读第二段。

pain.example: She felt a sharp pain in her knee after the long walk.
pain.zh: 走了很长的路后，她感觉膝盖一阵剧痛。

paint.example: They will paint the kitchen walls a warm light yellow.
paint.zh: 他们要把厨房的墙刷成温暖的浅黄色。

pair.example: He bought a pair of shoes for the coming winter.
pair.zh: 他为即将到来的冬天买了一双鞋。

palace.example: The old palace is now open to visitors every day.
palace.zh: 这座古老的宫殿现在每天向游客开放。

pale.example: His face turned pale when he heard the loud noise.
pale.zh: 听到那声巨响，他的脸变得苍白。

palm.example: She held the small stone in the palm of her hand.
palm.zh: 她把那块小石头握在手心里。

pamphlet.example: The nurse gave me a pamphlet about healthy eating habits.
pamphlet.zh: 护士给了我一本关于健康饮食习惯的小册子。

pan.example: Heat some oil in a pan and add the chopped onions.
pan.zh: 在平底锅里热些油，放入切碎的洋葱。

panda.example: The panda sat quietly and ate bamboo for hours.
panda.zh: 那只熊猫安静地坐着，吃了几小时竹子。

panel.example: A panel of three teachers judged the speech contest.
panel.zh: 由三位老师组成的评审小组评判了演讲比赛。

panic.example: Please do not panic; there is plenty of time left.
panic.zh: 请不要惊慌，时间还很充裕。

panorama.example: From the top of the tower we saw a wide panorama.
panorama.zh: 从塔顶望去，我们看到一片广阔的全景。

pant.example: The runner began to pant after the long steep climb.
pant.zh: 那跑者爬完又长又陡的坡后开始气喘。

pants.example: He put on his pants and a clean shirt this morning.
pants.zh: 今天早上他穿上裤子和一件干净的衬衫。

paper.example: She wrote her name on a piece of paper and waited.
paper.zh: 她把名字写在一张纸上，然后等着。

paperback.example: I found the novel in a cheap paperback edition at the shop.
paperback.zh: 我在店里找到了那本小说的廉价平装本。

parachute.example: The pilot opened the parachute and landed safely in the field.
parachute.zh: 飞行员打开降落伞，安全降落在田野里。

parade.example: The town holds a parade with music every spring.
parade.zh: 这个镇每年春天都会举行带音乐的游行。

paradigm.example: The new design became a paradigm for later models.
paradigm.zh: 这个新设计成了后来各款产品的范例。

paradise.example: This quiet island feels like a paradise in the summer.
paradise.zh: 这座安静的小岛在夏天宛如天堂。

paradox.example: It is a paradox that the richest man feels poor.
paradox.zh: 最富有的人却觉得自己贫穷，这是个悖论。

paragraph.example: Read the first paragraph again and find the main idea.
paragraph.zh: 再读一遍第一段，找出主旨。

parallel.example: The two roads run parallel for several miles near the coast.
parallel.zh: 这两条路在海岸附近平行延伸了好几英里。

paralyze.example: The heavy snow seemed to paralyze the whole small town.
paralyze.zh: 大雪似乎让整个小镇都瘫痪了。

parameter.example: Please set the main parameter before you run the program.
parameter.zh: 运行程序前请先设置主要参数。

parasite.example: A tiny parasite can live inside the body and cause illness.
parasite.zh: 微小的寄生虫能寄生在体内并引发疾病。

parcel.example: The postman left a large parcel at our front door.
parcel.zh: 邮递员把一个很大的包裹放在我们家门口。

pardon.example: I beg your pardon, but I did not hear your question.
pardon.zh: 对不起，我没听清您的问题。

parent.example: Every parent wants their children to be safe and happy.
parent.zh: 每位家长都希望孩子平安快乐。

parish.example: The small parish has one church and a primary school.
parish.zh: 这个小教区有一座教堂和一所小学。

park.example: We often walk in the park after dinner on warm days.
park.zh: 天气暖和时，我们常在晚饭后去公园散步。

parking.example: Free parking is available behind the library on weekends.
parking.zh: 周末图书馆后面有免费停车位。

parliament.example: The new law was discussed in parliament for several weeks.
parliament.zh: 新法律在议会里讨论了好几周。

parole.example: The man was released on parole after serving five years.
parole.zh: 那个人服刑五年后获假释出狱。

parrot.example: The parrot learned to repeat a few simple words.
parrot.zh: 那只鹦鹉学会重复几个简单的词。

part.example: She spent part of the summer working at a bookstore.
part.zh: 那个夏天她有一部分时间在书店打工。

participate.example: All students are welcome to participate in the art show.
participate.zh: 欢迎所有学生参加这次美术展。

particle.example: A tiny particle of dust can make the machine stop.
particle.zh: 一粒微小的灰尘就可能让机器停下来。

particular.example: She paid particular attention to the small details in the report.
particular.zh: 她特别注意报告中的细小细节。

partisan.example: Her partisan support for one side made the discussion quite unfair.
partisan.zh: 她对某一方的偏袒让讨论很不公平。

partition.example: A thin wooden partition divided the large room into two small offices.
partition.zh: 一道薄薄的木隔墙把大房间分成两间小办公室。

partly.example: The road was partly closed because workers were repairing the bridge.
partly.zh: 由于工人在修补桥梁，这条路部分封闭。

partner.example: He started the small business with his partner ten years ago.
partner.zh: 他十年前和合伙人一起创办了这家小公司。

party.example: We are planning a birthday party for my sister next Saturday.
party.zh: 我们打算下周六为我妹妹办一场生日聚会。

pass.example: Please pass the salt to me when you finish using it.

passage.example: Read the first passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.
passage.zh: 仔细阅读第一段短文，然后回答后面的问题。

passenger.example: Every passenger must wear a seat belt during the whole flight.
passenger.zh: 每位乘客在整个飞行过程中都必须系好安全带。

passerby.example: A kind passerby helped the old man carry his heavy bags home.
passerby.zh: 一位好心的过路人帮老人把沉重的袋子搬回家。

passion.example: She studies birds with great passion and writes down everything she sees.
passion.zh: 她对研究鸟类充满热情，并把看到的一切都记录下来。

passive.example: He stayed passive during the meeting and said almost nothing.
passive.zh: 他在会上态度消极，几乎什么也没说。

passport.example: Do not forget to bring your passport when you travel abroad.
passport.zh: 出国旅行时别忘了带护照。

password.example: You should change your password often to keep your account safe.
password.zh: 你应该经常更换密码以保证账户安全。

past.example: We often talk about the happy days of the past.
past.zh: 我们常常谈起过去那些快乐的日子。

pasta.example: She cooked pasta with fresh tomatoes and a little cheese.
pasta.zh: 她用新鲜西红柿和少许奶酪做了意大利面。

paste.example: Use a little paste to stick the picture onto the cardboard.
paste.zh: 用一点浆糊把图片粘到纸板上。

pastime.example: Reading is his favourite pastime on quiet winter evenings.
pastime.zh: 阅读是他在安静冬夜最喜欢的消遣。

pastry.example: The bakery sells fresh pastry every morning before eight o'clock.
pastry.zh: 那家面包店每天早上八点前出售新鲜糕点。

pasture.example: The sheep were eating grass in the green pasture behind the farm.
pasture.zh: 羊群正在农场后面的绿色牧场上吃草。

pat.example: She gave the little dog a gentle pat on the head.
pat.zh: 她轻轻拍了拍小狗的头。

patch.example: He sewed a small patch over the hole in his old coat.
patch.zh: 他在旧外套的破洞上缝了一小块补丁。

patent.example: The company applied for a patent on its new water filter.
patent.zh: 这家公司为其新型净水器申请了专利。

path.example: A narrow path leads through the trees to the quiet river.
path.zh: 一条狭窄的小路穿过树林通向安静的河边。

pathetic.example: The thin cat looked pathetic standing in the cold rain.
pathetic.zh: 那只瘦猫站在冷雨中，看起来十分可怜。

patience.example: Learning a new language takes patience and a lot of daily practice.
patience.zh: 学一门新语言需要耐心和大量的日常练习。

patient.example: The doctor spoke kindly to the patient before the examination began.
patient.zh: 检查开始前，医生和蔼地跟病人说话。

patriot.example: He always described himself as a patriot who loved his country.
patriot.zh: 他总说自己是热爱祖国的爱国者。

patrol.example: Two guards walk around the building on patrol every two hours.
patrol.zh: 两名保安每两小时绕着大楼巡逻一次。

patron.example: The little café thanks every patron who visits it each morning.
patron.zh: 这家小咖啡馆感谢每天早上光顾的每一位顾客。

pattern.example: The curtains have a simple flower pattern in soft blue.
pattern.zh: 窗帘上有柔和的蓝色简单花朵图案。

pause.example: She paused for a moment before answering the difficult question.
pause.zh: 她停顿了一下才回答那个难题。

pave.example: Workers will pave the road in front of the school next week.
pave.zh: 工人下周会给学校门前的路铺上路面。

paw.example: The cat hurt its front paw and could hardly walk.
paw.zh: 那只猫伤了前爪，几乎走不了路。

pay.example: You can pay for the tickets by card at the door.
pay.zh: 你可以在门口刷卡买票。

payroll.example: The accountant adds every new worker to the monthly payroll.
payroll.zh: 会计把每位新员工都加进每月的工资名单。

pea.example: She added a handful of green peas to the hot soup.
pea.zh: 她往热汤里加了一把青豌豆。

peace.example: The village has enjoyed peace and quiet since the factory closed.
peace.zh: 自从工厂关闭后，这个村子一直安宁平静。

peach.example: This peach is so sweet and soft that it melts in my mouth.
peach.zh: 这个桃子又甜又软，在我嘴里化开了。

peak.example: We reached the peak after climbing for nearly five hours.
peak.zh: 我们爬了将近五个小时后到达了山顶。

peanut.example: He eats a small bag of peanuts while watching the game.
peanut.zh: 他看比赛时吃了一小袋花生。

pear.example: The pear tree in our garden gives sweet fruit every autumn.
pear.zh: 我们花园里的梨树每年秋天都结出甜梨。

pearl.example: She wore a simple necklace with one small white pearl.
pearl.zh: 她戴着一串只镶一颗小白珍珠的简单项链。

peasant.example: An old peasant worked in the field from morning till night.
peasant.zh: 一位老农夫从早到晚在地里干活。

peck.example: The little bird pecked at the seeds on the ground.

peculiar.example: There was a peculiar smell coming from the old kitchen.
peculiar.zh: 老厨房里传来一股奇怪的味道。

pedal.example: She pressed the brake pedal hard when the dog ran out.
pedal.zh: 那只狗跑出来时，她用力踩下刹车踏板。

peddle.example: He used to peddle fresh fruit from a small cart downtown.
peddle.zh: 他过去常推着小车在市中心叫卖新鲜水果。

pedestrian.example: A pedestrian was waiting at the crossing when the light turned green.
pedestrian.zh: 绿灯亮时，一位行人正在人行横道处等候。

peel.example: Please peel the potatoes and cut them into small pieces.
peel.zh: 请把土豆削皮，然后切成小块。

peep.example: She peeped through the window to see who was outside.
peep.zh: 她从窗户偷偷往外看，想知道谁在外面。

peer.example: He peered at the small print and rubbed his tired eyes.
peer.zh: 他眯着眼看那行小字，揉了揉疲惫的眼睛。

peg.example: He hung his wet coat on a wooden peg by the door.
peg.zh: 他把湿外套挂在门边的一个木钉上。

pen.example: She signed the form with a blue pen and smiled.
pen.zh: 她用一支蓝色钢笔在表格上签了名，然后笑了。

penalty.example: Drivers who park here must pay a heavy penalty.
penalty.zh: 在这里停车的司机必须缴纳高额罚款。

pencil.example: He drew a rough map of the park with a pencil.
pencil.zh: 他用铅笔粗略地画了一张公园地图。

pending.example: The final decision is still pending until the test results arrive.
pending.zh: 在测试结果出来之前，最终决定仍未作出。

pendulum.example: The old clock's pendulum swung slowly from side to side.
pendulum.zh: 那座旧钟的钟摆缓慢地左右摆动。

penetrate.example: Sunlight could not penetrate the thick curtains in the dark room.
penetrate.zh: 阳光无法穿透黑暗房间里厚厚的窗帘。

penguin.example: A young penguin slipped into the cold water and swam away.
penguin.zh: 一只小企鹅滑进冰冷的水里游走了。

peninsula.example: The small town sits on a narrow peninsula beside the sea.
peninsula.zh: 这座小镇坐落在海边的狭长半岛上。

penny.example: He found an old penny under the cushion of the sofa.
penny.zh: 他在沙发垫子下面找到一枚旧便士。

pension.example: After forty years of work, he now lives on a small pension.
pension.zh: 工作四十年后，他现在靠一份微薄的养老金生活。

people.example: Many people come to this park to walk on sunny days.
people.zh: 天气晴朗时，许多人都到这个公园散步。

pepper.example: Add a little salt and pepper to the soup before serving.
pepper.zh: 上汤前加一点盐和胡椒。

per.example: The rent is two hundred dollars per month, including water.
per.zh: 房租是每月两百美元，含水费。

perceive.example: She perceived that something was wrong from his quiet voice.
perceive.zh: 她从他低沉的声音里察觉到出了什么事。

percent.example: About sixty percent of the students walk to school every day.
percent.zh: 大约百分之六十的学生每天步行上学。

perch.example: A small bird perched on the fence and sang for a while.
perch.zh: 一只小鸟停在栅栏上唱了一会儿。

perfect.example: The weather was perfect for a long walk by the lake.
perfect.zh: 天气非常适合在湖边长时间散步。

perform.example: The students will perform a short play at the school festival.
perform.zh: 学生们将在学校节庆上表演一出短剧。

perfume.example: She wore a light perfume that smelled of fresh flowers.
perfume.zh: 她喷了一种带着鲜花香味的淡香水。

perhaps.example: Perhaps we should leave a little earlier to avoid traffic.
perhaps.zh: 也许我们应该早点出发以避开拥堵。

peril.example: The climbers were in great peril when the storm arrived.
peril.zh: 暴风雨来临时，登山者们处境十分危险。

period.example: He lived in the city for a short period after college.
period.zh: 大学毕业后他在城里住了很短一段时间。

perish.example: Many small plants perished in the long, dry summer.
perish.zh: 在漫长干旱的夏天里，许多小植物都枯死了。

permanent.example: The accident left a permanent mark on the old wooden table.
permanent.zh: 那次事故在旧木桌上留下了一道永久的痕迹。

permeate.example: The smell of fresh bread permeated the whole little shop.
permeate.zh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫了整个小店。

permit.example: The rules do not permit visitors to feed the animals.
permit.zh: 规定不允许游客给动物喂食。

perpetual.example: The perpetual noise from the street kept her awake all night.
perpetual.zh: 街上不断的噪音让她整夜醒着。

perplex.example: The strange question seemed to perplex even the best students.
perplex.zh: 这个奇怪的问题似乎连最好的学生都感到困惑。

persecute.example: She did not want to persecute her son with too many rules.
persecute.zh: 她不想用太多规矩去苛责儿子。

persevere.example: If you persevere with your studies, you will succeed in the end.
persevere.zh: 如果你坚持学习，最终一定会成功。

persist.example: The rain persisted for three days and flooded the small garden.
persist.zh: 雨持续了三天，把小花园都淹了。

person.example: Only one person knew the answer to that simple question.
person.zh: 只有一个人知道那个简单问题的答案。

personnel.example: The hotel personnel were friendly and helped us with our bags.
personnel.zh: 酒店员工很友好，还帮我们搬了行李。

perspective.example: Try to see the problem from another person's perspective.
perspective.zh: 试着从别人的角度看待这个问题。

persuade.example: She persuaded her father to let her study art instead.
persuade.zh: 她说服父亲让她改学美术。

pessimism.example: His constant pessimism about the future tired everyone around him.
pessimism.zh: 他对未来不停的悲观态度让身边的人都很累。

pest.example: Farmers use nets to keep pests away from the young plants.
pest.zh: 农民用网子让害虫远离幼苗。

pesticide.example: This farm grows its vegetables without using any pesticide.
pesticide.zh: 这个农场种植蔬菜不使用任何杀虫剂。

pet.example: Their pet dog waits by the door every evening for them.
pet.zh: 他们的宠物狗每天晚上都在门口等他们。

petition.example: Hundreds of residents signed a petition for a new library.
petition.zh: 数百名居民签署了一份请愿书，要求建新图书馆。

petrochemical.example: The factory turns petroleum into many petrochemical products.
petrochemical.zh: 这家工厂把石油加工成许多石化产品。

petrol.example: He stopped at the station to buy some petrol for the car.
petrol.zh: 他在加油站停下来给车买些汽油。

petroleum.example: Petroleum is used to make fuel, plastic and many other goods.
petroleum.zh: 石油被用来制造燃料、塑料和许多其他产品。

petty.example: They argued about petty things that did not really matter.
petty.zh: 他们为一些无关紧要的琐事争吵。

pharmacy.example: The pharmacy near the corner is open until nine every night.
pharmacy.zh: 街角附近的药房每晚营业到九点。

phase.example: The project is now in its first phase of building.
phase.zh: 这个项目现在处于建设的第一个阶段。

phenomenon.example: Scientists study this strange natural phenomenon with great interest.
phenomenon.zh: 科学家们满怀兴趣地研究这种奇怪的自然现象。

philosophy.example: Her philosophy of life is to stay calm and enjoy simple things.
philosophy.zh: 她的人生哲学是保持平静、享受简单的事物。

photo.example: She showed me a photo of her garden in early spring.
photo.zh: 她给我看了一张初春时她花园的照片。

phrase.example: Write a sentence with each new phrase in your notebook.
phrase.zh: 在笔记本上用每个新短语造一个句子。

physical.example: Regular physical exercise helps you sleep better at night.
physical.zh: 经常进行身体锻炼有助于晚上睡得更好。

physician.example: The physician asked him to rest and drink more water.
physician.zh: 内科医生让他多休息、多喝水。

physics.example: She teaches physics at a secondary school near her home.
physics.zh: 她在离家不远的一所中学教物理。

physiological.example: Lack of sleep can cause clear physiological changes in the body.
physiological.zh: 睡眠不足会给身体带来明显的生理变化。

piano.example: He practices the piano for half an hour every evening.
piano.zh: 他每天晚上练半小时钢琴。

pick.example: You can pick any two books from the shelf.
pick.zh: 你可以从书架上任意挑两本书。

picnic.example: We had a picnic on the grass under the old tree.
picnic.zh: 我们在老树下的草地上野餐。

picture.example: The child drew a picture of a house and a tree.
picture.zh: 那孩子画了一幅有一座房子和一棵树的画。

pie.example: She baked an apple pie for the family dinner.
pie.zh: 她为家庭晚餐烤了一个苹果派。

piece.example: He cut the cake into eight equal pieces for the guests.
piece.zh: 他把蛋糕切成八等份给客人们。

pierce.example: A sharp nail pierced the tyre of my bicycle.
pierce.zh: 一枚尖钉子刺穿了我自行车的轮胎。

pig.example: The pigs on the farm sleep in a warm wooden shed.
pig.zh: 农场里的猪睡在温暖的木棚里。

pigeon.example: A grey pigeon landed on the roof and stayed there quietly.
pigeon.zh: 一只灰鸽子落在屋顶上，静静地待着。

pile.example: There is a pile of clean clothes on the bed.

pilgrim.example: The tired pilgrim walked slowly along the dusty road at sunset.
pilgrim.zh: 那位疲惫的长途旅行者日落时沿着尘土飞扬的路慢慢走着。

pill.example: Take one pill with water after each meal, the doctor said.
pill.zh: 医生说，每餐后用水服一粒药丸。

pillar.example: A tall stone pillar stands in the middle of the hall.
pillar.zh: 大厅中央立着一根高高的石柱。

pillow.example: She put a soft pillow behind her back while reading.
pillow.zh: 她看书时在背后垫了一个软枕头。

pilot.example: The pilot told the passengers that the weather was fine.
pilot.zh: 飞行员告诉乘客天气很好。

pin.example: She used a pin to hold the papers together.
pin.zh: 她用一枚别针把文件别在一起。

pinch.example: He pinched his arm to make sure he was awake.
pinch.zh: 他掐了一下胳膊，确认自己醒着。

pine.example: Tall pine trees cover the hills behind the small village.
pine.zh: 高大的松树覆盖着小村庄后面的山丘。

pink.example: She painted the walls of the baby's room light pink.
pink.zh: 她把婴儿房的墙刷成了浅粉色。

pint.example: He bought a pint of milk on his way home.
pint.zh: 他在回家的路上买了一品脱牛奶。

pioneer.example: She was a pioneer in the study of clean energy.
pioneer.zh: 她是清洁能源研究领域的先驱。

pipe.example: Water flows through a long pipe under the garden.
pipe.zh: 水从花园下的一条长管子流过。

pirate.example: The old story is about a pirate and his hidden treasure.
pirate.zh: 那个老故事讲的是一个海盗和他藏起来的宝藏。

pistol.example: The toy pistol in the shop looked almost real.
pistol.zh: 商店里的那把玩具手枪看起来几乎跟真的一样。

pit.example: Workers dug a deep pit to plant the young tree.
pit.zh: 工人们挖了一个深坑来种那棵小树。

pitch.example: He pitched the ball so hard that it flew over the wall.
pitch.zh: 他用力投球，球飞过了墙。

pity.example: It is a pity that you cannot come to the dinner.
pity.zh: 你不能来参加晚餐，真是遗憾。

pizza.example: We ordered a large pizza with cheese and fresh vegetables.
pizza.zh: 我们点了一个加奶酪和新鲜蔬菜的大比萨饼。

place.example: This quiet place by the river is perfect for reading.
place.zh: 河边这个安静的地方非常适合读书。

plague.example: Heavy rain and strong wind plagued the small town all week.
plague.zh: 大雨和强风整整一周困扰着这个小镇。

plain.example: The instructions are written in plain language for everyone.
plain.zh: 这些说明用简单易懂的语言写给所有人看。

plaintiff.example: The plaintiff asked the court to return the borrowed money.
plaintiff.zh: 原告请求法院归还借出的钱。

plan.example: We plan to visit the museum early on Saturday morning.
plan.zh: 我们计划周六一早去参观博物馆。

plane.example: The plane took off on time and landed an hour later.
plane.zh: 飞机准时起飞，一小时后降落。

planet.example: Our planet needs clean air and water to stay healthy.
planet.zh: 我们的星球需要干净的空气和水才能保持健康。

plant.example: She planted small flowers along the path in her garden.
plant.zh: 她在花园的小路旁种了些小花。

plastic.example: Please put the plastic bottles into the recycling bin.
plastic.zh: 请把塑料瓶放进回收箱。

plate.example: He put the hot soup into a deep white plate.
plate.zh: 他把热汤盛进一个深的白盘子里。

plateau.example: Prices rose quickly and then reached a high plateau.
plateau.zh: 价格迅速上涨，然后在高位趋于稳定。

platform.example: The train to the city leaves from platform three.
platform.zh: 去城里的火车从三号站台发车。

plausible.example: His explanation sounded plausible, but we still needed more proof.
plausible.zh: 他的解释听起来有道理，但我们仍需要更多证据。

play.example: The children play football in the park after school.
play.zh: 孩子们放学后在公园踢足球。

playground.example: The children ran to the playground as soon as class ended.
playground.zh: 一下课孩子们就跑向操场。

plaza.example: We met in the town plaza and walked to a small shop.
plaza.zh: 我们在镇上的广场见面，然后去了一家小店。

plea.example: Her plea for more time was met with a calm nod.
plea.zh: 她请求多给一些时间，得到的却只是平静地点了点头。

plead.example: He decided to plead with the manager for a second chance.
plead.zh: 他决定向经理恳求再给一次机会。

please.example: Please close the window before you leave the room.
please.zh: 离开房间之前请把窗户关上。

pledge.example: The company made a pledge to reduce waste this year.
pledge.zh: 公司承诺今年减少废弃物。

plenty.example: There is plenty of time to finish the work today.
plenty.zh: 今天有充足的时间可以完成这项工作。

plight.example: The film shows the plight of families without clean water.
plight.zh: 这部电影展现了没有干净水源的家庭的困境。

plot.example: The plot of the novel is simple but very moving.
plot.zh: 这部小说的情节简单，却非常动人。

plough.example: Farmers use a plough to turn the soil in spring.

plug.example: He pulled the plug out and the machine stopped at once.
plug.zh: 他拔出插头，机器立刻停了。

plumber.example: The plumber fixed the leak under the kitchen sink.
plumber.zh: 水管工修好了厨房水槽下面的漏水处。

plumbing.example: The plumbing in this old house needs a full repair.
plumbing.zh: 这栋老房子的管道设备需要全面维修。

plunge.example: She watched the price of the bike plunge last week.
plunge.zh: 她看着这辆自行车的价格上周大幅下跌。

plural.example: In English, the plural of most nouns ends with the letter s.
plural.zh: 英语中，大多数名词的复数形式以字母 s 结尾。

plus.example: Two plus three is five, as every child here knows.
plus.zh: 二加三等于五，这里每个孩子都知道。

pocket.example: He put the small key into his coat pocket and left.
pocket.zh: 他把小钥匙放进口袋，然后离开了。

podcast.example: I listen to a short podcast about science on my way.
podcast.zh: 我在路上会听一个关于科学的短播客。

poem.example: She wrote a short poem about the sea for her class.
poem.zh: 她为班上写了一首关于大海的短诗。

poet.example: The poet read his new work to a small crowd.
poet.zh: 诗人向一小群人朗读了他的新作。

point.example: He made a good point about the cost of the plan.
point.zh: 他关于这个计划成本的说法很有道理。

poise.example: She spoke with great poise in front of the whole school.
poise.zh: 她在全校师生面前讲话时非常镇静。

poison.example: Some wild berries contain a poison that makes people ill.
poison.zh: 有些野果含有一种让人生病的毒物。

poke.example: He used a stick to poke the fire and make it brighter.
poke.zh: 他用一根棍子拨弄火，让它烧得更旺。

pole.example: A long pole stood beside the gate and held the flag.
pole.zh: 大门旁立着一根长杆，上面挂着旗子。

police.example: The police helped the lost child find her way home.
police.zh: 警察帮助走失的孩子找到了回家的路。

policy.example: The school has a clear policy about using phones in class.
policy.zh: 学校对课堂上使用手机有明确的规定。

polish.example: He used a soft cloth to polish the old wooden table.
polish.zh: 他用一块软布把旧木桌擦亮。

polite.example: She was always polite to the people who worked there.
polite.zh: 她对在那里工作的人总是很有礼貌。

politics.example: He never talks about politics at the dinner table.
politics.zh: 他在餐桌上从不谈政治。

poll.example: A recent poll shows that most people prefer shorter meetings.
poll.zh: 最近的一项民意调查显示，多数人更喜欢短会。

pollute.example: Factories near the river should not pollute the water.
pollute.zh: 河边的工厂不应该污染河水。

polytechnic.example: He studied design at a polytechnic near his home town.
polytechnic.zh: 他在家乡附近的一所理工专科学校学习设计。

pond.example: Ducks were swimming slowly across the quiet pond at dawn.
pond.zh: 黎明时分，鸭子缓缓游过安静的池塘。

ponder.example: She sat by the window and began to ponder the question.
ponder.zh: 她坐在窗边，开始沉思这个问题。

pool.example: The children spent the afternoon in the small pool.
pool.zh: 孩子们在小水池里度过了一个下午。

poor.example: The family was too poor to buy new winter clothes.
poor.zh: 这家人太穷了，买不起新的冬衣。

pop.example: She turned on the radio and heard a pop song.
pop.zh: 她打开收音机，听到一首流行歌曲。

popular.example: This kind of music is very popular with young people.
popular.zh: 这种音乐在年轻人中非常受欢迎。

population.example: The population of the town has grown quickly in ten years.
population.zh: 十年间这个镇的人口增长很快。

porcelain.example: The cup is made of fine porcelain and feels very light.
porcelain.zh: 这个杯子由精细的瓷器制成，拿起来很轻。

porch.example: We sat on the porch and watched the rain fall.
porch.zh: 我们坐在门廊上，看着雨落下来。

pork.example: She cooked pork with fresh vegetables for the evening meal.
pork.zh: 她为晚饭做了猪肉配新鲜蔬菜。

porridge.example: He eats a bowl of warm porridge every cold morning.
porridge.zh: 每个寒冷的早晨他都会喝一碗热粥。

port.example: The ship reached the port after three long days at sea.
port.zh: 在海上航行了三天后，船抵达了港口。

portfolio.example: She carries a leather portfolio with her drawings inside.
portfolio.zh: 她随身带着一个皮公文包，里面装着画稿。

portion.example: He gave each child a small portion of the cake.
portion.zh: 他给每个孩子分了一小块蛋糕。

portray.example: The painting tries to portray the quiet life of a village.
portray.zh: 这幅画试图描绘一个村庄的宁静生活。

pose.example: The artist asked her to pose in front of the window.
pose.zh: 画家请她在窗前摆好姿势。

position.example: Please put the chair back in its original position.
position.zh: 请把椅子放回原来的位置。

positive.example: Her words had a positive effect on the whole team.
positive.zh: 她的话对整个团队产生了积极的影响。

possess.example: He does not possess the skills needed for this job.
possess.zh: 他不具备这份工作需要的能力。

possible.example: It is possible to finish the work before the weekend.
possible.zh: 有可能在周末前完成这项工作。

post.example: She will post the letter on her way to work.
post.zh: 她会在上班路上把这封信寄出去。

postage.example: The postage for this small parcel is quite low.
postage.zh: 这个小包裹的邮费相当低。

postcard.example: He sent me a postcard from the seaside last summer.
postcard.zh: 去年夏天他从海边给我寄了一张明信片。

poster.example: A bright poster on the wall announced the school concert.
poster.zh: 墙上的一张鲜艳海报宣布了学校音乐会。

postpone.example: They had to postpone the match because of heavy rain.
postpone.zh: 因为大雨，他们不得不推迟比赛。

pot.example: She left the soup in a large pot on the stove.
pot.zh: 她把汤留在一个大锅里，放在炉子上。

potato.example: I added one boiled potato to my plate of salad.
potato.zh: 我在沙拉里加了一个煮马铃薯。

potent.example: The medicine is potent, so take only one small pill.
potent.zh: 这种药药性很强，所以一次只吃一小片。

potential.example: The young player has great potential and works very hard.
potential.zh: 这位年轻球员潜力很大，而且非常努力。

pottery.example: The shop sells pottery made by people in the village.
pottery.zh: 这家店出售村里人做的陶器。

poultry.example: The farm keeps poultry for eggs and for their meat.
poultry.zh: 这个农场养家禽，取蛋也取肉。

pound.example: She bought a pound of fresh apples at the market.
pound.zh: 她在市场上买了一磅新鲜苹果。

pour.example: Please pour the milk into the cups for the guests.
pour.zh: 请把牛奶倒进给客人用的杯子里。

powder.example: She added a spoon of milk powder to the warm water.
powder.zh: 她在温水里加了一勺奶粉。

power.example: The storm cut off the power to the whole village.
power.zh: 暴风雨切断了整个村子的电力。

practical.example: This course gives students practical skills for everyday work.
practical.zh: 这门课程教给学生日常工作的实用技能。

practise.example: You need to practise the piano for an hour daily.
practise.zh: 你需要每天练一小时钢琴。

practitioner.example: As a general practitioner, she sees many patients each day.
practitioner.zh: 作为一名全科医生，她每天看很多病人。

praise.example: The teacher gave the class high praise for their hard work.
praise.zh: 老师高度赞扬了全班同学的辛勤努力。

pray.example: They gathered in the garden to pray for good weather.
pray.zh: 他们聚在花园里，祈求好天气。

prayer.example: She said a short prayer before starting the long journey.
prayer.zh: 她在开始长途旅行前做了一个简短的祈祷。

preach.example: The coach would preach teamwork before every important match.
preach.zh: 这位教练在每场重要比赛前都会讲团队合作。

precaution.example: As a precaution, they checked the door twice before leaving.
precaution.zh: 为以防万一，他们离开前把门检查了两次。

precede.example: A short welcome speech will precede the main talk today.
precede.zh: 今天的主讲之前会有一段简短的欢迎辞。

precious.example: Clean water is a precious resource in this dry area.
precious.zh: 在这片干旱地区，干净的水是宝贵的资源。

precise.example: The teacher gave precise instructions for the science test.
precise.zh: 老师对科学测试给出了明确的指示。

predator.example: The bird of prey is a fierce predator in the sky.
predator.zh: 这种猛禽是天空中的凶猛捕食者。

predecessor.example: The new manager kept most of her predecessor's ideas.
predecessor.zh: 新经理保留了她前任的大部分想法。

predict.example: Experts cannot always predict the weather for the next week.
predict.zh: 专家并不总能预报下周的天气。

predominate.example: Tall trees predominate in this quiet part of the forest.
predominate.zh: 这片安静的森林里以高大的树木为主。

preface.example: The author wrote a short preface to explain her idea.
preface.zh: 作者写了一篇短序来说明她的想法。

prefer.example: I prefer tea to coffee when I am working late.
prefer.zh: 熬夜工作时我更爱喝茶而不是咖啡。

pregnant.example: The vet said the pregnant cat needs more food and rest.
pregnant.zh: 兽医说这只怀孕的猫需要更多食物和休息。

prejudice.example: Good books can help young readers overcome prejudice and fear.
prejudice.zh: 好书能帮助年轻读者克服偏见和恐惧。

preliminary.example: The first report is only a preliminary study of the problem.
preliminary.zh: 这份报告只是对这个问题的初步研究。

premature.example: It is premature to judge the plan before the results.
premature.zh: 在看到结果之前就评判这个计划为时过早。

premier.example: The hotel is one of the premier places to stay here.
premier.zh: 这家酒店是这里最好的住宿地之一。

premise.example: The whole argument rests on a simple but weak premise.
premise.zh: 整个论证都建立在一个简单却薄弱的前提上。

premium.example: Customers pay a small premium for faster delivery service.
premium.zh: 顾客为更快的送货服务支付一小笔额外费用。

preoccupy.example: Money problems seem to preoccupy him most of the time.
preoccupy.zh: 钱的问题似乎大部分时间都占据着他的心思。

prepare.example: She began to prepare dinner while the children did homework.
prepare.zh: 孩子们做作业时，她开始准备晚饭。

preposition.example: The word in is a common preposition in English.
preposition.zh: in 是英语中一个常见的介词。

prerequisite.example: A basic course in maths is a prerequisite for this class.
prerequisite.zh: 一门基础数学课程是选修这门课的先决条件。

prescribe.example: The doctor may prescribe a simple cream for the rash.
prescribe.zh: 医生可能会为皮疹开一种简单的药膏。

presence.example: Your presence at the meeting would mean a great deal.
presence.zh: 你出席这次会议将意义重大。

present.example: She gave a small present to her friend at the party.
present.zh: 她在聚会上送给朋友一件小礼物。

presentation.example: He gave a short presentation about the new library plan.
presentation.zh: 他做了一个关于新图书馆计划的简短介绍。

presently.example: She is presently working on a book about city life.
presently.zh: 她目前正在写一本关于城市生活的书。

preserve.example: We must preserve these old trees for the next generation.
preserve.zh: 我们必须为下一代保护这些老树。

preside.example: The oldest member will preside over the meeting tonight.
preside.zh: 最年长的成员将主持今晚的会议。

president.example: The president of the club welcomed every new member.
president.zh: 俱乐部主席欢迎了每一位新成员。

press.example: Press this button to start the machine, then wait.
press.zh: 按下这个按钮启动机器，然后等待。

pressure.example: The nurse checked his blood pressure after a short rest.
pressure.zh: 短暂休息后，护士量了他的血压。

prestige.example: The old university enjoys great prestige around the world.
prestige.zh: 这所老大学在全世界享有很高的声望。

presume.example: I presume you have already read the whole report.
presume.zh: 我想你已经读完整份报告了。

pretend.example: The children like to pretend they are sailing a ship.
pretend.zh: 孩子们喜欢假装自己正在驾驶一艘船。

pretext.example: He left early under the pretext of a sudden headache.
pretext.zh: 他以突然头疼为借口提前离开了。

pretty.example: The garden looks pretty in the soft evening light.
pretty.zh: 花园在柔和的暮色中显得很漂亮。

prevail.example: Common sense will prevail when the facts are clear.
prevail.zh: 事实清楚时，常识会占上风。

prevent.example: Washing your hands often can prevent many common illnesses.
prevent.zh: 经常洗手可以预防许多常见的疾病。

preview.example: We watched a short preview of the film last night.
preview.zh: 昨晚我们看了一段这部电影的短预告。

previous.example: She had read the previous chapter before the class started.
previous.zh: 上课前她已经读完了前一章。

prey.example: The cat moved quietly toward its prey in the grass.
prey.zh: 猫悄悄地向草地上的猎物靠近。

price.example: The price of fresh fruit rose sharply this month.
price.zh: 这个月新鲜水果的价格大幅上涨。

pride.example: He takes great pride in the work of his students.
pride.zh: 他为学生们的作品感到非常自豪。

priest.example: The old priest has lived in the village for many years.
priest.zh: 这位老牧师在这个村子里住了很多年。

primary.example: Our primary aim is to help students read with ease.
primary.zh: 我们的主要目标是帮助学生轻松地阅读。

prime.example: This is the prime time of year for fresh vegetables.
prime.zh: 这是一年中新鲜蔬菜的最好时节。

primitive.example: Early computers were slow and had very primitive screens.
primitive.zh: 早期的电脑运行缓慢，屏幕也非常简陋。

prince.example: The young prince learned to ride a horse before winter.
prince.zh: 小王子在冬天到来之前学会了骑马。

principal.example: The principal spoke to every student at the morning meeting.
principal.zh: 校长在晨会上对全体学生讲话。

principle.example: Honesty is a basic principle in all of our work.
principle.zh: 诚实是我们所有工作中的一项基本原则。

print.example: Could you print two copies of this page for me?
print.zh: 你能帮我打印两页这个吗？

prior.example: You need prior permission before using the large machine.
prior.zh: 使用这台大机器前你需要事先得到许可。

prison.example: The old castle was used as a prison long ago.
prison.zh: 这座古堡很久以前曾被用作监狱。

private.example: He works in a private office at the end of the hall.
private.zh: 他在走廊尽头的一间私人办公室里工作。

privilege.example: It was a privilege to work with such a kind teacher.
privilege.zh: 能和这样一位和善的老师共事是一种荣幸。

prize.example: She won first prize in the school writing competition.
prize.zh: 她在学校写作比赛中获得了一等奖。

probable.example: It is probable that the shop will close early today.
probable.zh: 这家店今天很可能会提前关门。

probe.example: The team will probe the cause of the strange noise.
probe.zh: 团队将调查这种奇怪噪音的原因。

problem.example: We discussed the problem for an hour and found a fix.
problem.zh: 我们讨论这个问题一个小时，找到了解决办法。

procedure.example: The teacher explained the procedure for the science experiment.
procedure.zh: 老师讲解了科学实验的步骤。

proceed.example: Please proceed to the front desk to collect your ticket.
proceed.zh: 请到前台去领取你的票。

process.example: Learning a language is a slow process that needs daily work.
process.zh: 学一门语言是一个需要每天努力的缓慢过程。

procession.example: A long procession of cars moved slowly through the town.
procession.zh: 一长列车队缓缓穿过小镇。

proclaim.example: The sign seemed to proclaim the opening of a new shop.
proclaim.zh: 那块牌子似乎在宣告一家新店开业。

produce.example: This small factory can produce about a hundred chairs a day.
produce.zh: 这家小工厂一天能生产约一百把椅子。

product.example: The new product sold well during its first three months.
product.zh: 这款新产品在最初三个月里卖得很好。

profession.example: Teaching is a profession that demands patience and energy.
profession.zh: 教师是一个需要耐心和精力的职业。

professor.example: The professor answered every question with great patience and clarity.
professor.zh: 教授非常耐心而清楚地回答了每一个问题。

proficient.example: She is now proficient at reading long reports in English.
proficient.zh: 她现在能熟练地阅读英文长篇报告。

profile.example: The website lets you add a photo to your profile.
profile.zh: 这个网站可以让你在个人资料里添加照片。

profit.example: The shop made a small profit in its first year.
profit.zh: 这家店在第一年赚了一点利润。

profound.example: The book had a profound effect on the way she thinks.
profound.zh: 这本书对她的思维方式产生了深刻的影响。

program.example: The school runs a summer reading program for young children.
program.zh: 学校为幼儿开设了一个暑期阅读项目。

progress.example: She made good progress in her English class this term.
progress.zh: 这学期她的英语课取得了不错的进步。

prohibit.example: The rules prohibit visitors from feeding the animals here.
prohibit.zh: 规定禁止游客在这里喂动物。

project.example: Our class is working on a small project about local birds.
project.zh: 我们班正在做一个关于本地鸟类的小项目。

projector.example: The teacher turned on the projector to show the new slides.
projector.zh: 老师打开投影仪来展示新的幻灯片。

prolong.example: Heavy rain may prolong the journey by a whole day.
prolong.zh: 大雨可能把行程延长整整一天。

prominent.example: The notice is placed in a prominent position on the wall.
prominent.zh: 通知被贴在墙上一个显眼的位置。

promise.example: She promised to send me the photos by Friday evening.
promise.zh: 她答应在周五晚上之前把照片发给我。

promote.example: Regular exercise can promote good health and a longer life.
promote.zh: 经常锻炼可以促进健康和长寿。

prompt.example: We received a prompt reply to our letter the next day.
prompt.zh: 我们第二天就收到了对来信的迅速回复。

prone.example: Children are often prone to catching colds in cold weather.
prone.zh: 孩子们在寒冷天气里容易感冒。

pronoun.example: The teacher asked us to replace each noun with a suitable pronoun.
pronoun.zh: 老师让我们用合适的代词替换每个名词。

pronounce.example: Can you pronounce this long word correctly for the class?
pronounce.zh: 你能为全班正确读出这个长单词吗？

proof.example: The letter is clear proof that he paid the money.
proof.zh: 这封信是他付过钱的明确证据。

proofread.example: Please proofread this short article before we send it out.
proofread.zh: 请在我们发出这篇短文之前校对一下。

prop.example: He used a wooden stick to prop the window open.
prop.zh: 他用一根木棍把窗户撑开。

propaganda.example: The company used clever propaganda to make its product seem essential.
propaganda.zh: 这家公司用巧妙的宣传使自己的产品显得不可或缺。

propagate.example: These plants propagate quickly in warm and wet soil.
propagate.zh: 这些植物在温暖潮湿的土壤里繁殖得很快。

propel.example: The strong wind helped propel the small boat forward.
propel.zh: 强风推动着小船向前行进。

proper.example: Please put these books back in their proper places.
proper.zh: 请把这些书放回它们该放的地方。

property.example: The family sold their old property and moved to the city.
property.zh: 这家人卖掉了旧房产，搬到了城里。

proportion.example: A large proportion of the students walk to school every day.
proportion.zh: 很大一部分学生每天步行上学。

propose.example: I propose that we meet again early next week.
propose.zh: 我提议我们下周早些时候再见面。

prose.example: Her latest book is written in simple and clear prose.
prose.zh: 她的新书用简单清晰的散文写成。

prosecute.example: The company was prosecuted for selling unsafe products to customers.
prosecute.zh: 那家公司因向顾客出售不安全的商品而被起诉。

prospect.example: The prospect of working abroad excited the young engineer.
prospect.zh: 到国外工作的前景让这位年轻工程师很兴奋。

prosper.example: Small shops can prosper when the whole town supports them.
prosper.zh: 当整个小镇都支持它们时，小商店就能兴旺起来。

protect.example: A good hat will protect your face from the strong sun.
protect.zh: 一顶好帽子能保护你的脸不受烈日伤害。

protein.example: Beans and eggs are cheap and useful sources of protein.
protein.zh: 豆类和鸡蛋是廉价而有用的蛋白质来源。

protest.example: The workers gathered to protest against the sudden pay cut.
protest.zh: 工人们聚集起来抗议突然的减薪。

protocol.example: We must follow the safety protocol before using this machine.
protocol.zh: 使用这台机器之前，我们必须遵守安全规程。

prototype.example: The team built a simple prototype of the new lamp.
prototype.zh: 团队为这款新台灯做了一个简单的原型。

prove.example: He worked hard to prove that the idea could work.
prove.zh: 他努力工作以证明这个想法可行。

proverb.example: There is an old proverb about patience and hard work.
proverb.zh: 有一句关于耐心和勤奋的古老谚语。

provide.example: The hotel provides free breakfast for all its guests.
provide.zh: 这家酒店为所有客人提供免费早餐。

provided.example: You can borrow my car, provided you return it tomorrow.
provided.zh: 只要明天归还，你可以借我的车。

province.example: He grew up in a small village in the southern province.
province.zh: 他在南部省份的一个小村庄长大。

provoke.example: His careless words provoked a long argument at dinner.
provoke.zh: 他不经意的话在晚餐时引发了一场长时间的争论。

proximate.example: The proximate cause of the fire was a broken wire.
proximate.zh: 这场火灾的直接原因是电线破损。

psychiatry.example: He decided to study psychiatry after years of hospital work.
psychiatry.zh: 在医院工作多年后，他决定学习精神病学。

psychology.example: She read a book about the psychology of small children.
psychology.zh: 她读了一本关于幼儿心理学的书。

pub.example: The old pub on the corner serves warm meals every evening.
pub.zh: 街角那家老酒馆每天晚上供应热饭菜。

public.example: The library is open to the public every day.
public.zh: 图书馆每天向公众开放。

publish.example: The small press will publish her first novel next year.
publish.zh: 这家小出版社明年将出版她的第一部小说。

pudding.example: We had apple pudding for dessert after the simple meal.
pudding.zh: 简单的一餐之后，我们吃了苹果布丁当甜点。

pull.example: Two strong men pulled the heavy box up the stairs.
pull.zh: 两个壮汉把沉重的箱子拉上了楼梯。

pulse.example: The nurse checked his pulse and wrote it down.
pulse.zh: 护士检查了他的脉搏并记录下来。

pump.example: The old pump brings water up from the deep well.
pump.zh: 这台旧水泵把水从深井里抽上来。

pumpkin.example: She made a warm soup from pumpkin and fresh milk.
pumpkin.zh: 她用南瓜和新鲜牛奶做了一锅热汤。

punch.example: Use the punch to make a hole in this card.
punch.zh: 用打孔器在这张卡片上打一个孔。

punctual.example: Please be punctual because the meeting starts at nine.
punctual.zh: 请准时到场，因为会议九点开始。

punish.example: The teacher did not punish the child for the mistake.
punish.zh: 老师没有因为那个错误而惩罚这个孩子。

pupil.example: Every pupil in the class received a small new notebook.
pupil.zh: 班上每个学生都收到了一本新的小笔记本。

purchase.example: She decided to purchase a new desk for her room.
purchase.zh: 她决定为自己的房间买一张新书桌。

pure.example: The water in this mountain stream is clean and pure.
pure.zh: 这条山间溪流的水干净而纯净。

purple.example: The walls of the small room were painted light purple.
purple.zh: 这个小房间的墙壁被刷成了浅紫色。

purpose.example: The purpose of the meeting is to share the new plan.
purpose.zh: 这次会议的目的是分享新计划。

purse.example: She opened her purse and found only a few coins inside.
purse.zh: 她打开钱包，发现里面只有几枚硬币。

pursue.example: She moved to the city to pursue a career in design.
pursue.zh: 她搬到城里去追求设计方面的职业。

push.example: Please push the door gently and it will open.
push.zh: 请轻轻推门，它就会打开。

put.example: Please put the keys on the table near the door.
put.zh: 请把钥匙放在门边的桌子上。

puzzle.example: The strange answer puzzled everyone in the room.
puzzle.zh: 那个奇怪的答案让房间里的每个人都很困惑。

pyramid.example: The children built a pyramid with wooden blocks on the floor.
pyramid.zh: 孩子们在地板上用木块搭了一座金字塔。

quake.example: The ground began to quake and the windows shook loudly.
quake.zh: 地面开始震动，窗户发出很大的响声。

qualify.example: He worked hard to qualify as a doctor last year.
qualify.zh: 去年他努力学习以取得医生资格。

quality.example: The quality of the bread here is very high.
quality.zh: 这里面包的质量非常高。

quantify.example: It is hard to quantify the value of extra free time.
quantify.zh: 额外的空闲时间的价值很难量化。

quantity.example: We bought a large quantity of paper for the office.
quantity.zh: 我们为办公室买了大量的纸。

quarrel.example: The two brothers had a short quarrel about the radio.
quarrel.zh: 两兄弟为了收音机吵了一小架。

quart.example: The old recipe asks for a quart of fresh milk.
quart.zh: 这个老食谱需要一夸脱新鲜牛奶。

quarter.example: A quarter of the class chose the shorter book.
quarter.zh: 班里四分之一的人选了那本较薄的书。

queen.example: The queen greeted the guests at the palace gate with a smile.
queen.zh: 女王在宫殿门口微笑着迎接客人。

query.example: She sent a short query about the missing order.
query.zh: 她就缺失的订单发了一封简短的询问。

quest.example: His long quest for a quiet place finally succeeded.
quest.zh: 他长期寻找安静之处的努力终于成功了。

question.example: She asked a simple question about the bus times.
question.zh: 她问了一个关于公交车时间的简单问题。

queue.example: A long queue formed outside the small bakery.
queue.zh: 小面包店外排起了长队。

quick.example: She gave a quick answer and left the room.
quick.zh: 她快速回答后离开了房间。

quiet.example: The street is very quiet early in the morning.

quit.example: He decided to quit his job and travel for a year.
quit.zh: 他决定辞掉工作去旅行一年。

quite.example: The test was quite easy for most of the class.
quite.zh: 这次测验对班上大多数人来说相当容易。

quiver.example: Her voice began to quiver as she read the letter.
quiver.zh: 读那封信时，她的声音开始颤抖。

quiz.example: We had a short quiz on new words this morning.
quiz.zh: 今天早上我们进行了一次关于新单词的简短测验。

quota.example: The team met its monthly quota of new members.
quota.zh: 该团队完成了每月新增成员的配额。

quote.example: She likes to quote a line from an old song.
quote.zh: 她喜欢引用一首老歌里的一句歌词。

rabbit.example: A small rabbit ran across the field and disappeared.
rabbit.zh: 一只小兔子跑过田野，然后消失了。

race.example: He won the race by only a few seconds at the end.
race.zh: 他在最后只以几秒之差赢得了比赛。

racial.example: The school welcomes students of all racial and cultural backgrounds.
racial.zh: 这所学校欢迎各种种族和文化背景的学生。

rack.example: Please put your coat on the rack near the door.
rack.zh: 请把外套放在门边的架子上。

radar.example: The small boat was found by radar within an hour.
radar.zh: 小船在不到一小时内被雷达找到了。

radiate.example: The old stove radiates a pleasant warmth on cold days.
radiate.zh: 这台旧炉子在寒冷的日子里散发出宜人的暖意。

radical.example: The company made radical changes to its oldest product last year.
radical.zh: 公司去年对旗下最老的产品做了根本性的改动。

radio.example: He listens to the radio while he cooks dinner.

radioactive.example: Workers must handle radioactive waste with great care.
radioactive.zh: 工人必须非常小心地处理放射性废料。

rag.example: He wiped the table with a clean soft rag.
rag.zh: 他用一块干净的软抹布擦桌子。

rage.example: He shook with rage when he heard the unfair news.
rage.zh: 听到那个不公平的消息时，他气得发抖。

raid.example: The police raided the old warehouse and found stolen goods.
raid.zh: 警方突袭了那座旧仓库，发现了赃物。

rail.example: Hold the rail tightly while you walk down the stairs.
rail.zh: 下楼梯时请紧紧抓住扶手。

railway.example: The new railway connects the small town with the city.
railway.zh: 这条新铁路把小镇和城市连接起来。

rain.example: Heavy rain kept the children inside the house all day.
rain.zh: 大雨让孩子们一整天都待在屋里。

rainbow.example: A bright rainbow appeared after the short summer storm.
rainbow.zh: 短暂的夏季雷雨过后出现了一道明亮的彩虹。

raincoat.example: She put on her yellow raincoat before leaving the house.
raincoat.zh: 她出门前穿上了黄色的雨衣。

raise.example: They raised enough money to repair the old school roof.
raise.zh: 他们筹集到足够的钱来修理学校的旧屋顶。

rally.example: The team managed to rally in the final minutes and win.
rally.zh: 球队在最后几分钟重整旗鼓并赢得了比赛。

ranch.example: He grew up on a quiet ranch with horses and cattle.
ranch.zh: 他在一个有马和牛的安静牧场长大。

random.example: He picked a random page and began to read aloud.
random.zh: 他随手翻到一页，开始大声朗读。

range.example: Our shop sells a wide range of small kitchen tools.
range.zh: 我们店出售各种各样的厨房小工具。

rank.example: This restaurant ranks among the best in the whole city.
rank.zh: 这家餐厅在全城名列前茅。

rap.example: She gave a light rap on the door before entering.
rap.zh: 她进门之前轻轻敲了一下门。

rape.example: Local farmers grow rape in large fields and press its seeds for cooking oil.
rape.zh: 当地农民在大片田地里种植油菜，并压榨其种子制取食用油。

rapid.example: The city saw rapid growth in the last ten years.
rapid.zh: 这座城市在过去十年里经历了快速增长。

rare.example: It is rare to see snow in this warm place.
rare.zh: 在这个温暖的地方很少见到雪。

rash.example: It was a rash decision to spend all his savings.
rash.zh: 把全部积蓄都花掉是个轻率的决定。

rat.example: A large rat ran across the kitchen floor last night.
rat.zh: 昨晚一只大老鼠跑过厨房地板。

rate.example: The train moved at a slow rate through the hills.

rather.example: I would rather stay at home than go out tonight.
rather.zh: 今晚我宁愿待在家里也不愿出门。

ratify.example: The members voted to ratify the new agreement last week.
ratify.zh: 成员们上周投票批准了这项新协议。

ratio.example: The ratio of teachers to students here is quite low.
ratio.zh: 这里师生之间的比例相当低。

ration.example: Each worker received a daily ration of bread and water.
ration.zh: 每个工人每天领到一份面包和水的定量。

rational.example: Try to stay calm and make a rational choice about it.
rational.zh: 尽量保持冷静，对此做出理性的选择。

rattle.example: The old truck rattled loudly as it drove down the hill.
rattle.zh: 那辆旧卡车下山时发出很大的嘎嘎声。

raw.example: She cut the raw vegetables into small pieces for the salad.
raw.zh: 她把生的蔬菜切成小块做沙拉。

ray.example: A thin ray of sunlight came through the small window.
ray.zh: 一缕细细的阳光透过小窗户照进来。

reach.example: We finally reached the top of the hill before sunset.
reach.zh: 我们终于在日落前到达了山顶。

react.example: How did she react when you told her the news?
react.zh: 你告诉她这个消息时，她有什么反应？

read.example: I like to read a few pages before I go to sleep.

ready.example: Are you ready to start the meeting in five minutes?
ready.zh: 你准备好五分钟后开始会议了吗？

real.example: The story is based on a real event from last year.
real.zh: 这个故事基于去年发生的一件真实事件。

realistic.example: We need a realistic plan that we can actually finish.
realistic.zh: 我们需要一个真正能完成的现实计划。

realize.example: I did not realize how late it was until I looked at the clock.
realize.zh: 直到我看了钟，才意识到已经这么晚了。

realm.example: This question belongs to the realm of science, not art.
realm.zh: 这个问题属于科学领域，而不是艺术领域。

reap.example: Farmers reap their crops in the warm days of autumn.
reap.zh: 农民在温暖的秋日里收割庄稼。

rear.example: The kitchen is at the rear of the small house.
rear.zh: 厨房在这所小房子的后面。

reason.example: Please tell me the reason for your sudden change of plan.
reason.zh: 请告诉我你突然改变计划的原因。

reassure.example: The doctor tried to reassure the worried mother gently.
reassure.zh: 医生轻声安慰这位焦虑的母亲。

rebel.example: Many students rebel against the school's strict dress code.
rebel.zh: 许多学生反抗学校严格的着装规定。

recall.example: I cannot recall the name of that small bookshop.
recall.zh: 我想不起那家小书店的名字了。

recede.example: The flood water began to recede after two long days.
recede.zh: 洪水在漫长的两天之后开始退去。

receive.example: I received a warm letter from my old teacher yesterday.
receive.zh: 昨天我收到了以前的老师寄来的一封亲切的信。
