recent.example: The recent changes have made the website much easier to use.
recent.zh: 最近的改动让这个网站更容易使用了。

reception.example: A friendly woman at the reception gave us the room key.
reception.zh: 前台一位友好的女士给了我们房间钥匙。

recession.example: Many small shops closed during the long economic recession.
recession.zh: 许多小商店在漫长的经济衰退期间关门了。

recipe.example: My grandmother gave me her simple recipe for apple cake.
recipe.zh: 我祖母把她做苹果蛋糕的简单食谱给了我。

reciprocal.example: The two schools have a reciprocal agreement to share books.
reciprocal.zh: 这两所学校有一项共享图书的互惠协议。

recite.example: The boy stood up and recited the whole poem clearly.
recite.zh: 男孩站起来，清楚地背诵了整首诗。

reckless.example: He lost his licence after years of reckless driving.
reckless.zh: 多年鲁莽驾驶之后，他失去了驾照。

reckon.example: I reckon it will take about two hours to finish.
reckon.zh: 我估计完成这件事大约需要两个小时。

recognize.example: She recognized the old song as soon as it started playing.
recognize.zh: 那首老歌一开始播放，她就听出来了。

recommend.example: Can you recommend a good restaurant near the train station?
recommend.zh: 你能推荐一家火车站附近的好餐馆吗？

reconcile.example: The two friends finally reconciled after a long talk.
reconcile.zh: 两位朋友长谈之后终于和解了。

record.example: She records every lesson in a small notebook by hand.
record.zh: 她每节课都亲手记在一个小笔记本上。

recover.example: He slowly recovered from the illness and returned to work.
recover.zh: 他慢慢从病中恢复过来，重返工作岗位。

recreation.example: Walking in the park is my favourite form of recreation.
recreation.zh: 在公园散步是我最喜欢的消遣方式。

recruit.example: The company plans to recruit ten new workers this spring.
recruit.zh: 公司计划今年春天招聘十名新员工。

rectify.example: Please rectify the errors in this report before Friday.
rectify.zh: 请在周五之前改正这份报告中的错误。

recur.example: The same problem may recur if we do not fix the cause.
recur.zh: 如果我们不解决根本原因，同样的问题可能会再次出现。

recycle.example: We recycle old paper and glass to reduce waste at home.
recycle.zh: 我们回收旧纸张和玻璃，以减少家里的浪费。

red.example: She wore a red coat and carried a small black bag.
red.zh: 她穿着一件红色外套，还提着一个小黑包。

reduce.example: They decided to reduce the noise by closing the windows.
reduce.zh: 他们决定关上窗户来降低噪音。

redundant.example: The second paragraph is redundant and can be safely removed.
redundant.zh: 第二段是多余的，可以放心删掉。

reel.example: He turned the reel slowly to bring the fish closer.
reel.zh: 他慢慢转动卷轴，把鱼拉得更近。

refer.example: Please refer to the first page for more information about it.
refer.zh: 更多相关信息请参阅第一页。

referee.example: The referee stopped the game to check the final score.
referee.zh: 裁判暂停了比赛，以确认最终比分。

referendum.example: The city held a referendum on the new park plan.
referendum.zh: 该市就新的公园方案举行了全民投票。

refine.example: The team will refine the plan before the final meeting.
refine.zh: 团队会在最终会议前进一步完善这个方案。

reflect.example: The calm lake reflects the shape of the tall green trees.
reflect.zh: 平静的湖面映出高大绿树的轮廓。

reform.example: The school plans to reform its rules on late homework.
reform.zh: 学校计划改革关于作业迟交的规定。

refrain.example: Please refrain from using your phone during the test.
refrain.zh: 考试期间请避免使用手机。

refresh.example: A short walk can refresh your mind after long hours of work.
refresh.zh: 长时间工作后，散步一小会儿能让头脑清醒。

refreshment.example: Light refreshments will be served in the hall after the talk.
refreshment.zh: 讲座结束后，大厅里会提供茶点。

refrigerator.example: Put the milk back in the refrigerator before it gets warm.
refrigerator.zh: 趁牛奶还没变温，把它放回冰箱。

refuge.example: The small hut gave us refuge from the sudden heavy rain.
refuge.zh: 那间小屋让我们躲过了突然下起的大雨。

refund.example: The shop agreed to refund the full price of the broken chair.
refund.zh: 商店同意退还那把坏椅子的全款。

refuse.example: She politely refused the offer and left the room quietly.
refuse.zh: 她礼貌地拒绝了提议，悄悄离开了房间。

refute.example: The new data clearly refutes the old claim about the cause.
refute.zh: 新数据清楚地驳斥了先前关于原因的说法。

regard.example: Many people regard him as a fair and patient teacher.
regard.zh: 许多人认为他是一位公正而有耐心的老师。

regarding.example: I have a question regarding the date of the final exam.
regarding.zh: 我有一个关于期末考试日期的问题。

regardless.example: We will go hiking tomorrow regardless of the cold weather.
regardless.zh: 不管天气多冷，我们明天都会去徒步。

regime.example: The doctor suggested a strict regime of sleep and exercise.
regime.zh: 医生建议采用严格的作息和运动制度。

regiment.example: A whole regiment of volunteers helped clean the beach last Sunday.
regiment.zh: 上周日一大群志愿者帮忙清理了海滩。

region.example: This region is famous for its tea and fresh mountain air.
region.zh: 这个地区以茶叶和清新的山间空气闻名。

register.example: You must register for the course before the end of May.
register.zh: 你必须在五月底之前注册这门课程。

regret.example: I regret not studying harder when I was at school.
regret.zh: 我后悔上学时没有更用功地学习。

regular.example: He takes a regular walk in the park every morning.
regular.zh: 他每天早晨都固定去公园散步。

regulate.example: The device helps regulate the temperature inside the small room.
regulate.zh: 这个装置有助于调节小房间里的温度。

rehabilitate.example: Doctors helped him rehabilitate his injured knee over several months.
rehabilitate.zh: 医生在几个月里帮助他恢复了受伤膝盖的功能。

rehearse.example: The students rehearse the play twice a week after class.
rehearse.zh: 学生们每周课后排练两次这部戏。

reign.example: The young king reigned for only a few short years.
reign.zh: 那位年轻的国王在位仅仅短短几年。

rein.example: He pulled the rein gently and the horse turned left.
rein.zh: 他轻轻拉了一下缰绳，马便向左转。

reinforce.example: They used extra wood to reinforce the weak part of the floor.
reinforce.zh: 他们用额外的木料加固地板薄弱的部分。

reject.example: The editor decided to reject the story because it was too long.
reject.zh: 编辑决定退掉这篇故事，因为它太长了。

rejoice.example: The children rejoiced when they heard about the snow day.
rejoice.zh: 孩子们听说可以因下雪放假时高兴极了。

relate.example: She can relate the whole story in a clear and simple way.
relate.zh: 她能用清楚简单的方式把整个故事讲出来。

relative.example: A close relative came to stay with us for the weekend.
relative.zh: 一位近亲来我们家住了周末。

relax.example: You should relax and take a deep breath before you speak.
relax.zh: 开口之前，你应该放松并深吸一口气。

relay.example: He ran the last part of the relay and won the race.
relay.zh: 他跑完了接力赛的最后一棒并赢得比赛。

release.example: The band will release a new album in early spring.
release.zh: 乐队将在早春发行一张新专辑。

relentless.example: Her relentless effort finally turned a small idea into success.
relentless.zh: 她不间断的努力最终让一个小小的想法变成了成功。

relevant.example: Please bring only documents that are relevant to your application.
relevant.zh: 请只带上与你的申请相关的文件。

relic.example: The old coin is a relic of a much earlier time.
relic.zh: 这枚旧硬币是更早时代的遗物。

relieve.example: A warm bath can relieve the pain in your tired shoulders.
relieve.zh: 温水澡可以缓解你疲惫肩膀的疼痛。

religion.example: He read several books about the history of religion.
religion.zh: 他读过几本关于宗教历史的书。

relish.example: She ate the soup with great relish and asked for more.
relish.zh: 她津津有味地喝完汤，还要了更多。

reluctant.example: He was reluctant to lend his new bike to strangers.
reluctant.zh: 他不愿意把新自行车借给陌生人。

rely.example: You can rely on her to finish the work on time.
rely.zh: 你可以依靠她按时完成工作。

remain.example: Only a few seats remain for tonight's concert in the hall.
remain.zh: 今晚大厅里的音乐会只剩下几个座位。

remark.example: His remark about the weather made everyone at the table laugh.
remark.zh: 他关于天气的那句评论让桌边的人都笑了。

remedy.example: A simple remedy for a sore throat is warm water and honey.
remedy.zh: 喉咙痛的简单疗法是温水和蜂蜜。

remember.example: I still remember the first day I walked into this school.
remember.zh: 我仍然记得第一天走进这所学校的情景。

remind.example: Please remind me to call the office before noon tomorrow.
remind.zh: 请提醒我明天中午前给办公室打电话。

reminiscent.example: The smell of fresh bread is reminiscent of my childhood.
reminiscent.zh: 新鲜面包的香味让我想起童年。

remnant.example: A small remnant of the old wall still stands by the river.
remnant.zh: 那段旧墙的一小部分残迹仍立在河边。

remote.example: They live in a remote village far from the nearest town.
remote.zh: 他们住在一个远离最近城镇的偏僻村庄。

remove.example: Please remove your shoes before you enter the small room.
remove.zh: 进这个小房间之前请先脱鞋。

renaissance.example: The city enjoyed a cultural renaissance after the new museum opened.
renaissance.zh: 新博物馆开放后，这座城市迎来了一场文化复兴。

render.example: The heavy rain rendered the road unsafe for small cars.
render.zh: 大雨使这条道路对小汽车来说很不安全。

renew.example: I need to renew my library card before the end of the month.
renew.zh: 我需要在这个月底之前续办我的借书证。

renovate.example: They plan to renovate the old kitchen this coming summer.
renovate.zh: 他们计划今年夏天翻新那个旧厨房。

renown.example: The little bakery has won renown for its fresh bread.
renown.zh: 这家小面包店因新鲜面包而赢得了声誉。

rent.example: We pay the rent at the beginning of every month.

repair.example: A worker came to repair the broken lock on the door.
repair.zh: 一位工人来修门上坏掉的锁。

repay.example: He promised to repay the money by the end of June.
repay.zh: 他答应在六月底前还清这笔钱。

repeat.example: Could you repeat the last question a little more slowly?
repeat.zh: 你能把最后一个问题再慢一点重复一遍吗？

repel.example: This spray can repel insects from the garden for hours.
repel.zh: 这种喷剂能在花园里驱虫好几个小时。

repertoire.example: The pianist added two new pieces to her repertoire.
repertoire.zh: 这位钢琴家往她的曲目里加了两首新作品。

replace.example: Please replace the old battery with a fully charged one.
replace.zh: 请用充满电的电池换下旧电池。

reply.example: She sent a short reply to the email the same evening.
reply.zh: 她当天晚上就给那封邮件回了简短的答复。

report.example: He wrote a short report about the trip for the class.
report.zh: 他为班级写了一篇关于这次旅行的简短报告。

represent.example: The blue lines on the map represent small rivers and streams.
represent.zh: 地图上的蓝线代表小河和溪流。

repress.example: She tried to repress a smile when she heard the joke.
repress.zh: 听到那个笑话时，她努力忍住不笑。

reproach.example: His mother gave him a gentle reproach for coming home late.
reproach.zh: 母亲因他回家晚了而轻轻责备了他。

reproduce.example: These plants reproduce quickly in warm and wet weather.
reproduce.zh: 这些植物在温暖潮湿的天气里繁殖得很快。

republic.example: The country became a republic many years ago.
republic.zh: 这个国家在很多年前成为了共和国。

reputation.example: The small cafe has a good reputation for friendly service.
reputation.zh: 这家小咖啡馆以友好的服务享有好名声。

repute.example: This hotel is of high repute among local families.
repute.zh: 这家旅馆在当地家庭中声望很高。

request.example: She sent a polite request for more information about the course.
request.zh: 她礼貌地请求提供更多关于这门课程的信息。

require.example: All students require a quiet place to study every day.
require.zh: 所有学生每天都需要一个安静的地方学习。

rescue.example: The team worked all night to rescue the lost hikers.
rescue.zh: 救援队整夜工作，营救失踪的徒步者。

research.example: Her research on sleep has helped many tired students.
research.zh: 她关于睡眠的研究帮助了许多疲惫的学生。

resemble.example: The two brothers resemble each other in voice and smile.
resemble.zh: 这两兄弟在声音和笑容上很像。

resent.example: He resents being asked to do extra work without pay.
resent.zh: 他不满被要求无偿加班。

reserve.example: I would like to reserve a table for four this evening.
reserve.zh: 我想预订今晚一张四人的桌子。

reservoir.example: The reservoir supplies fresh water to the whole town.
reservoir.zh: 这座水库为整个镇子供应淡水。

reshuffle.example: The manager decided to reshuffle the team after the busy season.
reshuffle.zh: 忙碌季节过后，经理决定改组团队。

reside.example: Her grandparents reside in a quiet house near the lake.
reside.zh: 她的祖父母住在湖边一栋安静的房子里。

resign.example: He decided to resign from his job and travel.
resign.zh: 他决定辞去工作去旅行。

resist.example: I could not resist the smell of fresh bread.
resist.zh: 我抵挡不住新鲜面包的香味。

resolve.example: They met again to resolve the small problem about the bill.
resolve.zh: 他们再次见面，以解决关于账单的小问题。

resort.example: This seaside resort is quiet and lovely in early autumn.
resort.zh: 这个海滨度假胜地在初秋安静又迷人。

resource.example: Water is a precious resource that we must protect.
resource.zh: 水是我们必须保护的宝贵资源。

respect.example: We should respect the people who work quietly behind the scenes.
respect.zh: 我们应该尊重那些在幕后默默工作的人。

respective.example: After the meeting, they returned to their respective offices.
respective.zh: 会议结束后，他们各自回到了自己的办公室。

respond.example: Please respond to the invitation before Friday if you can.
respond.zh: 如果可以，请在周五之前回复邀请。

responsible.example: She is responsible for checking every order before it leaves.
responsible.zh: 她负责在每份订单发出前逐一核对。

rest.example: You look tired, so take a short rest on the sofa.
rest.zh: 你看起来很累，在沙发上休息一会儿吧。

restaurant.example: We had dinner at a small restaurant near the river.
restaurant.zh: 我们在河边一家小餐馆吃了晚饭。

restless.example: The children grew restless during the long train journey.
restless.zh: 长途火车旅行中，孩子们变得坐立不安。

restore.example: Workers will restore the old bridge over the next year.
restore.zh: 工人们将在接下来一年里修复这座老桥。

restrain.example: He could not restrain his laughter during the quiet speech.
restrain.zh: 在那场安静的演讲中，他忍不住笑了。

restrict.example: The new rules restrict the use of cars in the park.
restrict.zh: 新规定限制了公园里汽车的使用。

result.example: The final result of the match surprised almost everyone there.
result.zh: 比赛的最终结果让几乎所有人都感到意外。

resume.example: She will resume her studies after the summer holiday.
resume.zh: 她将在暑假后继续学业。

retail.example: The shop sells its products at retail and online.
retail.zh: 这家店既做零售也在网上销售产品。

retain.example: This old building still retains much of its original charm.
retain.zh: 这座老建筑仍保留着许多原有的魅力。

retaliate.example: He chose not to retaliate when his colleague made a rude remark.
retaliate.zh: 同事说了句粗鲁的话时，他选择不回敬。

retarded.example: Heavy rain retarded the work on the new road for a week.
retarded.zh: 大雨使新路的施工延误了一周。

retell.example: She asked the students to retell the story in their own words.
retell.zh: 她让学生用自己的话复述这个故事。

retire.example: After thirty years of work, my father plans to retire next spring.
retire.zh: 我父亲工作了三十年，打算明年春天退休。

retort.example: She retorted that the plan was simply too expensive for us.
retort.zh: 她反驳说，这个方案对我们来说太贵了。

retreat.example: The cat slowly retreated when it saw the large dog.
retreat.zh: 那只猫看到大狗后慢慢后退。

retrieve.example: He went back upstairs to retrieve his forgotten phone.
retrieve.zh: 他上楼去取他忘拿的手机。

retrospect.example: In retrospect, that difficult year taught me a great deal.
retrospect.zh: 回想起来，那艰难的一年教会了我很多。

return.example: Please return the book to the shelf when you finish it.
return.zh: 看完书后请把它放回书架。

reunite.example: The family will reunite for dinner at the end of the year.
reunite.zh: 一家人将在年底团聚吃晚饭。

reveal.example: The test results will reveal how well the new method works.
reveal.zh: 测试结果将揭示这种新方法的效果如何。

revenge.example: He wanted revenge, but in the end he let it go.
revenge.zh: 他本想报复，但最后放下了。

revenue.example: Online sales brought in more revenue than the shop this year.
revenue.zh: 今年网上销售带来的收益超过了实体店。

reverse.example: He reversed the car slowly and parked near the gate.
reverse.zh: 他慢慢倒车，停在门口附近。

review.example: I will review my notes before the test on Friday morning.
review.zh: 我会在周五早上考试前复习笔记。

revise.example: The writer had to revise the last chapter three times.
revise.zh: 作者不得不把最后一章修改了三次。

revive.example: A cup of hot tea revived me after the long walk.
revive.zh: 走了很长一段路后，一杯热茶让我精神起来。

revolt.example: The students revolted against the new rule about uniforms.
revolt.zh: 学生们反抗关于校服的新规定。

revolution.example: The computer brought a quiet revolution to office work.
revolution.zh: 计算机给办公室工作带来了一场静悄悄的变革。

revolve.example: The earth revolves around the sun once every year.
revolve.zh: 地球每年绕太阳转一圈。

reward.example: The school gave a small reward to every helpful student.
reward.zh: 学校给每位乐于助人的学生一份小奖励。

rhetoric.example: His speech was full of rhetoric but offered few real facts.
rhetoric.zh: 他的演讲充满辞令，却没给出多少真正的事实。

rhythm.example: The song has a slow and gentle rhythm that I love.
rhythm.zh: 这首歌有我喜欢的那种缓慢而柔和的节奏。

rib.example: He broke a rib while playing football last Saturday afternoon.
rib.zh: 上周六下午他踢足球时摔断了一根肋骨。

ribbon.example: She tied a red ribbon around the small gift box.
ribbon.zh: 她在小礼物盒上系了一条红丝带。

rice.example: We had rice and vegetables for dinner last night.
rice.zh: 我们昨晚吃了米饭和蔬菜。

rich.example: This soup is rich in flavor but very easy to cook.
rich.zh: 这汤味道浓郁，但做起来很容易。

rid.example: It took weeks to get rid of the old sofa.
rid.zh: 花了好几周才把那张旧沙发处理掉。

riddle.example: The children laughed at the funny riddle about a cat.
riddle.zh: 孩子们被那个关于猫的有趣谜语逗笑了。

ride.example: I ride my bike to school every day except Sunday.
ride.zh: 除了周日，我每天骑自行车上学。

ridge.example: We walked along the narrow ridge above the green valley.
ridge.zh: 我们沿着绿色山谷上方狭窄的山脊行走。

ridicule.example: He was afraid of ridicule, so he never asked questions.
ridicule.zh: 他害怕被嘲笑，所以从不提问。

rifle.example: The old rifle was kept in a locked glass case.
rifle.zh: 那支旧步枪被放在一个上锁的玻璃柜里。

rig.example: The crew rigged the small boat with a new sail.
rig.zh: 船员们给小船装上了一面新帆。

right.example: You have the right to ask for a clear answer.
right.zh: 你有权要求得到一个明确的答复。

rigid.example: The box is made of rigid plastic that will not bend.
rigid.zh: 这个盒子由不会弯曲的硬塑料制成。

rigor.example: The study was carried out with great rigor and care.
rigor.zh: 这项研究做得非常严谨仔细。

rim.example: She touched the rim of the glass with one finger.
rim.zh: 她用一根手指碰了碰玻璃杯的边缘。

ring.example: The phone began to ring just as we sat down.
ring.zh: 我们刚坐下，电话就响了。

riot.example: The noisy crowd outside turned the quiet street into a riot.
riot.zh: 外面喧闹的人群把安静的街道变成了骚乱。

rip.example: Be careful not to rip the page as you turn it.
rip.zh: 翻页的时候小心别把纸撕破。

ripe.example: The apples in the garden are ripe and ready to pick.
ripe.zh: 花园里的苹果已经成熟，可以摘了。

rise.example: The sun will rise over the hills at six tomorrow morning.
rise.zh: 明天早上六点太阳会从山那边升起。

risk.example: Driving too fast puts everyone on the road at risk.
risk.zh: 开得太快会让路上的每个人处于危险之中。

ritual.example: Making tea is a morning ritual she never skips.
ritual.zh: 泡茶是她每天早上都不会省略的仪式。

rival.example: The two shops are close rivals for customers in this small town.
rival.zh: 这两家店在这个小镇上是争夺顾客的竞争对手。

river.example: A wide river flows through the valley near our village.
river.zh: 一条宽阔的河流经我们村庄附近的山谷。

road.example: The road to the airport is closed for repairs this week.
road.zh: 通往机场的路本周因维修而封闭。

roar.example: The old engine began to roar as the car climbed the hill.
roar.zh: 汽车爬坡时，那台旧发动机开始轰鸣。

roast.example: We will roast the chicken with potatoes for dinner tonight.
roast.zh: 今晚我们会把鸡和土豆一起烤来当晚餐。

rob.example: The thief tried to rob a small bank near the station.
rob.zh: 那个小偷试图抢劫车站附近的一家小银行。

robot.example: This small robot can clean the floor by itself every day.
robot.zh: 这个小型机器人每天能自己清扫地板。

robust.example: The old bridge is still robust enough for heavy trucks.
robust.zh: 这座老桥依然足够坚固，能承受重型卡车。

rock.example: He sat on a large rock and watched the waves come in.
rock.zh: 他坐在一块大岩石上看海浪涌来。

rocket.example: The rocket rose slowly into the clear blue sky.
rocket.zh: 火箭缓缓升入晴朗的蓝天。

rod.example: He used a long rod to reach the box on the shelf.
rod.zh: 他用一根长杆去够架子上的盒子。

role.example: She played an important role in organizing the school concert.
role.zh: 她在组织学校音乐会的过程中发挥了重要作用。

roll.example: The ball began to roll down the hill towards the river.
roll.zh: 球开始沿着山坡滚向河边。

romance.example: Their romance began during a summer holiday by the sea.
romance.zh: 他们的恋情始于海边的一个暑假。

roof.example: Snow covered the roof of every house in the village.
roof.zh: 雪覆盖了村里每座房子的屋顶。

room.example: There is enough room in the car for five people.
room.zh: 车里空间足够坐五个人。

root.example: The roots of the old tree reach deep into the ground.
root.zh: 这棵老树的根深深扎进地面。

rope.example: He tied the boat to the post with a strong rope.
rope.zh: 他用一根结实的绳子把船拴在柱子上。

rose.example: She planted a red rose beside the garden gate last spring.
rose.zh: 去年春天她在花园门旁种了一株红玫瑰。

rot.example: Fruit left in the sun will rot within a few days.
rot.zh: 留在太阳下的水果几天内就会腐烂。

rotate.example: The Earth rotates once on its axis every twenty-four hours.
rotate.zh: 地球每二十四小时绕轴自转一圈。

rough.example: The rough surface of the wall hurt my hand.
rough.zh: 墙面粗糙的表面弄疼了我的手。

round.example: We sat round the table and shared a big meal.
round.zh: 我们围坐在桌旁，分享了一顿丰盛的饭。

rouse.example: The loud noise from the street roused him from sleep.
rouse.zh: 街上传来的巨响把他从睡梦中唤醒。

route.example: This bus route takes about forty minutes to the city centre.
route.zh: 这条公交路线到市中心大约要四十分钟。

routine.example: My morning routine includes a short walk and a cold shower.
routine.zh: 我早上的例行安排包括短距离散步和冷水澡。

row.example: They planted a row of small trees along the fence.
row.zh: 他们沿篱笆种了一排小树。

royal.example: The old palace was built for royal guests many years ago.
royal.zh: 这座古老的宫殿多年前是为皇家宾客建造的。

rub.example: She began to rub her cold hands to keep warm.
rub.zh: 她开始搓着冰冷的双手取暖。

rubber.example: This eraser is made of soft rubber and works very well.
rubber.zh: 这块橡皮由柔软的橡胶制成，很好用。

rubbish.example: Please put the rubbish in the bin before you leave.
rubbish.zh: 离开前请把垃圾放进垃圾桶。

rude.example: It is rude to interrupt when someone else is speaking.
rude.zh: 别人说话时打断是很无礼的。

rug.example: A small rug lies in front of the fireplace.
rug.zh: 壁炉前铺着一块小地毯。

ruin.example: The heavy rain may ruin the crops in the fields.
ruin.zh: 大雨可能会毁掉田里的庄稼。

rule.example: Players must follow the rules of the game at all times.
rule.zh: 运动员必须始终遵守比赛规则。

rumor.example: A rumor about the new shop spread through the town quickly.
rumor.zh: 关于那家新店的传言很快传遍了全镇。

run.example: He likes to run in the park before breakfast every day.
run.zh: 他喜欢每天早饭前在公园里跑步。

runway.example: The plane waited on the runway for almost an hour.
runway.zh: 飞机在跑道上等了将近一个小时。

rural.example: Life in rural areas is quiet and close to nature.
rural.zh: 乡村地区的生活安静而贴近自然。

rush.example: She had to rush to catch the last train home.
rush.zh: 她不得不匆忙赶去坐最后一班回家的火车。

rust.example: The old gate was covered with rust after years of rain.
rust.zh: 经过多年雨淋，那扇旧门布满了锈。

ruthless.example: The ruthless manager cared only about profit, not people.
ruthless.zh: 那位无情的经理只关心利润，不关心员工。

résumé.example: She sent her résumé to three companies last week.
résumé.zh: 她上周把简历发给了三家公司。

sack.example: He carried a heavy sack of potatoes on his back.
sack.zh: 他背着一袋沉重的土豆。

sacred.example: For many people, this mountain is a sacred place.
sacred.zh: 对许多人来说，这座山是神圣之地。

sacrifice.example: She made a big sacrifice to support her family.
sacrifice.zh: 为了支撑家庭，她作出了很大的牺牲。

sad.example: He felt sad when his best friend moved away.
sad.zh: 最好的朋友搬走时，他感到很难过。

saddle.example: He put the saddle on the horse and rode away.
saddle.zh: 他把马鞍放在马上，然后骑马走了。

safe.example: Keep your passport in a safe place while travelling.
safe.zh: 旅行时把护照放在安全的地方。

safeguard.example: Laws exist to safeguard the rights of ordinary workers.
safeguard.zh: 法律的存在是为了保护普通工人的权利。

sail.example: They plan to sail along the coast this summer.
sail.zh: 他们打算今年夏天沿海岸航行。

saint.example: In the old story, a kind saint helps poor children.
saint.zh: 在这个古老的故事里，一位善良的圣人帮助穷苦的孩子。

sake.example: For the sake of her health, he stopped smoking.
sake.zh: 为了她的健康，他戒了烟。

salad.example: I had a green salad and some bread for lunch.
salad.zh: 我午饭吃了一份蔬菜沙拉和一些面包。

salary.example: His new job offers a higher salary and shorter hours.
salary.zh: 他的新工作薪水更高，工时更短。

sale.example: The shop is having a sale on winter coats this week.
sale.zh: 这家店本周冬季外套打折促销。

salesman.example: The salesman explained how the new machine worked.
salesman.zh: 推销员讲解了这台新机器如何运作。

salmon.example: We had grilled salmon with vegetables for dinner last night.
salmon.zh: 昨晚我们吃的是烤鲑鱼配蔬菜。

salon.example: She goes to a hair salon near her office every month.
salon.zh: 她每月去办公室附近的一家美发店。

salt.example: Please add a little salt to the soup before serving.
salt.zh: 上桌前请往汤里加一点盐。

salute.example: The soldiers stood still and saluted the flag.
salute.zh: 士兵们站定，向旗帜敬礼。

salvage.example: They managed to salvage some furniture from the flooded house.
salvage.zh: 他们设法从被淹的房子里抢救出了一些家具。

salvation.example: The new factory was seen as the salvation of the town.
salvation.zh: 这座新工厂被视为这个小镇的救星。

same.example: We ordered the same dish and sat by the window.
same.zh: 我们点了同样的菜，坐在窗边。

sample.example: The shop gives a free sample of the new tea.
sample.zh: 这家店免费赠送新茶的样品。

sanction.example: The committee gave its sanction to the new building plan.
sanction.zh: 委员会批准了新的建筑计划。

sanctuary.example: The small park became a sanctuary for wild birds.
sanctuary.zh: 这个小公园成了野生鸟类的庇护所。

sand.example: The children built a tall castle in the warm sand.
sand.zh: 孩子们在温暖的沙子里堆了一座高高的城堡。

sandwich.example: He made a cheese sandwich and took it to work.
sandwich.zh: 他做了一个奶酪三明治带去上班。

sanitation.example: Good sanitation helps prevent disease in crowded cities.
sanitation.zh: 良好的环境卫生有助于在拥挤的城市里预防疾病。

sarcasm.example: His sarcasm hurt her feelings more than he knew.
sarcasm.zh: 他的讽刺比他所知道的更伤她的心。

satellite.example: The satellite sends pictures of the weather to the ground.
satellite.zh: 这颗卫星把天气图像传回地面。

satire.example: The novel is a sharp satire on modern office life.
satire.zh: 这部小说是对现代办公室生活的尖锐讽刺。

satisfy.example: The new design should satisfy most of our customers.
satisfy.zh: 新设计应该能让大多数顾客满意。

saturate.example: Heavy rain can saturate the soil in a few hours.
saturate.zh: 大雨能在几小时内使土壤浸透。

Saturday.example: We are going hiking this Saturday if the weather is fine.
Saturday.zh: 如果天气好，我们这个星期六去徒步。

sauce.example: She poured a little tomato sauce over the pasta.
sauce.zh: 她在意大利面上倒了一点番茄酱。

sausage.example: He fried two sausages and an egg for breakfast.
sausage.zh: 他煎了两根香肠和一个鸡蛋当早餐。

savage.example: The savage dog frightened the children at the gate.
savage.zh: 那只凶猛的狗吓到了门口的孩子们。

save.example: She tries to save a little money every month.
save.zh: 她尽量每个月存一点钱。

say.example: I cannot say what will happen next week.
say.zh: 我说不准下周会发生什么。

scale.example: The map is drawn on a scale of one to ten thousand.
scale.zh: 这张地图是按一比一万的比例绘制的。

scan.example: The machine can scan the whole page in a second.
scan.zh: 这台机器能在一秒钟内扫描整页。

scandal.example: The scandal forced the manager to leave his job.
scandal.zh: 这桩丑闻迫使那位经理辞去了工作。

scar.example: A small scar on his arm reminds him of the accident.
scar.zh: 手臂上的小疤痕让他想起那次事故。

scarce.example: Clean water is scarce in some dry regions.
scarce.zh: 在一些干旱地区，清洁的水十分稀缺。

scare.example: The loud thunder scared the little dog badly.
scare.zh: 响亮的雷声把小狗吓坏了。

scatter.example: The wind scattered the dry leaves across the yard.
scatter.zh: 风把干枯的叶子吹散到院子各处。

scenario.example: The worst scenario is a long delay in the project.
scenario.zh: 最坏的情况是项目长期延误。

scene.example: The police arrived at the scene within ten minutes.
scene.zh: 警察在十分钟内到达了现场。

scent.example: The scent of fresh bread filled the whole kitchen.
scent.zh: 新鲜面包的香味充满了整个厨房。

schedule.example: The train schedule changes at the end of the month.
schedule.zh: 火车时刻表在月底会有变动。

scheme.example: They worked out a simple scheme to save water.
scheme.zh: 他们想出了一个简单的节水方案。

scholar.example: He is a careful scholar of ancient Chinese poetry.
scholar.zh: 他是一位研究中国古代诗歌的严谨学者。

school.example: The children walk to school together every morning.
school.zh: 孩子们每天早上一起步行去学校。

science.example: She teaches science at a secondary school in town.
science.zh: 她在镇上的一所中学教科学。

scissors.example: Use these scissors to cut the paper into strips.
scissors.zh: 用这把剪刀把纸剪成条。

scold.example: His mother scolded him for coming home so late.
scold.zh: 他妈妈因为他回家太晚而训了他。

scope.example: This question is beyond the scope of our study.
scope.zh: 这个问题超出了我们研究的范围。

score.example: He scored two goals in the second half of the match.
score.zh: 他在比赛下半场进了两个球。

scorn.example: She looked at the cheap copy with scorn.
scorn.zh: 她轻蔑地看着那件廉价的仿制品。

scout.example: The scout walked ahead to find a safe path.
scout.zh: 侦察员走在前面寻找安全的路线。

scramble.example: The children scrambled up the hill to see the view.
scramble.zh: 孩子们爬上山坡去看风景。

scrap.example: He wrote the address on a scrap of paper.
scrap.zh: 他把地址写在一小片纸上。

scrape.example: She had to scrape the ice off the car window.
scrape.zh: 她不得不刮掉车窗上的冰。

scratch.example: The cat scratched the sofa with its sharp claws.
scratch.zh: 猫用锋利的爪子抓挠沙发。

scream.example: The baby began to scream when the toy broke.
scream.zh: 玩具坏了的时候，婴儿开始尖叫。

screen.example: The teacher showed the video on the large screen.
screen.zh: 老师在大屏幕上播放了那段视频。

screw.example: He used a small screw to fix the loose handle.
screw.zh: 他用一颗小螺丝固定住松动的把手。

script.example: The actor read the whole script before the first day.
script.zh: 演员在第一天之前读完了整个剧本。

scrub.example: She had to scrub the dirty floor for an hour.
scrub.zh: 她擦洗脏地板花了一个小时。

scrutiny.example: The plan came under close scrutiny from the committee.
scrutiny.zh: 这项计划受到了委员会的仔细审查。

sculpture.example: The museum shows a marble sculpture of a sleeping child.
sculpture.zh: 博物馆展出一件睡着的孩子的大理石雕塑。

sea.example: The sea was calm and the sky was clear.

seal.example: Please seal the envelope before you post it.
seal.zh: 寄出之前请把信封封好。

search.example: They searched the whole house for the missing keys.
search.zh: 他们找遍了整座房子，寻找丢失的钥匙。

season.example: Autumn is my favorite season because the air is cool.
season.zh: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节，因为空气凉爽。

seat.example: Please take a seat and wait for your name.
seat.zh: 请坐下，等着叫你的名字。

second.example: Wait a second while I find the right page.
second.zh: 等我一下，我找一下正确的那一页。

second-hand.example: She bought a second-hand bike for a low price.
second-hand.zh: 她花很低的价钱买了一辆二手自行车。

secondary.example: This is a secondary issue, not the main problem.
secondary.zh: 这是一个次要问题，不是主要问题。

secret.example: They kept the party a secret until the last day.
secret.zh: 他们把聚会一直保密到最后一天。

secretary.example: The secretary answered the phone and took a message.
secretary.zh: 秘书接了电话并记下了留言。

section.example: Please read the first section of the report carefully.
section.zh: 请仔细阅读报告的第一部分。

sector.example: Many people in this sector work from home now.
sector.zh: 这个行业里很多人现在在家工作。

secular.example: The school offers a secular education to all children.
secular.zh: 这所学校为所有孩子提供世俗教育。

secure.example: Make sure the door is secure before you go out.
secure.zh: 出门前确保门已经锁好。

seduce.example: The low price seduced many people into buying the old car.
seduce.zh: 低廉的价格诱使很多人买下了那辆旧车。

see.example: I can see the mountains from my bedroom window.
see.zh: 从卧室的窗户我能看见群山。

seed.example: She planted a few seeds in small pots by the window.
seed.zh: 她在窗边的小盆里播了几粒种子。

seek.example: Many young people seek advice before choosing a career.
seek.zh: 许多年轻人在选择职业前会寻求建议。

seem.example: The problem seems easy, but it takes time.
seem.zh: 这个问题似乎简单，但很花时间。

segment.example: This segment of the road is closed for repairs.

segregate.example: The library segregates old books from the new ones.
segregate.zh: 图书馆把旧书和新书分开存放。

seize.example: He seized the chance to ask a question.
seize.zh: 他抓住了机会提出一个问题。

seldom.example: He seldom eats out because he enjoys cooking.
seldom.zh: 他很少在外面吃饭，因为他喜欢做饭。

select.example: Please select three books from the list below.
select.zh: 请从下面的列表中挑选三本书。

self.example: She was too shy to speak about her true self.
self.zh: 她太害羞，不敢谈论真实的自我。

sell.example: They sell fresh fruit and vegetables at the market.
sell.zh: 他们在市场上出售新鲜水果和蔬菜。

semester.example: He studied hard and passed every exam this semester.
semester.zh: 这学期他学习努力，通过了每场考试。

seminar.example: The professor held a seminar on modern art last Friday.
seminar.zh: 教授上周五举办了一场关于现代艺术的研讨会。

senate.example: The university senate approved the new course on Monday.
senate.zh: 大学评议会周一批准了这门新课程。

send.example: Please send me the file before noon tomorrow.
send.zh: 请在明天中午之前把文件发给我。

senior.example: She is a senior engineer with twenty years of experience.
senior.zh: 她是一位有二十年经验的资深工程师。

sensation.example: He felt a strange sensation in his left hand.
sensation.zh: 他左手有一种奇怪的感觉。

sense.example: He has a good sense of humor and makes friends easily.
sense.zh: 他很有幽默感，容易交到朋友。

sensitive.example: Her skin is very sensitive to strong sunlight.
sensitive.zh: 她的皮肤对强烈的阳光非常敏感。

sentence.example: Please read the last sentence of the paragraph aloud.
sentence.zh: 请把这段的最后一句大声读出来。

sentiment.example: He shared the general sentiment that the plan was fair.
sentiment.zh: 他也认同大家的看法，认为这个计划是公平的。

separate.example: Keep the wet clothes separate from the clean ones.
separate.zh: 把湿衣服和干净衣服分开放。

September.example: The new term begins in September and ends in June.
September.zh: 新学期九月开始，六月结束。

sequence.example: Please put the pictures in the correct sequence.
sequence.zh: 请把这些图片按正确的顺序排好。

sergeant.example: The sergeant asked the young officer to check the report again.
sergeant.zh: 中士让那位年轻军官再把报告检查一遍。

serial.example: Her novel first appeared as a serial in a local paper.
serial.zh: 她的小说最初以连载形式发表在一家地方报纸上。

series.example: The teacher gave a series of short talks on health.
series.zh: 老师做了一系列关于健康的简短讲座。

serious.example: The doctor said the illness was not serious.

servant.example: He worked as a servant in a large country house.
servant.zh: 他曾在一座很大的乡间宅邸里当仆人。

serve.example: The small cafe serves hot soup and fresh bread.
serve.zh: 这家小咖啡馆供应热汤和新鲜面包。

session.example: The training session lasted two hours and ended with questions.
session.zh: 这次培训持续了两个小时，最后是提问环节。

set.example: Please set the table before our guests arrive.
set.zh: 请在客人到来之前把餐桌摆好。

setback.example: The team suffered a small setback but kept working on the plan.
setback.zh: 团队遭遇了一点小挫折，但仍继续推进这个计划。

setting.example: The school offers a calm setting for young learners.
setting.zh: 这所学校为年幼的学生提供了安静的环境。

settle.example: They decided to settle in a small town near the coast.
settle.zh: 他们决定在海岸边的一个小镇定居。

seven.example: The class starts at seven and ends at eight.

seventeen.example: My brother is seventeen and already drives a car.
seventeen.zh: 我弟弟十七岁，已经会开车了。

seventy.example: My grandmother is seventy but still walks three miles daily.
seventy.zh: 我奶奶七十岁了，但每天仍走三英里。

several.example: We waited several days for the package to arrive.
several.zh: 我们等了好几天，包裹才到。

severe.example: The area had a severe storm last night.
severe.zh: 这个地区昨晚遭遇了一场严重的暴风雨。

sew.example: She learned to sew her own clothes at school.
sew.zh: 她在学校学会了给自己缝衣服。

sex.example: Please write your name, age and sex on the form.
sex.zh: 请在表格上写下你的姓名、年龄和性别。

shabby.example: He wore a shabby old coat that had seen better days.
shabby.zh: 他穿着一件破旧的旧外套，早已不复当年。

shade.example: We sat in the shade of a large tree and rested.
shade.zh: 我们坐在一棵大树的树荫下休息。

shadow.example: The long shadow of the tree fell across the path.
shadow.zh: 树的长长的影子横落在小路上。

shaft.example: The lift moves up and down a deep shaft.
shaft.zh: 电梯沿着深深的竖井上下运行。

shake.example: She had to shake the bottle before opening it.
shake.zh: 她打开瓶子之前得先摇一摇。

shall.example: We shall meet again at the same place next week.
shall.zh: 我们下周还在同一个地方见面。

shallow.example: The children played in the shallow water near the shore.
shallow.zh: 孩子们在岸边浅浅的水里玩耍。

shame.example: It is a shame that you cannot stay for dinner.
shame.zh: 你不能留下来吃晚饭，真可惜。

shape.example: The cake was baked in the shape of a heart.
shape.zh: 这个蛋糕是烤成心形的。

share.example: They agreed to share the cost of the new computer.
share.zh: 他们同意分摊这台新电脑的费用。

shark.example: A large shark swam slowly past the small boat.
shark.zh: 一条大鲨鱼慢慢地游过小船旁边。

sharp.example: Be careful with that knife because it is very sharp.
sharp.zh: 小心那把刀，它非常锋利。

shatter.example: The glass fell and shattered into tiny pieces on the floor.
shatter.zh: 杯子掉下来，在地板上摔成了细小的碎片。

shave.example: He has to shave before every important meeting.
shave.zh: 每次重要会议之前他都要刮胡子。

she.example: She always arrives early and leaves a little late.
she.zh: 她总是来得很早，走得稍晚一些。

shed.example: The garden tools are kept in a small wooden shed.
shed.zh: 园艺工具放在一个小木棚里。

sheep.example: The farmer keeps about fifty sheep on the hill.
sheep.zh: 农民在山坡上养了大约五十只羊。

sheer.example: It was sheer luck that we caught the last train.
sheer.zh: 我们赶上末班车纯属运气。

sheet.example: Write your answers on a clean sheet of paper.
sheet.zh: 请把答案写在一张干净的纸上。

shelf.example: The books on the top shelf are hard to reach.
shelf.zh: 最上层架子上的书很难够到。

shell.example: The child picked up a white shell on the beach.
shell.zh: 孩子在沙滩上捡起一个白色的贝壳。

shelter.example: We ran for shelter when the rain suddenly started.
shelter.zh: 雨突然下起来时，我们跑去找地方躲雨。

shepherd.example: The shepherd led his sheep up the hill before sunrise.
shepherd.zh: 牧羊人在日出前把羊群赶上山坡。

shield.example: A thick wall shields the garden from the cold wind.
shield.zh: 一道厚墙为花园挡住了寒风。

shift.example: She works the night shift at the local hospital.

shine.example: The sun began to shine after a long grey morning.
shine.zh: 漫长的阴天早晨过后，太阳开始照耀。

ship.example: The goods will be shipped to the store next week.
ship.zh: 货物将于下周运往那家商店。

shipyard.example: My uncle works in a shipyard near the river.
shipyard.zh: 我叔叔在河边的一家造船厂工作。

shirt.example: He wore a clean white shirt to the interview.
shirt.zh: 他穿着一件干净的白衬衫去面试。

shit.example: He muttered that the whole idea was shit and walked away.
shit.zh: 他嘟囔说这整个想法就是狗屁，然后走开了。

shiver.example: She began to shiver in the cold wind from the sea.
shiver.zh: 海面上吹来的冷风让她开始发抖。

shock.example: The news of the change came as a shock to us all.
shock.zh: 这个变动的消息让我们所有人都很震惊。

shoe.example: One shoe was under the bed and the other was missing.
shoe.zh: 一只鞋在床底下，另一只不见了。

shoot.example: They went to the park to shoot a short film.
shoot.zh: 他们去公园拍一部短片。

shop.example: The little shop on the corner sells fresh bread.
shop.zh: 街角的小店卖新鲜面包。

shore.example: They walked along the shore and collected small stones.
shore.zh: 他们沿着海岸散步，捡了些小石头。

short.example: The meeting was short and we were home by noon.
short.zh: 会议很短，我们中午就到家了。

shortcoming.example: He knows his shortcomings and works hard to improve.
shortcoming.zh: 他知道自己的缺点，并努力改进。

shorthand.example: She took notes in shorthand during the long meeting.
shorthand.zh: 那场漫长的会议中她用速记做笔记。

shortly.example: The bus will arrive shortly, so please wait here.
shortly.zh: 公交车很快就到，请在这里等。

shot.example: He took a quick shot and the ball went in.
shot.zh: 他快速投了一球，球进了。

should.example: You should drink more water when the weather is hot.
should.zh: 天气热的时候你应该多喝水。

shoulder.example: He carried the heavy bag on his shoulder all the way.
shoulder.zh: 他一路把那重袋子扛在肩上。

shout.example: Please do not shout; the baby is sleeping upstairs.
shout.zh: 请不要喊，宝宝在楼上睡觉。

shove.example: He had to shove the heavy box across the floor.
shove.zh: 他不得不把那个重箱子推过地板。

show.example: Let me show you how to use the new machine.
show.zh: 让我示范一下怎么用这台新机器。

showcase.example: The glass showcase holds the most valuable items.
showcase.zh: 玻璃陈列柜里放着最贵重的物品。

shower.example: I take a quick shower before breakfast every morning.
shower.zh: 我每天早上吃早饭前冲个澡。

shred.example: She tore the old letter into shreds and threw it away.
shred.zh: 她把那封旧信撕成碎片扔掉了。

shrewd.example: She is a shrewd buyer who always checks the price.
shrewd.zh: 她是个精明的买主，总要核对价格。

shrimp.example: We had rice with fresh shrimp and vegetables for dinner.
shrimp.zh: 我们晚饭吃了米饭配新鲜虾和蔬菜。

shrink.example: Wool clothes may shrink if you wash them in hot water.
shrink.zh: 羊毛衣物用热水洗可能会缩水。

shrub.example: A small green shrub grows beside the front door.
shrub.zh: 前门旁边长着一丛绿色的矮灌木。

shrug.example: She gave a small shrug and said she did not know.
shrug.zh: 她轻轻耸了耸肩，说不知道。

shut.example: Please shut the window before you leave the room.
shut.zh: 离开房间前请把窗户关上。

shuttle.example: A small bus shuttles between the hotel and the airport.
shuttle.zh: 一辆小巴往返于酒店和机场之间。

shy.example: The shy boy stood quietly at the back of the room.
shy.zh: 那个害羞的男孩安静地站在房间后面。

sick.example: He stayed home because he felt sick this morning.
sick.zh: 他今天早上觉得不舒服，就待在家里。

side.example: There is a small door on the side of the building.
side.zh: 这栋楼的一侧有一扇小门。

sideways.example: He turned his head sideways to look at the map.
sideways.zh: 他把头转向一侧去看地图。

siege.example: The castle survived a long siege during the winter.
siege.zh: 那座城堡在冬天经受住了长时间的围攻。

sigh.example: She gave a long sigh and closed the book.
sigh.zh: 她长长地叹了口气，合上了书。

sight.example: The mountains were a wonderful sight after the long journey.
sight.zh: 长途旅行之后，群山是极美的景色。

sightseeing.example: We spent the whole afternoon sightseeing around the old town.
sightseeing.zh: 我们花了一整个下午在老城观光。

sign.example: He signed the form and handed it back to the clerk.
sign.zh: 他在表格上签了名，然后交还给职员。

signal.example: The driver gave a signal before turning left.
signal.zh: 司机在左转前打了转向信号。

significant.example: The study found a significant difference between the two groups.
significant.zh: 这项研究发现两组之间存在显著差异。

signify.example: A nod of the head can signify agreement in many places.
signify.zh: 在许多地方，点头可以表示同意。

silent.example: The whole room went silent when the teacher walked in.
silent.zh: 老师走进来时，整个房间都安静下来。

silicon.example: The chip is made of silicon and other common materials.
silicon.zh: 这种芯片由硅和其他常见材料制成。

silk.example: She bought a soft silk scarf for her mother.
silk.zh: 她给妈妈买了一条柔软的丝巾。

silver.example: He gave her a small silver ring for her birthday.
silver.zh: 他送了她一枚小银戒指作为生日礼物。

similar.example: These two pictures look very similar at first glance.
similar.zh: 这两张图片乍看之下非常相似。

simple.example: The instructions were simple enough for a child to follow.
simple.zh: 这些说明很简单，连孩子都能照着做。

simulate.example: The program can simulate the movement of the planets.
simulate.zh: 这个程序可以模拟行星的运动。

simultaneous.example: The two events were simultaneous, so we could not attend both.
simultaneous.zh: 两场活动同时举行，所以我们没法都参加。

sin.example: She felt it was a sin to waste so much good food.
sin.zh: 她觉得浪费这么多好食物是一种罪过。

since.example: He has lived in the city since he finished school.
since.zh: 他毕业后就一直住在这座城市。

sincere.example: Her sincere apology made everyone feel better about the mistake.
sincere.zh: 她真诚的道歉让大家对这个错误不那么在意了。

sing.example: The children sing a short song before class each morning.
sing.zh: 孩子们每天早上上课前唱一首短歌。

single.example: He lives alone in a single room near the office.
single.zh: 他独自住在办公室附近的一间单人房里。

singular.example: Put the verb in the singular form when the subject is one person.
singular.zh: 当主语是一个人时，把动词用单数形式。

sinister.example: There was something sinister about the empty house on the hill.
sinister.zh: 山上那座空房子让人感到有些凶险。

sink.example: The dishes are still in the sink waiting to be washed.
sink.zh: 盘子还在水槽里等着洗。

sip.example: She took a small sip of the hot tea.

sir.example: Excuse me, sir, could you tell me the way to the station?
sir.zh: 打扰一下，先生，您能告诉我去车站的路吗？

sister.example: My sister and I walk to school together every morning.
sister.zh: 我和姐姐每天早上一起走路去学校。

sit.example: Please sit down and wait for your name to be called.
sit.zh: 请坐下，等着叫你的名字。

site.example: They chose a quiet site for the new school.
site.zh: 他们为新学校选了一处安静的地点。

situate.example: The hotel is situated near the station and the park.
situate.zh: 这家酒店位于车站和公园附近。

situation.example: He explained the situation clearly and asked for our help.
situation.zh: 他把情况讲得很清楚，并请我们帮忙。

six.example: There are six chairs around the small kitchen table.
six.zh: 小餐桌周围有六把椅子。

sixteen.example: She will turn sixteen next month and wants a bike.
sixteen.zh: 她下个月就十六岁了，想要一辆自行车。

sixty.example: The old clock has been running for sixty years.
sixty.zh: 这座老钟已经走了六十年。

size.example: Do you have this shirt in a larger size?
size.zh: 这件衬衫有更大一号的吗？

skate.example: The children like to skate on the frozen lake in winter.
skate.zh: 孩子们喜欢冬天在结冰的湖面上滑冰。

skeleton.example: The museum has a complete dinosaur skeleton in the main hall.
skeleton.zh: 博物馆的主展厅里有一具完整的恐龙骨架。

skeptical.example: Many people were skeptical about the new plan at first.
skeptical.zh: 起初很多人对这个新计划持怀疑态度。

sketch.example: He drew a quick sketch of the tree in his notebook.
sketch.zh: 他在笔记本上给那棵树画了张速写。

ski.example: We learned to ski on a small hill near the hotel.
ski.zh: 我们在酒店附近的小山坡上学会了滑雪。

skill.example: Learning a new skill takes time and daily practice.
skill.zh: 学习一项新技能需要时间和每天的练习。

skim.example: She had only a few minutes to skim the report.
skim.zh: 她只有几分钟时间浏览这份报告。

skin.example: Protect your skin from the sun when you work outside.
skin.zh: 在户外工作时要注意保护皮肤免受日晒。

skip.example: You can skip the first chapter if you are short of time.
skip.zh: 如果时间紧，你可以跳过第一章。

skirt.example: She wore a blue skirt and a white shirt.
skirt.zh: 她穿了一条蓝裙子和一件白衬衫。

skull.example: The bird had a small skull and a very long beak.
skull.zh: 这只鸟头骨很小，喙却很长。

sky.example: The sky turned dark just before the storm arrived.
sky.zh: 暴风雨来临前，天空变暗了。

skyline.example: The city skyline looks beautiful from across the water.
skyline.zh: 从水对岸望去，城市的天际线很美。

skyscraper.example: A tall skyscraper now stands where the old shop was.
skyscraper.zh: 原来那家旧商店的位置上现在矗立着一座高耸的摩天大楼。

slack.example: Business is usually slack in the weeks after the holiday.
slack.zh: 假期后的几周生意通常比较清淡。

slam.example: She had to slam the door to make it close.
slam.zh: 她不得不使劲关门才把它关上。

slap.example: He gave the table a loud slap to get everyone's attention.
slap.zh: 他重重地拍了一下桌子，让大家注意。

slash.example: The company had to slash prices to sell its old stock.
slash.zh: 公司不得不大幅降价来卖掉旧库存。

slaughter.example: The farmer sent his cattle to slaughter at the end of autumn.
slaughter.zh: 秋末农民把他的牛送去屠宰。

slave.example: He works like a slave to finish the project on time.
slave.zh: 为了按时完成项目，他像奴隶一样拼命工作。

sleep.example: Most adults need about eight hours of sleep each night.
sleep.zh: 大多数成年人每晚需要大约八小时睡眠。

sleeve.example: He rolled up his sleeve and washed his hands.

slender.example: The tall girl had long slender fingers and a quiet voice.
slender.zh: 那个高个子女孩手指细长，声音轻柔。

slice.example: Please cut me a thin slice of bread for breakfast.
slice.zh: 请给我切一片薄薄的面包当早餐。

slide.example: The children love to slide down the hill in winter.
slide.zh: 孩子们喜欢冬天从山坡上滑下来。

slight.example: There was a slight change in the weather after lunch.
slight.zh: 午饭后天气有了一点变化。

slim.example: She stayed slim by walking to work every morning.
slim.zh: 她每天早上走路上班，保持了苗条的身材。

slip.example: Be careful not to slip on the wet kitchen floor.
slip.zh: 小心别在湿的厨房地板上滑倒。

slogan.example: The company chose a short slogan that people could remember.
slogan.zh: 公司选了一句人们容易记住的简短口号。

slope.example: The house stands on a gentle slope above the river.
slope.zh: 这所房子坐落在河上方的一处缓坡上。

slot.example: Put the coin into the slot and press the green button.
slot.zh: 把硬币投进投币口，然后按绿色按钮。

slow.example: The old bus is very slow on this narrow mountain road.
slow.zh: 这辆旧公交车在这条狭窄的山路上开得很慢。

slum.example: Many families in the slum still lack clean water and electricity.
slum.zh: 贫民窟里的许多家庭仍然缺少干净的水和电。

slump.example: Sales slumped badly last winter when the weather turned very cold.
slump.zh: 去年冬天天气变得很冷时，销量大幅下滑。

small.example: She keeps her small garden full of bright flowers all summer.
small.zh: 整个夏天，她的小花园里都开满了鲜艳的花。

smart.example: He is smart enough to solve the problem without any help.
smart.zh: 他足够聪明，不需要任何帮助就能解决这个问题。

smartphone.example: My smartphone battery dies quickly when I watch too many videos.
smartphone.zh: 我看太多视频时，我的智能手机电池很快就没电了。

smash.example: The ball smashed the kitchen window during the children's game.
smash.zh: 孩子们玩耍时，球打碎了厨房的窗户。

smell.example: The kitchen smelled wonderful when my mother baked fresh bread.
smell.zh: 妈妈烤新鲜面包时，厨房里闻起来香极了。

smile.example: She gave me a warm smile and welcomed me into the room.
smile.zh: 她给了我一个温暖的微笑，把我迎进房间。

smog.example: Thick smog covered the city and made the buildings hard to see.
smog.zh: 浓重的烟雾笼罩着这座城市，使建筑物难以看清。

smoke.example: Smoke from the kitchen fire rose slowly above the old roof.
smoke.zh: 厨房炉火冒出的烟缓缓升到旧屋顶上方。

smooth.example: The table has a smooth surface that is easy to clean.
smooth.zh: 这张桌子表面光滑，很容易清洁。

smuggle.example: They tried to smuggle fresh fruit across the border in boxes.
smuggle.zh: 他们试图把新鲜水果装在箱子里偷运过边境。

snack.example: I usually have a light snack between lunch and dinner.
snack.zh: 我通常在午饭和晚饭之间吃一点小吃。

snail.example: A small snail moved slowly across the wet garden path.
snail.zh: 一只小蜗牛慢慢地爬过潮湿的花园小径。

snake.example: The snake disappeared into the tall grass near the river.
snake.zh: 那条蛇消失在河边高高的草丛里。

snap.example: Be careful, or the thin branch will snap under your weight.
snap.zh: 小心，否则那根细枝会在你的重量下折断。

snatch.example: The boy snatched the last cookie from the plate and ran away.
snatch.zh: 男孩从盘子里抢走最后一块饼干就跑开了。

sneak.example: She tried to sneak quietly into the room without waking anyone.
sneak.zh: 她试图悄悄地溜进房间，不吵醒任何人。

sniff.example: The dog stopped to sniff the flowers along the garden wall.
sniff.zh: 狗停下来嗅了嗅园墙边的花。

snob.example: He is such a snob that he ignores people from small towns.
snob.zh: 他非常势利，瞧不起来自小城镇的人。

snow.example: Heavy snow covered the fields and stopped all the buses today.
snow.zh: 大雪覆盖了田野，今天所有的公共汽车都停运了。

so.example: It was so cold outside that we stayed home all day.
so.zh: 外面太冷了，我们整天都待在家里。

so-called.example: The so-called shortcut turned out to be much longer than expected.
so-called.zh: 所谓的近路结果比预想的远得多。

soak.example: Leave the dirty clothes to soak in warm water for an hour.
soak.zh: 把脏衣服放在温水里浸泡一个小时。

soap.example: Please wash your hands with soap before you eat anything.
soap.zh: 吃东西前请用肥皂洗手。

soar.example: The eagle soared high above the valley on the warm air.
soar.zh: 那只鹰乘着暖气流在山谷上空高高翱翔。

sob.example: The little girl began to sob when her toy broke.
sob.zh: 玩具坏了，小女孩开始抽泣。

sober.example: After a long sleep he felt sober and ready to drive.
sober.zh: 睡了一大觉之后，他觉得自己清醒了，可以开车了。

soccer.example: My brother plays soccer with his friends every Saturday morning.
soccer.zh: 我弟弟每周六上午和朋友们踢足球。

socialism.example: They studied socialism and its history in their final year.
socialism.zh: 他们在最后一年学习了社会主义及其历史。

society.example: Modern society depends heavily on computers and fast communication networks.
society.zh: 现代社会在很大程度上依赖计算机和快速的通信网络。

sociology.example: She chose sociology because she enjoys studying how people live.
sociology.zh: 她选择了社会学，因为她喜欢研究人们如何生活。

sock.example: One red sock is missing from the drawer again.
sock.zh: 抽屉里又少了一只红袜子。

socket.example: The lamp does not work because the socket is broken.

soda.example: He added a little soda to the cake mixture.
soda.zh: 他在蛋糕糊里加了一点苏打。

sodium.example: This food contains a lot of sodium, so it tastes quite salty.
sodium.zh: 这种食物含钠很多，所以味道相当咸。

sofa.example: The cat likes to sleep on the soft sofa all afternoon.
sofa.zh: 猫喜欢整个下午睡在柔软的沙发上。

soft.example: This pillow is so soft that I fall asleep quickly.
soft.zh: 这个枕头很软，我很快就睡着了。

software.example: The new software makes it easier to organize my daily work.
software.zh: 新软件让我更容易整理日常工作。

soil.example: The soil here is rich and good for growing vegetables.
soil.zh: 这里的土壤肥沃，适合种蔬菜。

solar.example: They installed solar panels on the roof to save electricity.
solar.zh: 他们在屋顶上安装了太阳能板以节省电费。

soldier.example: The soldier stood quietly at the gate and watched the road.
soldier.zh: 那名士兵静静地站在大门口，望着大路。

sole.example: She was the sole person who knew the answer to that question.
sole.zh: 她是唯一知道那个问题答案的人。

solemn.example: His solemn face told us that the news was not good.
solemn.zh: 他严肃的表情告诉我们情况不太好。

solicit.example: The shop put a sign outside to solicit new customers.
solicit.zh: 商店在门外摆了一块招牌来招揽新顾客。

solid.example: The table feels solid and will last for many years.
solid.zh: 这张桌子摸着很结实，能用很多年。

solidarity.example: The workers showed solidarity by supporting each other during the hard time.
solidarity.zh: 工人们在困难时期互相支持，表现出团结一致。

solitary.example: He leads a solitary life and rarely leaves his small house.
solitary.zh: 他过着独居的生活，很少离开他那栋小房子。

solo.example: She sang a solo at the school concert last night.
solo.zh: 昨晚她在学校音乐会上独唱了一首。

solve.example: We must solve this problem before the end of next week.
solve.zh: 我们必须在下周末之前解决这个问题。

some.example: Some of the students stayed after class to ask questions.
some.zh: 一些学生下课后留下来问问题。

somebody.example: Somebody left an umbrella in the classroom this morning.
somebody.zh: 今天早上有人在教室里落下了一把伞。

somehow.example: Somehow he managed to finish all the work on time.
somehow.zh: 不知何故，他设法按时完成了所有工作。

someone.example: Someone is knocking at the door, please go and see who it is.
someone.zh: 有人在敲门，请去看看是谁。

something.example: I have something important to tell you before the meeting.
something.zh: 开会前我有一件重要的事要告诉你。

sometime.example: Please come and visit us sometime next month.
sometime.zh: 请在下个月找个时间来拜访我们。

sometimes.example: Sometimes I walk to the office instead of taking the bus.
sometimes.zh: 有时我步行去办公室，而不坐公交车。

somewhat.example: The room is somewhat small, but it is clean and bright.
somewhat.zh: 房间有点小，但干净明亮。

somewhere.example: I left my keys somewhere in the living room last night.
somewhere.zh: 昨晚我把钥匙落在客厅的某个地方了。

son.example: Their son studies music and plays the piano very well.
son.zh: 他们的儿子学音乐，钢琴弹得很好。

song.example: This song always reminds me of my happy school days.
song.zh: 这首歌总是让我想起快乐的学校时光。

soon.example: The train will arrive soon, so please wait here quietly.
soon.zh: 火车很快就到，请在这里安静等候。

soothe.example: Soft music helped soothe the baby and she fell asleep.
soothe.zh: 轻柔的音乐使婴儿安静下来，她睡着了。

sophisticated.example: The lab uses sophisticated equipment to test very small samples.
sophisticated.zh: 实验室使用精密的设备来检测很小的样本。

sore.example: My throat is sore because I have been talking all day.
sore.zh: 我嗓子疼，因为我整天都在说话。

sorrow.example: Her eyes were full of sorrow after the sad news.
sorrow.zh: 听到那个悲伤的消息后，她眼里满是哀伤。

sorry.example: I am sorry that I forgot your birthday this year.
sorry.zh: 很抱歉我今年忘了你的生日。

sort.example: Please sort these papers into three piles by date.
sort.zh: 请把这些文件按日期分成三堆。

soul.example: The music touched her soul and brought tears to her eyes.
soul.zh: 那音乐触动了她的心灵，让她热泪盈眶。

sound.example: The sound of rain on the roof helped me fall asleep.
sound.zh: 屋顶上雨点的声音帮我入睡了。

soup.example: My mother makes a warm vegetable soup every Sunday evening.
soup.zh: 妈妈每个星期日晚上都做一锅热腾腾的蔬菜汤。

sour.example: The milk has gone sour and should not be used.
sour.zh: 牛奶已经酸了，不该再用了。

source.example: The sun is our main source of light and heat.
source.zh: 太阳是我们光和热的主要来源。

south.example: They moved south last year to find a warmer climate.
south.zh: 他们去年搬到南方，去寻找更温暖的气候。

southeast.example: The wind blows from the southeast during the summer months.
southeast.zh: 夏季的几个月里，风从东南方吹来。

southwest.example: Our window faces southwest, so we get plenty of sunshine.
southwest.zh: 我们的窗户朝西南，所以阳光充足。

souvenir.example: She bought a small souvenir from the seaside town for her friend.
souvenir.zh: 她从一个海滨小镇给朋友买了一件小纪念品。

sovereign.example: The old coin shows a picture of the sovereign on one side.
sovereign.zh: 这枚旧硬币的一面印着元首的头像。

sow.example: Farmers sow seeds in spring and harvest them in autumn.
sow.zh: 农民春天播种，秋天收获。

space.example: There is not enough space in the car for the boxes.
space.zh: 车里没有足够的空间放这些箱子。

spaceship.example: The spaceship carried three people into space and returned safely.
spaceship.zh: 这艘宇宙飞船载着三人进入太空，并安全返回。

spade.example: He dug a hole in the garden with an old spade.
spade.zh: 他用一把旧铲子在花园里挖了一个洞。

spaghetti.example: We cooked spaghetti with tomatoes and cheese for a quick dinner.
spaghetti.zh: 晚饭我们做了番茄奶酪意大利面条，很快就吃上了。

span.example: The bridge has a wide span and is very strong.
span.zh: 这座桥跨度很大，而且非常坚固。

spare.example: I keep a spare key in my desk drawer for emergencies.
spare.zh: 我在书桌抽屉里放了一把备用钥匙以备急用。

spark.example: A single spark from the old wire could start a fire.
spark.zh: 旧电线冒出的一点火花就可能引起火灾。

sparkle.example: The stars sparkle brightly over the quiet fields at night.
sparkle.zh: 夜晚，星星在宁静的田野上空明亮地闪烁。

speak.example: Please speak slowly and clearly so everyone can understand you.
speak.zh: 请说得慢一些、清楚一些，让每个人都能听懂。

spear.example: The fisherman held a long spear and watched the water.
spear.zh: 渔夫握着一支长矛，注视着水面。

special.example: We are planning a special dinner for her birthday.
special.zh: 我们正在为她的生日筹划一顿特别的晚餐。

specialty.example: Fresh fish is the specialty of this small seaside restaurant.
specialty.zh: 鲜鱼是这家海边小餐馆的特色菜。

species.example: This species of bird builds its nest near the water.

specific.example: Please give me a specific example of the problem you mean.
specific.zh: 请给我一个你说的这个问题的具体例子。

specify.example: The form asks you to specify your arrival date and time.
specify.zh: 这张表格要求你说明到达的日期和时间。

specimen.example: The scientist collected a small specimen of the rock for testing.
specimen.zh: 科学家采集了一小块岩石标本用于检测。

spectacle.example: The fireworks over the lake were a wonderful spectacle for everyone.
spectacle.zh: 湖面上的烟火对每个人来说都是一场美妙的景象。

spectator.example: Every spectator stood up and cheered at the end of the match.
spectator.zh: 比赛结束时，每位观众都站起来欢呼。

spectrum.example: Sunlight contains a wide spectrum of colors that we can separate.
spectrum.zh: 阳光包含很宽的光谱，我们可以把它分解开来。

speculate.example: People still speculate about the reason for his sudden move.
speculate.zh: 人们仍在推测他突然搬走的原因。

speech.example: He gave a short speech at the opening of the new library.
speech.zh: 他在新图书馆落成仪式上做了简短的演讲。

speed.example: The train gains speed quickly after it leaves the station.
speed.zh: 火车离开车站后很快就加速了。

spell.example: Can you spell your last name for me, please?
spell.zh: 你能为我拼一下你的姓吗？

spend.example: I spend two hours reading English every evening after dinner.
spend.zh: 我每天晚上晚饭后花两小时读英语。

sphere.example: The lamp is shaped like a glass sphere above the table.
sphere.zh: 这盏灯的形状像一个玻璃球，悬在桌子上方。

spice.example: A little spice makes this soup taste much more interesting.
spice.zh: 加一点香料能让这汤的味道有趣得多。

spider.example: A small spider built its web between two garden plants.
spider.zh: 一只小蜘蛛在两株花园植物之间结了网。

spill.example: Please carry the soup carefully so it does not spill.
spill.zh: 请小心端汤，别让它洒出来。

spin.example: The wheels began to spin quickly as the car moved forward.
spin.zh: 汽车前进时，轮子开始快速旋转。

spine.example: He hurt his spine when he fell from the ladder.
spine.zh: 他从梯子上摔下来，伤了脊椎。

spiral.example: A spiral staircase led up to the top of the tower.
spiral.zh: 一道螺旋楼梯通向塔顶。

spirit.example: She has a strong spirit and never gives up easily.
spirit.zh: 她精神坚强，从不轻易放弃。

spit.example: He was warned not to spit on the street again.
spit.zh: 他被警告不要再在街上吐痰。

spite.example: In spite of the rain, the children played outside happily.
spite.zh: 尽管下雨，孩子们还是在外面玩得很开心。

splash.example: The children love to splash water in the small pool.
splash.zh: 孩子们喜欢在小水池里泼水。

splendid.example: The view from the hill was splendid on that clear morning.
splendid.zh: 在那个晴朗的早晨，从山上看到的景色十分壮丽。

split.example: Let us split the work and finish it before noon.
split.zh: 我们把工作分开做，在中午前完成吧。

spoil.example: Too much rain can spoil the vegetables in the garden.
spoil.zh: 雨水太多会把花园里的蔬菜糟蹋了。

spokesman.example: A spokesman for the company answered questions from the newspaper.
spokesman.zh: 公司的一位发言人回答了报纸的提问。

sponge.example: She cleaned the table with a wet sponge and some soap.
sponge.zh: 她用湿海绵和一些肥皂把桌子擦干净了。

sponsor.example: A local company agreed to sponsor the school sports event.
sponsor.zh: 一家本地公司同意赞助学校的体育活动。

spontaneous.example: Her spontaneous laughter made everyone in the room feel happy.
spontaneous.zh: 她不由自主的笑声让屋里的每个人都感到开心。

spoon.example: Please give me a spoon so I can eat the soup.
spoon.zh: 请给我一把勺子，这样我就能喝汤了。

sport.example: Swimming is a popular sport among students in hot weather.
sport.zh: 天气炎热时，游泳在学生中是一项受欢迎的运动。

sportsman.example: The young sportsman trains every morning before school starts.
sportsman.zh: 这位年轻的运动员每天早上在上学之前训练。

spot.example: There is a small ink spot on the left sleeve.
spot.zh: 左边袖子上有一个小墨点。

spotlight.example: The spotlight followed the singer across the dark stage.
spotlight.zh: 聚光灯跟着歌手穿过昏暗的舞台。

spouse.example: You may bring your spouse and children to the party.
spouse.zh: 你可以带配偶和孩子一起来参加聚会。

sprawl.example: He sprawled on the sofa after a long and tiring day.
sprawl.zh: 忙碌疲倦的一天之后，他摊开四肢倒在沙发上。

spray.example: She used a spray to give the plants more water.
spray.zh: 她用一个喷雾器给植物多浇了些水。

spread.example: Butter spreads more easily when it is not too cold.
spread.zh: 黄油不太冷的时候更容易涂抹开。

spring.example: We visited the park in spring when the flowers opened.
spring.zh: 春天花开的时候，我们去了公园。

sprinkle.example: Sprinkle a little salt and pepper on the eggs.
sprinkle.zh: 在鸡蛋上撒一点盐和胡椒。

spur.example: Good teachers know how to spur students to try harder.
spur.zh: 好老师知道如何激励学生更加努力。

spy.example: In the story, a spy follows the traveler through the old town.
spy.zh: 故事里，一名间谍在旧城里跟着那位旅行者。

squad.example: A small squad of workers repaired the road last week.
squad.zh: 上周一小组工人修好了这条路。

square.example: They sat in the square and watched people walk past.
square.zh: 他们坐在广场上看人们走过。

squeeze.example: Gently squeeze the lemon to get a little juice.
squeeze.zh: 轻轻挤压柠檬，挤出一点果汁。

stab.example: He felt a sudden stab of pain in his right knee.
stab.zh: 他突然感到右膝一阵刺痛。

stable.example: The old bridge is not stable enough for heavy trucks.
stable.zh: 这座旧桥不够稳固，承受不了重型卡车。

stack.example: There is a tall stack of books beside my bed.
stack.zh: 我床边有一摞高高的书。

stadium.example: Thousands of people filled the stadium to watch the match.
stadium.zh: 成千上万的人挤满体育场观看比赛。

staff.example: All the staff attended the meeting on Monday morning.
staff.zh: 全体职员都参加了周一上午的会议。

stage.example: The actors walked onto the stage and the lights went down.
stage.zh: 演员们走上舞台，灯光暗了下来。

stagger.example: The tired man staggered home through the heavy rain.
stagger.zh: 那个疲倦的男人冒着大雨踉踉跄跄地走回家。

stagnate.example: Without new ideas, the business began to stagnate last year.
stagnate.zh: 由于缺少新想法，这家公司去年开始停滞不前。

stain.example: Coffee left a dark stain on the front of my shirt.
stain.zh: 咖啡在我衬衫前面留下了一块深色污渍。

stair.example: He walked up the stairs slowly with a heavy bag.
stair.zh: 他提着一个沉重的包，慢慢走上楼梯。

staircase.example: A wooden staircase leads to the bedrooms on the top floor.
staircase.zh: 一段木楼梯通向顶层的卧室。

stake.example: Each player put a small stake on the result of the game.
stake.zh: 每位玩家都在这场比赛的结果上押了一点赌注。

stale.example: The bread had gone stale and hard after a few days.
stale.zh: 几天后，面包变得不新鲜，硬邦邦的。

stalk.example: The plant has a thick green stalk and narrow leaves.
stalk.zh: 这株植物有一根粗壮的绿色茎和细长的叶子。

stall.example: He bought fresh fruit from a small stall by the road.
stall.zh: 他在路边的小摊上买了新鲜水果。

stammer.example: He began to stammer when the teacher asked him a question.
stammer.zh: 老师问他问题时，他开始结结巴巴地说话。

stamp.example: She put a stamp on the envelope and posted the letter.
stamp.zh: 她在信封上贴了邮票，把信寄了出去。

stance.example: Try to keep a relaxed stance while you wait for the ball.
stance.zh: 等球的时候，尽量保持放松的站立姿势。

stand.example: We had to stand in line for almost an hour.
stand.zh: 我们不得不排队站了将近一个小时。

standard.example: This machine meets the required safety standard and works well.
standard.zh: 这台机器符合规定的安全标准，运行良好。

standby.example: A backup generator is on standby in case the power fails.
standby.zh: 一台备用发电机随时待命，以防停电。

standpoint.example: From a teacher's standpoint, the new plan makes good sense.
standpoint.zh: 从老师的立场看，这个新计划很有道理。

staple.example: He pressed a staple through the papers to keep them together.
staple.zh: 他按下一枚订书钉，把纸张固定在一起。

stapler.example: The stapler on my desk is empty and needs more staples.
stapler.zh: 我桌上的订书机空了，需要装更多订书钉。

star.example: A bright star appeared in the sky above the hills.
star.zh: 山丘上方的天空中，出现了一颗明亮的星星。

stare.example: The child stared at the huge fish in the tank.
stare.zh: 那个孩子盯着水箱里的大鱼看。

stark.example: The empty room looked stark with no furniture at all.
stark.zh: 那个空房间没有任何家具，显得十分荒凉。

start.example: The lesson will start at nine in the morning.
start.zh: 课程将在早上九点开始。

startle.example: The loud noise startled the birds in the garden.
startle.zh: 巨大的声响惊飞了花园里的鸟。

starve.example: Some birds starve when the cold weather lasts too long.
starve.zh: 天气寒冷持续太久时，有些鸟会饿死。

state.example: Please state your name and address clearly on the form.
state.zh: 请在表格上清楚地写明你的姓名和地址。

statesman.example: The old statesman was respected for his honesty and calm judgment.
statesman.zh: 这位年长的政治家因诚实和冷静的判断而受人尊敬。

static.example: The image on the screen stayed static for several minutes.
static.zh: 屏幕上的图像静止不动了好几分钟。

station.example: We waited for the train at a small quiet station.
station.zh: 我们在一个安静的小车站等火车。

stationery.example: The office needs more stationery, such as paper and pens.
stationery.zh: 办公室需要更多文具，比如纸和笔。

statistic.example: One statistic shows that most accidents happen close to home.
statistic.zh: 一项统计数据显示，大多数事故发生在离家很近的地方。

statue.example: A bronze statue of a horse stands in the middle of the square.
statue.zh: 广场中央立着一匹马的青铜雕像。

status.example: Her status in the company rose after the successful project.
status.zh: 那个项目成功后，她在公司的地位提高了。

statute.example: The new statute requires shops to close before midnight.
statute.zh: 新的法规要求商店在午夜前关门。

stay.example: We decided to stay at home because of the heavy rain.
stay.zh: 因为大雨，我们决定待在家里。

steady.example: His hands were steady as he painted the thin line.
steady.zh: 他画那条细线时，手很稳。

steak.example: He ordered a thick steak with potatoes and green beans.
steak.zh: 他点了一份厚牛排，配土豆和青豆。

steal.example: Someone tried to steal my bike outside the shop.
steal.zh: 有人想在商店外偷我的自行车。

steam.example: Steam rose from the hot soup on the table.
steam.zh: 热气从桌上的热汤里升起来。

steel.example: The bridge is made of steel and strong concrete.
steel.zh: 这座桥由钢材和坚固的混凝土建成。

steep.example: The path up the hill is too steep for young children.
steep.zh: 上山的小路对小孩子来说太陡了。

steer.example: She held the wheel and steered the boat toward the shore.
steer.zh: 她握着舵，把船驶向岸边。

stem.example: The flower has a long green stem and small white petals.
stem.zh: 这朵花有一根长长的绿色花茎和小小的白色花瓣。

step.example: Take one step forward and then stop on the line.
step.zh: 向前迈一步，然后在线上停下。

stereotype.example: It is unfair to judge people by a stereotype.
stereotype.zh: 用刻板印象来评判人是不公平的。

stern.example: The teacher gave us a stern look and asked for silence.
stern.zh: 老师严厉地看了我们一眼，要求大家安静。

steward.example: The steward brought us water and a warm blanket.
steward.zh: 乘务员给我们送来了水和一条温暖的毯子。

stick.example: He used a thin stick to draw lines in the sand.
stick.zh: 他用一根细树枝在沙地上画线。

sticky.example: The child's hands were sticky after eating the sweet cake.
sticky.zh: 孩子吃完甜蛋糕后，双手黏黏的。

stiff.example: My neck felt stiff after sitting at the desk all day.
stiff.zh: 在书桌前坐了一整天，我的脖子发僵。

stifle.example: She had to stifle a laugh during the quiet meeting.
stifle.zh: 在那场安静的会议上，她不得不忍住笑。

stigma.example: There is still a social stigma attached to failing an exam.
stigma.zh: 考试不及格仍然带着一种社会污名。

still.example: He was still working at the desk when the sun came up.
still.zh: 太阳升起时，他还在书桌前工作。

stimulate.example: The teacher used games to stimulate interest in the subject.
stimulate.zh: 老师用游戏来激发学生对这门学科的兴趣。

sting.example: A bee may sting you if you touch its home.
sting.zh: 如果你碰它的窝，蜜蜂可能会蜇你。

stipulate.example: The contract stipulates that rent must be paid each month.
stipulate.zh: 合同规定租金必须每月支付。

stir.example: She stirred the soup slowly with a long wooden spoon.
stir.zh: 她用一把长木勺慢慢搅动汤。

stitch.example: The doctor put a small stitch in the cut on my hand.
stitch.zh: 医生在我手上的伤口处缝了一针。

stock.example: The shop has plenty of winter coats in stock right now.
stock.zh: 这家店现在库存里有很多冬衣。

stocking.example: The shop sells warm wool stockings for the winter months.
stocking.zh: 这家店出售适合冬季的保暖羊毛长袜。

stomach.example: My stomach felt much better after a light breakfast and tea.
stomach.zh: 吃了一顿清淡的早餐、喝了茶之后，我的胃舒服多了。

stone.example: He threw a flat stone across the quiet lake.
stone.zh: 他把一块扁平的石头扔过平静的湖面。

stool.example: She sat on a tall wooden stool by the kitchen counter.
stool.zh: 她坐在厨房操作台旁的一张高木凳上。

stoop.example: He had to stoop to pick up the fallen paper.
stoop.zh: 他不得不弯下腰去捡掉落的纸。

stop.example: The bus will stop here every morning at eight.
stop.zh: 这趟公交车每天早上八点会在这里停。

storage.example: We keep the winter clothes in storage under the bed.
storage.zh: 我们把冬衣存放在床底下。

store.example: The little store on the corner sells fresh bread.
store.zh: 街角的小店卖新鲜面包。

storm.example: A heavy storm kept us indoors for the whole afternoon.
storm.zh: 一场大暴风雨让我们整个下午都待在室内。

story.example: My grandmother told us a story about her first job.
story.zh: 奶奶给我们讲了一个关于她第一份工作的故事。

stout.example: The farmer was a stout man with a loud laugh.
stout.zh: 那个农夫是个矮胖结实的男人，笑声很响。

stove.example: She left the soup on the stove for too long.
stove.zh: 她把汤放在炉子上太久了。

straight.example: Draw a straight line from the top to the bottom.
straight.zh: 从顶部到底部画一条直线。

straightforward.example: The instructions are straightforward and easy for anyone to follow.
straightforward.zh: 这些说明简单明了，任何人都很容易照做。

strain.example: The long journey put a strain on his back.
strain.zh: 长途旅行让他的背部承受了很大压力。

strait.example: The ship sailed slowly through the narrow strait at dawn.
strait.zh: 船在黎明时缓慢地穿过狭窄的海峡。

strand.example: One strand of the rope had broken in the wind.
strand.zh: 绳子的一股在风中断了。

strange.example: It felt strange to be back in that quiet old house.
strange.zh: 回到那栋安静的老房子，感觉很奇怪。

strangle.example: Too many rules can strangle a small business.
strangle.zh: 过多的规定会扼杀一家小企业。

strap.example: He tightened the strap on his bag before the walk.
strap.zh: 出发散步前，他把包上的带子拉紧了。

strategy.example: The team met to plan a better strategy for the game.
strategy.zh: 队员们聚在一起，为比赛制定更好的策略。

straw.example: She drank the juice through a thin paper straw.
straw.zh: 她用一根细纸吸管喝果汁。

stray.example: A stray dog followed the children all the way home.
stray.zh: 一只流浪狗一路跟着孩子们回家。

streak.example: A bright streak of light crossed the dark sky.
streak.zh: 一道明亮的光划过黑暗的天空。

stream.example: A small stream runs behind the old wooden house.
stream.zh: 一条小溪从老木屋后面流过。

streamline.example: The team hopes to streamline the process and save time.
streamline.zh: 团队希望简化流程、节省时间。

street.example: The narrow street was quiet after the rain had stopped.
street.zh: 雨停之后，狭窄的街道很安静。

stress.example: The job puts a lot of stress on young workers.
stress.zh: 这份工作给年轻员工带来很大的压力。

stretch.example: He stood up to stretch his arms and legs.
stretch.zh: 他站起来伸展胳膊和腿。

strict.example: Our teacher is strict about handing in work on time.
strict.zh: 我们老师对按时交作业要求很严格。

stride.example: She walked with long strides across the empty field.
stride.zh: 她迈着大步走过空旷的田野。

strike.example: The workers went on strike for better pay and safer conditions.
strike.zh: 工人们为了更好的工资和更安全的工作条件举行罢工。

string.example: She tied the box with a piece of thin string.
string.zh: 她用一根细绳把盒子捆好。

strip.example: He cut the paper into a long thin strip.
strip.zh: 他把纸剪成一条细长的纸条。

stripe.example: The shirt has a blue stripe down each sleeve.
stripe.zh: 这件衬衫的每只袖子上都有一条蓝色条纹。

strive.example: We must strive to do our best in every task.
strive.zh: 我们必须努力在每项任务中做到最好。

stroke.example: She painted the wall with long, even strokes of color.
stroke.zh: 她用长而均匀的笔触粉刷墙壁。

stroll.example: We took a slow stroll along the river after dinner.
stroll.zh: 晚饭后我们沿着河边慢慢散步。

strong.example: She is strong enough to carry the heavy box alone.
strong.zh: 她足够强壮，能独自搬动那个沉重的箱子。

structure.example: The structure of the old bridge is still very solid.
structure.zh: 这座老桥的结构仍然非常坚固。

struggle.example: He had to struggle to open the frozen window.
struggle.zh: 他费了好大劲才打开冻住的窗户。

stubborn.example: My stubborn brother refused to admit that he was wrong.
stubborn.zh: 我固执的弟弟不肯承认自己错了。

student.example: Each student must bring a notebook to every class.
student.zh: 每个学生每次上课都必须带笔记本。

studio.example: The artist works in a bright studio near the river.
studio.zh: 这位艺术家在河边一间明亮的工作室里工作。

study.example: She likes to study in the quiet library after lunch.
study.zh: 她喜欢午饭后在安静的图书馆里学习。

stuff.example: Please put your stuff in the box by the door.
stuff.zh: 请把你的东西放进门口的箱子里。

stumble.example: I stumbled on a small stone and dropped my bag.
stumble.zh: 我被一块小石头绊了一下，把包掉了。

stump.example: A wide tree stump stood in the middle of the field.
stump.zh: 田野中央立着一个宽大的树桩。

stun.example: The size of the old castle stunned the visitors.
stun.zh: 古堡的规模让游客们惊叹不已。

stupid.example: It was a stupid mistake, and he learned from it.
stupid.zh: 那是个愚蠢的错误，他从中吸取了教训。

sturdy.example: The table is sturdy enough to hold all these books.
sturdy.zh: 这张桌子足够结实，能承受所有这些书。

style.example: Her writing style is simple, clear and easy to follow.
style.zh: 她的写作风格简洁明了，容易理解。

subject.example: Math is my favorite subject at school this year.
subject.zh: 今年数学是我在学校最喜欢的科目。

subjective.example: His opinion is interesting but highly subjective and personal.
subjective.zh: 他的看法很有趣，但非常主观且个人化。

submarine.example: The submarine stayed under the sea for many days.
submarine.zh: 那艘潜艇在海下待了很多天。

submerge.example: The heavy stone slowly submerged in the deep water.
submerge.zh: 那块沉重的石头慢慢沉入深水中。

submit.example: Please submit your work before the end of the day.
submit.zh: 请在今天结束前提交你的作品。

subordinate.example: A good manager listens to every subordinate in the team.
subordinate.zh: 好的管理者会倾听团队中每一位下属的意见。

subscribe.example: I subscribe to a magazine about nature and travel.
subscribe.zh: 我订阅了一本关于自然和旅行的杂志。

subsequent.example: The first test failed, but subsequent tests gave better results.
subsequent.zh: 第一次测试失败了，但随后的测试取得了更好的结果。

subsidy.example: The farm received a small subsidy to buy new machines.
subsidy.zh: 农场获得了一笔小额补贴，用来购买新机器。

subsistence.example: The family grew their own food for basic subsistence.
subsistence.zh: 这家人自己种粮食，以维持基本生活。

substance.example: This substance becomes hard when it dries in air.
substance.zh: 这种物质在空气中变干后会变硬。

substitute.example: You can substitute honey for sugar in this recipe.
substitute.zh: 在这个食谱里，你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

subtle.example: There is a subtle difference between these two words.
subtle.zh: 这两个词之间有细微的差别。

subtract.example: If you subtract five from twelve, you get seven.

suburb.example: They moved to a quiet suburb outside the busy city.
suburb.zh: 他们搬到了繁忙城市外一个安静的郊区。

subway.example: She takes the subway to work every morning.
subway.zh: 她每天早上乘地铁去上班。

succeed.example: If you keep practicing, you will succeed in the end.
succeed.zh: 如果你坚持练习，最终会成功的。

success.example: The small shop was a great success from the start.
success.zh: 这家小店从一开始就非常成功。

such.example: I have never seen such a beautiful garden before.
such.zh: 我以前从未见过这么美的花园。

suck.example: The baby began to suck milk from the bottle.
suck.zh: 婴儿开始从奶瓶里吸奶。

sudden.example: There was a sudden change in the weather after lunch.

sue.example: She decided to sue the company for breaking the contract.
sue.zh: 她决定起诉那家公司违反合同。

suffer.example: Many plants suffer when the room is too hot and dry.
suffer.zh: 房间太热太干时，许多植物会受损。

suffice.example: A short message should suffice to explain the delay.
suffice.zh: 一条简短的消息就足以解释延误的原因。

sufficient.example: The food we bought is sufficient for three days.
sufficient.zh: 我们买的食物足够吃三天。

sugar.example: He stirred a spoon of sugar into the warm milk.
sugar.zh: 他把一勺糖搅进温牛奶里。

suggest.example: The doctor suggested a short walk after every meal.
suggest.zh: 医生建议每顿饭后散一小会儿步。

suicide.example: The school held a talk about suicide prevention and support.
suicide.zh: 学校举办了一场关于自杀预防与支持的讲座。

suit.example: That dark suit looks very good on you today.
suit.zh: 那套深色西装今天穿在你身上很好看。

suitable.example: This film is not suitable for very young children.
suitable.zh: 这部电影不适合很小的孩子观看。

suitcase.example: Her suitcase was too heavy to carry up the stairs.
suitcase.zh: 她的手提箱太重了，没法搬上楼。

suite.example: They stayed in a quiet suite on the top floor.
suite.zh: 他们住在顶层一间安静的套房里。

sulfur.example: The hot spring has a strong smell of sulfur.
sulfur.zh: 这处温泉有一股浓烈的硫磺味。

sum.example: The sum of these two numbers is twelve, as we expected.
sum.zh: 这两个数字的和是十二，正如我们所料。

summary.example: Please write a short summary of the article before Friday.
summary.zh: 请在周五之前写一篇简短的文章摘要。

summer.example: We spent the whole summer reading books by the lake.
summer.zh: 我们整个夏天都在湖边读书。

summit.example: They reached the summit after six hours of climbing.
summit.zh: 他们爬了六个小时后到达山顶。

summon.example: The manager summoned everyone to the meeting room this morning.
summon.zh: 经理今天早上把大家召集到会议室。

sun.example: The sun rose over the hills and warmed the valley.
sun.zh: 太阳从山丘上升起，温暖了山谷。

Sunday.example: We usually visit our grandparents on Sunday afternoon and stay late.
Sunday.zh: 我们通常在周日下午去看望祖父母，并且待到很晚。

sunlight.example: Bright sunlight came through the window and lit the room.
sunlight.zh: 明亮的阳光透过窗户照进房间。

sunrise.example: We left the house before sunrise to catch the train.
sunrise.zh: 我们在日出前离开家去赶火车。

sunset.example: The sky turned pink at sunset over the water.
sunset.zh: 日落时，水面上方的天空变成了粉红色。

sunshine.example: The children played outside in the warm sunshine all afternoon.
sunshine.zh: 孩子们在外面温暖的阳光下玩了一下午。

super.example: We had a super time at the beach last weekend.
super.zh: 上周末我们在海滩玩得非常开心。

superb.example: The view from the hill was superb in the evening light.
superb.zh: 在傍晚的光线中，山上的景色美极了。

superficial.example: His knowledge of the subject was superficial and full of gaps.
superficial.zh: 他对这门学科的了解很肤浅，而且有许多空白。

superintendent.example: The building superintendent fixed the broken lift early this morning.
superintendent.zh: 大楼管理员今天一早修好了坏掉的电梯。

superior.example: Her work is clearly superior to anything we have seen before.
superior.zh: 她的作品显然优于我们以前见过的任何东西。

supermarket.example: I stopped at the supermarket on my way home to buy milk.
supermarket.zh: 我在回家路上顺道去超市买了牛奶。

superstition.example: That old superstition still makes some people avoid walking under ladders.
superstition.zh: 那个古老的迷信仍让一些人不敢从梯子下面走过。

supervise.example: A senior teacher will supervise the students during the whole experiment.
supervise.zh: 一位资深教师将在整个实验过程中指导学生。

supper.example: We had a light supper and then went out for a walk.
supper.zh: 我们吃了顿清淡的晚餐，然后出去散步了。

supplement.example: She takes a vitamin supplement every morning with her breakfast.
supplement.zh: 她每天早上吃早饭时服用一种维生素补充剂。

supply.example: The farm can supply fresh vegetables to the whole village.
supply.zh: 这个农场能为整个村子供应新鲜蔬菜。

support.example: My parents always support my decision to study abroad next year.
support.zh: 父母一直支持我明年出国留学的决定。

suppose.example: I suppose the train will be late again because of the rain.
suppose.zh: 我想火车又会因为下雨而晚点。

suppress.example: She tried hard to suppress a smile during the serious meeting.
suppress.zh: 在严肃的会议上，她努力忍住不笑。

supreme.example: The chef showed supreme skill in preparing this simple dish.
supreme.zh: 这位厨师在烹制这道简单的菜肴时表现出极高的技巧。

sure.example: I am sure you will pass the exam if you keep practising.
sure.zh: 我相信只要你继续练习，就一定能通过考试。

surf.example: They learned to surf on the quiet beach near their hotel.
surf.zh: 他们在酒店附近安静的海滩上学会了冲浪。

surface.example: The surface of the lake was completely still in the early morning.

surge.example: A sudden surge of wind shook the windows of the old house.
surge.zh: 一阵突如其来的强风震动了老房子的窗户。

surgery.example: He needs surgery on his knee before he can run again.
surgery.zh: 他需要做膝盖手术才能再次跑步。

surname.example: Please write your surname clearly at the top of the form.
surname.zh: 请把你的姓清楚地写在表格顶端。

surpass.example: Her second book managed to surpass the success of the first.
surpass.zh: 她的第二本书成功超越了第一本的成功。

surplus.example: The shop sold its surplus stock at a very low price.
surplus.zh: 这家店以极低的价格卖掉了剩余的库存。

surprise.example: The party was a complete surprise to my younger sister.
surprise.zh: 这个聚会对我妹妹来说完全是个惊喜。

surrender.example: The team refused to surrender even when they were far behind.
surrender.zh: 即使远远落后，这支队伍也拒绝认输。

surround.example: Tall trees surround the small lake behind our school.
surround.zh: 高大的树木环绕着我们学校后面的小湖。

surveillance.example: The shop keeps the car park under constant video surveillance.
surveillance.zh: 这家店对停车场进行持续的视频监控。

survey.example: The researchers carried out a survey of local eating habits.
survey.zh: 研究人员对当地人的饮食习惯做了一项调查。

survive.example: Few plants can survive in such dry and sandy soil.
survive.zh: 很少有植物能在如此干燥的沙质土壤中存活。

susceptible.example: Young children are more susceptible to colds in the winter months.
susceptible.zh: 幼儿在冬季更容易感冒。

suspect.example: I suspect he forgot about the meeting again this morning.
suspect.zh: 我猜他今天早上又把会议忘了。

suspend.example: They had to suspend the game because of the heavy rain.
suspend.zh: 由于大雨，他们不得不暂停比赛。

suspicion.example: Her strange behaviour raised suspicion among her close friends.
suspicion.zh: 她的奇怪举动引起了密友们的怀疑。

sustain.example: The small business could not sustain such high costs for long.
sustain.zh: 这家小企业无法长期承受如此高的成本。

swallow.example: He took a deep breath and swallowed the bitter medicine.
swallow.zh: 他深吸一口气，把苦药咽了下去。

swamp.example: Heavy rain turned the low field into a muddy swamp.
swamp.zh: 大雨把低洼的田地变成了泥泞的沼泽。

swap.example: The two friends decided to swap seats before the film started.
swap.zh: 两个朋友决定在电影开始前交换座位。

sway.example: The tall grass began to sway gently in the evening wind.
sway.zh: 高高的草在晚风中开始轻轻摇摆。

swear.example: He had to swear that he was telling the whole truth.
swear.zh: 他不得不发誓说自己讲的全是实话。

sweat.example: After the long run, sweat ran down his face and neck.
sweat.zh: 长跑之后，汗水顺着他的脸和脖子流下来。

sweep.example: She used a wide brush to sweep the leaves off the path.
sweep.zh: 她用一把宽刷子把小路上的落叶扫开。

sweet.example: This soup tastes too sweet for me, so add less sugar.
sweet.zh: 这汤对我来说太甜了，所以少放点糖。
