swell.example: His ankle began to swell after he fell off the bike.
swell.zh: 他从自行车上摔下来后，脚踝开始肿起来。

swift.example: The company took swift action to fix the broken website.
swift.zh: 公司迅速采取行动修复了出问题的网站。

swim.example: My brother can swim across the river in ten minutes.
swim.zh: 我弟弟十分钟就能游过这条河。

swing.example: The child laughed as she went higher on the swing.
swing.zh: 孩子在秋千上荡得更高时笑了起来。

swipe.example: He took a quick swipe at the ball with his hand.
swipe.zh: 他用手朝球快速挥了一下。

switch.example: Please switch off the lights when you leave the room.
switch.zh: 离开房间时请把灯关掉。

sword.example: The old sword in the museum was found in a river.
sword.zh: 博物馆里那把古剑是在一条河里被发现的。

symbol.example: In many cultures, the dove is a symbol of peace.
symbol.zh: 在许多文化中，鸽子是和平的象征。

symmetry.example: The garden was designed with perfect symmetry on both sides.
symmetry.zh: 这座花园两侧的设计完全对称。

sympathy.example: I felt deep sympathy for her after hearing the sad news.
sympathy.zh: 听到那个令人难过的消息后，我深感同情。

symphony.example: The orchestra played a long symphony to a full hall.
symphony.zh: 管弦乐团向满座的观众演奏了一首长篇交响曲。

symposium.example: Several experts spoke at the symposium on modern teaching methods.
symposium.zh: 几位专家在现代教学方法研讨会上发了言。

symptom.example: A high fever is a common symptom of this mild illness.
symptom.zh: 高烧是这种轻微疾病的一个常见症状。

syndicate.example: A large syndicate bought the old factory and rebuilt it.
syndicate.zh: 一个大型财团买下了这家旧工厂并进行了重建。

syndrome.example: The doctor said the tiredness was part of a common syndrome.
syndrome.zh: 医生说这种疲倦是一种常见综合征的一部分。

synonym.example: In this sentence, the word happy is a synonym for glad.
synonym.zh: 在这个句子里，happy 是 glad 的同义词。

synthesis.example: Her essay offers a careful synthesis of the two theories.
synthesis.zh: 她的文章对这两种理论做了细致的综合。

system.example: The new system makes it easier to find old records.
system.zh: 新系统让查找旧记录变得更容易。

table.example: We put the books on the table and sat down to talk.
table.zh: 我们把书放在桌上，然后坐下来谈话。

tablet.example: The doctor told him to take one tablet after each meal.
tablet.zh: 医生让他每餐后吃一片药。

taboo.example: In some places, it is a taboo to talk about money.
taboo.zh: 在一些地方，谈论钱是件忌讳的事。

tack.example: She used a small tack to fix the note to the board.
tack.zh: 她用一枚小图钉把便条钉在板子上。

tackle.example: We must tackle this problem before it becomes much worse.
tackle.zh: 我们必须在问题变得更糟之前解决它。

tact.example: She handled the difficult question with great tact and patience.
tact.zh: 她非常得体和耐心地处理了这个难题。

tactic.example: Changing the subject was a clever tactic to avoid arguing.
tactic.zh: 转移话题是避免争吵的一个聪明策略。

tag.example: Please write your name on the tag attached to the bag.
tag.zh: 请把你的名字写在包上挂的标签上。

tail.example: The dog wagged its tail when it saw its owner.
tail.zh: 那条狗看到主人时摇了摇尾巴。

tailor.example: The tailor made a new coat for me in three days.
tailor.zh: 裁缝三天就给我做了一件新外套。

take.example: Please take this box to the room at the end.
take.zh: 请把这个箱子搬到尽头那个房间。

takeoff.example: The plane's takeoff was delayed by almost forty minutes.
takeoff.zh: 飞机的起飞延误了将近四十分钟。

tale.example: My grandmother told us a long tale about a clever fox.
tale.zh: 奶奶给我们讲了一个关于聪明狐狸的长故事。

talent.example: She has a real talent for drawing animals and plants.
talent.zh: 她在画动物和植物方面很有天赋。

talk.example: We need to talk about the plan before Friday afternoon.
talk.zh: 我们需要在星期五下午之前谈谈这个计划。

tall.example: The tall tree in the garden blocks much of our light.
tall.zh: 花园里那棵高大的树挡住了我们很多光线。

tame.example: The farmer kept a tame bird beside the kitchen door.
tame.zh: 那个农民在厨房门边养了一只驯服的鸟。

tan.example: His arms turned tan after a week at the beach.
tan.zh: 在海滩待了一周后，他的胳膊晒成了棕褐色。

tangible.example: The project brought tangible benefits to the whole neighbourhood.
tangible.zh: 这个项目给整个社区带来了实实在在的好处。

tangle.example: The garden wires were a tangle after the strong wind.
tangle.zh: 大风过后，花园里的电线乱成一团。

tank.example: The water tank on the roof needs cleaning this weekend.
tank.zh: 屋顶上的水箱这个周末需要清洗。

tanker.example: A large tanker arrived at the port with fresh oil.
tanker.zh: 一艘大型油轮载着新鲜的油抵达港口。

tap.example: Please turn off the tap while you brush your teeth.
tap.zh: 刷牙时请把水龙头关掉。

tape.example: I used tape to fix the poster to the wall.
tape.zh: 我用胶带把海报贴在墙上。

target.example: Our target is to finish the report by Friday noon.
target.zh: 我们的目标是在星期五中午之前完成报告。

tariff.example: The shop raised its tariff for delivery to distant areas.
tariff.zh: 这家店提高了向偏远地区送货的收费。

task.example: Finishing the whole report in one day was a hard task.
task.zh: 一天之内完成整份报告是项艰巨的任务。

taste.example: This tea has a mild taste that most people enjoy.
taste.zh: 这种茶味道温和，大多数人都喜欢。

tax.example: The new tax on sugary drinks starts next month.
tax.zh: 对含糖饮料征收的新税下个月开始实施。

taxi.example: We took a taxi to the station because it was raining.
taxi.zh: 因为下雨，我们打车去了车站。

tea.example: She drinks a cup of tea every afternoon at four.
tea.zh: 她每天下午四点喝一杯茶。

teach.example: My uncle will teach me how to fix a bike.
teach.zh: 我叔叔要教我怎样修自行车。

team.example: Our team won the match after a long and close game.
team.zh: 经过一场漫长而接近的比赛，我们队赢了。

tear.example: She wiped the tears from her face and smiled again.
tear.zh: 她擦去脸上的眼泪，又笑了起来。

tease.example: The boys like to tease their sister about her new glasses.
tease.zh: 男孩们喜欢拿妹妹的新眼镜取笑她。

technical.example: The report was too technical for most of the readers.
technical.zh: 这份报告对大多数读者来说太专业了。

technique.example: This simple technique helps students remember new words faster.
technique.zh: 这个简单的技巧能帮助学生更快地记住新单词。

technology.example: Modern technology has changed the way we shop and travel.
technology.zh: 现代技术改变了我们购物和出行的方式。

tedious.example: Copying the whole list by hand was a tedious job.
tedious.zh: 手抄整份名单是件乏味的工作。

teen.example: In old poems, teen often means deep sorrow and grief.
teen.zh: 在古诗中，teen 常常表示深深的悲伤。

teenager.example: As a teenager, he spent every summer helping on the farm.
teenager.zh: 少年时，他每个夏天都在农场帮忙。

telecommunications.example: The company works in telecommunications and builds fast phone networks.
telecommunications.zh: 这家公司从事电信行业，建设高速电话网络。

telephone.example: She answered the telephone and wrote down the message.
telephone.zh: 她接起电话，把留言记了下来。

telescope.example: We used a small telescope to look at the moon.
telescope.zh: 我们用一架小望远镜看月亮。

television.example: He turned off the television and opened a book instead.
television.zh: 他关掉电视，转而打开一本书。

tell.example: Could you tell me the way to the nearest bank?
tell.zh: 你能告诉我去最近的银行怎么走吗？

teller.example: The bank teller counted the money twice before handing it over.
teller.zh: 银行出纳员把钱数了两遍才递过来。

temper.example: He lost his temper when the bus was late again.
temper.zh: 公交车又晚点时，他发了脾气。

temperament.example: Her calm temperament makes her good at handling complaints.
temperament.zh: 她性情平和，因此很擅长处理投诉。

temperature.example: The temperature dropped quickly after the sun went down.
temperature.zh: 太阳落山后，气温迅速下降。

temple.example: He pressed two fingers gently against his temple and sighed.
temple.zh: 他用两根手指轻轻按住太阳穴，叹了口气。

tempo.example: The band slowed the tempo for the final song.
tempo.zh: 乐队为最后一首歌放慢了节奏。

temporal.example: The course deals with temporal matters rather than abstract ideas.
temporal.zh: 这门课程讨论的是现实事务，而不是抽象观念。

temporary.example: This is only a temporary solution to the parking problem.
temporary.zh: 这只是解决停车问题的临时办法。

tempt.example: The low price might tempt you to buy more than needed.
tempt.zh: 低廉的价格可能会诱使你买下超过需要的东西。

ten.example: There are ten chairs around the long table in the hall.
ten.zh: 大厅里的长桌周围有十把椅子。

tenant.example: The tenant paid the rent on time every single month.
tenant.zh: 房客每个月都按时交房租。

tend.example: Small children tend to catch colds more often in winter.
tend.zh: 小孩子在冬天往往更容易感冒。

tender.example: The meat was so tender that it almost fell apart.
tender.zh: 这肉非常嫩，几乎一碰就散。

tennis.example: We play tennis in the park every Sunday morning.
tennis.zh: 我们每个星期天早上都在公园打网球。

tense.example: Everyone felt tense while waiting for the final result.
tense.zh: 等待最终结果时，每个人都感到紧张。

tension.example: You could feel the tension in the room before the test.
tension.zh: 考试前你能感觉到房间里的紧张气氛。

tent.example: We put up the tent beside the river before it got dark.
tent.zh: 天黑前我们在河边搭起了帐篷。

tentative.example: We have made a tentative plan for the summer holiday.
tentative.zh: 我们已经为暑假制定了一个初步的计划。

tenure.example: During his tenure as manager, the shop doubled its sales.
tenure.zh: 在他担任经理期间，这家店的销售额翻了一番。

term.example: The new term begins in the first week of September.
term.zh: 新学期在九月的第一周开始。

terminal.example: The bus terminal is a short walk from the main station.
terminal.zh: 公交终点站离主火车站只有一小段路。

terminate.example: The company may terminate the contract if the work stops.
terminate.zh: 如果工作停止，公司可能会终止合同。

terrace.example: We had breakfast on the terrace and watched the sunrise.
terrace.zh: 我们在露台上吃早饭，看着日出。

terrain.example: The rocky terrain made the long walk much harder.
terrain.zh: 多岩石的地形让这次长途步行艰难得多。

terrible.example: The weather was terrible, so we stayed inside all day.
terrible.zh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们一整天都待在屋里。

terrific.example: The view from the hill was absolutely terrific at sunset.
terrific.zh: 日落时从山上看到的景色美极了。

territory.example: The bird marks its territory with a loud morning song.
territory.zh: 这种鸟用响亮的晨鸣标记自己的领地。

terror.example: She felt terror when the lights suddenly went out.
terror.zh: 灯突然熄灭时，她感到一阵恐惧。

tertiary.example: He works in the tertiary sector, mostly in banking services.
tertiary.zh: 他在第三产业工作，主要从事银行服务。

test.example: The teacher gave us a short test on Friday morning.
test.zh: 老师在星期五早上给我们做了一次小测验。

testify.example: Two neighbours agreed to testify about what they saw.
testify.zh: 两位邻居同意就他们看到的情况作证。

testimony.example: Her calm testimony helped the court understand the facts.
testimony.zh: 她冷静的证词帮助法庭了解了事实。

text.example: Please read the text carefully before you answer the questions.
text.zh: 回答问题前请仔细阅读课文。

textbook.example: I left my textbook in the classroom after the last lesson.
textbook.zh: 最后一节课后我把课本落在教室里了。

textile.example: The city is famous for its textile factories and wool.
textile.zh: 这座城市以纺织厂和羊毛闻名。

texture.example: This cloth has a soft texture that feels very pleasant.
texture.zh: 这种布质地柔软，摸起来非常舒服。

than.example: This box is much heavier than the one beside it.
than.zh: 这个箱子比旁边那个重得多。

thank.example: I want to thank you for all your help last week.
thank.zh: 我想感谢你上周给予的所有帮助。

Thanksgiving.example: Our family always shares a big meal together on Thanksgiving Day.
Thanksgiving.zh: 感恩节那天我们全家总是一起吃一顿大餐。

that.example: The book that you lent me last month was very helpful.
that.zh: 你上个月借给我的那本书很有帮助。

the.example: Please close the window before you leave the room tonight.
the.zh: 今晚离开房间前请把窗户关上。

theater.example: We went to the theater to see a new play.
theater.zh: 我们去剧院看了一出新戏。

theft.example: The shop installed cameras to prevent theft in the store.
theft.zh: 这家店安装了摄像头以防店内发生盗窃。

their.example: The students put their books away and left the room.
their.zh: 学生们把书收好，离开了房间。

theirs.example: This small blue car is theirs, not ours.
theirs.zh: 这辆蓝色的小车是他们的，不是我们的。

them.example: I saw the keys on the desk and picked them up.
them.zh: 我看到桌上的钥匙，把它们拿了起来。

theme.example: The main theme of the book is the value of friendship.
theme.zh: 这本书的主题是友谊的价值。

themselves.example: The children learned to cook dinner for themselves last summer.
themselves.zh: 去年夏天，孩子们学会了自己做晚饭。

then.example: We finished our work and then walked home together.
then.zh: 我们做完工作，然后一起走回了家。

theory.example: Her theory explains why the leaves change colour in autumn.
theory.zh: 她的理论解释了秋天树叶变色的原因。

therapy.example: The doctor said that physical therapy would help his knee.
therapy.zh: 医生说理疗对他的膝盖有帮助。

there.example: We waited there for almost an hour before the bus came.
there.zh: 我们在那里等了将近一个小时，公交车才来。

thereby.example: She arrived early, thereby avoiding the heavy traffic on the road.
thereby.zh: 她到得早，因此避开了路上拥堵的交通。

therefore.example: The road was closed, and therefore we had to take another route.
therefore.zh: 那条路封了，因此我们只好走另一条路线。

thermal.example: This jacket has a thermal lining that keeps you warm in winter.
thermal.zh: 这件夹克有保暖内衬，冬天穿能让你暖和。

thermometer.example: Please put the thermometer in your mouth and wait for three minutes.
thermometer.zh: 请把温度计放进嘴里，等三分钟。

these.example: These apples are much sweeter than the ones we bought yesterday.
these.zh: 这些苹果比我们昨天买的那些甜多了。

thesis.example: He spent two years writing his thesis on modern education.
thesis.zh: 他花了两年时间写那篇关于现代教育的论文。

they.example: They often walk to school together when the weather is fine.
they.zh: 天气好的时候，他们常常一起走路上学。

thick.example: The walls of the old house are very thick and keep out noise.
thick.zh: 这所老房子的墙很厚，能挡住噪音。

thief.example: The thief ran away quickly when he heard the dogs barking.
thief.zh: 那个小偷听到狗叫，很快就跑掉了。

thigh.example: She hurt her thigh while playing football with her classmates.
thigh.zh: 她和同学踢足球时伤到了大腿。

thin.example: The ice on the lake is too thin to walk on safely.
thin.zh: 湖上的冰太薄，走上去不安全。

thing.example: The first thing I do every morning is open the window.
thing.zh: 我每天早上做的第一件事就是开窗。

think.example: I think we should leave now to catch the last train.
think.zh: 我认为我们现在就该动身去赶末班车。

third.example: Our team finished third in the school running competition.
third.zh: 我们队在学校的跑步比赛中得了第三名。

thirst.example: After the long walk, they felt a strong thirst for water.
thirst.zh: 走了很长的路后，他们感到非常口渴。

thirteen.example: There are thirteen students in the reading group this term.
thirteen.zh: 这学期阅读小组里有十三名学生。

thirty.example: My father worked at the factory for thirty years.
thirty.zh: 我父亲在那家工厂工作了三十年。

this.example: This is the best cake I have ever tasted.
this.zh: 这是我吃过的最好吃的蛋糕。

thorn.example: A sharp thorn stuck in his finger while he picked roses.
thorn.zh: 他摘玫瑰时，一根尖刺扎进了他的手指。

thorough.example: The teacher made a thorough check of all our answers.
thorough.zh: 老师把我们的答案彻底检查了一遍。

those.example: Those shoes by the door belong to my younger brother.
those.zh: 门边那些鞋子是我弟弟的。

though.example: It was cold outside, though the sun was shining brightly.
though.zh: 外面很冷，尽管阳光很灿烂。

thought.example: The thought of seeing her again made him smile.
thought.zh: 想到能再见到她，他笑了。

thousand.example: The little town is about a thousand years old.
thousand.zh: 这个小镇大约有一千年的历史。

thread.example: She used a thin thread to sew the button back on.
thread.zh: 她用一根细线把纽扣缝了回去。

threat.example: Heavy rain is a serious threat to the small village.
threat.zh: 大雨对这个小村庄是一个严重的威胁。

three.example: We need three more chairs for the guests tonight.
three.zh: 今晚我们还需要三把椅子给客人。

threshold.example: She stood at the threshold and looked into the dark room.
threshold.zh: 她站在门槛上，往黑漆漆的房间里看。

thrift.example: His habit of thrift helped him save enough money for a car.
thrift.zh: 他节约的习惯帮他攒够了买车的钱。

thrill.example: The children felt a great thrill when the ride started.
thrill.zh: 游乐设施启动时，孩子们感到一阵强烈的兴奋。

thrive.example: These plants thrive in warm weather and plenty of sunlight.
thrive.zh: 这些植物在温暖的天气和充足的阳光下长得很好。

throat.example: I have a sore throat and cannot speak very loudly today.
throat.zh: 我喉咙痛，今天没法大声说话。

throne.example: The old king sat on his throne and greeted the visitors.
throne.zh: 老国王坐在王座上迎接来访的人。

through.example: The train went through a long tunnel before reaching the station.
through.zh: 火车穿过一条长长的隧道才到达车站。

throughout.example: The museum is open throughout the year except on holidays.
throughout.zh: 博物馆全年开放，只有节假日除外。

throw.example: Please throw the ball gently so the little boy can catch it.
throw.zh: 请轻轻扔球，这样小男孩才能接住。

thrust.example: He thrust the key into the lock and turned it quickly.
thrust.zh: 他把钥匙插进锁里，迅速转动了一下。

thumb.example: She hurt her thumb while cutting vegetables in the kitchen.
thumb.zh: 她在厨房切菜时伤到了拇指。

thunder.example: The thunder was so loud that the baby woke up.
thunder.zh: 雷声太响了，把孩子惊醒了。

Thursday.example: We have a maths test every Thursday afternoon.
Thursday.zh: 我们每周四下午都有数学测验。

thus.example: The shop closed early, and thus we could not buy bread.
thus.zh: 商店提早关门了，因此我们没能买到面包。

tick.example: The old clock on the wall went tick tock all night.
tick.zh: 墙上那座旧钟整夜滴答作响。

ticket.example: I bought two tickets for the film on Saturday evening.
ticket.zh: 我买了两张周六晚上的电影票。

tickle.example: The little girl laughed when her father began to tickle her.
tickle.zh: 爸爸一开始挠她痒痒，小女孩就笑了。

tide.example: The tide comes in twice a day along this beach.
tide.zh: 这片海滩每天涨两次潮。

tidy.example: Her desk is always tidy and everything is in its place.
tidy.zh: 她的书桌总是很整洁，每样东西都在原位。

tie.example: He wore a blue tie to the meeting this morning.
tie.zh: 今天上午开会时他系了一条蓝领带。

tiger.example: The tiger slept quietly under a tree in the shade.
tiger.zh: 老虎在树荫下静静地睡着。

tight.example: These shoes are too tight and hurt my feet.
tight.zh: 这双鞋太紧了，夹得我脚疼。

tile.example: The kitchen floor is covered with small white tiles.
tile.zh: 厨房地面铺着白色的小瓷砖。

till.example: We waited at the bus stop till the rain stopped.
till.zh: 我们在公交站一直等到雨停。

tilt.example: Please tilt the bottle slowly so the water does not spill.
tilt.zh: 请慢慢倾斜瓶子，别让水洒出来。

timber.example: The table was made of good timber from the forest.
timber.zh: 这张桌子是用林子里上好的木料做的。

time.example: Do you have time to help me with this box?
time.zh: 你有时间帮我搬这个箱子吗？

timid.example: The timid child hid behind his mother in the crowd.
timid.zh: 那个怕生的孩子躲在人群中的妈妈身后。

tin.example: She kept the biscuits in a small tin on the shelf.
tin.zh: 她把饼干放在架子上的一个小铁罐里。

tiny.example: A tiny bird landed on the window and sang softly.
tiny.zh: 一只小鸟落在窗上，轻声唱着。

tip.example: He gave the waiter a tip for the good service.
tip.zh: 因为服务好，他给了服务员小费。

tire.example: The front tire of my bike went flat this morning.
tire.zh: 今天早上我自行车的前胎瘪了。

tissue.example: She took a tissue from her bag and wiped her nose.
tissue.zh: 她从包里拿出一张纸巾，擦了擦鼻子。

title.example: The title of the article is easy to remember.
title.zh: 这篇文章的标题很好记。

to.example: We walked to the park and sat by the lake.
to.zh: 我们走到公园，坐在湖边。

toast.example: He ate two pieces of toast with butter for breakfast.
toast.zh: 他早餐吃了两片抹黄油的吐司。

tobacco.example: The farmer grows tobacco on a small field near the river.
tobacco.zh: 这位农民在河边的一小块地里种烟草。

today.example: The weather is warm and sunny today, so let us go out.
today.zh: 今天天气暖和晴朗，我们出去吧。

toe.example: He hurt his toe when he kicked the ball too hard.
toe.zh: 他踢球太用力，伤到了脚趾。

together.example: We cooked dinner together and talked about our day.
together.zh: 我们一起做晚饭，聊着各自的一天。

toil.example: The workers toil in the fields from morning until evening.
toil.zh: 工人们从早到晚在田里辛苦劳作。

toilet.example: The toilet is at the end of the hall on the left.
toilet.zh: 厕所在走廊尽头的左手边。

token.example: Please show this token at the door to get your gift.
token.zh: 请在门口出示这个代币领取礼物。

tolerate.example: Our teacher cannot tolerate noise during the reading lesson.
tolerate.zh: 我们的老师无法容忍阅读课上的噪音。

toll.example: Drivers must pay a toll to use this new bridge.
toll.zh: 司机使用这座新桥必须交通行费。

tomato.example: She cut a red tomato into thin slices for the salad.
tomato.zh: 她把一个红番茄切成薄片做沙拉。

tomorrow.example: We will visit the museum tomorrow if the weather is fine.
tomorrow.zh: 如果天气好，我们明天去参观博物馆。

ton.example: The truck carried ten tons of sand to the building site.
ton.zh: 卡车运了十吨沙子到建筑工地。

tone.example: She spoke in a soft tone so as not to wake the baby.
tone.zh: 她用轻柔的语气说话，生怕吵醒孩子。

tongue.example: He burned his tongue on the hot soup.

tonight.example: We are going to watch a film at home tonight.
tonight.zh: 今晚我们要在家看电影。

too.example: The suitcase is too heavy for me to carry upstairs.
too.zh: 这个箱子太重了，我搬不上楼。

tool.example: A hammer is a useful tool for fixing small things.
tool.zh: 锤子是修理小东西的有用工具。

tooth.example: The dentist said one tooth needs a little more care.
tooth.zh: 牙医说有一颗牙齿需要多加留意。

top.example: They reached the top of the hill after two hours.
top.zh: 两小时后他们到达了山顶。

topic.example: The topic of today's talk is how to save water.
topic.zh: 今天讲座的话题是如何节约用水。

topple.example: The strong wind toppled the old tree across the road.
topple.zh: 大风把那棵老树吹倒在路上。

torch.example: He used a torch to find his way in the dark cave.
torch.zh: 他用火把在黑暗的洞穴里找路。

tornado.example: The tornado damaged several houses but no one was hurt.
tornado.zh: 龙卷风毁坏了几座房屋，但没有人受伤。

torture.example: Waiting for the exam results was pure torture for her.
torture.zh: 等考试结果对她来说简直是折磨。

toss.example: He tossed the ball to his sister across the garden.
toss.zh: 他把球扔给花园另一头的妹妹。

total.example: The total cost of the trip was lower than we expected.
total.zh: 这次旅行的总花费比我们预期的低。

touch.example: Please do not touch the paintings in the museum.
touch.zh: 请不要触摸博物馆里的画。

tough.example: Learning to swim was tough at first, but she kept trying.
tough.zh: 学游泳起初很难，但她一直坚持。

tour.example: They took a tour of the old city on Sunday morning.
tour.zh: 周日早上他们游览了这座老城。

tournament.example: Our school won the chess tournament last month.
tournament.zh: 上个月我们学校赢得了国际象棋锦标赛。

tow.example: A small truck came to tow our broken car away.
tow.zh: 一辆小卡车来把我们的坏车拖走了。

toward.example: She walked slowly toward the door and opened it quietly.
toward.zh: 她慢慢走向门口，轻轻把门打开。

towel.example: He dried his hands with a clean towel after washing.
towel.zh: 他洗完手后用干净的毛巾擦干了手。

tower.example: The old tower stands at the centre of the town.
tower.zh: 那座古塔矗立在城镇的中心。

town.example: The small town has a market every Saturday morning.
town.zh: 这个小镇每周六上午都有集市。

toxic.example: The factory must not pour toxic waste into the river.
toxic.zh: 工厂不得把有毒废料倒进河里。

toy.example: The baby played with a soft toy on the floor.
toy.zh: 宝宝在地板上玩一个软玩具。

trace.example: The police found no trace of the missing bicycle.
trace.zh: 警察没有找到丢失自行车的任何踪迹。

track.example: The runners followed the track around the edge of the field.
track.zh: 跑者沿着场地边缘的跑道跑。

tract.example: A large tract of land behind the village is still empty.
tract.zh: 村子后面有一大片土地还空着。

tractor.example: The farmer drove his tractor across the muddy field.
tractor.zh: 农民开着拖拉机穿过泥泞的田地。

trade.example: The two countries have increased their trade in recent years.
trade.zh: 近年来两国之间的贸易增加了。

trademark.example: The company put its trademark on every product it sells.
trademark.zh: 公司在其销售的每件产品上都印上商标。

tradition.example: It is a family tradition to eat noodles on birthdays.
tradition.zh: 生日吃面条是我们家的一项家庭传统。

traffic.example: The traffic was heavy, so we arrived twenty minutes late.
traffic.zh: 交通很拥堵，所以我们晚了二十分钟到。

tragedy.example: The fire was a tragedy for the whole village.
tragedy.zh: 那场火灾对整个村子来说是一场灾难。

trail.example: We followed a narrow trail through the quiet forest.
trail.zh: 我们沿着一条窄窄的小径穿过安静的森林。

train.example: We took the early train to the city this morning.
train.zh: 今天早上我们坐早班火车去了城里。

trait.example: Patience is an important trait for a good teacher.
trait.zh: 耐心是好老师的重要特质。

tram.example: We rode the tram to the market and walked back.
tram.zh: 我们坐电车去市场，然后走了回来。

tranquil.example: The lake looked calm and tranquil in the early morning.
tranquil.zh: 清晨的湖面看起来平静安宁。

transaction.example: The bank records every transaction made with your card.
transaction.zh: 银行记录用你的卡进行的每一笔交易。

transcend.example: Great music can transcend language and touch many hearts.
transcend.zh: 伟大的音乐能超越语言，打动许多人的心。

transcript.example: She asked the school office for a copy of her transcript.
transcript.zh: 她向学校办公室要了一份成绩单的副本。

transfer.example: He asked to transfer some money to his sister's account.
transfer.zh: 他要求转一些钱到他妹妹的账户。

transform.example: A good teacher can transform a boring lesson into a fun one.
transform.zh: 好老师能把枯燥的课变得有趣。

transient.example: The joy of winning was brief and transient for him.
transient.zh: 胜利的喜悦对他来说是短暂而瞬息的。

transistor.example: The small radio stopped working when one transistor broke.
transistor.zh: 那台小收音机在一个晶体管坏掉后就不响了。

transit.example: The boxes were damaged in transit and arrived wet.
transit.zh: 这些箱子在运输途中受损，送到时是湿的。

transition.example: The transition from summer to autumn is slow here.
transition.zh: 这里从夏天到秋天的过渡很缓慢。

translate.example: Could you translate this letter from English into Chinese?
translate.zh: 你能把这封信从英文翻译成中文吗？

transmit.example: The station transmits its radio signal across the whole valley.
transmit.zh: 这个电台把广播信号传遍整个山谷。

transparent.example: The glass bottle is transparent, so you can see the water.
transparent.zh: 这个玻璃瓶是透明的，所以你能看到水。

transplant.example: The gardener will transplant the young tree next spring.
transplant.zh: 园丁明年春天会移栽这棵小树。

transport.example: The city uses buses to transport people to work each day.
transport.zh: 这座城市每天用公交车送人们去上班。

trap.example: The mouse was caught in a simple trap by the wall.
trap.zh: 那只老鼠被墙边一个简单的陷阱夹住了。

trash.example: Please put the empty bottles in the trash before you leave.
trash.zh: 离开前请把空瓶子扔进垃圾桶。

trauma.example: The fall caused a small trauma to his left knee.
trauma.zh: 那一摔使他的左膝受了轻微的损伤。

travel.example: They plan to travel by train across the country in June.
travel.zh: 他们打算六月坐火车穿越全国旅行。

tray.example: She carried a tray with three cups of tea.
tray.zh: 她端着一个放着三杯茶的托盘。

tread.example: Please tread carefully on the wet floor of the hall.
tread.zh: 请在走廊湿滑的地面上小心行走。

treasure.example: The old letters are a treasure she keeps in a box.
treasure.zh: 那些旧信件是她珍藏在一只盒子里的宝物。

treasury.example: The treasury keeps careful records of all the money it receives.
treasury.zh: 财务部门仔细记录收到的每一笔款项。

treat.example: We will treat you to dinner after the concert.
treat.zh: 音乐会结束后我们请你吃晚饭。

treaty.example: The two sides signed a treaty to end the long dispute.
treaty.zh: 双方签署了一项条约，结束了长期的争端。

tree.example: A tall tree in the garden gives shade in summer.
tree.zh: 花园里一棵高树在夏天提供荫凉。

trek.example: They went on a long trek through the hills last week.
trek.zh: 上周他们去山里做了一次长途跋涉。

tremble.example: Her hands began to tremble when she stood up to speak.
tremble.zh: 她站起来发言时，双手开始发抖。

tremendous.example: The new bridge was a tremendous help to the village.
tremendous.zh: 这座新桥给村子带来了极大的帮助。

trench.example: The workers dug a deep trench beside the new road.
trench.zh: 工人们在新路边挖了一条深沟。

trend.example: There is a growing trend of working from home.
trend.zh: 在家办公的趋势正在增长。

trial.example: They gave the new machine a short trial before buying it.
trial.zh: 他们在买下这台新机器之前，先对它进行了短时间的试用。

triangle.example: She drew a small triangle inside the circle on the paper.
triangle.zh: 她在纸上的圆圈里画了一个小三角形。

tribe.example: The tribe built their homes from wood and dry grass.
tribe.zh: 这个部落用木头和干草搭建自己的住所。

tribune.example: The guide explained what a tribune did in ancient times.
tribune.zh: 导游讲解了古代护民官的职责。

tribute.example: The old song was written as a tribute to the workers of the town.
tribute.zh: 这首老歌是为了赞颂镇上的劳动者而写的。

trick.example: He played a clever trick on his friends and they all laughed.
trick.zh: 他对朋友们耍了一个巧妙的恶作剧，大家都笑了。

trickle.example: Water began to trickle from the old pipe onto the floor.
trickle.zh: 水开始从旧管道里滴到地板上。

trifle.example: He thought the problem was a trifle, but it took hours to fix.
trifle.zh: 他原以为这个问题是件小事，结果花了几个小时才修好。

trigger.example: A single loud noise can trigger a strong reaction in some people.
trigger.zh: 一声巨响就可能引起某些人的强烈反应。

trillion.example: The company said the project would cost over a trillion dollars.
trillion.zh: 公司表示这个项目将耗资超过一万亿美元。

trim.example: He used small scissors to trim the bushes along the path.
trim.zh: 他用小剪刀修剪小路两旁的灌木。

trip.example: We took a long trip to the mountains last summer.
trip.zh: 去年夏天我们去山里做了一趟长途旅行。

triple.example: The price of the tickets was triple what we paid last year.
triple.zh: 票价是我们去年所付价格的三倍。

triumph.example: Her hard work ended in triumph when she won the prize.
triumph.zh: 她的努力最终以胜利告终，她赢得了那个奖项。

trivial.example: They argued about trivial things instead of solving the real problem.
trivial.zh: 他们为琐事争论，却没有解决真正的问题。

trolley.example: He pushed the heavy trolley down the aisle of the store.
trolley.zh: 他推着沉重的手推车走过商店的过道。

troop.example: A troop of children ran across the field after the ball.
troop.zh: 一群孩子追着球跑过田野。

trophy.example: She lifted the golden trophy above her head and smiled.
trophy.zh: 她把金质奖杯举过头顶，笑了。

tropic.example: The map shows the tropic as a dotted line across the warm region.
tropic.zh: 地图上用虚线标出穿过温暖地区的回归线。

trouble.example: She had trouble finding the key in her crowded bag.
trouble.zh: 她在塞满东西的包里找钥匙，费了不少劲。

trousers.example: He rolled up his trousers before walking through the shallow water.
trousers.zh: 他走过浅水前把裤腿卷了起来。

truck.example: A large truck delivered fresh vegetables to the market this morning.
truck.zh: 今天早上，一辆大卡车把新鲜蔬菜送到了市场。

true.example: I think his story is true because the details all match.
true.zh: 我认为他的说法是真实的，因为细节都对得上。

trumpet.example: She played the trumpet in the school band for three years.
trumpet.zh: 她在学校乐队里吹了三年小号。

trunk.example: A small bird built its nest on the trunk of the tall tree.
trunk.zh: 一只小鸟在高大的树干上筑了巢。

trust.example: You can trust her to finish the work on time.
trust.zh: 你可以相信她会按时完成工作。

truth.example: He finally told the truth about what happened that night.
truth.zh: 他终于说出了那天晚上发生的事情的真相。

try.example: I will try to finish the report before the meeting starts.
try.zh: 我会努力在会议开始前完成报告。

tub.example: The children filled the tub with warm water and bubbles.
tub.zh: 孩子们在浴盆里放满了温水和泡泡。

tube.example: A thin tube carries water from the tank to the garden.
tube.zh: 一根细管子把水从水箱引到花园里。

tuck.example: She tucked the letter into her pocket and left the room.
tuck.zh: 她把信塞进口袋，然后离开了房间。

Tuesday.example: We will meet again on Tuesday to discuss the new plan.
Tuesday.zh: 我们星期二再见，讨论一下新计划。

tug.example: He had to tug hard to open the heavy wooden door.
tug.zh: 他不得不使劲拉才打开了那扇厚重的木门。

tuition.example: The cost of tuition at that college rises every year.
tuition.zh: 那所大学的学费每年都在上涨。

tumble.example: The little boy tumbled off his bike but was not hurt.
tumble.zh: 小男孩从自行车上摔了下来，但没有受伤。

tumor.example: The doctor found a small tumor and sent her for more tests.
tumor.zh: 医生发现了一个小肿块，并让她做进一步检查。

tune.example: He hummed a happy tune while washing the dishes.
tune.zh: 他一边洗碗一边哼着欢快的曲子。

tunnel.example: The train went through a long tunnel under the mountain.
tunnel.zh: 火车穿过山下一段长长的隧道。

turbulent.example: The small boat struggled in the turbulent water near the shore.
turbulent.zh: 小船在岸边湍急的水中艰难前行。

turkey.example: We cooked a large turkey for the family dinner last night.
turkey.zh: 昨晚我们为家庭晚餐烤了一只大火鸡。

turmoil.example: The office was in turmoil after the sudden change of plans.
turmoil.zh: 计划突然改变后，办公室里一片混乱。

turn.example: Please turn left at the corner and walk two blocks.
turn.zh: 请在拐角处向左转，走两个街区。

turnout.example: The turnout for the concert was larger than we expected.
turnout.zh: 音乐会的到场人数比我们预想的多。

turnover.example: The shop reported a higher turnover this year than last.
turnover.zh: 这家店今年的营业额比去年高。

turtle.example: A green turtle swam slowly past the rocks near the beach.
turtle.zh: 一只绿海龟慢慢游过海滩附近的岩石。

tutor.example: My tutor helped me prepare for the difficult math exam.
tutor.zh: 我的家教帮我准备那场很难的数学考试。

twelve.example: The meeting will start at twelve and end around two.
twelve.zh: 会议将在十二点开始，大约两点结束。

twenty.example: She counted twenty small stones and put them in a row.
twenty.zh: 她数了二十块小石头，把它们排成一行。
